listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Alma Blanca Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A radiant and serene aura, pure and captivating, capable of inspiring admiration at first sight. Inspired by one of the most enigmatic and influential figures of the Renaissance, this fragrance originates from an ancient manuscript attributed to the wise Caterina de' Medici.

listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Alma Nera Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A bold and intoxicating fragrance, so enveloping it shakes the will. An essence that seduces mercilessly, leading those who wear and encounter it beyond the boundaries of control. Inspired by the most arcane secrets from the Book of Secrets of the Ars Mirabile Profumatoria by Caterina de’ Medici, this composition is born as a dangerously fascinating blend. It is an olfactory potion full of mystery, capable of confusing the senses and awakening deep desires.

listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Canto dell’Angelo Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A celestial, ethereal, and radiant composition, capable of touching the soul and stirring the senses, like the song of an angel caressing the vault of the sky. From the precious Book of Secrets of the Ars Mirabile Profumatoria, attributed to the wise Caterina de’ Medici, comes the inspiration for this fragrance filled with nostalgia, art, and spirituality.

listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Lato Oscuro Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A dark and captivating essence, charged with magnetism and power. It enchants, conquers, dominates… with subtle elegance. Inspired by the most enigmatic scented secrets kept in the Book of Secrets of the Ars Mirabile Profumatoria, this fragrance embodies the art of hidden seduction. Born from the legend of Caterina de’ Medici, it is an olfactory potion that enchants and subjugates, leaving behind an aura of mystery and irresistible authority.

listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Oblio dei Sensi Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An arcane, seductive, and transgressive fragrance, capable of bewitching the senses and clouding reason. An enchanted caress that alters mind and spirit. Inspired by the ancient secrets of Caterina de’ Medici’s Ars Mirabile Profumatoria, this fragrance was born as an olfactory spell: magnetic, bold, deeply hypnotic.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella 8 Days a Week Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Desire fuelled a passionate flame in Astrophil’s soul, a fire that the space and time of this world were not enough to contain. In every instant, every suggestion carried him to the cosmos alongside Stella. He closed his eyelids, taking a deep breath and allowed his senses to ascend to her, following the trails of comets beyond the galaxies. A sparkling harmony of citrus and floral notes mix with absolute pearls of orange blossom and jasmine, invigorated by a final blend of patchouli, with woody and musky notes.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella 8 Days a Week Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Desire fuelled a passionate flame in Astrophil’s soul, a fire that the space and time of this world were not enough to contain. listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Amberlievable Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From Stella’s fertile luminosity comes a lightning bolt which, crossing the atmospheres, plunges into a lake into which Astrophil has just dived. He picked up the astral fragment that preserved her glow and the transparency of the waters in which he admired her reflection. He breathed the honey coloured gem, and the gem breathed with him: it was Stella’s heart, given to him as a sign of eternal love.. An effervescent accord of citrus notes envelops an oriental heart of myrrh and elemi, nuanced by notes of ylang ylang flowers. The composition finale is a symphony of woods, enriched by notes of vanilla, cedar wood, patchouli and guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Chromodoro Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Chromodoro is inspired by the Space Age design era, reflecting the boldness and innovation of the 1960s. This perfume celebrates the creativity of advertisers and designers from the American West Coast during a time when interior design was characterized by clean lines and futuristic shapes.  The perfume captures the essence of a time when the world looked eagerly towards the future with optimism and excitement.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella In Extremis Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: In the midst of darkness that dances with light, a fragrance captures the essence of a genius who challenged his Time, turning contrasts and passions into eternal masterpieces. IN EXTREMIS is dedicated to Caravaggio, observer of humanity, imperfect Master. A tribute to his art, a journey that delves into the depths of expression. For those who live passionately, embracing contrast as a source of inspiration the love for Caravaggio pays homage to his revolutionary art, his restless spirit, and his ability to transform the canvas into a mirror of the soul. A genius that transcends time, an artist who has left an indelible mark on the hearts of those, like us, who find continual inspiration in his work.This perfume is an invitation to travel beyond the boundaries of the known, to explore the depths of the human spirit, to live every moment with fierce passion.Perfumer: Meo Fusciuni

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Into the Oud Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Astrophil listened to the drops falling in the woods, cancelling out the distance with the heavens hidden between the branches. Stella’s voice, star of his desire, whispered to him, delicate words through the rain, and, inspired by that enchantment, he etched them onto the wet barks to evoke her presence.A spicy and citrusy cocktail envelops a sweet and silky heart of toffee and davana, embellished with sumptuous notes of oud, amber and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Into the Oud Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Astrophil listened to the drops falling in the woods, cancelling out the distance with the heavens hidden between the branches. Stella’s voice, star of his desire, whispered to him, delicate words through the rain, and, inspired by that enchantment, he etched them onto the wet barks to evoke her presence.A spicy and citrusy cocktail envelops a sweet and silky heart of toffee and davana, embellished with sumptuous notes of oud, amber and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Love is lost Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Like a petal that magically returns to its corolla after settling on the ground, Stella has embedded herself in the rose of the skies, seeking to retain the sensation of Astrophil’s proximity. She recognised that the Universe has the scent of attraction and thought that if every flower fades only then to blossom again, all love is lost only to be regained.. Precious citrus notes rest on a floral bouquet of Bulgarian rose, Egyptian geranium and jasmine. A fragrance enriched with a base bursting with vanilla and spices.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Madame M Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: When the city turns chilly, her maison derrière comes ablaze with clandestine lights. When vices and virtues merge into a single homage to life, the mask falls and all humanity feels the dominance of the most divine part of its nature. That is, it feels that all moral effects are in a state of undisturbed serenity.A perfume that goes against social conventions, a timeless erotic symbiosis. Madame m is a veil of mystery, a sensual and carnal scent.“Tout voir, tout entendre et ne rien dire”Guatemalan cardamom oil expresses its charm while cocoa absolute, a hint of pear and carrot oil give the fragrance just the right amount of sweetness. Hedione, virginia cedar oil and patchouli oil inflame desire. Cistus labdanum projects into a world where everything is permitted and every desire is legitimate.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Mellow Yellow Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Looking to the stars, aiming for their twinkle, men usually consider their solitude and eternal distance. Not so in the fiery heart of Stella, in which explosions of imaginative dances at the thought of Astrophil followed one another in the placid serenity of reflecting her own glow in the enchanted mirror of the Milky Way.. Green notes and hints of orange and lemon are the greeting, enhancing a rich and precious heart of absolute orange blossom, iris, carrot seeds and cloves, elements that give vivacity to a superfine and elegant fragrance that floats on a woody and musky base of vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Mellow Yellow Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Looking to the stars, aiming for their twinkle, men usually consider their solitude and eternal distance. Not so in the fiery heart of Stella, in which explosions of imaginative dances at the thought of Astrophil followed one another in the placid serenity of reflecting her own glow in the enchanted mirror of the Milky Way.. Green notes and hints of orange and lemon are the greeting, enhancing a rich and precious heart of absolute orange blossom, iris, carrot seeds and cloves, elements that give vivacity to a superfine and elegant fragrance that floats on a woody and musky base of vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Nabati Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Also known as the people’s poetry and bedouin poetry, nabati has a long heritage. Nabati is the vernacular arabic poetry that stems from the arabic dialects of the arabian peninsula.In the darkness, among the undulating dunes, illuminated by the carpet of stars that adorned the sky with a milky light, a fire crackled, cutting the silence of the desert. The flame danced sinuously, inviting the celestial bodies to descend and join in its shimmering dance. The fallen comet thus called to the other stars that were dazzlingly spinning in a sublime luminous cascade, lighting up the night.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Paris Chéri Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Mon beau paris c’est toujours, toi que j’aime, paris chériton chic naturel est resté le même. Te revoir qu’elle joie extrêmedans mon coeur vient de naître un grand bonheur paris chéripour toujours c’est toi mon amour – joséphine baker.. The last stars were shining on the whiteness of the sacré-coeur, while apuff pastry half-moon gen-tly rested behind the hill of montmartre and the magic of dawn peeked through the dreamy rooftops of paris. The viennoiseries were already spreading their dainty and delicious aroma along the sleeping boulevards and encircling the whole city in a lively and fragrant morning embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Shanghai 1930 Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Shanghai the mysterious, the romantic, the inscrutable; And, above all else, shanghai the improbable. In the early 30’s shanghai was a city like no other. A melting pot of cultures, ethnicities, individuals, politics. British spies, soviet agents, rich tycoons, journalists, revolutionaries and intellectuals. Shanghai in the 30’s was an extraordinary city at an unusual time.A powerful and distinctive floral oriental fragrance with deep, heady and suave notes. The top note is characterized by a fresh green earl grey tea accord which marries perfectly with the narcotic elegant tuberose having itself a sweet oriental dry down. The background is mystical and somehow fine powdery with typical oriental ingredients, supported by an elegant musky accord which gives the scent a long lasting character and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Astrophil & Stella Sweet Pulp Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: In a whirlwind of history and myth, a scent dances between the ancient secrets of Minoan civilization and the delights of Mediterranean fruits. Inspired by the vestiges of a distant time, its aroma winds like a golden thread through an artist's fingers, painting a timeless fresco.In the air, the essence of great eras, intricate labyrinths and wind-whispered mysteries can be sensed. Fruity notes rise like the columns of a forgotten temple, while the sweet aroma of orange rises like an offering to the gods. A sweet chant resonates in the atmosphere, evoking the love and fertility of ancient clay.Woven silk threads compose a symphony that resonates in the soul. Explore the lush gardens of the palace of Knossos, where every step awakens the spirit. The sweetness of ripe figs melds with the intensity of roses, while ambergris and sandalwood reveal age-old secrets.Sweet pulp is an invitation to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a distant past, to discover the beauty hidden among legends and to embrace a bright future.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Bendito Beso Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Formentera, the aroma of the sea, the green of the Savina forests and the wild bushes. The blinding sun, reflecting on the water, the traces on the sand left as the water disappears and the heat of the sun on the skin. Tanned, a warm body comes out of the water, a refreshing kiss, which becomes sweeter when the bergamot vanishes to reveal its jasmine heart. And it is placed in the shade under the wooden notes of the cedar and the elegance of the musk.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso Canalla Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A lively departure thanks to the notes of orange and lavender, prompts barefoot walks in the cool sand under the deck of Beso Beach. A meeting of sun and notes gourmands (evokes edible smells) like the toasted sugar spread on the tables, the sandalwood floods the space and the music gives harmony in a moment that you do not want to end.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso De Fuego Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: As night falls, immerse yourself in the passion and mystery of the beso de fuego. Guatemalan cardamom, Madagascar black pepper, Indian jasmine, and cedarwood intertwine in a passionate blend that illuminates the night. Like drawing closer to the flames of the bonfire, the magical nights of the islands, this captivating fragrance invites you to experience the intensity of the night.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso De Sal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the pink of the salt pans, this fragrance blends the vitality of lemon, tangerine, sage, shiso leaves, and mineral accords. Like the beginning of a day full of promises, this refreshing fragrance transports you to the magical moment when the sun gives the salt pans a pink glow.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso De Sol Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the orange light of the setting sun over the magical island of Es Vedrá, this fragrance evokes the warmth and serenity of that moment. The notes of apricot and bergamot offer a radiant sweetness, while osmanthus and helvetolide add depth and mystery. An olfactory experience that captures the magic of the sunset in every drop.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso Dorado Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sensual, like a second skin.Beso Dorado is inspired by the 10 years of magic and splendor of Beso Beach. It is an addictive fragrance with intense and fresh aromas. It captures the authentic Mediterranean spirit of summer evenings with sunsets and endless nights. Pink pepper and juniper give a lively and spicy top note, cinnamon and patchouli make Beso Dorado a warm and seductive fragrance, with the vibrant and refreshing notes of vetiver. A woody personality with a touch of mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso Feliz Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The hippy movement found in Ibiza in the 1960s a place of tranquillity, an open and hospitable people. Ibiza's nature, original architecture, landscapes and beaches were an invitation to stay. Thus, the movement found in Ibiza one of its places of pilgrimage. Beso feliz conveys this peace and harmony, as well as the symbols of freedom, peace and love. A kiss with a smoky marijuana flavour, which provokes a feeling of well-being and calm. The spirit is renewed with its woody, balsamic warmth and suddenly you realise that the real pleasures of life are here with our people. Here you would stay forever.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso Negro Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An elegant sunset, intense and fascinating.An invitation to a kiss; notes of violet and cardamom invite the night to move forward, to the provocation of patchouli and to the wilder side of leather and sandalwood.A unique personality, a carnal kiss in which the darkness and the moon are the only witnesses.

listings.rawTitle: Beso Beach Beso Pasion Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A passionate kiss coloured with mystery, aphrodisiacal yet sweet like the fruit of the fig trees on the island. The elegance of cedarwood and the intensity of patchouli blend together to make this kiss even more carnal and passionate.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Ambreide Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Pure amber: nothing more and nothing less. Finally Ambreide was created, the real grey amber that seems made especially for you, the one that your nose has wanted to hear for years and finally found it. Ambreide, your perfume is persuasive, strong and stormy like the waves of the sea that have carried it for a long time, wild like the beach on which they found the raw material in its raw state and tenacious to stay on your skin for days.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Ambreide Eau de Parfum 1.8 ml
listings.description: Pure amber: nothing more and nothing less. Ambreide, your perfume is persuasive, strong and stormy like the waves of the sea that have carried it for a long time, wild like the beach on which they found the raw material in its raw state and tenacious to stay on your skin for days.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Kalila Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Kalila is the highest expression of incense in its various facets: essence from the faraway desert of Yemen and incense resin in its infinitely persistent base notes.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Kalila Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Kalila is the highest expression of incense in its various facets: essence from the faraway desert of Yemen and incense resin in its infinitely persistent base notes.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Kalila Eau de Parfum 1.8 ml

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide L’Eau Lita Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A sweet provocation that teases the senses.. Powerful seduction that immortalizes pleasure.The thirst for a kiss, a veil of magic, a trail of candy sugar that makes everything more electrifying.. Is the irrepressible desire to fall into the pleasure of temptation.L’Eau Lita, light of my life, exquisite delight.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide L’Eau Lita Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A sweet provocation that teases the senses.. Powerful seduction that immortalizes pleasure.The thirst for a kiss, a veil of magic, a trail of candy sugar that makes everything more electrifying.. Is the irrepressible desire to fall into the pleasure of temptation.L’Eau Lita, light of my life, exquisite delight.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Maè Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: As glamorous as the French Riviera, Maè is the scent of a summer on the most chic Riviera on the planet.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Maè Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Maè Eau de Parfum 1.8 ml

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Rose Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Rose is an explosive bomb: an exceptional mix of Grasse Rose, amber and vanilla. Never has a rose been so modern and bewitching.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Rose Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Rose is an explosive bomb: an exceptional mix of Grasse Rose, amber and vanilla. Never has a rose been so modern and bewitching.

listings.description: Le Supreme Patchouly by Blancheide is truly an exceptional, unique and irreplaceable fragrance.  Very successful in the 1970s, the amber-coloured patchouly of Indonesia, with its deep perfume, has enchanted those who choose to wear it for many years.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Supreme Patchouly Eau de Parfum 1.8 ml

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Taitù Tiarè Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Intoxicating and voluptuous, with exotic and enfolding scents.The fragrance of the precious tiarè releases a sensual note and originality. The powerful and hypnotics ylang-ylang, vanilla of Madagascar and tuberose enrich the heart notes and lead to a base of amber, resinoid benzoin and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Taitù Tiarè Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Intoxicating and voluptuous, with exotic and enfolding scents.The fragrance of the precious tiarè releases a sensual note and originality. The powerful and hypnotics ylang-ylang, vanilla of Madagascar and tuberose enrich the heart notes and lead to a base of amber, resinoid benzoin and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Vanille Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Vanille is the right vanilla for those looking for a new vanilla in life. Vanille brings with it the exotic scents of Madagascar, where the best vanilla in the world is extracted. The hypnotic note of ylang-ylang from the Comoros Islands is mixed with the sweetness of heliotrope and cocoa.

listings.rawTitle: Blancheide Vanille Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Vanille is the right vanilla for those looking for a new vanilla in life. Vanille brings with it the exotic scents of Madagascar, where the best vanilla in the world is extracted. The hypnotic note of ylang-ylang from the Comoros Islands is mixed with the sweetness of heliotrope and cocoa.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Almas Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Almas is Arabic for 'diamond', a symbol of the endurance and intensity of this bold pure perfume. Thus, a diamond is featured in the centre of this uniquely designed shield. A scent full of rich and creamy opulence that is sure to leave everyone longing for more. Almas is guaranteed to ignite the warrior within, inspiring total self-assurance.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Angelic Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Herbaceous hedonism is the essential vibe of Angelic by Boadicea the Victorious; Eden and the apple tree surrounded by musky sage  and cardamom then a serpentine damask rose appears, written across a dry papyrus note and as Angelic becomes more ethereal, a base of vetiver, ambered woods, patchouli and musk rises beautifully, holding the rosy garden ambiance in nebulous stasis.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Aqua Sapphire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Aqua Sapphire is inspired by the tempestuous and enticing nature of the sea, it is a tantalizing scent with an optimistic personality. Oozing with aquatic tendencies and luxe floral accords, Aqua Sapphire is a pure perfume full of contemporary feel.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Ardent Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the feelings of falling in love, Ardent is both addictive and alluring. Rich with emotion and warmth, the stirring nature of this scent cannot be ignored. Creamy and comforting whilst passionate and intriguing, it is the perfume for both new beginnings and enduring love.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Azrak Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the hypnotic motion of the ocean, this perfume is relaxing and tranquil, giving the feeling of escapism and optimism.  Unwind and invigorate with captivating Azrak.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Blue Sapphire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A burst of sunshine with a nod to the exotic. This fragrance celebrates happy and carefree times with its uplifting and engaging personality.  A confident pure perfume that does not overpower, but has an underlying coolness that is utterly irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Blue Sapphire Supercharged Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Blue Sapphire Supercharged is the pumped-up companion to Blue Sapphire, a compelling oud, patchouli and amber base supporting a lush heart of raspberry, rose and jasmine. Cardamom and orange have been added and a generous whoosh of aldehydes fizz throughout this double blue, double depth, double dazzle scent.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Bodacious Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A warm and inviting scent full of Eastern promise. Cherry dominates this gourmand tour de force, but its sweetness is tempered with the inclusion of clove, pepper and a host of light woods. Bodacious is a mature and seductive delight.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Bravery Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An optimistic and beautiful fragrance sure to make you feel splendid and refined. Bursting with white florals as dazzling as the first sunbeam of spring. Bravery is simply perfection.Thrill to the zing of this bright floral scent, created for those unafraid to make an impact wherever their social whirl takes them. Vibrant and vivacious it’s a potent coalescence of jasmine, lily and rose topped by the heady charms of Bulgarian lavender and smoky saffron. Beneath lies a base of amber, moss, heliotrope and animal elementals, an intriguing counterpoint to Bravery’s unashamedly flowery highs. All peppery pizzazz and potency – a complete one-off with a commanding presence.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Complex Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A multifaceted perfume that showcases the complexities of your individual personality in a simple blend of seamless quality. A tour de force of power and seduction. Now an iconic Boadicea the Victorious scent.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Complex 2020 Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Complex 2020 is a supercharged version of the original Complex, giving perfume lovers an opportunity to wear a euphoric celebration of the original with an intensified herbal bouquet and a more profound leather heart. Incense-infused violet fills the senses as earthy oud and musks enhance the interconnecting pieces of this fascinating perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Consort Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A perfume that exudes an easy elegance with its bright, charming, and inspiring sentiment.  You can depend on Consort to invigorate the mind and be by your side with grace and stature. The perfect companion.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Dasman Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This lush scent is centred around a rich triumvirate of roses, golden saffron and amber, opening with an unexpected boozy mood and a fingerprint of menthol echoing the petrolic whiff of certain roses, while exuding a scent of beeswax polish warmed by smouldering oud, cypriol and incense fumes over musks, vetiver and lavender. A fortress of desert roses.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Defender Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Layers of imaginatively composed notes, accords and technologies by Kamila Lelakova, the first female perfumer for Boadicea the Victorious, has produced a bold perfume of tenacity and emotional impact. Defender opens with a rebellious shout of zesty ginger, grapefruit and unexpected swirls of dark liquorice and honeyed cognac mingled with a fascinating red berry compote and hints of kirsch. Orange blossom announces the arrival of Defender’s all-important heart of Night Blooming Jasmine and the background for the jasmine is an alluring blend of mournful myrrh, its earthy smoke and balsamic mood mixed with a note of hay absolute used by Defender perfumer Kamila Lelakova to hint at Boadicea’s childhood, farming wheat and barley with her family. The other main note is a verdigris leather accord, a seductive homage to the tactile, atmospheric nature of natural skins and hides.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Dragon Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The strength and fluidity of the dragon oozes from the first spray of this refined scent. The bright top notes are indicative of the height and breath of this magnificent beast, while the floral heart denotes its beauty and potential to seduce.Boadicea the Victorious presents the hotly anticipated celebration of Chinese New Year - Dragon. Rightly named after the symbol of the zodiac 2024 represents, Dragon illustrates the perfect blend of power and sublime sophistication. Among the symbols of the Chinese Zodiac, the dragon is the sole imaginary creature; its importance is therefore innate. Boadicea the Victorious’ representation of this inspiring creature reflects this sentiment; leaving the wearer with an unquestionable elevated sense of self. The temperament of Dragon is feisty and passionate. This pure perfume has a whimsical flavour, with tenacious staying power. It is certainly not to be underestimated & leaves nothing to chance.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Elaborate Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A huge perfume, Elaborate has a pungently supreme keynote of labdanum, creating a shimmering leather that plunges into a maelstrom of animalic musks and oud, spiked terpenic pine needles, intensifying on skin, dramatically invading the senses with the added rippling sensuality of Oud, tempered by the ghostly saline wash of ambergris tincture.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Empire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A scent of stature and authority with an underlying tone of true jubilation. The rich concoction of ingredients nod to exotic far off lands whilst balancing a sense of regal tradition. Empire is altogether buoyant and full of character with a dusting of gravitas in its dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Energizer Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fragrance of positivity and reflection. Its beginning is uplifting with energetic and dancing citrus tones that take you away from the everyday, yet it's true beauty lies in its calm and muted musky dry down that will leave your soul hankering for more.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Envious Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An uplifting, white floral, eau de parfum of beauty and charm, that ensures your scent will make everyone you meet envious! An intriguing and brooding fragrance with notes of mandarin, jasmine, and vanilla, enhances your mood so that you feel highly coveted as it exudes the scent of success and confidence.Sparkling notes of Bergamot and Mandarin complement soft sensual roses and beguiling Jasmin Sambac to set the senses tingling, while a brooding base of Blond Woods, Cashmere Musk, Vetiver and Amber creates a backdrop of earthly delights. High-living, hedonistic, vibrant and alive - feel the anticipation building as Envious works its precious magic to evoke the ultimate desire.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Glorious Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by glorious summer days and blossoming British orchards, this carefree fragrance is loaded with playful mischief and will allow you to reminisce of a forgotten childhood. With an utterly enchanting blend of fruity florals and succulent delight, the luxury is palpable.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Green Sapphire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A bewitching and intriguing perfume, inspired by a British woodland in exceedingly early spring. Green Sapphire brings a sense of anticipation for things to come. It’s a gripping, hazy scent that will leave you wanting more. It feels positive and hopeful, but with that classic Boadicean edge.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Hanuman Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Hanuman celebrates the Chinese Year of the Monkey, representing loyalty, heroism and mischief, with an impish mix of tangy citrus, butter-smooth blooms over woods and ambered musks while vetiver suggests the greenness of forest canopies. It is a blast to wear, sun-dappled flowers glowing with lemon and orange, illuminating a tagete-tinged bouquet at the heart, warmed by warm amber and musks.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Harmonious Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This dynamic, romantic floral is flawless; ambrette seed brings powdered musk, pollen, saffron, cinnamon and cardamom doused in rum and cognac, balanced by a squeeze of bergamot as the blend expands with orris and dewy rose de mai, and a subtle mix of soft woods over coriander seed, suede, spiced leather, vanillic amber, vetiver and milky sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Hasu Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the rabbit of Chinese Zodiac, eternal symbol of Rebirth, fertility and abundance, Hasu smells pagan, top notes of conifer-tinted cypress, soapy sage and lavender spritzed with  juicy citrus. Saffron and violet leaf announce a heart of rose and osmanthus layered with nutmeg, iris and hay, Hasu is sacred and moon-lit, bewitching on skin.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Heroine Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Feel like a modern day heroine with this all conquering, courageous fragrance from Boadicea the Victorious. Heliotrope, mimosa and bold incursions of orris and prized tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Imperial Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Conjuring up the majestic reassuring rulers of the past and present, Imperial is both nostalgic and captivating. It has a calm and reassuring sentiment, bringing with it a sense of security and peaceful, all pervading power.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Jubilee Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A brilliant perfume created for Queen Elizabeth II to celebrate her Jubilee year. This majestic and celebratory scent was gifted to our Monarch to pay homage to her great leadership and guidance. Jubilee promises to  gladden the heart.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Knight of Love Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This romantic woody perfume is inspired by Arthurian legends, forged like a shimmering sword in the top notes: zesty bergamot, sparkling pink pepper, cardamom and juniper with its distinctive gin odour and hints of pine resin; heralding a heart of rose, creamy magnolia and violet, with romantic staging of woods, amber, leather, vanilla, moss with lingering traces of tobacco in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Lavish Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Lavish is technically a citrus fragrance, but one with layers of illuminating sillage, opening with a dazzling overdose of lemon and bergamot before cool roses and orange flowers bloom over creamy nutmeg and a stylish base of smoky guaiac wood, amber, green and rooty with vetiver and moss wrapped in zing and brightness.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Monarch Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A perfume inspired by a powerful monarch who exudes opulence, wealth and sophistication. Warm and refined with a hint of sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Nemer Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Creamy, luxurious and sensual – the provocative power of Nemer is something to behold. It's a perfume full of pure elegance that promises to satisfy.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Opal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Opal is iridescent and irresistible with moody rose and violet lipstick dreams enhanced by bay and rich black coffee. A sensual mood is reflected deep in the perfume, a haze of herbal fire diffused through cinnamon, saffron and black pepper and dusted with orris. Cedar and Cashmeran layer with oakmoss, tonka and leather. Opal is olfactive silk on radiant skin, changing perfumed hues as luxurious hours drift by.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Oud Sapphire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This stately, lingering perfume is an homage to oud, one of the most alluring and costly materials in perfumery. Boadicea the Victorious is passionate about oud or agarwood. This divine scent wraps the pungent oud in powdery ambrette, saffron and black pepper, exalted by osmanthus over rich earthy resins, woods and iris. The notes glitter with seductive confidence making it irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Rebellious Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This shapeshifting perfume reinforces the brand legend of Iceni Queen Boadicea, in an edgy mix of sweet spices, citrus, leathered roses and powdered green violet, sublimely tempered to a smooth finish with suede, leather and patchouli. A labyrinth of effects, that develops from whisper to roar and back again, immense fragrant power embedded in the details and individuality of scented armour.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Tobacco Sapphire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Flamboyant Tobacco Sapphire is a evocation of vintage fumoirs, tempered by spiced fumes and ambrosial flowers, memories lacquered with benzoin, cedar, sandal and guaiac woods, cistus, patchouli, musks, oud and honeyed tobacco, this heady mix ennobled with magnolia, heliotrope, rose and sparkling Hedione, then a finale of anisic cumin and coriander infused with mandarin, incense and saffron opening like a pungent parasol.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Valiant Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A super bright, super luxe, super soft and super indulgent pure parfum. The bright beginning paves the way for a smooth and sumptuous dry down that will leave you in glorious rapture.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Vetiver Imperial Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An elegant explosion of gentle woods with a touch of spice and a dash of citrus. This fragrance is fresh, refined, and enlivening.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Coffee White Flowers Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The eccentric Coffee White Flowers is the scent of the impenetrable power of combined aromas. The sensual notes of Coffee, golden Rum and Vanilla are broken with the delicacy of White flowers, creating an addictive combination that became the quintessence of this unique composition. The contrasting combination of intense and subtle aromas symbolizes leaving your own comfort zone.Uncertainty turns into blissful peace, and an intimate conversation into a soul connection.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Coffee White Flowers Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: The eccentric Coffee White Flowers is the scent of the impenetrable power of combined aromas. The sensual notes of Coffee, golden Rum and Vanilla are broken with the delicacy of White flowers, creating an addictive combination that became the quintessence of this unique composition. The contrasting combination of intense and subtle aromas symbolizes leaving your own comfort zone.Uncertainty turns into blissful peace, and an intimate conversation into a soul connection.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Dark Vinyl Musk Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dark Vinyl Musk is the quintessence of life, the jazzy scent of Black vinyl and the scent of enveloping Musk combine to create a metaphor for beautiful and difficult moments, ups and downs that build us.The fragrance contains mesmerizing incense and enveloping balsamic notes that protect us and take us to special and exciting moments. Intense Leather notes show the dark side of the world, and the magnetizing scent of the Rose shows its bright side. This composition symbolizes the experience and hope that the change is inscribed in our life, and that in the end, you are always reborn as a new you. A new day comes and a new year, the beginning of something unknown and exciting, like the swirling hypnosis of life.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Eternal lily - Amber Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Perfume encapsulates the metaphysical will to flourish, the desire to explore the meaning of existence, grasp life along with its passing. The dignified and ethereal lily intertwined with the sicilian mandarin symbolizing happiness and prosperity and the juicy richness of the granny smith apple, vibrating hypnotize the energy of the future. The fertile lily also finds its way to the heart of the composition, that is our inner world, creating a bouquet in its center with an intoxicating rose and sweet jasmine. This chapter of the experience is enclosed in a completely shaped warm amber, oriental patchouli and the enveloping scent of exotic madagascar vanilla that symbolizes our abundance. The composition allows you to fully immerse yourself in life, mindfully accept changes and be ready for the future.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Eucalyptus Patchouli Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The characteristic, clear Eucalyptus enclosed in the Eucaliptus Patchouli gives a feeling of refreshment and energy, and the notes of Pink pepper, accentuated by the aroma of Patchouli intertwined with Cardamom, emphasize its intensity even more.A mystical fragrance, saturated with strong emotions, introduces a unique mood. The intriguing composition almost stops time, enables spiritual union and offers a moment to appreciate the kindness of another human being.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Geranium Balsamic Note Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Beautiful memories related to grandmas became an inspiration for the creator of the BOHOBOCO perfume line. Thanks to them, came to life a mysterious and surprising perfume composition hidden in the Geranium Balsamic Note. One can discover delicate balsamic notes surrounded by essential oils hidden in the rough scent of geraniums. The combination of these contrasting aromas allowed for the creation of an unusual perfume, combining enigmatic spirituality with intriguing self-confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Geranium Balsamic Note Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Beautiful memories related to grandmas became an inspiration for the creator of the BOHOBOCO perfume line. listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Jasmine White Leather Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Perfume is a journey to a new place on earth, full of challenges and opportunities. The strength of jasmine’s will to flourish despite the harshest circumstances. The protective life energy is encapsulated in a deep note of white leather, and the grounding space of a strong, dignified cedar provides a place to consolidate values and regrow roots. The composition opens with a lemon full of positive vibrations, italian bergamot and a clove that repels bad energy. The depth is revealed by a magical bouquet of independent jasmine and a velvet rose, followed by lavender symbolizing the expectation of unconditional love and violet that embodies enlightenment and openness to new sensations, like a bouquet of white flowers. A powdery intoxicating tonka, bathed in warm ambergris, combined with vanilla, patchouli and enveloping musk tops the composition that strengthens your self-esteem, gives courage and pushes you to act so that you embark on a great adventure of your life.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Magic Mushrooms Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The fragrance embodies transformation, spiritual magic, and dimensionality, brimming with unconventional, energetically extraordinary ingredients. The composition, fused with notes of calming cypress, vivacious grapefruit, and healing cardamom – teems with life, opening gates of perception. The heart of the composition beats in an eccentric rhythm of magical mushrooms and blackcurrant, enshrouded in herbs and the secretive energy of davana, ylang-ylang, and consciousness-elevating cannabis.Each essence is a key allowing proximity to one’s inner self, where, through the incredible power of thyme, lavender, clove, and immortelle, magic intertwines with the everyday. It is a path leading to the soul, where beneath, in the shadow of liqueur notes, patchouli, vetiver, and moss, lies the promise of deeper dimensions of existence.This magical composition unveils the uncharted landscape of the soul, where magic is not just a promise, but a space where each "now" becomes an eternity.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Olibanum Gardenia Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Olibanum Gardenia is a soothing and addictive perfume, with a characteristic note of attractive Incense, perfectly harmonizing with the delicacy of bitter Orange flowers and expressive Gardenia.The enigmatic composition delights with mystical and spiritual energy that protects, ennobles, and accompanies moments when dreams come true. Energizing perfume purifies the aura and puts you in a magical mood filled with pride and emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Olibanum Gardenia Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Olibanum Gardenia is a soothing and addictive perfume, with a characteristic note of attractive Incense, perfectly harmonizing with the delicacy of bitter Orange flowers and expressive Gardenia.The enigmatic composition delights with mystical and spiritual energy that protects, ennobles, and accompanies moments when dreams come true. listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Oriental Saffron Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Oriental Saffron perfume opens with an explosion of intense spices. Refined saffron, accompanied by intense cardamom, cumin, turmeric, coriander and warming ginger, creates an aromatic kaleidoscope, opening the gates to a world full of magic and mystery, while vibrant, spicy seeds of clove and distinct anise add depth. The heart of the composition resounds with notes of Thai oud, labdanum, ylang-ylang and tamboti wood, creating an intensive blend of dazzling Middle East bazaar. Each breath leads us deeper into the maze of senses of this unique composition where we discover warm vanilla, mysterious musk and earthy tones of patchouli.  Sweet, opulent notes encapsulate the whole performance into a sensual essence, transporting us to a world of luxury and mysticism.  Immerse yourself in this majestic concoction, opening a portal to a distant olfactory world vibrating with magic, full of undiscovered mysteries and sensual riches.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Polish Potatoes Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Polish Potatoes perfume is a journey into the depths of childhood experiences. Deep accords of beetroot, golden wheat, and vibrant pine, enriched with notes of leather and grass, evoke the atmosphere of a bustling market. At the heart of the composition, notes of noble potato, rose, heliotrope, and carnation pulse, capturing the beauty of market rituals. The Polish potatoes lends this composition a rich character that combines earthiness with a pronounced sweetness and pays homage to the earth, which is the beginning of everything. Deep down, patchouli, fertile birch and notes of damp earth resonate, enveloping us with their warmth and reminding us of our inseparable connection with nature. Earthy accords intertwine with balsamic oud, sensual amber, sweet vanilla, golden honey, warm hay, labdanum, and benzoin, creating an unmistakable, sensual essence. The composition, encapsulated in a crystal bottle, becomes a seal that encloses the memories of an empty market in the morning, which was full of life just a moment ago and carries the soul of those moments within it. The unique accords of potato, intense wood and sweet earthy notes will stay with you forever.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Red Wine Brown Sugar Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Red Wine Brown Sugar secrets notes of dry Red wine, enriched with the aromas of Wood and Brown sugar. It is an unconventional composition that awakens the senses. The enveloping sweetness gives courage, introduces you to a world full of inspiration and self-awareness. Spicy notes of Red Wine open the door of extravagance and allow you to overcome all adversities. This addictive perfume will let you feel spiritual bliss from both sweet success, and the bitter path that leads to it.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Sandalwood Neroli Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sandalwood Neroli perfume is an invitation to a world full of sensual experiences. Its heart is Sandalwood, the strength of which stimulates intense Jasmine notes. This subtlety, however, is only a game of appearances. The nature and intensity of the composition are hidden in the tempting accents of Cedar Wood and bitter Orange.The magnetic scent perfectly emphasizes the intimate moments in which the physical attraction and spiritual rapture unconsciously fight the inner struggle and create our existence.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Sea Salt Caramel Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The contrasting notes of Sea Salt Caramel are like a harmonious and calm, yet penetrating and decisive gust of refreshing breeze, broken with a few drops of thick caramel. Sea minerals and Pink pepper, combined with a coquettish sweetness, evoke carefree moments and magically transport you to a world where there are no limits.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Sea Salt Caramel Parfum 2 ml

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Vanilla Black Pepper Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The metaphysical experience inspired Michał Gilbert Lach, the creative director of BOHOBOCO to design a unique line of perfume.Vanille Black Pepper is an invisible streak that which brings the magical layers of emotion, fascination and devotion together. This composition reflects a journey within oneself, in order to find one's true self and the path to a life of passion. In a minimalist bottle of perfume, he secreted dreams of creative passion, devotion and inner excitement of the moment. The sweet and spicy scent is very seductive and lingers on in one’s memory for a long time.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Wet Cherry Liquor Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Wet Cherry-Liquor perfume is an over-sensual, almost erotic journey into the depths of temptations and memories. It is the search for elation that brings inner rebirth. They combine the intoxicating liquor, which introduces us to adulthood of passionate sensations and the tempting cherry syrup symbolizing the beginnings of innocent delight. These feelings are kindled by caramel and a subtle hint of strawberry with a deep aroma of sandalwood and aromatic vanilla. The longing mixes with fulfillment, and the fruity power is complemented by expressive, spicy accords of wood vetiver and the intense, spicy aroma of tonka beans. The composition matures and provokes, and at the same time sensually envelops our warm, excited body.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Wild Carrot Oud Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Wild Carrot-Oud perfume is the quintessence of multidimensional austerity enclosed in a crystal bottle filled with a wild and overwhelming sense of freedom and unity with the elements representing the path to the desired destination. Organic, semi-sweet and earthy notes of carrot symbolizing wildness intriguingly contrast with the stunning citrus-tart aura of fresh, cinnamon spiced bergamot. The heart of the fragrance is based on a strong oriental oud with a deep wood finish that reflects an earthy union with nature. The whole is completed with animal notes as well as a deep tobacco aroma, balsamic styrax and a characteristic scent of sun-warmed skin that does not yield to olfactory definitions.

listings.rawTitle: Bohoboco Yellow Rose Incense Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Yellow Rose Incense is an addictive combination of contrasting and surprising notes.The sharp, intense aromas of cloves are reminiscent of the thorns of the proud Rose. After a while, we find enveloping, courageous, and protective fragrances, such as Incense, Musk and Amber. The expressiveness, depth and uniqueness of Yellow Rose incense are emphasized by the strong scent of rose and oud from the agar tree that is grown in the desert, and, like your journey, is not easy to make.In a crystal bottle of perfume, the creator hid notes inspired by mystical nirvana, which is the essence of any creative work.

At the end, the green and boisé base notes of Vetiver from Haiti and Cedarwood from China slide gently into the exotic enchantment of Sandalwood from the Antilles.

listings.rawTitle: Bois 1920 Dolce di Giorno Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Seductive, mysterious and unmistakable, this jus debuts with an extremely fresh and modern head, a meeting of explosive and juicy citrus notes of Grapefruit and Bergamot interspersed with sensual and intriguing spicy notes of Cinnamon and Pepper. The essence blends with the innovative heart in which Thyme, Cardamom, Nargamutta and Prunus are intertwined, seemingly distant in scent but creating a memorable alchemy. The base is the element that seals and enhances the fragrance, a chiaroscuro of extraordinary woods, dense and deep Patchouly, Cashmere and Guaiacum, luminous and elegant Vetiver, Sandalwood and Cedar, linked by an embrace of soft Vanilla and virile Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Bois 1920 Elite II Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An elegant olfactory pyramid, finely soft in all its evolution. The delicacy of Rose drifts to notes of White Flowers, Amber and Precious Woods. A refined lightness which seizes the mind revealing its inebriating charm.

listings.rawTitle: Bois 1920 Elite III Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A mystical, irresistible, mysterious fragrance. A complex olfactory pyramid, a timeless journey, cradle of past memories…The sensual essence of Rose joins the precious notes of Jasmine and Ylang – Ylang, while fragrant accords of Patchouly introduce Incense, creating a lofty dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Bois 1920 Elite IV Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A warming and intense fragrance, a glimmer of passion full of imagination and sensorial facets. The entire evolution, characterized by the amber dry down, conceals a mysterious, exciting and creamy heart thanks to the enlightened union of Honey, Iris and Tobacco notes.

listings.rawTitle: Bois 1920 Oro 1920 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A decisive and deep fragrance, at times dark and for this reason magnetic. An olfactory fantasy that opens in a weave of elegant nuances of Ginger and Incense, touched by unprecedented caresses of Aromatic Fir and punctuated by unusual fruity sparks of Raspberry. Mysterious and sensual notes of Guaiac Wood are released in the heart, which is completed by the sumptuous floral accord given by the refined and precious Iris and May Rose, nestled between the soft and sinuous Osmanthus and Opoponax. The base is dark and intense, a melange of Tobacco, dense resins (Benzoin, Beeswax) and touches of Vanilla that enhance the full strength of Leather, a symbol of class and durability.

listings.description: A sophisticated bouquet created to express timeless elegance and femininity. The fine Bergamot from Calabria and Chinese Mandarin melt with the liveliness of Blackcurrant and the freshness of Litchi fruit. listings.description: Green orange, hyacinth, ivy.A horseback ride through the Mongolian steppe. The trail of the gallop stirs the ground, stirs up the scent of flowers, and stirs the earth. listings.description: Tuberose, saffron, suede leather.A stroll through Grasse, a city of a thousand scents, a city of leather craftsmanship and flowers. listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 201 Gold September Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Apple, Thrush, Quince - A tangy apple.Like an apple sorbet. The lively, crisp notes of fruit play with the sparkling facets of bergamot. Green apple and blackcurrant leaf open the fragrance with a fresh, vegetal dimension. One could imagine an orchard! The heart is a magnificent bouquet of magnolia and lily-of-the-valley flowers. The woody intensity of cedar and vetiver, combined with musks, reinforces the staying power of this airy fragrance.“What if a fragrance could encapsulate the soft light of September? The play of shadows and the colors of the season are captured by this fragrance of complicity.” - Ludovic BonnetonParfumer: Philippe Romano

listings.description: Cumin, Almond blossom, Cedar- Spicy Hot.Weekend in Marrakech. A room in the shade of the Riyadh courtyard. The sound of water, the scent of spices. Skin, gaze, touch, sensual night. Fresh touches of ginger in an incandescence of cumin. An electric head between the spicy facet of ginger and the overdose of warm and sweet cumin. In the heart, almond reassures, envelops, and soothes carnal tension. And cedar as the fragrance's lifeblood.“I imagined a contrast rarely seen in perfumery. Boldness and warmth meet modesty. The fragrance is as tempting as it is shy.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumeur: Anne Flipo

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 401 Prune Velours Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Cedar, Plum, Vanilla- A fruity vanilla.A fragrant liqueur with fruity and vanilla accents. A fresh and tangy trio of cypress, elemi, and bergamot begins. Then, plum reveals sweet and captivating tones of candied fruit, balanced by the elegance of cedarwood. Vanilla gives this creation a bold character, adding roundness and sensuality."I wanted to recreate the effervescent atmosphere of an evening at the Opéra Garnier in this fragrance. The syrupy plum or the polished parquet floor of the wings." - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Nathalie Koobus

Sandalwood, sweet and milky, warms this fragrance. A terribly addictive scent on the skin.“One snack and the scent came to me. Sometimes inspirations are as simple as they are fleeting.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Corinne Cachen

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 403 Myrrh Shadow Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Myrrh Shadow - Timut pepper, myrrh, benzoin.“Combining dreams and modernity was the guiding principle behind the creation of this fragrance. Inspired by the tales of my childhood.” Ludovic BonnetonThe subtle scents of vanilla, as if from another time, are reminiscent of a tale from the Arabian Nights. Fragrant emotions, nostalgia for the fragrances of yesteryear. The heart is marked, and so is memory. The depth of woods and spices meets the roundness of balsamic resins and vanilla.Perfumers: Quentin Bisch and Amélie Jacquin.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 501 Praline Royale Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Praline, Licorice, Patchouli - A regressive praline.The scent of our first childhood pleasures! Hazelnut sets the tone, then in the heart, praline and licorice form a bubble of sweetness. A powdery iris launches the transition to musky notes. A deliciously addictive fragrance, with a strong trail of patchouli!“I had the image of the crunchy praline unfolding in the heart of a powdery iris wrapped in cashmere, to awaken impatient memories of childhood.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Philippe Romano

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 502 Iris Cartagena Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Iris Cartagena - Iris, cocoa, papyrus."I wanted the Cartagena night to become a perfume. I wanted to forever remember that summer evening under the stars with my wife. A tribute to Colombia and its scents." Ludovic BonnetonA dinner for two, in the summer, under the stars. Conversations are drawing to a close. The tablecloth is stained and wrinkled. Coffee, rum, and chocolates are served. A calm, warm breeze, a delicious dance of aromas. The indulgence of cocoa and the warmth of rum are balanced by the woody character of papyrus.Perfumer: Clément Marx.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 601 Nuit Vétiver Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Vetiver, Cedar, Bergamot - A very fresh vetiver.Timeless elegance in a bottle. Sparkling and fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper. The heart notes are violet leaf, bringing a vegetal dimension. Vetiver and cedar, with their intense and rich woody facets, are then discovered in the background. A distinguished and chic olfactory signature.“Because Vetiver was one of my first perfumes, it became the inspiration for my first woody fragrance. A fragrance I wanted to be eternal.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Nathalie Koobus

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 602 Bois Narcotique Intense Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Bois Narcotique - Incense, pepper, cedar.“My intention was to make our 602 more intense to extend its longevity and make it even more addictive with an overdose of incense.”Ludovic BonnetonA walk after a torrent of rain. Rays of sunshine after the storm, glimpsed through the foliage of the undergrowth. An overdose of pepper, pungent incense, and wet earth. Cold spices scattered through amber woods. Unexplained addiction, captivating scents.Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 603 Cuir Sahib Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Cuir Sahib - Leather, incense, tonka bean.“The golden temple of the Sikhs in perfume. A magnetic place to which I returned every morning.” Ludovic BonnetonSoftness in a leather glove. A citrusy opening refreshed by the aromatic facets of cypress. The fragrance continues with notes of leather that blend with incense for a mystical effect. Cashmere wood and tonka bean give the trail a warmer, more sensual dimension.Perfumer: Mylène Arlan.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 701 Eau de Cyprès Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Eucalyptus, Coriander, Cypress - An aromatic explosion.A fragrance that makes you soar! First, a great, slightly fruity freshness and a hint of bitterness brought by the grapefruit and pineapple duo. 701 is an explosion of spices and herbs: pepper, rosemary, coriander, eucalyptus, cypress. They raise the temperature, and blend wonderfully with amber wood and incense."A restaurant, La Chassagnette in Camargue, where words, smells, and feelings intersect. Calm and nature invite themselves to the table." - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Benoist Lapouza

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 702 Encens Privé Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Incense, Lavender, Cashmere Wood - A woody lavender.The scent of a Parisian barbershop! The initial sparkling, citrusy notes of elemi give way to incense. The woody-aromatic heart opens with a trio of lavender, cedar, and cashmere wood. The vanilla-musk base brings a powerful, rounded feel to this creation.“Recreates that proud moment between father and son. Incense and cashmere wood vied for the spotlight and ultimately, a duet." - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Juliette Karagueuzoglou

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 801 Blu Palermo Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Spray, Cedar, Grapefruit - A sea breeze.Sea, spray, and sun! Like a breeze of sea spray caressing our faces, 801 is refreshing with its grapefruit opening. This breeze intensifies, swirling spices: pink pepper and nutmeg add a hint of spice. Rows of cedar and cypress trees diffuse their sun-dried wood into the air. A summer fragrance to wear all year round.“I wanted more than an exotic fragrance, I wanted it to take us astray in the middle of the sea.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Karine Dubreuil-Sereni

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 802 Nymphéa Céleste Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Peony, Lotus, Bamboo - A rosy freshness.Like waking up in a Japanese garden. Lotus flower and bamboo combine for a Zen, plant-like freshness. Crafted around a floral bouquet of freesia, peony, and osmanthus, this fragrance reminds us of the scent of morning dew. The airy musks prolong this bubble of softness."I couldn't resign myself to leaving the meditative garden and inspiring atmosphere of Giverny behind me." - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Jacques Chabert

A frosty opening with marine accents, warmed by a spicy trio: ginger, pink berries, and juniper. The power and intensity of warm patchouli notes in the base.“Sharing our memories of walking in Brittany with Paul and the fragrance was born.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Paul Guerlain

listings.description: Nutmeg, Almond, Patchouli - A spicy patchouli.A shot of energy and spice. Ginger awakens the first fresh notes of grapefruit. Nutmeg and black pepper add spice, while almond reveals its sweetness and opens the transition to suave vanilla facets. Patchouli and musk leave sensual scents on the skin."The genesis of my perfumery, the first perfume I created and the first unclassifiable fragrance in the collection. listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 902 Hazy Spice Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Armagnac, Tobacco, Cinnamon -A tobacco Armagnac.If the Peaky Blinders had to wear a perfume, this would be it! Fresh and zesty notes of orange and ginger. Then, the spicy duo of cinnamon and clove intoxicates us. Scents of tobacco leaves and Armagnac emanate from the fragrance, revealing a bold and rich trail.“A fragrance that was born in my mind while I was playing poker with friends. The swirl of spices was born from the tensions around the table. And the tobacco that surrounds them.” - Ludovic BonnetonPerfumer: Karine Dubreuil-Sereni

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 903 Oud Ilam Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Oud Ilam - Nepalese berries, saffron, oud.“The magic of an afternoon browsing antiques. Identifying with the different styles of the pieces. Rare ingredients, just like the objects on display.” Ludovic BonnetonWoodland animality, eroticism, and mystery. The fragrance opens with an intriguing contrast between the fresh notes of Nepalese berries and the warm notes of saffron. The body of the perfume is designed around oud and musk, supported by other powerful woods. A captivating and very sensual fragrance.Perfumer: Serge de Oliveira.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Beekman Place Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The secret is out: Manhattan's most exclusive - and elusive - enclave, in luxurious scent form. Home to artists, royalty, heiresses and diplomats, this quaint span of two blocks near the East River is tucked on the edge of Turtle Bay in midtown Manhattan, making it perhaps the city's most exclusive and desirable neighborhood.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Bleecker Street Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Art, fashion, seduction and dessert in liquid form. A warm and sensual aphrodisiac that glides from day into evening.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Chelsea Nights Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Always gender-neutral, Chelsea Nights is for anyone who wants to make a statement and is looking for a good time. This bold new fragrance reflects the many aspects of its Manhattan destination with its blend of gourmand and oriental composition. And just like a decadent night out, it’s undeniably sexy. This statement-making fragrance is made to last a whole night out and will get you home safely in the wee hours of the morning.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Chez Bond Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The essence of downtown maleness: Cool, strong, brash, unabashed. Like a bracing mug of tea with a smooth, seductive aftertaste.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 FiDi Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Financial District—nicknamed FiDi—is a neighborhood in transformation, reflecting the best of old and new New York. An energetic, magnetic, audacious scent tailor-made for an outgoing, confident, modern man.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Gold Street Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: It's nouveau, and it's riche: not-so quietly luxurious, Gold Street. Named after this small but mighty street nestled squarely within the dizzying maze of the Financial District, the area is both literally and figuratively rich with the energy and excitement of the iconic financial center of North America.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Governors Island Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Introducing Governors Island. A seductive, addictive incense-filled scent. Invokes the smell of the island's dense woodlands. A rule-breaking symphony of tenacious forest notes.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Greenwich Village Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With Greenwich Village, Bond No. 9 brilliantly captures one of New York’s most beloved neighborhoods in a scent.It is a celebration of individuality and creativity, and the rich heritage of the city’s artists and intelligentsia, and the community they created. The result is an oriental vanilla with a touch of light floralcy.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Hamptons Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Your own private Jitney transport to New York's outermost neighborhood, where country lanes dotted with World of Interiorshouses and McMansions meet salt-sea mist. A male-female weekend scent, combining lush florals with a woody musk that lingers like a creamy ocean mist.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Lafayette Street Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Bond No. 9’s been headquartered right around the corner from Lafayette Street. This once unsung thoroughfare cuts a swath through Downtown’s most iconic neighborhoods, including Little Italy, Soho and Chinatown, it’s in serious revival mode today.The scent is a smooth ultra-male oriental fougere.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Madison Avenue Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The world's first shopping scent. We named it Madison Avenue, after New York's most celebrated street of boutiques.A high-energy daytime bouquet with come-hither woody-mossy chypre notes long favored by fashionistas.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Madison Square Park Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Madison Square Park was the height of fashion in the Gilded Age. Today it's back-in hip-&-cool revival mode. So now is the time for a neighborhood eau de parfum.An intoxicatingly ultra-feminine mélange: romantic--even voluptuous--florals on a backdrop of crisp greens.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 New York Flowers Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Winner of Harpers Bazaar Best Fragrance of 2023.New York Flowers honors not just the democracy of city’s “public” botanicals, but also celebrates the spirit of joy, renewal, and the natural wonders that each spring brings to our town. A celebratory scent that opens with sparkling notes, almost like popping the cork off of a bottle of champagne.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 New York Forever Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The legacy of a beloved city… New York Forever honors the 20th anniversary of Bond No. 9, with none other than liquid gold. A smell of luxury and authenticity, this fall scent leaves a memorable trace in its wake, representative of the everlasting legacy of the beloved city Bond No. 9 was originally created for. As an Oriental gourmand, New York Forever contains exotic notes of Indonesian patchouli oil and dewy moss paired with accents of cinnamon and vanilla to evoke feelings of nostalgia.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 New York Gardenia Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The parks and gardens are in full bloom to herald a bold new fragrance that stands alone as an audacious ambassador of spring.  Stunning, unapologetic, provocative. Sounds like a city we know.  Like NYC itself, this sensual gardenia gourmand floral is strong and powerful, a fitting symbol for a city that roars for attention.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 New York Nights Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: It’s incandescent. It’s luminescent. It’s New York Nights, Bond No. 9’s celebration of Manhattan’s evening skyline, ablaze with a riot of colors.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Nolita Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The neighborhood that begins just across Houston Street, two blocks south of us, has become a Millennials’ favorite and the hottest of Downtown’s hotspots. The scent is a ladylike classic Freesia paired with the unexpected wake-up of tangerine.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 NoMad Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Capturing the free spirit of New York’s dreamy wanderers. A strong, sensual, statement-making oud, with modern fruity notes and luxurious amber.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Riverside Drive Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Indie-style maleness, with a hint of Hudson River clearwater sloops. A woody-mossy masculine classic, updated with contemporary aqua accords and a hint of exotic fruit for cool crispness.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Signature Scent Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Arabian Nights come to Noho. To mark the 10-year anniversary of Bond No. 9's headquarters boutique, we had no choice but to unveil our signature scent, Bond No. 9 Perfume Oud, not for a New York neighborhood, but for our NoHo address. As a 30 percent concentration, thereby moving it into a category that's rare today: pure perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Sutton Place Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sutton Place, Bond No. 9’s classically masculine newest scent, celebrates that quiet, serene, understated enclave that serves as home to the traditionally male cadre of U.N. diplomats.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 The Scent of Peace For Him Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: At Bond No. 9, we're peacekeepers as well as perfumers. So now at last we're introducing The Scent of Peace for Him-the male counterpart of our No. 1 bestseller. That's what we call conflict-resolution.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 The Scent of Peace Natural Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Finally, the breath of fresh air we have all been waiting for! Introducing our very first all-natural fragrance. Clean beauty isn’t just an ask, it’s a demand. Now, we present a graceful eco-chic scent alternative. Natural and vegan essential oils made from raw materials to compose a sophisticated, effervescent fragrance crafted to linger on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 TriBeCa Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: TriBeCa is having a moment. Meet the chic new fragrance that tells its story. The style is a sexy, unisex, floriental, that’s sophisticated and young, much like the residents of TriBeCa.

listings.rawTitle: Bond No. 9 Wall Street Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The world's first securities parfum: Dollars and scents never smelled so good. A cool, zesty, spicy androgynous career scent, laden with a portfolio of brisk citrus, marine, and herbal notes.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Angels’ Powder Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Childhood dreams bottled, ready for adventure. Imagine the sweet smell of cotton candy after a carousel ride, the faint scent of your mother's nail polish as she helps you dress for a tea party, and the playful hint of paint from a freshly decorated dollhouse. This scent is all that magic. Angels powder captures the feeling when anything felt possible, and the world smelled like sweet treats and new beginnings.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Black Guava Extrait de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Eternal duality of light and dark.Black Guava embodies the eternal duality of light and dark. The sweet, vibrant brightness of guava, full of life and energy, is overtaken by the smoky, seductive depth of oud—capturing the alluring mystery of shadow and darkness.  The delicate balance between the two forces creates the unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Black Guava Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Eternal duality of light and dark.Black Guava embodies the eternal duality of light and dark. listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Black Mango Extrait de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: A perfectly ripe mango.Sinking your teeth into a perfectly ripe mango, its golden juice drips down your fingers, flooding your senses with tropical sweetness—it’s one of life’s simplest, purest pleasures. For me, mangoes are more than a fruit—they’re an obsession. That moment when you reach the core, where the sweetness fades into  something raw and primal, yet you crave every last bite—that’s unforgettable. Black Mango captures that exact experience.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Black Mango Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A perfectly ripe mango.Sinking your teeth into a perfectly ripe mango, its golden juice drips down your fingers, flooding your senses with tropical sweetness—it’s one of life’s simplest, purest pleasures. listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® DGAF Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: DGAF by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a high-impact olfactory journey—vibrant, layered, and bursting with color and attitude. The opening is fresh and aromatic: Calabrian bergamot lights up the composition, while sage, violet, and citrus notes add a green, sparkling twist that grabs your attention instantly.. The heart beats with intensity. Lively spices, a smooth woody touch of sandalwood, and a veil of incense intertwine with the refined character of Bulgarian rose, creating a magnetic and distinctive core.. The base brings warmth and comfort: golden amber, black balsam, and tonka bean deliver a soft, enveloping richness, amplified by musk and cashmeran for a modern, lingering trail.. DGAF is a fragrance that doesn’t ask for permission—it stands out, captivates, and leaves a lasting impression. Perfect for those who live unapologetically.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Heaven Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dirty Heaven opens with a radiant burst of white florals: jasmine and neroli shine intensely, their sweetness not tamed but amplified until it becomes almost hypnotic. At the heart, tonka bean swirls in creamy waves; its almond-like richness, touched with a hint of saffron, adds warmth and velvety sensuality.. Then comes the base, where the fragrance truly unveils its character. Ambroxan, vanilla, and white musks form a soft, enveloping cloud of warmth, while ambergris and modern woods introduce a subtle animalic edge—unexpected, yet incredibly captivating.. Dirty Heaven is made for those who crave beauty laced with intrigue. For those who are drawn to scents that sit on the edge of the familiar and the forbidden, where sweetness intertwines with a whisper of mischief. Wear it and embrace an aura that murmurs promises—suggesting something deliciously out of reach.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Rice Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Dirty Rice is pure seduction, but with a sophistication that doesn't need to be loud. It opens with a brilliant flash of bergamot and almond, a lively and inviting accord that hints at a more intimate and complex warmth beneath the surface.. The heart reveals its most surprising signature: basmati rice. Warm, sweet, and slightly earthy, it envelops the skin with an unexpected, almost carnal sensuality. Peony and milk intervene like a soft breath, adding a floral delicacy and a creaminess that borders on innocence, creating a perfect balance between purity and desire.. The base is a dance of contrasts: smoky sandalwood and vetiver build a classic, woody structure, while an animalic touch of musk adds depth and erotic tension. Cetalox closes the circle with a velvety warmth, similar to bare skin, amplifying the fragrance's intimacy and ensuring a persistent, enveloping, and irresistible trail.. Dirty Rice is more than just a perfume: it's a ritual of closeness, a whisper between two people, a memory that lingers like a touch on the skin. Perfect for those who know the power of stolen moments and shared passion.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum 100 ml
