listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Maple Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: This fragrance is pure indulgence, a scent made for unforgettable nights. Imagine candlelight flickering across velvet drapes, the intoxicating aroma of warm spices swirling with notes of molten caramel. This fragrance is a decadent indulgence, a scent that whispers "Treat yourself”. It shimmers with golden sweetness, a luxurious escape. Wear this, feel the rich, and the night becomes your stage.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Saffron Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Drunk Saffron opens with a voluptuous burst of velvety plum, bathed in the enveloping warmth of a fine cognac. Then comes the saffron: opulent, intoxicating, shot through with a golden sweetness that immediately captivates the senses. A veil of supple leather and a hint of dark, roasted coffee add depth and an almost sinful elegance.. As the minutes pass, the fragrance settles into a warm and sensual base: smoky patchouli, creamy vanilla and enveloping musk blend into a lingering, unabashedly voluptuous trail.. It's a perfume designed for those who know how to enjoy life's forbidden pleasures. Drunk Saffron whispers secrets, speaks of stolen encounters and desires that leave a mischievous smile on the lips. Wear it and let the night decide the rest.

listings.description: Imagine a secret rendezvous where desire runs wild and the night blurs reality. This fragrance captures that electric thrill, the magnetic pull of forbidden love. It opens with a bold, provocative warmth, leads into a sensual, untamed heart, and finishes with a seductive, lingering allure. It's a scent for those who crave excitement, rebellion, and indulgence. listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Indecent Cherry Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Cherries with character, without hesitation. Indecent Cherry opens with a sugary wave of cherry and a flirtatious touch of almond: the perfect innocence... or so it seems. Because immediately afterward, the mask falls away. Tangy black cherry and bold strawberry add an irresistible bite, while rose and mimosa lend a slightly provocative "who, me?" sophistication.. And just when you think you've got the mood, the twist arrives. Musk, patchouli, and benzoin darken the sweetness, transforming it into something adult, sensual, almost dangerous. It's like secretly pouring bourbon into your cherry milkshake.. Wear it if you're the type who always gets away with it, the one who can be adorable and a touch dangerous at the same time. Indecent Cherry is your signature: because life is definitely more interesting with a stinging sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Mad Honey Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The fragrance opens with a sharp burst of pink pepper and a vapor of fiery rum: an incendiary opening that paves the way for a golden, forbidden heart. Honey—raw, viscous, almost wild—flows with a primal sensuality, verging on the illicit. It intertwines with damask rose, which adds a hypnotic sweetness, creating a rich, dense, intoxicating cloud.. Then comes the all-encompassing warmth. Bourbon vanilla and tonka bean build a creamy, opulent smoothness, while smoky patchouli, resinous benzoin, and the musky tremor of Orcanox push the fragrance into an enveloping, irresistible darkness.. The result is a sensual, magnetic trail that seduces without asking permission.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Mary Jane Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: This fragrance is an ode to Mary Jane, the rebellious spirit who’d rather embrace a wild bouquet of cannabis and pine liqueur, than a predictable bunch of roses and champagne. The scent embodies the intoxicating freedom of defying convention – the heady green scent of rebellion, laced with sharp wit and a playful, almost daring sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Mud Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Hazy scent of wet soil amidst the rain”The pouring rain cools off the ground. Water fiercely falls from edge of the roof, raindrops splashes between the grass, and the ground turns to mud. The subtle scent of the water, the wet grass, and muddy ground permeates the air.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Naked Laundry Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: A decadent reinterpretation of vintage charm, where the innocence of fresh sheets meets the forbidden heat of entwined bodies. A fragrance that begins pure and luminous, then slowly slips into the irresistible warmth of heated skin.. The opening is fresh and innocent: mandarin and aldehydes evoke freshly laundered, clean, white linen. But it only takes a moment for the atmosphere to change. Ambrinole and the "skin" notes bring a carnal warmth to the surface, that scent of raw skin that suggests bodies pressed together, in sheets that are now anything but immaculate.. Mimosa and white caramel add a seductive sweetness, while warm honey and musk transform the fragrance into a cheeky, sensual, almost indecent embrace. In the drydown, tonka bean, velvety milk, and ambery woods blend into an enveloping trail reminiscent of skin on skin, radiant with warmth and unfiltered.. The finish? A soft, mysterious blanket of ambery woods that seals the fragrance in a lingering, intimate, and deeply magnetic aura.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Nuts Eau de Parfum 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal d’Afrique Absolu de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by his connection to Africa—particularly through the travels and years his father spent there—Ben Gorham conceived Bal d’Afrique as both an imaginary journey and a celebration of Africa’s profound cultural impact on dance, art, and music. This reinterpretation enhances the contrast between the vivid lightness and irresistible depth of Bal d’Afrique by intensifying its gourmand characteristics, for a richer and more captivating experience. Notes of bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant release a vibrant intensity that blends with the sweetness of praline, musks, and violet, eventually settling into a powerful base of cedarwood, vetiver, and warm black amber.Beyond the fragrance, the new Absolu de Parfum bottle is also a tribute to craftsmanship. The tactile cap is inspired by Yakisugi (the Japanese art of wood carbonization) and reflects the essence of Absolu—marked by deep intensity, transformation, and lasting strength. With its industrial gold and silver design, the spray top complements the bottle’s clean curves and minimalist glass form. Inside, the intense hue of Absolu de Parfum gives a visual hint of the fragrance’s rich concentration.

listings.description: Black Saffron is a powerful celebration of the deep-rooted symbolism of saffron—an emblem of fire, purity, and spiritual detachment. Inspired by the Indian heritage of founder and creative director Ben Gorham, this fragrance embodies the spirit of unity and cultural reverence for this sacred hue. listings.rawTitle: Byredo Blanche Absolu de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: L'Absolu de Parfum is rooted in the iconic story of Blanche, defined by intimacy, texture, and comfort, and elevates the contrast between purity and warmth, revealing the sensuality of skin, touch, and closeness in the soft and long-lasting embrace it wraps around the body. Intensifying the fragrance’s warm characteristics, this reinterpretation blends the fresh aldehydic top notes with the intensity of black pepper and the warmth of neroli, making way for a brighter floral heart. Rose, violet, and jasmine come alive in a stronger and slightly fruity nuance. Thanks to the sensual white musk, enveloping cashmere wood, and seductive ambroxan, the fragrance embraces the body in an intimate warmth, like the skin-to-skin hug of someone we love.Beyond the fragrance, the new Absolu de Parfum bottle is also an homage to craftsmanship. The tactile cap is inspired by Yakisugi (the Japanese art of wood charring) and reflects the essence of Absolu, characterized by deep intensity, transformation, and lasting strength. With its gold and silver industrial design, the spray head complements the minimalist design and clean curves of the glass bottle. Inside the bottle, the intense hue of Absolu de Parfum offers a visual clue to the fragrance’s rich concentration.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Rose of No Man’s Land Absolu de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the iconic story of *Rose of No Man’s Land*, the Absolu de Parfum pays tribute to the rose that blooms where no one else dares—a symbol of strength, grace, and compassion for those who help others under the most challenging circumstances. This reinterpretation reveals the fragrance’s refined dimensionality by amplifying its smoky characteristics. At the heart of this composition beats a trilogy of exquisite roses, perfectly woven into the top and base notes to create elegant depth. Saffron and blackcurrant emerge first, offering a fruity touch that blends with pink pepper for an immediate impact. Black raspberry and peony intertwine with the roses to complete the floral heart, adding a sweet nuance to every petal. A smoky base of papyrus, dark patchouli, and warm amber ensures the fragrance’s longevity.Beyond the fragrance, the new Absolu de Parfum bottle is also a tribute to craftsmanship. The tactile cap is inspired by Yakisugi (the Japanese art of wood carbonization) and reflects the essence of Absolu—defined by deep intensity, transformation, and lasting strength. With its industrial gold and silver design, the spray top complements the simple lines and clean curves of the glass bottle. Inside, the intense hue of Absolu de Parfum offers a visual cue to the fragrance’s rich concentration.

listings.description: An authentic, almost secret garden that opens up among the narrow streets of Capri and intertwines under the veil of the waves, brings coral branches and plant compositions to the shore, together with shells and unexpected explosions of a natural heritage illuminated by a day in full sun . Bergamot, sunny and brilliant meets Rosemary. Aromatic, sometimes pungent. On the skin the Salt, made into crystal. Clear, unmistakable. A dip refreshes, leaves room for the new. The magic of the story takes place, all around.

listings.description: With the new dawn arises new hope, you are no longer the person you used to be.With the new dawn arises new hope. Levar del Sole poeticises on the skin. Literally translated as “rising of the sun”, Levar del Sole is the perfume inspired by the immortal phoenix. A symbol of renewal, whose scent breathes new life onto the person it is sprayed upon in a baptism of new beginnings.Opening to fresh citrus nuances and the nurturing aura of delicate rose, these hand-picked roses were chosen especially for Levar del Sole from India’s perfume capital, Kannauj. With cardamom, violet and lily at the heart, Levar del Sole eau de parfum breathes prosperity. New beginnings unfold and transformations are made, as the senses lean into the deliciously comforting blend of musk, Tonka bean and caramel at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Casamorati Quattro Pizzi Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The story of a Sicilian dynasty that has known glory, wealth and power.Quattro Pizzi, the most iconic palace that was home to Palermo’s most symbolic and prominent families. A perfume reminiscent of the Belle Époque era, where love, beauty and nobility entwine with secrecy and sin. A juxtapose of sweet and spicy hits the senses on first spray with rum, davana and pink pepper, where the intoxicating notes of tuberose enchant and seduce at the heart, a sensual scent that lingers like a lover’s forbidden touch on the skin long after the sun goes down. Heat and passion unravel through the notes of this scented story ahead of Sicily’s breathtakingly beautiful backdrop.

listings.rawTitle: Casamorati Regio Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A bouquet of exquisite spices and rare precious wood.A memorable voyage along sea breezes and a collision of warm and fresh aromas like a sudden storm entrapping boats in a gigantic sea. Regio is a clash of warm oriental ylang-ylang and captivating animal nuances with freshly squeezed bergamot and lemon blossom, all cocooned by aromatic herbs and geranium. The fragrance opens with the essence of spices and astringent citruses. With the infusion of lavender and geranium which are promises to its oriental core, Regio is like a fresh breeze and the sun glimmering on the bright surface of a calm sea that tired shipmen in their ships eventually return to from the wrath of sea.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Alheba Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Al Heba, which in Arabic means “the gift”… is an invitation to let yourself be carried away and embark on a true journey of the senses. It is much more than a perfume. It is the fragrance that encapsulates, in itself and in its notes of grey amber and woods, a pure and decisive jus – refined and unmistakable, fragile and resistant at the same time; the metaphor of a journey through memories of mystical scents, light, fashion, art, beauty, and the mystery of the eternal city.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Amor Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Cradle of a millennia-old history, where everything that has been and will be can coexist with everything else: the high and the low, the old and the new, religion and atheism, opulence and misery – even God and the Devil seem to have found a stable and lasting balance. Getting lost in its streets, letting yourself be guided by the great beauty, reveals a new surprise at every moment. At every corner, a monument, streets, and alleys paved with cobblestones, where, if you close your eyes, you can almost hear the ancient murmur of humanity – cultures, languages, and tastes blending into a single identity… that of the Caput Mundi… the identity of ROME. In the top notes, an elegant combination unfolds with a jus of tropical fruits, citrus, and green apple, followed by a seductive floral and spicy accord represented by a timid French violet, heliotrope, cashmere wood, lily of the valley, and finally, a Peruvian tonka bean. The whole composition is rounded off in the base with the powdery notes of Florentine iris embraced by delicate woods, amber, and Madagascar vanilla, as if it had emerged from a snapshot of Campo de’ Fiori.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Caffè Rosa Vaniglia Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A journey ready to reveal itself in union with your skin. Amber, gourmand, oriental, aromatic. The main accord is an imaginative journey to a bright, exotic, and fresh land. A journey where the awakening of the senses happens through the aromatic union of stimulating coffee beans and the delightful Turkish rose. But the pulsating warmth of this journey is held in its heart, where pure vanilla and luscious hazelnut cream open the doors to the first soft base notes – a carpet of fresh, white musks that gradually give way to the warm and enticing memory of amber and precious woody notes, sealing the essence with a present, seductive, enveloping, yet never intrusive signature.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Love Declaration Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fresh and juicy blend of Mediterranean citrus and sweet red fruits appears in the top and heart notes of the fragrance, followed by a warm oriental base with notes of white musk, amber, and Madagascar vanilla. A breeze of freshness that surprises and awakens the senses. Sparkling and vibrant like the first encounter. Delicious like the first kiss. Embracing and sensual like a tender hug. “I love the fact that, after spending a day with you, I can still smell your fragrance on my clothes. There will always be a part of you in me, there will always be a part of me in you.” A fresh and juicy blend of Mediterranean citrus and sweet red fruits appears in the top and heart notes of the fragrance, followed by a warm oriental base with notes of white musk, amber, and Madagascar vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Marine Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An intense and sensual perfume with fresh and enveloping notes. The fragrance stimulates the senses, opening with sunny and luminous notes of orange blossom and bergamot, followed by pure and opulent floral notes of tuberose and Indian jasmine. An intoxicating celebration of white flowers resting on a sweet base of vanilla and oriental accents of cedarwood and musk. A perfume that evokes a secluded beach, bathed by the gentle movement of the sea, the salt on the skin, the sun’s rays flirting with the crystal-clear waters, creating a hypnotic shimmer of light. It is an invigorating breeze carrying from the coast the fresh, iodized scent of the sea mist, colored by the nectar of floral notes, patchouli, vanilla, and white musk—for an atmosphere of endless holidays.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Mystic Moon Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The composition releases a powerful cosmic energy… On an enchanted full moon night, a dazzling comet brushed past the Earth, leaving behind a mystical glow and an intoxicating fragrance. The first notes are a gust of solar wind, a luminous explosion of orange peel and spicy spices, carried upwards by a trail of sacred incense. This is the prelude to an intense and pulsating heart of life particles caressing and covering the planet, where lavender and saffron dance in unison in a primordial aromatic symphony. Slowly… the darkness of the night reclaims its space within the sudden light, evoking the vastness of the universe. Cedarwood and guaiac wood echo an endless expanse, while patchouli and Gurjum balsam intertwine in a reassuring embrace that slowly fades into a deep darkness. Amber and benzoin shine with the pure light of stars that vividly sparkle in the void of the cosmos, sealing the memory of what has transpired.

listings.rawTitle: Cave White Amber Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An explosion of purity and warmth: White Amber is an exquisite fragrance that harmoniously combines delicate floral notes with the richness of amber. Striking a perfect balance between ethereal lightness and enveloping depth, this perfume unfolds as a multifaceted symphony, designed to captivate the senses of even the most discerning connoisseurs.The bright and vibrant top notes burst with refreshing aquatic accords, delicate white flowers, and succulent fruits, elevated by a subtle, spicy hint of black pepper. At the heart, a timeless bouquet of rose and lily of the valley unfolds, softened by the indulgent sweetness of vanilla and caramel. The rich warmth of tonka bean adds a touch of velvety sensuality. At the base, ambergris and ambrette seeds meld with the richness of sandalwood and cedar, while the depth of cypriol oil adds an intense, earthy allure.A fragrance that mirrors the wearer's duality: luminous and delicate, yet possessing a magnetic depth that leaves an unforgettable signature.

listings.rawTitle: Cave Xander Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A sensual, woody-spicy, and oriental signature – a blend of power and nobility. An intense sillage, mysteriously powerful and highly concentrated, with a masculine and reassuring allure. The top notes are illuminated by the crackling freshness of Calabrian bergamot, spiced with oregano leaves and cedarwood. The balsamic and oriental heart invites you to surrender to your instincts, where warm amber and opoponax wood are wrapped in myrrh and incense resins. The final leather notes, with their smoky accents, assert a virile character, manifesting boldly over a wild base of oud, sandalwood, and patchouli, elegantly sealed with myrrh resin.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Chic et Bohème Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Chic et Bohème brings together the beguiling and alluring power of the flowers and releases them full of optimism, charm and personality again. An eau de parfum which carries both a playful lightness as well as a wonderful spirit.Cool, sweet and juicy tangerine combines with the beautiful flower essences of bitter orange, accented by floral ylang-ylang. Orange flowers exude their delicate, bright glow, actively supported by jasmine that leads to a refined plum note. This vibrant creation is held together by a base of patchouli, warm ambergris and fine vanilla that lends a long-lasting character to the creation.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Fleur de Figuier Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Conjures a picture of spring and summer on the Mediterranean and the powerful, unleashed greenery that gives life to nature by responding with timeless elegance, freshness and softness.. A beautiful composition of green notes gathered in various iridescent shades: from the earthy power of delicate roots to the rich foliage of majestic trees. The heart beats for its protagonist, the fig, which with its characteristic fruity-green aroma tantalizes both nose and palate at the same time. New shades of green are introduced by conifers and flanked by herbaceous lavender. Above it all the fig sits enthroned with an almost minty appearing aureole. Cedar and sandalwood keep this explosion of life thoughtfully in check. The fragrance creation Fleur de Figuier pays homage to the warm season in the Mediterranean by responding with timeless elegance, freshness and softness.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Lait Concentré Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Lait Concentré evokes a childhood memory that is connected to the popular and delicious condensed milk. It is fairylike, suggesting a transparent veil, merging smoothly with skin, like a fleeting memory that you can just hold on to with your fingertips - a delicious and ethereal eau de toilette.. At the beginning of the fragrance we encounter bright milk notes, that remind us of the delicious concentrated milk, which the French confectioner Nicolas Appert invented in the 19th Century. The light and seemingly transparent fragrance continues with a slighty tart, unsweetened coconut and closes with restrained caramel notes.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Lait de Biscuit Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Lait de Biscuit takes us on a flash back to our childhood. This is a delicious fragrance, reminiscent of cherished treats. A fateful blend of sweetness and mouthwatering delicacies. A wonderful eau de toilette that offers a journey through time and maximum enjoyment all at once.The fragrance composition of Lait de Biscuit consists of a triumvirate of the finest sweets. The beginning is made by pastry notes. Should we think of butter biscuits, cake or ladyfingers? Perhaps the caramel notes, reminiscent of toffee and roasted almonds, are already leading us by the nose? Finally, there is also the subtle vanilla, and who wants to decide amongst all these treats whether it's a vanilla ice or a vanilla pudding?

listings.description: Is a gift full of sweetness, comfort and recovered innocence which reminds us of an inner peace and a sense of well-being, that a cup of hot milk, a butter cookie or the taste of vanilla once gave us. An eau de toilette - delicious enough to eat - with the lightness of memories and a self confience.The fragrance titled vanilla milk starts with notes of confiture de lait, a French spread for bread made from milk, sugar and vanilla, which is especially popular in South America under the name dulce de leche, where it is used as an ingredient for all kinds of culinary temptations. The heart consists of chocolate-balsamic notes of benzoin that, with a base of vanilla and caramel perfectly closes the circle.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Mysterious Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In Mysterious Oud the performers pass by in a hypnotic dreamlike procession, inspired and fulfilled by a mystery which they share with us. A fragrance as mysterious as the cultures of distant lands, composed from secret recipes and supported by an unspeakable and magical harmony.. Peppery and spicy elemi opens the composition and hints at the fragrant secrets that await us. Cedar, warm and woody labdanum and a hint of jasmine fill the heart notes to prepare a grand entrance for the protagonist. Woody-resinous oud with fine sharp notes shows its face, accompanied by sandalwood and a harmonious blend of ambergris and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Chabaud Maison de Parfum Vintage Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Vintage is a fragrance that captures the magic of yesteryear with its classic floral fragrances, reminiscent of sweet childhood memories, while remaining anchored in the here and now. A nostalgic yet modern fragrance with an exciting and gentle oriental accent.. Devoted and nostalgic,Vintage begins with carnation and splashes of juicy tangerine. But it quickly becomes clear that here the flowers are firmly in control : ylang-ylang, jasmine and tuberose exude their own unique, enchanting white blossoming charm. Delicious dessert notes of caramel, aromatic honey and bright almonds provide an oriental-style treat in contrast to their fruity-floral predecessors.

listings.rawTitle: Cherigan Adhara Oud Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the original use of perfume, incense uplifts and purifies. Majestic, mysterious and seductive, oud wood is its most precious essence. It is found in the way of Japanese incense - Kodo - but also in Middle Eastern rituals.In Adhara Oud , star material meets rose absolute and geranium leaf, intensified by a leather accord and patchouli. An intoxicating, bewitching power, like an echo of the history of perfumery and its most luxurious materials.98% natural ingredients

listings.rawTitle: Cherigan Fiesta Habana Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Hemingway, the most French of American writers in the Paris of the Roaring Twenties, published in 1926  Fiesta - The Sun Also Rises,   a story of passion, a tribute to absolute love and the pleasure of limitless parties between France and Spain. Soon after, he moved to his favorite house in the Keys, just across the street from Cuba, the nightlife, casino and party paradise of the 1930s, where Cherigan was already a favorite perfume brand. of the local jet set.Fiesta Habana is an ode to the vibrations of the night, a free and captivating fragrance, enveloped in a swirl of Cuban rum and sweet tobacco, enhanced by a bewitching vanilla, preceded by an illicit trail, which takes you to other heaven.

listings.rawTitle: Cherigan Iris Coffee Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: To warm up passengers on transatlantic flights, Joseph Sheridan, owner of an Irish café, created a hot and invigorating drink in the 1930s: Irish coffee .The fragrance recalls that moment when the traveler finds stimulating comfort. The freshness of bergamot and cardamom gives way to a powerful sensation, between bitterness and sweetness, transcribed by notes of coffee, tonka, iris and jasmine. A sweet and ardent sip.90% natural ingredients

listings.rawTitle: Cherigan Lovers in Pink Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This Paris of all possibilities is the chosen land of many artists, who find there the source of an abundant impulse. Marc Chagall is one of them, and it is in homage to his work that we have created Lovers in Pink . Inspired by a series of portraits of his wife and muse Bella in red, pink and blue tones, the composition invents a color with a thousand shades.Like a champagne bubble, it sparkles with a blackcurrant - lemon - ginger effect. On a woody background, a bouquet of roses, peonies and jasmine is offered. A declaration of love for art in all its forms.90% natural ingredients

listings.rawTitle: Cherigan Or Des Iles Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Another exoticism is told in the bottle of Or des Iles , heavenly, burning. Like a kaleidoscope of fantasy offered by the turquoise seas, immersed in the thick air of lush vegetation.Painted by Gauguin at the beginning of the century, the Tropics are the occasion of a renaissance of art. A tribute to Joséphine Baker's famous wild dance on the Champs-Elysées.99% natural ingredients

In the pages of Anaïs Nin and Henry Miller, the desire to live becomes a quest for pleasure. listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Agra Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A tribute to mystical India, Caroline Dumur captures the essence of the city of Agra and the impressive monument of the Taj Mahal in a sublime fragrance.The fragrance opens on a dazzling ginger and a fresh combination of cardamom and neroli. The heart reveals opulent, floral notes of Indian tuberose and jasmine, symbols of love in Indian culture. Finally, the creation translates the warmth of the city with tonka and vanilla beans.It was during a trip to India with her mother when she felt the magic of the city that inspired her later. The sun began its gentle descent, casting a golden hue over the iconic Taj Mahal, a monument to eternal love and loss. She remembers strolling through the well-kept gardens of the great Mughal empire, where the soft fragrance of jasmine filled the air. Later, as she wandered through the ancient streets of Agra, she marveled at the intricate carvings and tall domes that bore witness to a bygone era of grandeur and power. However, amid the bustling bazaars, filled with the sounds of vendors and the vibrant colors of textiles, there was a quiet reverence for the past. The contrast between the city’s rich heritage and the soft whispers of the Yamuna River reminded her that Agra was not just a place of history, but a living tribute to the power of emotion and artistry. There, time seemed to stand still, and despite the hustle and bustle, she felt a peace and inner calm that she carried with her forever.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Bilbao Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Growing up in Bilbao, Ane recreates those walks with her father to the park, where she was lost as a child during the summer afternoons.The fragrance opens with citrus and lavender, whilst the depth of oak and coffee are at the heart. Metallic accords mimic the noticeably industrial side of Bilbao, together with the green and woody notes that characterise those afternoons spent in park during the summer.She was born here and enjoyed the days her father took her by the hand walking through the busy street of Bilbao. She would chat constantly to him as they walked hand in hand along the narrow streets in direction of the park. The street-side cafes, that at night bustling with adults searching for the best tapas with their glasses of beer, during daytime filled with pensioners. It was coffee, tobacco and chatter mixed with the sound of banging dominos that filled her memory when walking alongside her father. Once in the park, surrounded by immense green trees, pretty flowers and the vast expanse of grass to play on, it always seemed unusual to her that the air, although fresh, had an underlying metallic scent to it. But as a child you cannot be aware of the importance that industrialization has on the city, she called home. Bilbao a proud city of proud people.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Dubai Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fragrance as unique and exclusive as is its place of inspiration, Dubai, a benchmark city of luxury.Anne reflects on her memories of Dubai through her unforgettable gastronomy. Notes that make us savour arabic sweets, spices and dates, which give the fragrance quality and exquisite taste. An intense background of exotic VANILLA wrapped in an amber universe gives a great trail to the fragrance.The hotel was a luxurious five-star oasis surrounded by the Dubai desert. Entering the restaurant, it was as if she has stepped back in time to the Arabian nights despite the unmistakable futuristic Dubai Skyline seen far in the distance through the windows. Lavish arabesque carved wooden partitioning, coloured glass lanterns glinted while musicians sat on cushions expertly played ouds. The attentive waiter festooned her table with indulgent, amber-coloured dates studded with almonds, and a banquet-style array of traditional pastries and sweets. Each a work of art, elaborated with pine nuts, pistachios, walnuts, honey and dried fruits, with the delicate sweet aromas of orange and rose. Cardamom flavoured Arabic coffee in an ornate tall coffee pot, was masterfully poured for her in a traditional gold decorated glass cup, filling the air, and her heart, with a flavour of an Arabic bygone era. Dubai a lavish, avant-garde city, retaining its culinary traditions of years gone by.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Hydra Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: It was a vacation trip in search of peace and quiet on the Greek Island of Hydra for Ilias.A fragrance that offers simplicity, peace, tranquillity and beauty, opening with the fresh fruit that depict the paradisiacal white island. The warm air, and the bright sun that carry the distinctive jasmine and hyacinth which is rounded with the simplistic strength of white musk. It was a holiday trip of peace and quiet on the Greek Island of Hydra, something he desperately needed. With the crystalline sea protecting this paradisiacal white island of simplistic beauty, it was his sanctuary. The warm air, bright sun and little beach being his only companions for a few weeks of reflection and relaxation. As he walked down the narrow stone steps of his garden, only metres from the beach, he gazed at the splendour of the sea as the sun, slowly setting, created a glorious burst of orange colour in the sky. He was accompanied only by the rhythmic sound of the waves gently breaking on the golden sand and the sweet heady scent of jasmine flowers and hyacinths growing in pots in his garden completing this moment of idyllic bliss. Sipping his refreshing watermelon juice, adorned with fresh mint leaves from his garden, he thought how life was good. Hydra his peace and tranquillity.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Marrakesh Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Nelly Hachem-Ruiz captured the captivating sensations she felt while strolling through the alleys of the souk and being amazed by the fragrant nectars filling the air in Marrakesh.The fragrance opens on a symphony of spicy facets where cardamom, saffron, cinnamon, cumin, nutmeg reveal their colorful profile. This vibrant combination then melts with the city’s tannery deep scents where leather and amber notes create a powerful and opulent trail.As the sun dipped low over the horizon, Marrakesh came alive in a dance of vibrant colors and sounds. The air in the medina was thick with the mingling scents of saffron, cinnamon, and roses, an olfactory invitation to explore the soul of the city. She wandered through the labyrinthine alleys of the souk, captivated by the chaos and charm of life unfolding around her. The rhythmic hum of conversation, the clink of handcrafted brassware, and the vibrant hues of handwoven carpets created a sensory tapestry that was as rich as the city’s history. At the heart of it all, the call to prayer echoed, reminding her that amidst the bustling market, there was always a moment of peace and reflection.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Positano Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A proposal as ground-breaking as it is unexpected, a very personal interpretation of beautiful Italy from the hands of Carlos.Its aromatic and citrus side with characteristic Mediterranean spices is combined with a marine and salty accord typical of the cities of the Italian coast. A hay accord and a woody background make us remember the warm climate of the Italian coast.It was a glorious summers day, everything bathed in the heat of the midday sun, not a shadow in sight beneath the immaculate blue sky in Positano. He felt the constant gentle sea breeze, with its slight saltiness, caressing everything in its path, a reminder of the sea’s proximity. Standing proud, the unique, steeply-stepped houses nestled in the hillside, in tons of peach, pink and terracotta, all paying homage to the coast. He was fascinated by the tiny, well-kept gardens with lemon and orange trees laidened with fruit, together with pots brimming with lavender, bayleaf, rosemary and thyme that instantly evoke the aromatic indulgence of the Mediterranean cuisine. It was always the unexpected from Positano that he loved, and kept him returning to the very dramatic and exclusive delights of this treasure on the Amalfi coast.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Reykjavik Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An olfactory journey of Iceland’s incredible Golden Circle, with a mandatory stop in Reykjavik, as told by Delphine.The complex but balanced structure of this fragrance represents the contrasts that can be found in Iceland. On the one hand, it is a very aromatic and fresh fragrance that is inspired by the green fjords and glaciers covered in ice of an almost polar country. On the other hand, we find a warm and comforting side with a sauna steam accord. Finally, its spicy, woody and slightly mineral side represents its great volcanic activity.The cruise ship skilfully navigated through the last fjord towards its final dock in Reykjavik. The lush green vegetation came close to the water’s edge, contrasted by the unbelievably close ice-covered glaciers along the fjord. As she disembarked, the grey cloudy sky was being whipped by the pure, cold air. It instantly caught her breath, a reminder that this was Iceland. They boarded the warm luxury coach in search of the volcano she so desperately wanted to see. It did not disappoint. She walked towards the imposing volcano that stood silently awaiting its guests. The air, slightly mineral ladened and combined with the heavy aromas of the damp land and trees in between her and the volcano, was even more powerful than she had ever imagined. Reykjavik, an experience of strong yet balanced contrasts.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Salalah Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With a genuine love and passion for Arabic perfume, its culture and origins, a trip to one of history’s most important frankincense cities was a discovery for Julien and its important perfume roots.Arabic fragrance philosophy recreated to modern-day fine fragrance. Opening with subtle PLUM and ROSE offering a gentle floral entry into a heart of the luxuriously enveloping TURKISH ROSE and PACHOULI. With rich, woody base notes of unmistakable OUD, soft and cosy LABDANUM and fresh, spicy GURJUN further reiterate the exquisitely rounded elegance, strength and depth of this modern creation of Arabic roots.His passion for traditional Arabic perfume and Arabic culture was undeniable. His trip to Oman was a pilgrimage to the ancient home of frankincense. Salalah, the southern city in Oman is a true dichotomy. With its contrasting world of lush green mountainous vegetation, natural waterfalls and moderate temperatures. An abundance of colour with fruits and flowers grown in this natural oasis during the monsoon or ‘khareef’ summer months. It’s friendly, bustling local market full of heady spices, contrasted by the sweet smell of dried apricot, rose petals, rose and orange waters offering a softer cushion for the nose. Fresh fruits: plums, pineapples, bananas and mango suggest utter deliciousness. Then it hit him, the warm evening air in the narrow market streets intertwined with the smoke of Arabic bakhoor, agarwood (oud) and frankincense, ignites his passion, imagination and emotions. He is instantly transported back centuries to Salalah’s domination of the opulent frankincense era, and once again he relives his memorable visit to the UNESCO frankincense site.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Shanghai Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Shanghai has a special place in his memory, as it was the origin of his training process as a perfumer.This creation represents the union between modernity and the characteristic tradition of the city. The fragrance opens with an outflow of juicy nashi pear, a symbol of Chinese tradition as well as Asian culture. In its most floral part, the chinese peony stands out, providing colour and freshness, while in the background, a soft amber lingers and gives the fragrance great strength.Crossing the busy streets of this city decorated in red, he was immediately hit by the frenetic, yet strangely organised, movement of his new neighbours. The cacophony of urban life was loud, overwhelming but exciting. Mobiles and designer handbags mingled amongst the aromas of spicy beef and dim sum. The juxtaposition of contemporary glass-clad skyscrapers, haute-couture shops and luxury cars harmoniously cohabitating with the myriad of traditional street vendors, barrows and bicycles was a unique phenomenon of modern-day Shanghai. He stopped by a fruit stall, marvelling at the variety of such exotic fruits, the old man gave a toothless grin as he offers him a slice of real China to try, the Nashi pear. Its unforgettable smell and crisp juicy taste instantly cemented his sense of residence in Shanghai, now his city to live and work.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Sydney Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: I am inspired by one of my great passions: sailing! Breeze, sea, sun and blue sky in a unique architectural environment. Ramon’s passion for sailing is a recollection of Sydney. Citrus notes of bergamot and pineapple perforate the architectural blue skies and bright sun. Wind ladened marine accords combined with noble woods invoke images of a majestic sailboat on the sea, combined with musk to give the fragrance heart and a genuine quality and depth.He sipped fresh pineapple juice as he finished his late breakfast. Beautiful full bloom rose bushes perfumed the pristine terrace. The clear blue sky and bright sun further set the stage as he contemplated and marvelled at the awe-inspiring architectural backdrop of the Sydney Opera House. A visual realisation of an architect’s passion, which soon would combine with his true passion, sailing. He delighted with anticipation of what was to come. Stepping on the sailboat, the wooden deck welcomed him with a familiar humid scent of noble wood, the soothing gentle rocking back and forth as the final preparations were made for this much await experience. He set sail, gaining speed as he passed under the harbour bridge, cutting sharp angles through the sea as the continuous wind filled the magnificent sails, his face sprayed with a constant salty reminder that the sea was ever omni-present in their togetherness. Sydney, a day of great passions.

listings.rawTitle: Contes de Parfums Tokyo Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A delicate fragrance that transports us to Japan to relive a Hanami – contemplation of cherry blossoms – through the different lost corners of Tokyo in which Anne is inspired.The sophisticated character of the cherry blossom is flavoured with notes of bergamot tea and rose to add freshness, while background musk and cotton accords pamper our skin.The usually calm residents of Tokyo were visible excited at the thought of the Hanami, the annual tradition of viewing of the cherry blossom. Late March, the city was alive with delight, hope and happiness for two important weeks, the ultimate party given by nature. She slowly walked the immaculately kept streets marvelling at the intense beauty of nature. Thousands of cotton-like trees filled each street, bursting with luminous, pink-toned flowers, refreshing the air with their subtle delicate scent. A symbol of life, albeit fleeting. Families and friends gathered in parks enjoying picnics celebrating this auspicious occasion, seated beneath the sophisticated canopy as the delicate flowers drop like pink snowflakes, caressing them in celebration. As she continued her walk, she reflected on Tokyo, a city revered for its technological advances, yet she had just experienced the most incredible display of tradition at peace with nature.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Amber Kiso Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A ritual in the holy Kiso forest: ceremonial katana unguent of rare woods, temple incense, leather bushi armor.Japanese forests contain numerous trees with wood that is sacred in traditional religious ceremonies. The connection to the forest is realized in ritual offerings that include incense made from these rare woods.Hinoki wood’s strong timber has been used for temples, Noh theaters, baths, and masu. Hinoki from the Kiso forest was sourced for the holy Ise shrine in Mie Prefecture. Sawara Cypress is a sturdy lemon scented “false” cypress with red stringy bark. The timber is also used for temples and shrines. It grows wild on the is- lands of Kyushu and Honshu.Asahi zuru maple is an ancient variety of maple native to Japan with beautifully ornate pink, white, and green leaves. Its name means “swan at dawn".

Put a gem in the ground.. Notorious Oud 1.5 ml: sublime Indonesian oud with a worldwide perspective.. Italian Citrus 1.5 ml: bracing cologne on the Gold Coast.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Big Sur Eucalyptus Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Deep spicy green groves on the cool cool California coast.. "Big Sur After Rain is one of our most successful products. People have asked for us to make it as a perfume, but I really don’t dig candle oils on the skin. So I took the dominant accord, and many of the same materials and fashioned them into a foggy meditation on coastal California eucalyptus groves that sits wonderfully on the ol’ epidermis. Eucalyptus is one of my top five favorite smells in the world. The oil alone cannot encapsulate its real essence – balmy, green, woody, and deeply spicy. I hope this perfume captures this for all the seekers and tweakers out there."

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Bistro Waters Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: I grew up working in New York restaurants. Working in restaurants forever shapes your understanding of the world. You're literally in the "right place," in the frenzy of service (at 8:30 on a Friday night). It's electric: shouted orders, laughter, shitty music your loser boss plays on repeat, crazy line cooks, drinking, first dates, possibilities, old friends. The outside world is sealed off by the walls of the bistro. Inside, you escape or go inside to experience the scene, the aroma, the food. This is a snapshot of a New York bistro from the '90s and '00s, when tourists ordered peartini, vegetables became sophisticated, and people wore fresh, aquatic perfumes.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Brown Flowers Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Aging vials of umber hues, weird brown orchids, coffee flower, and dry jasmine buds littered with faded citrus peels.This is a deep brown flower perfume for amateur modernists dressed up in gigantic peak collar brown velvet tuxes and cheetah pantsuits to sip martinis at their friend's friend’s glasshouse out of the city. Have you met their eccentric childhood friend who wears polka dot headbands? She’s taken over the guest cottage & is making experiments with all sorts of dried flowers and herbs. The desk is littered with plant parts, vials of old extracts, and vases of bizarre looking orchids she sources from “the best little shop” in Chinatown. See her collection of antique herbals with ridiculous recipes for “tussie mussies,” “pomanders,” “herbal vinegars,” and rudimentary perfumes. Her newest fragrance is “to die for.” Made with “exquisite” floral extracts, her own distillations, and a musk that “she can only get in Europe.”It’s chic, it’s drab, it’s what all her friends are wearing in the city. Don’t you want to try it?

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Burning Barbershop Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fire broke out in the Curling Bros. barbershop in Westlake, N.Y. in 1891. All the shaving tonics with their spearmint, lime, vanilla and lavender burned. A charred bottle was found half-full. It smelled like this.. The other original mainstay of DSD along with Cowboy Grass. A truly old fashioned dandified visit to ye old barbershop through classic aromatic association—lavender, pine, mint, roses, vanilla‚with a unique modern twist: devastating smoke.. Burning Barbershop is a fougere—a classic genre of usually men’s fragrances that use hay and vanillic notes with herbal lavender and the bitter green base of oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Coriander Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Sparkling leaf, cubeb, green pepper, & cracked coriander seed. Cool spices & Black Sea breeze—like the hills above Odessa.Coriander is cool. It is a spice, but it is cool. When we think of spices, we think of warmth: nutmeg, ginger, clove, cinnamon. We picture roaring fires, winter warmth, or the tropical climes where these plants grow. Of course with some perfume wizardry you can turn these on their heads. But coriander is already cool. It is fresh, green, pungent, and evocative of the grass, the expanse of fields, the sweeping sea.

listings.description: American sagebrush, flowering white thyme, and prairie switchgrass from the wild western territories. Perfect for robbing banks on horseback.Cowboy Grass is a play of contrasts. The freshness of bergamot with the dustiness of thyme. The medicinal notes of clary sage and basil against the softness of rose otto. And ultimately the dry peanut wood crackle of vetiver against the warm amber of benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Debaser Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Frank Black's rough voice on an August afternoon, stinging lyrics, the heat sticking to your skin. First love, the kind that leaves its mark. Debaser is like that: warm, humid, irresistibly sensual.. Notes of long green stems open the scene, followed by the juicy depth of dark fig. Light woods add an enveloping softness, while white musk adds a moist, evanescent touch. Tonka bean, with its coumarin and vanilla nuances, closes the circle with a carnal and magnetic sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Grapefruit Generation Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Grapefruit Generation draws inspiration from the spirit of the 1960s, a time of cultural revolution and soul-searching. The fragrance pays homage to Yoko Ono's Grapefruit , reinterpreting its imagery with the aura of a rarefied oriental garden, imbued with an almost mythological freshness.. The result is a perfume that invites you to look inside yourself, to create, to let yourself be carried away by a light yet powerful energy.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga I Don’t Know What Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: I Don't Know What is an enhancer that transforms any oil into an intense, long-lasting fragrance. It's a secret blend of raw materials that perfumers use to make the notes of a composition shine. A bergamot accord highlights fresh nuances, vetiver acetate adds a soft amber tone, firsantol provides a lingering sandalwood note, Iso E Super adds luminosity... and so on.. Imagine it like the airy scaffolding of a building: you simply fill the interior with the oil or perfume you love—even the one that's long lost its scent. I Don't Know What gives body, depth, and presence to everything it encounters.. The result is a transparent and luminous amplifier that infuses each fragrance with that certain, as the French would say, je ne sais quoi : irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Italian Citrus Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Italian coast is pure magic: a landscape capable of putting everyone back in their place, with those endless roads that climb and intertwine above the dazzling blue of the Mediterranean. Secret corners, tables set outdoors, slow conversations, the pleasure of not being rushed. Old vintage cars whizzing by elegantly, white suits, ties, and dresses in sunny colors. Wonderful people, brilliant life.. There's something special about spraying on a perfume that evokes those places where everything seems brighter. Italian Citrus is an invigorating cologne, built on a range of citrus zests: chinotto, blood orange, cold-pressed lemon, and green mandarin, underpinned by ambrette seeds and musk.. The result is a rich, juicy, vibrant fragrance—and surprisingly long-lasting. A hymn to the Mediterranean dolce vita.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Jazmín Yucatan Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Yazmin Yucatan was created to showcase the cultural and wild richness of the Yucatán: a land of dense jungles, mysterious Mayan ruins, and flora straight from a tropical dream. It's an invitation to lose yourself, to be captivated, to experience the ancient magic that still pulses beneath every stone.. The opening unleashes an explosion of bright citrus and pink pepper: immediate, vibrant, and full of energy. A rich and sensual floral heart follows, where jasmine, ylang-ylang, and orchid intertwine in a warm and exotic bouquet.. The trail rests on an enveloping base of vanilla, musk, and cedar, providing depth, softness, and a lasting finish that lingers for hours. A fragrance that captures the soul of the peninsula and infuses it into the skin.

listings.description: Leatherize Eau de Parfum is a sensory journey that begins with the instinctive call of the skin, that primordial vibration that evokes freedom, power, and movement. From windswept steppes, where horses run wild, to metropolitan streets ridden by untamed motorcyclists, the fragrance traverses eras and imaginations.. Here, the leather is modern, subtle, almost translucent: a filter that amplifies and transforms every other aroma. With floral notes—rose, orange blossom, ylang-ylang—LEATHERIZE transforms the petals into living, warm, pulsating leather. Paired with patchouli, incense, and amber, it becomes an ally that intensifies the depth of these essences, creating a dynamic interweaving of scents that enhance and reinvent each other.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: "It's hot, but the sea breeze brings cool, salty air in the late afternoon. The cloudless sky looks east over the Atlantic. Seagulls soar high above cutters, sloops, and scoonahs. The edges of the beach are carpeted with single-petalled rosa rugosa bushes. The musk rose. So fresh and fruity, purple in the summer sun. In late summer, the rose hips are a bright tomato red. They're tart and full of seeds. They hang heavily on glossy, deep-green leaves. Honeysuckle, black raspberry, and other vines entwine among the dune grass. [...] This perfume isn't just a rose. It has the ocean, the delicate petals, the green stem, the waxy leaves, and the cool, idyllic dust of summer. It's a perfume for every day."

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Sweet Do Nothing Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Suspended moments, extraordinary orange blossoms, a dip in a rock-cut pool, cacti, life at a slow pace. The residents of El Cosmico have their own way of describing the timeless encounter between nomadic friends in the high deserts of West Texas: "Sweet Do Nothing." It's a state of mind you can invite, but never force. Here, everything slows down: the landscapes expand, the horizon seems just a stone's throw away.. This perfume captures just that suspension. A harmony of orange blossom, flowering cactus, Texas cedar, fig, and creosote—the warm, earthy vibration of the desert distilled into an eternal moment.

listings.description: Iris, Orange Blossom, Cashmeran.A Floral, Citrus unisex fragrance evoking secret love, created by Fanny Bal for D’ORSAY.A fragrance that keeps you in the tangy moment before… Yes, that one, just before… It is a fragrance of absolution with a hint of Iris, a wind of forbidden mixed with Orange Blossom. listings.description: Saffron, Black Pepper, Nagarmotha, Benjoin.An Amber leathery fragrance, evoking unconditional love, imagined by Vincent Ricord for D'ORSAY.V.H. is a fragrance of conviction illuminated by the golden light of Saffron. This fragrance will take you on a journey... From the look you exchanged to Varanasi, drawing promises on your skin with Henna. A story caressed by Roses picked in the valleys of the East, protected by Benzoin brought from Java.

At the fifth aurora borealis, we fall tenderly into a space-time rift where Musk and Sandalwood lull us to sleep... until the night of time.

listings.rawTitle: Duchessa di Parma Profumo alla Violetta Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The story links the perfume symbol of the city of Parma to the Duchess Maria Luigia, Napoleon's second wife.The violet was particularly loved by the Duchess as a symbol and as a color and it was Maria Luigia who encouraged the research and experiments of the friars of the Convent of the Annunciata, who were able to extract from the violet and its leaves a particular essence perfectly equal to the perfume. of the flower.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Almanera Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The perfume is a promise...There are a lot of elements and reflections that gave life to the almanera perfume ... a game of chess in which the freshness of star anise, the sweetness of dried fruit and caramelized sugar, the warmth of rose and milk (white) won. , but above all the promise of the smell of coffee has won ... that small quantity of black liquid, which for many represents the beginning and the end but anyway it always represents a certainty.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Don’t Call Me Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: We are the sum of our history, our experiences and our past. We are who we are; because everything in us has left a mark, and we often judge the lives of others for everything we have experienced, seen, heard and felt. We tend to simplify reality, giving a quick label, a judgement, a verdict; but we are often deceived by first impressions, because we choose the easiest path, the fastest one, but not everything is as it seems.I'm speaking to you... if you think you know me, you're wrong because of what you're seeing or hearing now... I ask you to wait, to be curious, to give yourself time and ask me questions, don't judge me, don't call me by any name, I'm not whatever you think...there is a story behind me. Do you want to hear it?

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Eremo Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Simplicity is the fundamental essence of refinement."Live on the sidelines, to be in the heart of the world". Hermitage, is the symbol of those who want to immerse themselves in a private, intimate and solitary place. Whoever dresses Eremo, symbolically, wants, at least for a moment, to be estranged from the world, to get back in touch with the world. Spiritual reflection, rediscovery of places abandoned in childhood, removal from the existential void and from the stress of everyday life. The Hermitage is peace and serenity. Eremo is a strong, clean, fresh perfume with a woody twist. The refinement of this fragrance can be perceived from the first second, thanks to the freshness of basil and lavender that mix with the notes of tobacco and hay, deep and warm, almost hypnotic that give the fragrance that feeling of calm and tranquility typical of a country house. Finally we feel a mix of fresh pungent woodland green typical of cypress and the wild note of cistus that blend with the warmth of sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Frida Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Elegance and kindness have an irresistible charm!An extremely refined and elegant perfume, a metallic rose, gentle, unobtrusive but always present... which is enhanced by the light woods, and by the amber notes, which are given energy and freshness by the champagne accord, as a moment of celebration of all of our elements.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Gitano Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: I travel around the world, but my favorite place is in your perfume."Being Gypsies in the soul means not being found where the others settle. The Gypsies of the soul have infinite departures."The Gypsy is curious and uncomfortable because he is free and does not let himself be imprisoned easily by the conformism of the common society. Where the others stop Gitano leaves and travels. Gitano is second life, clothes patched, torn, then adorned with creative patchworks, make us think that life always gives us a second chance, and that to live it you need a free and light soul.Gitano is a powerful, woody, leathery, animalic scent. Gitano has a strong, determined character. starts immediately very decisive and warm thanks to the labdanum and the rose Bulgarian, which warm the ground, to welcome a riot of woods, such as oud and cypriol which with their smokiness characterize the fragrance, patchouli and jasmine make this animalic fragrance more rounded and wise. Sandalwood and amber, full of wisdom and continue this spiritual journey into the precious and highly prized world of woods.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Merci Cafè Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: 4 Rue LEPIC – ParisIt’s 3:00 AM, and that’s when you need your courage the most – that moment when you feel alone and come face-to-face with what you’re going through; everything feels like an impossible mountain to climb. Your heart beats fast, anxiety builds, you pace the room endlessly, look out the window and see the streetlamps, some flickering – as if they too are struggling. Constant flashes of darkness and light, darkness and light.Then it’s 4:00, then 5:00, and your gaze is lost in the void, until you hear the first birds chirping. The sun begins to rise, the street stirs with life, and the massive mountain begins to shrink. It’s 6:30 in the morning, you open the window to breathe in the fresh air, and right then, from a little patisserie down the street, the smell of coffee reaches you.The mountain is gone. Because, like it or not, all around the world, coffee marks the start of a new day. The sun has risen, and that scent of coffee gives me the strength to move forward and begin my life again.Here in Paris, everything is much clearer now. Merci Café.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Otello Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Talking about love, I imagined its perfume. The concept between sweet and salty, between good and evil, between black and white ... are the soul of this fragrance, super persistent. The chili pepper helps the sweet part of the fragrance, to be pungent, to be respected ... to bring out its energetic, lively, dynamic side. The toasted hazelnut, on the other hand, rounds the angularity of the spices and helps pure cocoa to express itself in all its smokiness. Vanilla, honey and patchouli fix the determination of the perfume's character, with the elegance and charm that distinguish them.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Sultan Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: It was your perfume that made me immortal.Sensual, hot and Mysterious… Of Sultan we can certainly say that it is an olfactory experiment... well done.The note Saffron, bittersweet, intimate like terraceo honey mixes with the bursting freshness of grapefruit and cloves, pungent and lively. The whiskey accord gives an unprecedented charm to this sweet oriental fragrance. The white rose and cedar wood open the way to woods such as oud and sandalwood, increasing the mystery, and black amber intensifies the charm of this perfume that makes us fly to the east with sweetness and preciousness.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Thelycheeus Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In a hidden corner among the hills, where the wind danced through green tea plantations and lychee trees, there was a village called Thelycheeus. A place where time seemed to stop, where the world flowed in a slow embrace of stillness. But for Sofia, that village, once a refuge, had become too small, too confining. Every breath felt heavy, as if she were a prisoner of a life she had not chosen, as if she were living the life someone else had chosen for her.Every day was the same: the expectations of others weighed heavily on her heart, an invisible straitjacket seemed to imprison her in something she had never been allowed to choose. Her dreams, buried deep within, felt like a distant echo, silenced by the fear of facing the truth. Yet within her, a flame burned that never went out, a desire for change she dared not embrace.One day, as she walked through the green tea fields, the wind whispered a secret to her. The scent of fresh leaves wrapped around her, sweet as an embrace. The words of the wind were clear: “Do not fear change, embrace it with patience and trust.” The green tea, growing with determination, spoke to her of strength born of time, of change that comes slowly, but ultimately brings peace.Soon after, the scent of lychee, sweet and powerful, struck her like a revelation. The exotic fruit, hidden among the leaves, spoke to her of itself, of its rough beauty, of the strength hidden behind every imperfection. Sofia looked at it and saw herself. Tough on the outside, but with a hidden beauty, ready to bloom.Each time the scent of green tea and lychee surrounded her, something inside her lit up. The tea gave her calm and resilience, the lychee showed her that beyond difficulties, there was a sweetness ready to blossom. And so, one night, after deep reflection, Sofia understood: she would no longer fear change. Like the green tea, she would learn to face it with patience; like the lychee, she would reveal her beauty, her truth.With her heart beating fast, Sofia stood up. She breathed deeply the fresh air of Thelycheeus, and the wind, like a promise, enveloped her. The scent of green tea and lychee caressed her like an awakening, like a hug from destiny. In that moment, as the wind touched her face, Sofia took the first step toward her new life.A step of courage, an act of freedom. It was no longer just a physical step, but a cry of life, a dance of rebirth. And as the wind continued to blow through the green tea leaves and the lychee trees, Sofia understood that every change, however painful, was necessary. Every step, every sorrow, had led her to the best version of herself – and now, finally, she could breathe.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Vanesia Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Beauty is pleasant to the eyes, but the scent fascinates the soul.Is it really frivolous and silly to take care of yourself? Highlighting one's physical, intellectual or moral qualities sometimes makes us appear vain and frivolous, and makes all of this appear wrong, when it is not. For Epico 'vanity is as if it were a work of the theater; it means looking, getting used to observing, immersing oneself and contemplating; no one would be vain if he couldn't see himself and, above all, if he couldn't be seen.Vanesia is the expression of an inner language, which does not want to impress, but fascinates in its simplicity. In the opera the first two actors, are bergamot and yellow mandarin that stand out immediately, thanks to their role of light and that of energy and freshness and just as we were in the theater, the iris becomes the soundtrack that will accompany the whole Opera.It starts slowly with a light introduction, but which helps the other characters to come out and have their say, as happens with the delicacy of the violet and the liveliness of the ginger, but while the work reaches the heart of its show the iris enters on stage and grows, grows more and more, thanks to an orchestra that supports it, made of cedar wood, muscho and a tonca bean that embraces and comforts her. The work of love of vanity for oneself ends with a predominant iris, delicate, sweet and fascinating for the soul.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Vanì Charnel Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Love is recognizing each other through a perfume.Vanì charnel, is the taste of a night of love. Which is described in this poem I wrote.The scent of the soul: this exchange of us is a game of head. Because tonight with tea will have a different flavor... Come closer.  Cling to me so as not to fall, sink your nails into my back. And close your eyes, I walk the curves of your hips with my hands and I feel something sliding down... I feel your breath growing in my ear, I want to hear new words of forbidden thoughts... I want to find the most hidden part of you, the most secret, I want to find what you don't even know .. I want to feel your skin on mine caressing the desire that comes... the taste of your freshly bitten lip and your wet hair between your mouth. I feel your belly move slowly, and the pleasure grow... I want your eyes and I want your gaze.. Yell out... I want to feel you mine for this night, mine... mine alone... I caress your breasts with the warm oil of a consumed candle... and I chase the drop that falls down into the navel and beyond... I lose my breath, I take my breath and go up, I kiss you... again I go down and I lose my breath... I want to touch your lips and feel your legs tighten. I feel your hands tremble and your strength pushing me to you... I want to smell the scent of the soul and get where no one has gone so far... I want you.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Vanì Noire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: I don't know the question,but your perfume is definitely the answer.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Vanì Rhum Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: It all started with a fantasy, with a dream...the game was to make it real. We experienced fantastic moments of rebirth. We closed with the uncertainty of believing in destiny and took our lives into our own hands. We were preparing to love again, without canceling ourselves...without falling into the fears of those who don't know you and thinking they love you want to change you. Aware that we were not new people, but just ourselves... we ran to drink a pint of sunshine, to warm up what had been in the cold for too long. In this change, we were certain of one thing...that you cannot truly love if you don't love yourself. You never forget your first love...and I had forgotten about myself. I hope you have wonderful moments wearing this perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Will Be Love Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Because you realize it's her from the little things. You realize it's her, that while she's looking for space in her messed up life, she gives you a caress of love to give you courage and not make you feel alone.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the radiant Winsor violet of Escentric 01, the colour of star- stained dusk, the colour of touch. Iso E Super is a molecule that hovers close to the skin to create an indefinable aura around the wearer.Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris, balsamic notes, and fresh musk.Geza Schoen: "I wanted to create something unconventional, not too perfumistic, something for my friends who said they didn't like fragrance."

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Shift the spectrum of your reality with the basking golden tangerine of Escentric 02.Ambroxan has a subtle sensual quality with a radiant, long-lasting drydown.Escentric 02 contains 13.5% Ambroxan (13.5% is the maximum percentage of Ambroxan that can be dissolved in a fragrance compound. Any more, and the Ambroxan begins to crystallise out of the solution) in a formula designed to amplify its mineral note with hedione (green jasmine bud), a 'gin and tonic' accord, and a hint of the Austrian lemonade called almdudler. Schoen describes the final effect as "super-longlasting freshness into the drydown, with a subtle sensuality."

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Let the soothing sap green of Escentric 03 conjure up odour images and pull you into a lush fantasy of multisensorial overload.Vetiveryl Acetate could be described as a hybrid molecule, half-natural, half-synthetic. It is a fraction of vetiver oil distilled from the roots of an Indian grass, which is then ‘crossed’ with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root.Escentric 03 focuses on Vetiveryl Acetate in a formula that pays tribute to the three roots used in perfumery: vetiver, ginger and orris, which is extracted from the roots of the Florentine iris. "I wanted Escentric 03 to bring out the scent impressions of these roots,” says Geza Schoen, “and show how they harmonise with each other."Ginger dominates the top note, which is vibrant, green and spicy with lime peel and green peppercorn. The heart is rich, velvety orris with Egyptian jasmine and tea notes. The drydown emphasises the dark green woodiness of vetiver together with sandalwood, cedar, mellow balsams and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Enter the synaesthetic palette of Escentric 04, robed in diluted magenta and flushed with salacious grapefruit.Javanol is a sandalwood-type molecule that retains the radiance and endurance of natural sandalwood, but is sheer and transparent like no sandalwood in nature.Escentric 04 focuses on Javanol in a formula that highlights the grapefruit accent in the molecule. The result is a uniquely fresh interpretation of a sandalwood fragrance, fizzing with crisp, bitter topnotes of pink grapefruit peel with added zest of lime. Juniper and pink pepper give an extra shot of freshness, and marijuana brings out the softer quality of the grapefruit pith.The heart is orris with a ‘fresh soft rose’ composed from four different rose ingredients. The drydown is balsamic and woody with Javanol in combination with the somewhat sweeter sandalwood molecule, Polysantol.“In the other Escentric fragrances I used a huge amount of the Molecule,” says Geza Schoen. “But Javanol is like truffles. A few slices of truffle shaved on top of your pasta are enough to transport you to heaven.”Consequently Javanol and Polysantol together make up 15% of Escentric 04.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 05 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the cerulean blue of Escentric 05, a portal to the summerscapes of the Mediterranean.“Cashmeran is dry, radiant, warm and woody with an unexpected touch of pine resin,” says Geza Schoen. “That gave me the idea of creating a different kind of summer fragrance. I wanted to evoke what it was like to be by the sea, but not by using the usual marine notes, which I find too artificial. Instead, I wanted to recreate the experience of being on an island in the Mediterranean.The top note of Escentric 05 is very simple: bergamot to keep things light, and orange, an ingredient which has an emotional tone to it, bright and happy. It reflects the orange groves that cover this island.Laurel and rosemary are typical Mediterranean plants with a spicy freshness, juniper brings a herbal tonality and cypress is a very dry, pungent wood.The drydown has two classic Mediterranean ingredients, cistus labdanum and mastic. Mastic is a resin produced by a small tree that grows especially near the sea. It has the clean sharp scent of newly-cut branches. Cistus is a small plant that grows everywhere in the Med. It has a sweet, leathery, balsamic quality which I love. And of course, there is around 15% of cashmeran - which gives the fragrance its piney warmth.For this fragrance was introduced a subtle fig, both the bitterness of the leaves and the ripeness of the fruit. Figs had to be in there because there is a fig tree by our house on the island. Fig feels authentic to the place, it reminds me of the happiness of summer by the sea.

It reflects the orange groves that cover this island.Laurel and rosemary are typical Mediterranean plants with a spicy freshness, juniper brings a herbal tonality and cypress is a very dry, pungent wood.The drydown has two classic Mediterranean ingredients, cistus labdanum and mastic. Mastic is a resin produced by a small tree that grows especially near the sea. It has the clean sharp scent of newly-cut branches. Cistus is a small plant that grows everywhere in the Med. It has a sweet, leathery, balsamic quality which I love. And of course, there is around 15% of cashmeran - which gives the fragrance its piney warmth.For this fragrance was introduced a subtle fig, both the bitterness of the leaves and the ripeness of the fruit. Figs had to be in there because there is a fig tree by our house on the island. Fig feels authentic to the place, it reminds me of the happiness of summer by the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette 30 ml
listings.description: Molecule 01 consists of 100% Iso E Super, pure and singular. It combines with - almost caramelises with - your own smell to meld into a personal scent signature.Molecule 01 has been said to cause animal magnetism - a latter-day love potion. Geza used the beautifully mysterious and democratic aroma-molecule Iso E Super as the star of this juice. He felt it expressed everything a perfumer could want: radiance, tenacity, and power."Iso E Super is one of those scents that makes you want to nestle into it. It's comforting and cocooning," says Geza Schoen.Molecule 01 has a marked intermittence. To the wearer, it seems to vanish and then re-appear. This is due to the way it sits with receptors in the olfactory system, only slowly releasing to make it easy for a new charge of the molecule on the receptors.Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973."Molecule 01 is for the individual who might be a bit bored with fragrance and would prefer to radiate an aura. It's difficult to call a single aroma-chemical a fragrance - it's so much more personal," says Geza.Molecule 01 is a cult classic of today that remains as disruptive and avant-garde as the day it was first bottled.
