listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Agarwood Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The elegant scent that surrounds a Japanese temple.An elegant and sophisticated fragrance that was inspired by the scent of incense that surrounds Japanese temples. This is not an animalic oud type of agarwood. The combination of the incense with the transparent sweetness of orange peel gives this scent an elegant touch. The presence of natural woody notes such as cedarwood and patchouli with the spicy cinnamon-accent turns this into a refined and modern oud, creating a mysterious allure.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Aurantium Jasmine Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Scent of aurantium blossom bathing in warm sunlight.Inspired by the scenery of the people of Japan appreciating the sun, as we do for the first sunrise of the year, this scent expresses the warmth of the sun and the fresh aurantium blossoms bathing in sunlight. The fresh fragrance of the pure white orange-blossom changes over time to the white floral of jasmine, then into a sweet white musk embracing in sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Beyond Oblivion Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Myoga is an edible flower bud or herb that you can only find in Japan. It is referred to as Japanese ginger. Long ago, it was said in Japan that if you eat this myoga, it made you forget and lose your memory. Forgetfulness was not considered to be unfortunate because there is deep sorrow in life. The process of forgetting and overcoming will lead you into a new stage. This fragrance expressing such philosophy of life is dynamic and challenging, taking you beyond oblivion.The green herbal top starts with the scent of myoga which is refreshing but bitter at the same time. Then followed by the aromatic notes of green tea with the white floral of  tuberose, jasmine, and gardenia, leaving the faint scent of hinoki cypress, vetiver, and dry woody expressing the beauty of nature.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Cafe Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: This fragrance recreates enjoying a coffee in a Showa-era retro coffee shop. The contrast of the bitterness of roasted coffee beans and the sweetness of orange blossom brings a sparkle, and the dry down of a caramel-like romantic gourmand note expresses this old-fashioned atmosphere. Underneath the glittering contrast between bitter and sweet, the warmth of the final notes of vanilla and musk reminds you of a romance from bygone days.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Hakka Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Fresh, transparent, and breathtaking.This fragrance sublimates the scent of mint into a delicate, fine fragrance. It starts off with a cool feeling of transparent mint, then the subtle sweet aroma of jasmine and lilies arises, turning into a fresh and natural fragrance with clean irises and white musk that spreads lightly throughout. When putting it on your skin, you may feel a cooling sensation from the minty menthol.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Hanamachi Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A sensual and lustrous atmosphere of Hanamachi, the geisha district.The so-called “Hanamachi” used to be the area where geishas gathered. This intriguing scent evokes the passion of an “oiran,” the highest-ranking courtesan, expressing the contradictory charms of innocence yet being lustrous at the same time. Iris adds ravishing powdery notes to an alluring bouquet of rose and violet. The sensual scent of agarwood's decadence creates a beautiful harmony reminding you of bygone days.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Hanamizake Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Scent of cherry blossom petals ﬂuttering down into a sake cup.Hanamizake refers to drinking Japanese sake underneath the cherry blossom trees while enjoying the arrival of spring. This fragrance expresses such scenery where cherry blossom petals slowly flutter down into your sake cup. The marriage of cherry blossom floral and “ginjo” sake aroma will dance gloriously from the top to the middle into the last musk note which fades out pleasantly as if you were slightly tipsy, inviting you to this beautiful hanami (cherry blossom viewing) experience.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Honey & Lemon Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The pure scent of melty tasty honey and fresh lemon.The balsamic sweetness of honey intertwines with the freshness of lemon, expressing the sweet and sour memories of youth hidden in its freshness. This perfume starts with a fresh and simple scent of lemon, which is harmoniously blended with undertones of rose and jasmine. The nostalgic and bittersweet fragrance brings a heartwarming purity wrapped in a gentle and melty sweet base of honey.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Hydrangea Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of clean and beautiful hydrangea on a rainy afternoon.Japan has a rainy season from June to July, which we refer to as “tsuyu.” Hydrangea is a symbolic flower during this rainy season. This fragrance evokes the scenery of quietly appreciating hydrangea flowers blooming in the gentle rain. Hyacinth and violet meet the fresh floral scent of jasmine and iris, combining with a hint of cedarwood undertone. This fresh floral scent, combined with the humidity and the smell of soil, expresses the uniqueness of this season.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Koiame Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A story of rain and love.A scent that reminisces the joy and how your heart dances when finding a rainbow shimmering in the sky after the rain. The top-note is a faint aroma of mandarin and cassis, like the smell of air just before the rain. Then it starts to rain quietly, with whispers of violets and magnolias, which awakens a special memory of a past love. And finally, the scent turns into sunshine, and you find a rainbow in the sky, also finding your heart dancing with joy.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Paper Soap Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A nostalgic soap scent with a fresh feel and creamy sweetness.Paper Soap is different from that of a simple soap because it spawns a fresh and creamy sweetness with a touch of nostalgia. First comes the freshness of lavender and aldehyde, then combined with the sweetness of rose, jasmine, and muguet flowers spreads, harmonizing into a gentle musk, which will open the gate to nostalgic memories.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Ramune Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Nostalgic scent of corking open a ramune bottle.Ramune is a traditional Japanese soda pop that comes in a unique pale blue glass bottle whose mouth is sealed with a glass marble. There is always a sense of excitement when corking this glass ball while opening this drink. The refreshing scent of ramune will cool your body on a sizzling summer night. This perfume starts with the clear notes of lemon, aldehyde, and mint, then brings the gentle sweet notes of rose, muguet, and magnolia, eventually leaving behind the notes of musk and vanilla, relaxing the senses. Evoking an old summer festival memory, lighting your heart with nostalgic dreamy paper lanterns.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Roasted Green Tea Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The premium aroma of roasted tea leaves when brewed.The uniqueness of this fragrance is that it portrays “hojicha (roasted green tea),” a tea that is popular and well consumed by the people of Japan. The scent combines the roasted crispness of the tea leaves when brewed with the creaminess of steaming milk. Also, the existence of gyokuro (high-grade green tea) and seaweed accents creates a pleasant depth that gently diffuses.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Sacred Animal Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance inspired by the legend of the divine beast, Tenko. Tenko is the name of the highest-ranking fox that turned to be holy through aging 1000 years and has the power to foresee the future as a servant to God. Although the animal fox is portrayed as being mischievous in many stories, Tenko is considered to be God-like. It features an animalic scent but is completely animal-free. The scent contains a nostalgic warmth within.A fragrance with euphoric scents of cognac and chocolate, followed by the sweetness of cocoa and vanilla reminiscent of the soft and fluffy fur of the animal. The last has sandalwood and leather, expressing the warmth of life.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Shaft of Light Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of warmth that emerges from the shaft of light from heaven to nature.Inspired by the scenery where lights shine like a ladder straight down from the clouds to the ground in the forest. This light represents warmth and life that are shed on grasses and trees, which are bathing in nature. The light showers down upon grapefruit and lemon trees, and creamy white ﬂowers like magnolias and gardenias. This perfume's warm tones of sandalwood, patchouli, and oakmoss remind us of nature's power of life.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Sumo Wrestler Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of bintsuke (hair oil) subtly ﬂoating from digniﬁed sumo wrestlers.Sumo wrestlers use a special wax called “bintsuke oil” to style their hair. When a sumo wrestler passes by, you can smell a dignified scent that faintly follows them, which includes a tint of this traditional hair oil. Eucalyptus and anise give this perfume an aromatic scent, and the notes of violet and heliotrope create a powdery scent, then turning into musk with the combination of patchouli and sandalwood. This scent represents a powerful sumo wrestler with a gentle incense-like warmth.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Tender Peach Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Captivating scent of the iconic Japanese peach.The cultivation of the Japanese peach represents the delicacy and thoughtfulness of the people of Japan. Starting from the green fragrance which represents the yet unripe fruit, then gradually changing to the sweetness and delicacy of the peach, finally into creamy sandalwood and musk offering a velvety accord. This natural, alluring fragrance has notes of the enrapturing sweetness of tuberose which represent the sensuality hidden deep within.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Ume Amaretto Oath Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: There was a time in Japan when we adored watching the Ume (Japanese plum) flowers compared to the now well-known Sakura (cherry blossoms). Ume blossoms are a symbol of “elegance” and “grace.” We eat the fruit of the Ume as picked plum.  Amaretto, the liquor which tastes a bit bitter, goes well when mixed with various flavors. The Japanese plum falls in love with Amaretto, creating a tasty Japanese and Western harmony.This harmony starts with notes of red plum, perilla, and amaretto. From there, the rose and jasmine add gorgeousness to this scent. The chocolate and amber in the last notes express an aromatic love story about love with a sip of alcohol.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Yawahada Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A sensual scent inspired by Yasunari Kawabataʼs novel, "The House of the Sleeping Beauties".Yawahada is not a perfume that makes a strong statement, but a fragrance that has been created to trigger the unconscious. The refreshing notes of fruit resonate to the nose, then the soft sweetness of milk and rice powder arrives, and lastly, the smooth aroma of sandalwood and musk warms your body. This perfume invites you to a fantastical and sensual world, a world of daydreams, where you can forget about your daily life.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Yuzu Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Refreshing scent of Japanese citrus yuzu and thyme.Yuzu is a familiar citrus of Japan and is used in the same way as lemons are, to add freshness, acidity, and toppings to dishes. This citrus fragrance is full of sizzle and expresses everything about yuzu, from the astringency of its peel to the sweet and sour taste of its pulp. A ﬁne citrus accord of bergamot and orange with the distinguishing presence of yuzu and herbal thyme. Yuzu adds to the perfume a bittersweet accent. The lustrous aroma of Japanese citrus yuzu is sensuously fresh and elegantly sweet.

listings.rawTitle: J.U.S Parfums Andaluiza Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Andaluiza is an astonishing, lively, and vibrant garden. The combinations are bold, the assosciations unexpected. The fruity and hearty arrangements are immediately transformed by the vigorous zest of mandarin essence from madagascar. The heat gradually intensifies: the cistus flowers deliver strong amber notes, the essence of atlas cedar bears witness to the strength of a dry and powerful wood, resistant to the test of time. The incandescence is softened, as this intensity is refined by ambergris and vetiver.

listings.description: Bloomastral is a tribute to the most singular of jasmines: the Galant de Nuit. This variety has the specificity of revealing its perfume only at nightfall. Its generous clusters of white flowers open up to offer a powerful and intoxicating, intriguing and opulent fragrance.. The fragrance of Galant de Nuit oscillates between notes of Jasmine and Tuberose. Its fruity and green freshness is reminiscent of Egyptian Jasmine with the milky roundness and spicy sensuality of Tuberose.

listings.description: A tribute to a new and captivating freshness. A refreshing fougère sublimated by the delicate scent of Long Jing tea.

listings.rawTitle: J.U.S Parfums Spicydelice Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An opulent and colorful whirlwind, spicydelice is devilishly irresistible. The creation opens with a rich bouquet of spices: cardamom, ginger, pink berries, pepper, nutmeg, cinnamon, and cloves intermingle and join together. The floral and liquorice facet of the davana, equally masculine as feminine, breathes a luminous glow into this playful dance. Finally, the vetiver, patchouli, and sandalwood mingle with the warm, suave vanilla, bringing depth to a resolutely voluptuous and playful creation.

listings.description: Spritzlove offers a light-dark contrast. On one hand, the sparkling and luminous accords of this venetian cocktail anchor the creation in contagious joy. On the other, the smoky and rich notes of oud wood bring density and an enveloping, dark texture. The scent is unified by the sensuality of a rose mixed with vetiver, and a golden accord of saffron and cistus absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Jehanne Rigaud Ambre Obscur Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Amber is the secretion of the Sperm Whale, a cetacean that lives in the Indian Ocean by releasing this substance naturally into the water. This raw material is carried by the waves and sometimes floats for decades on the sea. The sun and the water of the oceans purify it until it takes on the sweet and unmistakable scent of the sea and leather that has fascinated man since its origin.When the Amber is fresh, it is black in colour, but dried in the sun, it turns grey and, in addition to its waxy consistency, takes on a delicious perfume that is sometimes reminiscent of tobacco. The waves deposit it on the beaches of Madagascar and often after months of floating it drifts into the Indian Ocean. It is one of the most precious fragrances of animal origin. As it matures it acquires an intense musky, oriental and persistent odour and this is why it has always been a highly sought-after perfumed raw material.

listings.rawTitle: Jehanne Rigaud Imperial Poudre Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Imperial Poudré by Jehanne Rigaud is a captivating fragrance where the talcumed note of iris combines with the sweet and soft notes of Bourbon vanilla and heliotrope. The trail, persistent and refined, rich in floral notes leaves a heady poudré scent in the air.

listings.rawTitle: Jehanne Rigaud Patchouli Premier Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Patchouli Premier by Jehanne Rigaud is the perfect fusion of the sensual note of natural patchouli with the seductive note of myrrh, oak moss and Bourbon vanilla. Patchouli Premier boasts 70% natural raw materials and 50% pure patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Jehanne Rigaud Vanille Blonde Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The scent of Vanilla has a strong seductive power, its hypnotic sweetness goes straight to the heart of those who love it and knows how to recognize it among a thousand essences, because nothing satisfies the senses like its softness.

listings.rawTitle: Jeroboam Ambra Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Taking on an olfactory family this well-known is no mean feat. It’s a testament to Vanina’s originality and creativity that this Ambra is very “Jeroboam”, in other words modern, daring and sensual.

listings.rawTitle: Jeroboam Boha Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Boha is constructed around a white flowers bouquet that evoke purity. An almost intimidating purity, like a gaze that runs through you with intensity. In his heart, gardenia mixes with jasmine and orange blossom and together burst into a compelling monotonous chant.The subtle, both delicate and opulent perfume will move you deeply and is worn like a provocation. Vanina Muracciole allowed herself to some eccentricities while adding to her musky base some ambery and woody note like sandalwood, reinforcing the sensual aura and the indelible sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Jeroboam Floro Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: An enchanting elixir that plays it close to the chest, FLORO will win the hearts of women and men alike. Pride of place goes to the formidable secret weapons each flower deploys to seduce or simply ensnare its prey. Enthralling!. How often have you been “caught on the fly” by a flurry of flowers, a powerful distillation of surprising, radiant, and seriously seductive fruity notes?. listings.rawTitle: Jeroboam Unue Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: It was in 2014 that London department store Selfridges first took a chance on a new born perfume brand called Jéroboam. With only 30ml extracts, the tiny Jéroboam bottles have travelled a long way since then. Whether in pockets, handbags or backpacks, Jéroboam fragrances have become the perfect accessory for those who like to seduce with just one spray.To pay tribute to those who UNUE (“FIRST” in Esperanto) launched Origino, Oriento, Vespero and the rest of the collection, this new extract designed once more by Vanina Muracciole, steps away from the original DNA of the brand. For the first time, Jéroboam – known for its black bottles – will appear in brilliant white with a redesigned carton that no longer requires cello wrap.As a token of gratitude from this French perfume house to Selfridges that so supported it, the visual by the French illustrator depicts a Royal Guard in a passionate embrace with a beautiful French revolutionary.This touch of humour, with its hint of spice, reminds us how much these two countries can, in spite of their differences, join forces and move forward towards a united future.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris 21 Conduit St Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Jovoy’s new fragrance, “21 Conduit St”, revisits a great classic of English perfumery while giving it a new, intriguing and decidedly modern twist. Whether the memory conjures dried flowers from Norfolk tucked into ornate sachets, or the fragrance of a bottle of authentic British Eau de Cologne, lavender is to English perfumery what scones are to teatime. The result of a creative tandem, 21 Conduit St gives the scent of lavender a singular brightness. The accord comes from a formula by Oli Marlow, whose fascination with this aromatic note goes back to his childhood. He dreamt of giving it greater contrast, making it more multi-facetted, upping the tangy, fruity freshness and warming it through with resinous notes.“It’s a lavender that’s chiseled from the freshness of cold, crisp oranges, the cheekiness of cassis and the bittersweet comforting warmth of pine”  Marlow explains. In Paris, his meeting with the perfumer Marie Schnirer (Laboratoire Maelstrom) opened the door to a new world of raw materials, most notably a quality of Javanese Vetiver that enriches the ensemble with a whorl of smoky, earthy notes. “It’s like a very original note of hashish”  Marie Schnirer observes.“But,” she adds, “above all, the secret of 21 Conduit St is the richness of its dual lavender - a very aromatic essential oil and an absolute with the coumarone notes of a plant that has spent several days drying in the sun - it radiates all the way through to the perfume’s woody base.”It’s also a lavender cloaked in the freshness of citrus and the fruity notes of fir balsam, whose candied accents evoke a tantalisingly soft amaretto accord, balanced by a mysterious, shadowy, woody facet. Sleek, intense, and daring, 21 Conduit St radiates English elegance tinged with a dash of impertinence that gives it all its charm. A signature perfume that beckons you back, again and again. A gentlemanly masterpiece that men will love - and women won’t be able to get enough of.

listings.description: Beware of first impressions… A sweet whisper brings to mind cotton candy – simple innocence, and yet Ambre Premier hides its real intentions and lives up to its name. Grandiose and out to conquer, it tattoos the skin with a voluptuous and indelible mark that leaves nothing to chance and even less to weakness. Night time is its preferred domain, passionate nights that are profound and sensual, where the heat of its lingering wake collides with the first light of dawn, as if to better defy the day.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Aqua Memorabilis Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: At first comes a wave of clementine poised between fruit and zest, a lively bouquet tinged with bittersweet green notes, with grapefruit, pink peppercorn and bitter orange sharing the lead. Pepper and violet delicately veil a decidedly fruity top note. A powerful wave of cedarwood a delicate wisp of vetiver, rounded out by creamy sandalwood and intense musk, rests on an "indelible" amber wood base."The delicacy and roundness of Italian clementine opens this powerful, harmonious fragrance. A warm, spicy heart reveals the nobility of sandalwood and vetiver, accompanied by an overdose of cedar. A touch of raspberry and oakmoss add sparkle to this volcanic accord."

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Fire at Will Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Vanilla and Mimosa, intensity and subtlety, seduction and enchantment, a perfume who delivers the promise of enticing encounters and a return to more lightness.In the beginning there’s vanilla, of course, but it’s an unexpected vanilla, subtle, ethereal, as if suspended, with a unique note of honeyed, powdery mimosa. Next comes a vanilla that’s gourmand but not heady, fruity but not baked, poised between a “real” vanilla ice cream and sweet promises that echo like languorous kisses. An unambiguous fragrance trail, conceived like a beckon, arousing the appetite, and casting a spotlight on whoever wears it. Whether your personality is discreet or, to the contrary, completely intense, this perfume is made for those who wish never to go unnoticed again.. By day, you can wear it like a signature: you know I’m there, my perfume identifies me. By night, it envelops yuuo in sweet promises. It fills the space, slips into every corner of the mind and makes others feel a void when you move away. And if you're no longer around and your absence has not yet become overpowering, it must be that I left something behind: a scarf, a jacket, a little bit of myself.

It fills the space, slips into every corner of the mind and makes others feel a void when you move away. And if you're no longer around and your absence has not yet become overpowering, it must be that I left something behind: a scarf, a jacket, a little bit of myself.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris L’Arbre de la Connaissance Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: White and black, good and bad, wisdom and madness, sun and night… Ever since the beginning of time, the fig tree has revealed its magical, luminous and magnetic powers. Yet where, among its astonishing green freshness and its solar sensuality, lies the truth? Without a doubt, it is in the contentment that comes when thinking of nothing, letting ourselves slip little by little into absolute serenity, savoring the present moment exactly under the sun. The wisdom of this Tree of Enlightenment guides each of us to the discovery of our true desires.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris La Liturgie des Heures Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: A venerable Roman chapel in the south of Italy or a monastery lost in the perfumed hills of Greece… Here, time has no importance. There is only eternity. On the cool flagstones, worn to a satiny polish over the centuries, the Mediterranean summer's burning caress exalts an infinite love, almost holy. Suspended in the air a perfume of mysticism and mystery, hinting at a torrid, almost violent fever. Incense, olibanum and myrrh, immemorial aromas for entire, impetuous passion, ready for communion.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Musc Pallas Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: A clean perfume with powdery, floral, and fruity echoes, Musc Pallas is an original creation that gives pride of place to intense musks and a memorable trail. A resolutely iridescent bouquet with velvety peach notes, posed on a base of tonka and musk. A modern and heady powdery perfume that imparts a unique aura: your signature. “Perfume is a bit like an invisible aura, something reassuring and protective that delineates one’s territory. It signs a presence: it says you’ve been here or announces your arrival. With Musc Pallas, Vanina and I wanted to create a powerful perfume, with a distinctive trail, that would inhabit the space around its wearer. We wanted it to be in the image of an asteroid belt in perpetual revolution." François Hénin

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Pavillon Rouge Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: As daylight starts to decline, a schooner is busy readying itself to dock. “This one must be a privateer...” mumble the old people assembled in the port.Sucked in by the promises of the amber and vanilla aromas of rum and whiskey, a buccaneer rushes out onto the dock and blends into the crowd.A perfume of conquest and adventure, Pavillon Rouge is an ode to life. It invites conquering both day and night, without any fear and with the confidence of those who have braved death for some long-lost fortune or legendary glory.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Psychédélique Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Peace and love forever… This "revival" perfume pays homage to the '70s, the decade that transformed patchouli into the legendary scent of the counterculture. At all the festivals, from Wight to Woodstock, patchouli's woody and mysterious richness sang the backup vocals for the rock mindset of a new generation of rebellious youth. Today, it has made its comeback, more hippie-chic than ever and the boho-glam idol par excellence. It is a classic in its own right, with all of its audacity intact. Retro-nostalgia has never been so modern.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Remember Me Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: How many times have you let yourself be taken by surprise and found yourself enticed by a fragrance wafting from a café terrace, captivated by scent of a secret garden — or perhaps beguiled by an unforgettable perfume worn by a stranger in a crowd? And how many times have you secretly wished to be that anonymous stranger who captivates merely by virtue of a perfume?Like perfectly formed exotic dancers, frangipani flowers engage in an elaborate, spellbinding choreography. As the enchantment takes hold, a plume of traditional chai tea perfects the charm. Ginger and cardamom set ablaze an irresistible cloud of milky, gourmand notes.A spell in the guise of a perfume that murmurs Remember Me.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Touche Finale Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Whenever it appears that an artist’s work is finally finished, there is always a moment where a sense of doubt overwhelms the artist. Should they change a note? Do they need any more of this? Or a little less of that?But when the artist trusts their vision and makes their final stroke, any sense of doubt is replaced by an ultimate satisfaction. Then the only desire that follows is the will to reveal it to the world. This is the exact moment when a master decides that their work is finished. And this is the very moment that Jovoy has grasped and put into a bottle.This new perfume is also a tribute to the seductive souls who each have their own rituals of preparation. The slow, measured method of dressing. The make up, the rice powder... these are all a prelude to seduction. And even if their gestures are different and their secrets proper, they all share a common ritual: their ‘final touch’ is the application of perfume.Touche Finale is a reinterpretation of a perfume that has already left it’s mark in the history of the rebirth of Jovoy: 2006’s renowned Poudré. After more than two years of work, the independent perfumer, Vanina Muracciole has managed to preserve the soul of the original Poudré, whilst exalting it, in this new, ultimate version.

With its gourmand fruity smell of Wild Strawberries, laying on a bed of voluptuous creamy notes and enticing Vanilla, Miami Shake is the ultimate scented treat to indulge."Her pink villa is the stage for her fantasies. She follows her own rules, and only hers. Red hair and big bows don't care, rollerblading in the villa and all-day dessert are a must. Whipped cream and wild strawberries, her favorite treat, savored while lying on her back like a diva. The strawberry on top of this sweet feast? Her edible fragrance, swirling around her dress like a fruity cloud. Miami Shake truly takes the cake!"The essence of Miami Shake begins with a burst of juicy Wild Strawberries, evoking the freshness of sun-ripened summer fruits. The heart notes reveal a rich whipped cream, adding a subtle and indulgent sweetness. In the base notes, a touch of silky Vanilla completes the composition, leaving a warm and irresistible impression.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Hair & Body Mist Hair fragrance 75 ml
listings.description: NOT A COLLETION contains only what you need, the purest ingredients and a unique scent.The clean, pure and minimalist scent of NOT a perfume is infused in this home & body collection. Not a Perfume is a unique molecular fragrance made of a single ingredient, called Cetalox. Usually used in perfumery as a base note, it plays here the leading role... The result is clean, minimalist, pure. A perfumery gem, which has the particularity of containing NO allergen. A unique property that inspired the creation of this cosmetic line.Enjoy Not a perfume’s Clean, Pure and Unique scent with this water-basedhair and body mist. An antioxidant formula targeted to balance pH levels in hair & skin PH to restore the hair shine and bring a luminous skin complexion. Bonus: a continuous atomizer spray for a sensuous beautifying gesture. Guaranteed free from parabens and artificials colorants.

A scent that plays with the light and the generosity of woody notes. A voluptuous fragrance. A royal elixir where the red gold of Saffron blends with the yellow gold of Amber.The promise of a wild nature revealed with sophistication will charm you and unveil with grace. Oil Fiction tells the tale of an elegant trail, suave and animal. Elegant and sophisticated, the bottle is presented in a bright, modern white lacquered box.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Äican Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the depths of darkness, I can seek the light. When faced with the impossible, I can persevere. If surrounded by negativity, I can choose love.ÄICAN, a beautiful Arabic term of deep significance, represents gold that has been purified of all imperfections. A piece of gold may lie for years, concealed beneath layers of earth and stone, yet even through the darkness, its radiance is not diminished. Optimism, fortitude, and a tenacious desire for improvement can erode those layers of impurity, revealing a truly astonishing brilliance. The power of positivity is ours to unleash. We all have the choice to embrace a new beginning and to shine once again, revealing the magnificence that has always resided within us."We can. You can. ÄICAN."ÄICAN was crafted from a passionate belief in the transformative power of optimism. It embodies an ardent aspiration to encapsulate the invigorating vibrance of positive energy into a fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Almaz Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A beauty so enchanting, it has enraptured people for centuries.A clarity so pure, one glimpse is enough to mesmerize. A love so powerful, its eternal radiance will forever shine.Treasured throughout history, precious gemstones have been sought after on many a quest. By far the most desired and cherished is the Almaz, a gem of legendary sparkling brilliance which symbolizes everlasting love, strength, and good health. Almaz, the Arabic name for diamonds, are renowned not only for their sublime beauty, but also for their timelessness as they withstand millions of years of immense pressure to form.

Dahab by Kajal is a fruity, ambery fragrance with a strong personality and unrivaled self-confidence. Its character exudes wealth and symbolizes the luxury and mystery of a magical, self-confident individual.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Jihan Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: ihan is… sacrifice.Jihan, the Arabic name given to the beautiful crocus flower, is symbolic of cheerfulness, joy, youthfulness, and glee. The flower appears at the first sign of spring. The Jihan flower can be found in white, purple, and yellow. The purple Jihan is the most prized, and it reflects pride, dignity, and success.. But it is the sacrificial aspect of Jihan that has captivated people for centuries: giving up something beautiful and valued for the sake of something else. The Jihan flower is sacrificed to give the famous threads that are used worldwide in cooking: saffron, one of the most expensive spices of the world.

A red rose is… joorie.Never mistreated, never mishandled, never abandoned.Joorie is the red rose in all its aspects of love, caring and confident.. Joorie is the red rose reflecting strength, supportive and dependable.. Joorie is the red rose in all its splendour, marvellous and beautiful.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Kajal Homme Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A scent that is charming, sincere and representative of a charismatic person. This fragrance is the first fragrance for men launched from the House of Kajal. The universal appeal that the fragrance has garnered has made it a favorite unisex perfume.Another unique feature is the fact that this is a great summer "oud" scent...for a person seeking to own a oud scent that can be worn in both the colder winter temperatures and equally enjoyed in higher summer temperatures.. The scent is rich, graceful, sleek and sexy.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Kajal III Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Amid times of great adversity, Courage may manifest in a myriad of ways. Endurance, fortitude, integrity, and hope, Guide us to sublime exhilaration. Memento Vivere.From time to time in our lives, we encounter unanticipated hardships. The battle we face may be physical, it may be spiritual, it may be within ourselves.We are not defined by our circumstances, but by how we choose to confront them. Bravery is not always a spectacular display of heroism. Sometimes, the strength to remain optimistic, the resolve to endeavor, and an ardent desire for life, are the most astonishing forms of courage of all.Symbolically, three is a powerful number which holds great significance as it represents the wholeness of a completed cycle. The past, the present, the future. Encapsulating spirited vibrance, Kajal III has been meticulously created to honor all forms of determination and fortitude.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Kajal IV Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Kajal IV is a celebration of nomadic exoticism, echoing the wilderness of the African Savannah.The warm embrace of a Sahara breeze, The intoxicating allure of adventure. Infinite grains of sand form an undulating golden panorama, vast and untamed, blending harmoniously into spectacular glowing skies. Sun kissed skin shimmers, evocative of the celestial stars soon to emerge. The gentle caress of a sultry, aromatic breeze encapsulates the elation of adventure. Our footprints may be a momentary reminder of our presence, but the memories we make last forever.Spiritually, four represents calmness and balance, the stability of feeling connected to the present moment. It also symbolizes the wholeness of the universe, four elements, four seasons, four cardinal points, connecting us all.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Kolada Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: When we radiate rays of gratitude. We bathe in a boundless ocean of abundance.Inspired by the iconic Pina Colada, Kajal Kolada pays homage to happiness, tranquility, and exoticism. The Pina Colada conjures visions of a lush, tropical paradise, where the emerald palm leaves of coconut groves gently sway as a blissfully balmy breeze caresses them, offering momentary respite from the sultry heat. Pristine ivory sands meet shimmering aquamarine waters, seamlessly blending into pastel-colored cotton candy skies as infinite as the hopes and dreams within us all.While we may long for the euphoria of exploring distant horizons, let us not overlook the myriad of blessings that surround us in our everyday existence. When we choose to focus on being truly present in the moment, we become aware of the vast treasures that enrich our lives, allowing us to cherish what may seem to be the smallest of things. Practicing gratitude is among the most precious gifts we can bestow upon ourselves, as it leads us to the tranquil beauty of inner peace and contentment, a realm of happiness beyond compare.Kolada opens with a delightfully vibrant burst of Italian Bergamot combined with fruity notes, including Pineapple, which symbolizes prosperity and friendship.The heart notes reveal the delicate sweetness of violet, exquisitely blended with the gentle freshness of Lily of the Valley, a flower believed by many to symbolize luck, happiness, and love.As Kolada unfurls, we are greeted with an exhilarating fusion of musky warmth from Amber and Siamese Benzoin, combined with the soft, exotic creaminess of coconut milk. Coconuts represent the unity of body, mind, and spirit, which must be in harmony for spiritual growth.Kajal Kolada. perfume meets paradise.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Lamar Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Lamar…beauty in a name, beauty in a bottle, beauty in a scent. A name with French origins Lumière, meaning light, Lamar is also known to be liquid gold: mesmerizing, fascinating and enticing. A scent created to resemble the beauty of a golden sun setting in the horizon. Distant clouds reflect rich rays of color: hues of red, streaks of yellow and shimmers of gold. The scent of Lamar evokes fragrant notes of rose and jasmine that float on a Mediterranean breeze. A magnificent scent.Lamar…magnificent beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Lamar Caviar Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: When we venture into the tantalizing lure of the unknown, we reveal the profound beauty of life’s infinite possibilities. Immersed in the mesmerizing depths of tropical lagoons, bathed in the luminous glow of sunlight cascading through the undulating waters, some of nature’s rarest treasures lie waiting to be unveiled, timelessly elegant, lustrous, Golden Pearls.Lamar Caviar by Kajal is the first ever ethanol-free fine fragrance to harness the innovation of Microcaps’ patented “perfume-pearls” technology, which introduces unique features that will redefine the future of the fine fragrance industry for both brands and consumers.Kajal, Microcaps AG and LUZI AG have collaborated to create Lamar Caviar by Kajal.This precious, water-based fragrance oil is encapsulated within alginate pearls, preserving the scent until it is dispensed. Upon application, the alginate capsules break, releasing a magnificent mist of luxurious Lamar Caviar by Kajal.The revolutionary appearance of Lamar Caviar encapsulates each of these definitions as much as the fragrance itself, a wonderfully opulent celebration of exoticism which was exquisitely created by master perfumer Mark Buxton, to resemble the radiant beauty and warmth of a golden sun setting on the horizon.Lamar Caviar exudes an irresistible mystique, a truly bewitching symphony of extravagant elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Lamar Noir Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: By navigating through the raw and unrefined shadows within us, we can heal... transforming wounds into wisdom, and chaos into calm.It takes immense courage to truly embrace the art of introspection, to face our deepest fears, and linger in the darkness of the night. Yet, with enough patience, we can await the incomparable golden glow of enlightenment that guides us toward serenity. The transformative journey from darkness to light.Lamar Noir opens with a vibrant and sophisticated blend of bergamot, green apple, and tropical fruits, harmonized by the delicate, powdery elegance of violets, a flower that symbolizes honesty and determination.The heart notes emerge with the opulent warmth of the balsamic accord, enriched with the velvety sweetness of vanilla and caramel. This exquisite blend seamlessly transitions into a beautiful bouquet of rose and floral accords, accented by the subtle spice of geraniums, symbolizing happiness and positivity. As the base notes unfold, we are greeted by a deeply sensual composition of leather, oud, guaiac wood, cashmere wood, musk, amber, wood musk, and sandalwood, often associated with healing and balance.Perfumer: Patrick Müller.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Masa Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: "Patience and hope, never fade with time,. despite the darkness and pressure, we must endure.""We emerge in a light, so precious, sublime,. shining with beauty, exquisitely pure."- Jo Khalaf. Masa, the arabic name for a singular diamond. If we had an eternity to sift through a sea of diamonds, we would never find two the same, they are renowned for their uniqueness as much as they are for their astonishing beauty.. Diamonds represent resilience, eternal love, purity, and new beginnings. These enchanting attributes highlight the ambiguous elements of this gem’s invincibility and the inherent delicacy of the one who wears it.. The moon is a symbol of illumination, each lunar phase is represented in the design of masa in silver, which is associated with strength, abundance, and enlightenment.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Ruby Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: "A burning flame glows from the heart,. Its embers enduring, with passion divine.. Entwined in a bond, never to part,. Eternally treasured, pure love will shine.. Forever, to be, my Ruby."Many ancient cultures revered rubies, believing an eternal flame burned at their very core, one that would never dim or fade, making them a timeless symbol of true love. In the whispered legends of antiquity, rubies were said to be the very lifeblood of Mother Earth, crystallized over millennia into fiery gems. These sacred stones became immortal emblems of love, vitality, and the unyielding pulse of life itself. Ruby is a tribute to love in all its forms, romantic, familial, or platonic. In a world often shrouded in shadow, love’s radiant glow remains constant, ever ready to illuminate and guide us. Ever pure. Ever yours. Forever more.Ruby opens with a burst of red berries, coconut, almond, pineapple, and juicy cherries. Much like cherry blossoms, cherries capture the delicate and fleeting nature of beauty and life, a reminder of moments that are too precious to last. The heart notes unfold in a delectable swirl of whipped cream, soft powdery accents, ice cream, and brown sugar, embodying warmth, and comfort. Finally, the base settles into a rich fusion of musk, vanilla, amber, benzoin, and tonka beans, which are symbollic of love and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Sareef Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sareef is a deep, oriental, and intensely sensual fragrance. Its bold character comes from the encounter of leather, vanilla, and oud—rich, enveloping materials that create a warm, magnetic trail that's impossible to ignore.. The opening surprises with woody notes crossed by lively citrus accents of bergamot and lemon, which bring energy and contrast, making the composition luminous without dampening its power.. Wearing Sareef means occupying space: the fragrance precedes, accompanies, and lingers. It enters the room with you and fills it, conveying presence, security, and a charm that needs no explanation.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Sawlaj Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sawlaj is the name of someone who enters and immediately stands out. It indicates an influential presence, a personality who chooses to convey strength and boldness from the very first moment. It is a clear, unambiguous fragrance, yet magnetic and seductive at the same time.. Jasmine and patchouli expand the olfactory structure, giving the composition depth and breadth. Around them develops a surprising accord of warm and cool woods, in perfect balance, expressing a decisive, authoritative character, confident in its direction.. Its aroma is deep and reassuring: it calms overly rational minds, dissolves rigidity, and leaves room for the authentic vibration of emotions and feelings. Sawlaj doesn't accompany, it guides. It's the scent of those who choose to leave a clear and lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Warde Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Wardé is a generous flower, as only true flowers can be. It is a pure expression of beauty, intense and unfiltered. Experiencing this fragrance means being captivated from the first moment, drawn into a rich and deeply evocative composition.. The opening is dark and hypnotic, dominated by absinthe, enlivened by the armoise and resinous nuances of pine. A deep blackcurrant note adds character and contrast, making the attack vibrant and magnetic.. The heart gives meaning to the fragrance's name: a bouquet of white flowers – jasmine, orange blossom, violet, and rose – that work in perfect harmony, creating an opulent yet balanced floral blend, never affected.. In the base, oud intertwines with a green, balsamic note of fir, creating a solid and enveloping foundation. Musk and patchouli, softened by balsamic accents, provide depth and elegant persistence, leaving a lasting allure on the skin.. Wardé is a fragrance that combines strength and grace, instinct and refinement. A scent that doesn't go unnoticed and accompanies the wearer with confidence and presence.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Warek Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Warek is a fragrance that doesn't ask for permission: it enters the scene and leaves its mark. Magnetic, intense, designed to exert a profound and almost hypnotic allure, it captivates both the wearer and those who encounter its trail, drawing them into its sensorial universe.. The opening is bold and enveloping, with spicy and incense notes naturally balanced by warm and vibrant guaiac woods. The heart reveals a sophisticated and textured leather, blending with a base of voluptuous and persistent amber, creating a sensual and profound trail.. Warek is an intense, grounding, almost telluric essence. It conveys solidity, presence, and awareness. It's the perfect perfume when everything changes and you need to stay centered: it strengthens the personality, supports the character, and accompanies those who choose to move forward without hesitation.

listings.rawTitle: Kajal Yasmina Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Yasmina is…powerA jasmine flower, when held in the hand, can be perceived as delicate, soft, and fragile. But the inner hidden secret of this flower is its scent, which is symbolic of strength, projection, and power.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Introducing a new olfactive family, Kilian Hennessy pays tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac-making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn. A first-time collaboration with French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, the perfume Angel’s Share is Kilian Hennessy’s most personal fragrance creation yet, inspired by his eighth-generation inheritance of Hennessy savoir-faire in cognac making. The perfume goes deep into the cellars of founder’s mind and memory, and into its most mysterious dimension: “la part des anges” or “angels’ share”— an evaporation of liquor in oak barrels that lifts, while aging, like a silent offering to the gods.The Perfume: Much like a Master Perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a Master Blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels’ Share contains the essence of Cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel color. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and Tonka bean absolute, the scent’s long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Apple Brandy on the Rocks Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of New York, Kilian Paris introduces its new addition to the Liquors olfactive family: Apple Brandy on the Rocks, an olfactive soundtrack to nightlife’s liberation to come. Apple Brandy was first conceived with perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur for the opening of Kilian Paris’s New York flagship eight years ago.The fragrance returns, featuring the original apple brandy core but, this time, with an added uplift—Kilian Paris’s signature “on the rocks” accord blended into the opening for an ice-cold liquored delight expressing a uniquely Kilian Paris character. A blend of bergamot, apple brandy and cardamon, the accord cools down the original, adding excitement and modernity.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Black Phantom Memento Mori Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: On turbulent seas, an inescapably transient pirate ship braves black waters, leagues deep in mystery. Black Phantom “Memento Mori” reveals its hidden treasures to the curious nose in waves.Fragrance story: Rum accord from Martinique, akin to ‘pirates water’, spikes the scent of strong coffee at its heart, balanced by vetiver essence. A deadly bite of cyanide accord hides menacingly, like the smile from death itself. Smile back as sugar cane and dark, creamy sandalwood assures a trying journey holds a sweet reward. Olfactive Family: Cellars - Woods in all their forms - from sandalwood to cedarwood, from patchouli to Vetyver - but always with a Kilian twist: rum, coffee, cacao, cognac, whisky, as a reminder of Kilian Hennessy's heritage.

It hits like an explosion, sparkles like true character and takes a classic cola into exciting new sensations. A scented creation featuring a cool and confident attitude impossible to forget.. listings.description: The perfume Dark Lord ‘EX TENEBRIS LUX’ is part of the KILIAN Smokes family. DARK LORD ‘EX TENEBRIS LUX’ is a gentleman of the night. listings.rawTitle: Kilian Fièvre Verte Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of Paris, KILIAN PARIS presents Fièvre Verte by KILIAN, a hymn to a legendary Parisian liqueur: absinthe. The scent evokes the traditional French aperitif hour, that early evening window when absinthe was served with sugar in a glass and mixed slowly with a spoon in a peaceful ritual, during which the liquid takes on a green hue pastel. This shade reappears in Fièvre Verte by KILIAN, an entirely natural color: soft like a Parisian mist, or a Van Gogh painting that comes to life.The Perfume: the fragrance opens with the essence of Absinthe supported by Violet Leaf and Licorice Root . Its base revolves around a unique raw material, Patchouli. It resonates throughout the fragrance, blending into a marquetry of woody notes composed around Vetiver and Sandalwood. Fièvre Verte by KILIAN is a tribute to Parisian celebration and pleasures.Perfumer: Mathieu Nardin.

listings.description: KILIAN PARIS introduces its second hair mist inspired by the scent of its most iconic perfume creation, Good girl gone Bad by KILIAN. Good girl gone Bad by KILIAN Hair Mist, an advanced formula that nourishes the hair to help defend against dryness, is the final and finest gesture of the personal perfume ritual for becoming entirely wrapped in a whirlwind of petals.Fragrance story: Good girl gone Bad by KILIAN is KILIAN PARIS' iconic fragrance, loved for its narcotic and airy floral blend of orange blossom, tuberose and osmanthus notes, always flirting on the edge of darkness and light, innocence and experience. A powerful and perfumed secret weapon of the finest order, Good girl gone Bad by KILIAN Hair Mist takes perfuming oneself into its ultimate dimensions—where no detail is forgotten and takes scent intoxication deep into the night.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Extreme Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: KILIAN pushes one of its heritage fragrances to its olfactive extremes.Inspiration: Take the uninhibited whirlwind of flowers in Good girl gone Bad by KILIAN and envelop it in a luscious, milky facet.Fragrance story: It opens with a pink and white bouquet of roses of May, and the most beautiful orange blossoms carried by the song of three sirens, calling from its core: tuberose, Egyptian jasmine sambac, and narcissus. These exquisite flowers are wrapped in a milky toffee elixir, making them half-innocent, half-voluptuous, and now—a delicious temptress altogether.The perfume Good girl gone bad - Extreme is part of the KILIAN Narcotics family. From rose to tuberose, from orange blossom to gardenia… Kilian flowers are composed like a narcotic dependence.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Intoxicated Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: A cup of smooth dark Turkish coffeeFragrance story: Inexplicably addictive, Intoxicated curbs craving like a cup of rich Turkish coffee, laced with green cardamom–both in oil and absolute–doubling the addictive stronghold of this stimulating substance. Warmth rises like stream with a spicy cinnamon and hallucinogenic nutmeg. At its base, like at the bottom of a delicate porcelain mug, floats the crystallized sweetness of caramelized sugar. Olfactive Family: Cellars - Woods in all their forms - from sandalwood to cedarwood, from patchouli to Vetyver - but always with a Kilian twist: rum, coffee, cacao, cognac, whisky, as a reminder of Kilian Hennessy's heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Kologne Shield of Protection Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: Founder Kilian Hennessy had been developing his own cologne for years, sparked by a desire to return to the roots and meaning of this unique genre of perfume. The result, an unique interpretation of Cologne which take you on an incredible sensory trip across freshness, intensity and time.  The Perfume: Kologne, Shield of protection takes a classic out to party. With luminous citrus notes throughout, Kologne, Shield of protection is a splash of freshness. The fragrance debuts with refreshing notes of green mandarin, bitter orange and mint leading into a heart of rosemary and neroli. A woodsy drydown is built around cedarwood, cashmeran and and a unique “sap” accord of green vegetal notes. Created as a shield of protection, it is a fragrance to spray around oneself like an aura of purity and vitality.Olfactive Family: The Fresh - Composed with citrus, aldehydes or aquatic notes, they bring freshness, lightness, and a serene feeling to Kilian compositions.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Liaisons Dangereuses Typical Me Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The perfume Liaisons Dangereuses, typical me is part of the KILIAN Narcotics family. The connection intensifies as blackcurrant buds absolute mark love’s stain, its deep purple undercurrents tangling with hedonistic ambrette seed essence, cultivated in the heat of equatorial terrain, mirroring heated nights of passion. Vanilla absolute and moss keep the scent suspended just above the natural world, keeping the secret safe a little while longer.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Love Don’t Be Shy Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: Exhilarating, unforgettable, Love, don’t be shy implores you at the opening with tender orange blossom absolute.Fragrance story: First love’s innocence makes itself known with juicy honeysuckle and plush rose softly caressed by the sweetness of luscious marshmallow sugar accord, satisfying the craving pang of new love. A warm amber base lends a pulsing touch of sensuality, hinting the possibility of soon knowing another soul, inside and out. Each KILIAN bottle is transformed into a precious object. The black-lacquered flacon is engraved on its various sides with a ceramic fresco representing the Achille's shield and decorated with a silver plate where the name of the fragrance has been carved and manually filled with black enamel.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Moonlight in Heaven Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: A dazzling beam of pearlized light dances on the oceans belly, witnessed by two lovers who watch from a balcony draped in floating white opaque gauze that seems alive, responding to a warm wind that blows. The lovers, high above the world to almost touch the stars, with full hearts and bodies light as air.Fragrance story: Omnipresent, Moonlight in Heaven sparkles with a citrus-forward opening, driven by a duo of lemon and grapefruit, spiced with pink pepper berry. Coconut milk and rice–white as the moon’s face–rounds out creamy mango and powdery jasmine sambac, while a tonka bean drydown envelops delicate vetiver. The perfume Moonlight in Heaven is part of the KILIAN Fresh Citrus family. Fresh aromas reminiscent of a sip of sparkling citrus fruits, aquatic notes or refreshing aldehydes, they bring freshness, lightness, and a serene feeling to Kilian compositions.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Musk Oud Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The perfume Musk Oud is part of the KILIAN Smokes family. A contemporary, Western twist on classic Rose Oud, Musk Oud is a quiet expression of syrupy rose and geranium petals, silken musk and spices. A heady drydown of oud accord, patchouli and musk anchors an intoxicating rum-filled opening. Going down smooth, as sweet as it is seductive, a new page for ancient oud is written.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration by Kilian Hennessy: Old Fashioned is the new sophisticated Kilian fragrance built around a whisky accord inspired by the complex tasting structure of an 18-year-old single malt. This fragrance transports the senses to the heart of the Scottish Highlands, next to a fireplace in a family estate steeped in history. Old Fashioned is a fragrance of a bygone era that recreates its essence with modernity and elegance, much like the experience of tasting an exceptional whisky can engage all the senses. The fragrance: It opens like a dazzling first sip, where the aromas of Wheat Absolute blend with the delicately floral liqueur aspect of Davana Essence. It unfolds into a sophisticated bouquet built around an ultra-concentrated Cedar essence and Immortelle Absolute, with persistent notes of Styrax and Tolu Balsam that evoke barrel aging and the misty woodlands of Scotland. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Rolling in Love Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: An addictive intimate cocoon.Fragrance story: Rolling in Love is a musc de peau, capturing the sensation of feeling so high on love that it seems to almost “get under the skin.” Working with perfumer Pascal Gaurin, Kilian Hennessy took an entirely new direction. Rolling in Love is more direct and less faceted than his previous fragrances—almost “monochromatic” in its focused representation of a single emotion. Rolling in Love is a “white” scent, layering different textures along the scent’s trail with notes of ambrette seeds, almond milk, iris, and musk. The perfume Rolling in Love is part of the KILIAN Narcotics family. From rose to tuberose, from orange blossom to gardenia… Kilian flowers are composed like a narcotic dependence.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Roses On Ice Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Introducing a brand new collection, Kilian Hennessy felt it was time to pay tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn. As a first-time collaboration with perfumer Franck Voelkl, Kilian Hennessy wanted to recreate the tasting of “gin on the rocks” with a splash of lime—recalling his wife’s favorite drink.The Perfume: Anyone for notes of gin, distilled with rose and cucumber? The perfume Roses on Ice opens with the aquatic freshness of cucumber and the aromatic uplift of juniper berries, creating an icy sensation, rounded in an accord with voluptuous Rose Centifolia. Upon a drydown of sandalwood and musk, the scent expresses the sharp—yet deeply infused—character of gin consumed in its ideal.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Sacred Wood Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sacred Wood is a portrait of sandalwood, particularly the most coveted variety from Mysore, with its spicy, woody and milky facets that are simply incredible. The fragrance opens with Ambrette Seed Absolute and Carrot Seed Essence for spicy and earthy elements, then unfolds into a multilayered Sandalwood accord with Atlas Cedarwood Oil from Morocco and Amyris Oil from the Dominican Republic. Copaiba Balsam Oil adds warmth with an animalic apricot aspect. A milky, malty vapor rises like incense for an exceptional, long-lasting sillage.

listings.description: Sacred Wood is a portrait of sandalwood, particularly the most coveted variety from Mysore, with its spicy, woody and milky facets that are simply incredible. The fragrance opens with Ambrette Seed Absolute and Carrot Seed Essence for spicy and earthy elements, then unfolds into a multilayered Sandalwood accord with Atlas Cedarwood Oil from Morocco and Amyris Oil from the Dominican Republic. Copaiba Balsam Oil adds warmth with an animalic apricot aspect. A milky, malty vapor rises like incense for an exceptional, long-lasting sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Smoking Hot Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: at night, there are no rules but one: just be Smoking Hot! KILIAN PARIS newest smoky fragrance is a truly caramelised delight. It features Kentucky Tobacco absolute, infused with a hookah drag of Apple-flavoured shisha tobacco and intense Bourbon Vanilla. Evoking everything from European clubs to Eastern hookah lounges, Smoking Hot redefines what a smokey scent is today, going almost where it's too hot to handle.The Perfume: the fragrance opens with forbidden fruit: a round Apple Hookah flavour blends with warm Cinnamon Bark essence. In a slow burn, notes of fire-cured Kentucky Tobacco absolute emerge. Harmonized with Oakmoss, this resonant Tobacco absolute leads into a Bourbon Vanilla, with balsamic tonalities. Also known as a Pure Jungle essence Bourbon Vanilla, it is of the highest quality Vanilla available, especially intense, and textured. When crossed with Orcanox™, a powerful sensuality comes full circle.Olfative Family: The SmokesPerfumer: Mathieu Nardin

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration: Moments of ecstasy envelop the senses with Straight to Heaven, white cristal.Fragrance story: Smoldering with addictive sensuality, a burning splash of rich dark rum defines the opening, its sweet gourmand chord is softened by creamy vanilla and dried fruit. Spicy patchouli pairs with the fresh, woodsy scent of cedarwood to finish, finding animalic harmony at long last. The perfume Straight to Heaven, white cristal is part of the KILIAN Cellars family.Woodsy perfumes in all their forms - from sandalwood to cedarwood, from patchouli to Vetyver - but always with a Kilian twist: rum, coffee, cacao, cognac, whisky, as a reminder of Kilian Hennessy's heritage.A lot of attention is taken in each KILIAN refillable perfume bottle, to make them real precious objects.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Sunkissed Goddess Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration by Kilian Hennessy: A luxurious reinterpretation of the Polynesian elixir, Monoi oil. A fragrance that evokes the scents of summer, tanning oil, and the warmth of the sun shining on the skin.The fragrance: Sunkissed Goddess opens with the softness of white Tiare and the sensuality of Ylang-Ylang, followed by the warm roundness of Coconut and Vanilla, to finish with deep notes of Guaiac and Cistus Labdanum, two emblematic signatures of Kilian Paris, known for their resinous character, vibrant energy, and timeless seduction.Fragrance notes: Ylang Ylang Essence, Tiare Flower, Coconut.Olfactory family: Narcotic Flowers.Perfumer: Calice Becker.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Woman in Gold Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspiration:A perfume as complex and dazzling as the woman who wears it.Fragrance story: The notes conjure, in scent, the delicate gold leafing and play between light and shadow, for which the painting is celebrated. Perfumer Calice Becker was inspired by the fascinating contrast between the painting’s facets, which she describes as “texturized and brilliant, rich and voluptuous". Its zesty luminosity is the fragrant expression of this brightness. The petal-y rose heart depicts all of the facets of the rose. Finally, vanilla absolute’s unctuosity appears generously in the drydown, adorned by an exclusive patchouli molecule, the Akigalawood. The perfume Woman in Gold is part of the KILIAN Narcotics family. From rose to tuberose, from orange blossom to gardenia… Kilian flowers are composed like a narcotic dependence.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Woman in Gold Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by Kilian Hennessy: KILIAN PARIS presents Woman in Gold Hair Mist, a fragrant creation that joins the season's captivating arsenal, a secret, protective weapon. The finishing touch to any hairstyling ritual.The Fragrance: Woman in Gold Hair Mist opens with luminous notes of bergamot oil and heart notes of multi-faceted rose absolute. Woman in Gold Hair Mist has UV protection and moisturizing properties to protect your hair from the drying effects of the sun. For true layering enthusiasts, apply the Woman in Gold fragrance along with the scented mist to create a sublimated, faceted olfactory trail.Perfumer: Calice Becker

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Ambre & Tonka Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Une parabole de sensualité exaltée par le jeu des contrastes entre l’Ambre, qui confère une profondeur sensuelle, et la Fève Tonka, à la douceur envoûtante. " Ambre est une fragrance extraordinaire comme aucune autre. Lorsqu’on en découvre l’essence magique, on tombe irrémédiablement amoureux de son harmonie voluptueuse. Pleine de mystère, à la fois intrigante et délicate, sophistiquée et persistante, elle se dévoile sur la peau et laisse un sillage enchanteur ! Imaginée et réalisée il y a plus de 100 ans, archétype de la parfumerie française, elle demeure l’essence du désir et traverse les époques sans effort. Pour cette version Season 1, j’ai d’abord gardé tout mon sérieux et amené les ingrédients classiques à leur point d’équilibre. Puis, très lentement, avec de petites nuances, je me suis laissé emporter vers l’enfance et le péché de l’insouciance... " Parfumeurs : Jean-Claude & Céline Ellena.

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Bois de Mangrove Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Mangrove Wood, a rare and protected ingredient, as the centerpiece of this collection. We have given body and life to this raw material, integrated into a perfume for the first time."I wanted to highlight this little-known wood, but so precious for the environment and captivating olfactory. I was inspired by its physical characteristics, its dry roots and the quality of its flesh which seems to have been soaked in water. Around leathery, saffron and iridescent facets, I added aromatic and floral touches to evoke the surrounding ecosystem."Parfumer : Margaux Le Paih Guerin.

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Bois de Mangrove Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Bois Oriental & Ylang Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The exoticism and richness of the fragrance of the Ylang-Ylang flower cultivated by local populations. An olfactory adventure that one encounters only rarely in a lifetime. A marriage between two points of the world: the Orient and the tropics."For this fragrance, I was inspired by my first encounter with the Ylang flower in Martinique. This seemingly delicate white flower reveals its power through heady, captivating and animal notes. An olfactory journey that captures the quiet strength of Ylang, and the brute force of upcycled Atlas Cedar. A unique sensory experience, a fusion of fragility and power, embodied in every drop of this unforgettable fragrance."Parfumeur : Karine Vinchon.

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Incense & Cuir Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Patchouli, different because it’s upcycled to reshape the raw material whilst preserving its nobility. Reinvente the notes of Leather and Incense with upcycled ingredients, to create a totally new form of a timeless perfume."The intense elegance of this racy fragrance plunges us into the heart of the Middle East. For this fragrance, I have chosen the unique and most beautiful qualities of its palette. The notes of Saffron captivate the senses, followed by a captivating heart of mystical Incense. In the base, the sumptuous and deep Patchouli creates an amber and leathery trail. A fragrance that combines the sophistication of Robertet raw materials for an unforgettable olfactory experience."Parfumeur : Amandine Galliano.

listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Vetiver & Iris Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Atelier Ellena summons the memory of a lost love. A passion for opposites staged by the alliance of the roots of Vetiver and Iris to remain still and always under the spell."I touched the roots of love. Since then, my memory has cultivated the remains of this enchantment and lost attachment. Until the moment when, distraught, I felt the need to tell my ephemeral story by offering it the perpetuity of scents. This perfume evokes in turn in a whisper the melody of happiness and the serenity of nostalgia, the desire for light and the comfort of shadow. It is a perfume that tells the story of our sensual and loving lives. Without regrets or manners. With passion and materials. I love the grainy bitterness of Vetiver essence and the velvety softness of Iris butter punctuated with hot and cold spices. Root materials, ethereal materials, anchored or sensitive, which express so well our appetite for happiness and our dreams of flight... of being still and often, under the Charm."Parfumeur : Celine Ellena.

listings.rawTitle: La Manufacture Admirabilis Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An emotion of serenity and beauty emerges from the Abbey of Fontfroide, an extraordinary place, as fascinating as it is mysterious. This Cistercian abbey invites us to travel through time, along its walls and stone vaults. In this place, full of character, this sacred fragrance composed of balms and warm resins resonates. Admirabilis, a mysterious and enveloping breeze.

listings.rawTitle: La Manufacture Grey Senses Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Great Ladies have successively beautified the Château de Chenonceau over the centuries. The sumptuous gardens, lined with delicate spirals of santolina, contrast with the grey hues imposed by the stone of the building. Power and contrasts are the very definition of the architecture of the new fragrance Opus Matières. The vibrant shades celebrate the wild and the built. A beautiful tribute to the Château des Dames.

listings.rawTitle: La Manufacture Omelie 44 Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A summer solstice. The sun rises at the top of the Temple of Isis, marking a magical moment. The bird goddess, Isis, gives the “breath of life” to the wind by flapping her wings, bringing the fragrance of Elemi and Geranium. She spreads all her love, a sensual and feminine rose scent fills the Temple, like a rebirth of the soul. Suddenly, the sun sets, allowing the incense to take all its power and open the fascinating world of dreams. Odyssey between Heaven and Earth, the Pearl of the Nile gradually reveals itself.

listings.rawTitle: La Manufacture Rêve Ottoman Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: We begin to imagine Sultan Soliman the Magnificenter wandering in his Dolmabahçe Palace on the banks of the Bosphorus. A palace with a thousand treasures where unseen corridors, hidden stairways, secret fountains are the witness of the Orient’s intrigues. From this dream comes the spellbinding notes of the Orient. Rêve Ottoman is sensual and addictive, exhaling its sovereign aroma of amber, arabian rose, and saffron.  Rêve Ottoman, unexpected encounter with the mystery of the East.

listings.rawTitle: La Manufacture Sable Noir Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: After a long walk, the temple of Kalabshanous plunges into the heart of Ancient Egypt. Like a force of nature, this place symbolizes exploration and boldness. Stop at one of the majestic columns of the temple to feel the warmth of the hot sand on our skin, like an enchanting aura. A powerful immersion between the coolness of a temple and the vastness of the burning sand.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Alambar Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: This fragrance is Enrico’s tribute to an icon and its amber-scented world – amber, ambar, alambre, ambra, ambrum, ambarum, Alambar. He has chiselled precious grains together with the golden tears of a divine diva.Ambracadabra…And the fragrance works its magic on the skin. With its heightened concentration of elegance wrapped in exotic arabesques, this distillation of amber excites the senses and soothes the skin. Warm notes surround the olfactory pyramid with intensity, leaving a trail of pure amber.The perfumer: Enrico Buccella

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Amberbomb Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Power, opulence, creativity, originality, quality. Amberbomb is all of these things. For the first time in the Olfactory Laboratory, we collaborate with Arturetto Landi and we thought we would leave an indelible mark: a perfume capable of surprising and fascinating. Amberbomb, with its mix of fruity, floral, dry woody and amber notes, intrigues and seduces. A perfume with great projection and very long duration.A vibrant opening, rich in fruity notes tempered by the bitter note of coffee which gives depth and binds with the enveloping floral heart, composed of powerful flowers such as rose, iris, jasmine and lily of the valley. This floral harmony gives an ethereal and refined note that softens the base, which represents the profound secret of this perfume. The warmth and sensuality of amber and vanilla combine with the earthy and woody notes of patchouli and sandalwood, while the power of leather and nagarmotha give mystery and seduction. Amberbomb captures attention and leaves an unforgettable trail. Luxury and magnetism…The perfumer: Arturetto Landi

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Arancia Rossa Cologne 100 ml
listings.description: "Bergamot is elegant, lemon is energetic, mandarin is cheerful. Orange is sunny and ironic. In the Italian city of Ivrea, not far from Turin, a battle of oranges is the highlight of the annual carnival celebrations. In 1801 oranges became a symbol of military defeat when Prince Manuel Godoy y Álvarez de Faria sent a basket of these fruits to his mistress the Queen to celebrate the victory of Spain over Portugal. Only to take their revenge by bearing the name of Portugal for many years after that in the perfume industry. The oranges extoled and sold by merchants accompany the tragic end of Carmen in Bizet's homonymous opera. But my favourite story is a Christmas one. In December, oranges are a gift of light, a message hinting to the end of winter, rebel fruits wearing the colour of summer."The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Baliflora Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "There are places whose scents are stored in memory much longer than landscapes. When the red spider lily, the white lily ginger and the frangipane bloom, encircling the streets, and the lotus opens onto the smallest mirrors of water, the landscapes become fragrance in turn. Among the flowers of Bali, the inhabitants have made the Frangipane, the emblem of their island to offer to the gods of the Hindu pantheon. Centered to ceremonies, dances, offerings where smells and colors mix until they become one, it seemed to me then that the scent of those flowers told the beauty and diversity of the island.">The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Bergamotto Cologne 100 ml
listings.description: "Although citrus fruits originate from China, Bergamot is Italian. It is a pity that nobody knows who created it by crossing a lemon tree with a bitter orange: this inventor might have been honoured in the same way as the colleague Clément, who invented the clementine. Italian traders managed to sell Bergamot to the Chinese Market to add fragrance to their second-rate tea, which they sold back to the English Market. I am often asked whether I have olfactory preferences. I have always said I do not, wishing to conceal the manipulations I perform on fragrances, as the work of a perfumer is always that of an illusionist. Yes, I have preferences and they vary according to my needs, my desires. I have passing loves, as well as solid, perennial loves, among which there is my love for bergamot. It was time for me to make that official."The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Cozumel Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Gathering reflections from a past journey, the nose has infused the olfactory pyramid with some Mexican sun, wafts of aromatic herbs mixed with the intimate smell of men’s skin and the wild smells of a distant island.This aromatic, passionate fragrance oscillates constantly between warmth and coolness. Wild, and narcissistic, it melds notes of fresh tobacco, Indian hemp and velvety wood, offering a light touch on the skin that becomes more distinctive once it has pervaded the senses. It is a truly new way of capturing sensuality in a perfume.The perfumer: Marie Duchêne
