listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Décou-Vert Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Décou-Vert is born to fulfill the goal to gather three different types of fragrances, often considered at odds: flowery notes, those genuinely vegetables and the so called “green”. A blind frame lifted us to new experience, in which we could feel the colors and perceive a hint of a sultry magnolia carried by the rustle of green leaves and we were enormously amazed when we realized how the unusual combination led to a watery scent. A true discovery: Décou-Vert.Look beyond the leaves, walk through a lush, intoxicating meadow: it appears to be green all over. Décou-Vert is released into the air and the green surrenders to a luminous magnolia with a transparent, aquatic character. A multicoloured painting. A lively, vibrant palette of green flowers and leaves, a bouquet of sparkling, joyful notes. At the base, still protagonist with its pollen, magnolia introduces us to a calm warmth of intrigant woody and musky notes. Décou-Vert is the astonishment coming from the hazardous discovery of a floral oasis, illuminated by a bright sun. A playful, crystalline fragrance, a true olfactory surprise.The perfumer: David Maruitte

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo ExpLOud Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "ExpLOud marks the beginning of a new creative synergy: Laboratorio Olfattivo meets Pierre Guéros. Without hesitation, we entrusted him the mission of giving body to “our vision” of Oud. ExpLOud was born, as an aromatic explosion based on the most precious and luminous of Ouds, with floral notes to lift and twist the characteristic scent of this unique raw material which has already experienced numerous interpretations on the market" - Roberto Drago"I had the chance to work with an amazing quality of Oud from Ajmal, located in India. It is the perfect balance of all the facets of oud: smoky, leathery, slightly animalic, vibrant, addictive and powerful. What makes this fragrance perfectly unique is the fresh floral Magnolia - Lilybelle accord in the heart, projecting the fragrance to a brighter, enthusiast and joyful place. Lilybelle® in particular, gives an almost aquatic character to the fragrance, which allows the perfume to breathe. On the other hand, Ambrocenide® and Ambrostar®, provide a unique sharpness, projection and vibrance. These molecules can virtually make this fragrance last forever. Then, I choose a combination of three exceptional woody raw materials: Patchouli heart fraction to convey the darkness of oud, Sandalwood Album to impart an addictive soft and milky sandalwood effect, and finally our precious Vetiver from Madagascar, that possess an earthy, rooty, and slightly smoky impression. At the end, the addition of Oud Boya underlines the woody oriental character of the fragrance." - Pierre Costantin GuérosThe perfumer: Pierre Guéros

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Kashnoir Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Narcotics flowers, psychotropic herbs and haunted spices are the main ingredients of Kashnoir, the eleventh fragrance of Laboratorio Olfattivo, created after embarking on a long journey in search of the most forbidden and mysterious East. More than a fragrance, Kashnoir is a softly lethal drug, that obscures reason and stuns the senses. A powerful scent, which leads to oblivion, almost dangerous to the wearer.Kashnoir, a scent that starts warm and bright, alternating shades of fresh citrus with deep touches of lavender. A discreet opening that leads to a hypnotic heart, full of passion, that evolves for many hours, made by a very high-quality orange blossom absolute combined with an oriental velvety rose and a handful of green coriander. It’s at this stage that the fragrance literally “explodes”, revealing its most sinful soul. This "liaison dangereuse" is joined by the almond aroma of the heliotrope and the golden-warm one of vanilla and benzoin, that round and soften the fragrance, without succeeding in taming it, to a tail that comes solemnly forward in the semblances of the most dangerous essence that exists, the patchouli.The perfumer: Cécile Zarokian

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Limone Cologne 100 ml
listings.description: "Limone has its origins in one of my journeys on the Amalfi Coast. The coast road is narrow and runs alongside the cliffs, which plunge into the blue of the Mediterranean. At each bend the landscape surprises you. Understanding nature’s magic, men and women have built terraces to lovingly cultivate lemon trees. It is impossible to resist the beauty of these places where the yellow lemon cuts across the coppery blue of stone walls. Between the bright and cheerful yellow and a lavish, princely blue, I found the theme for a new Cologne, unquestionably aristocratic"The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Mandarino Cologne 100 ml
listings.description: "It is the most joyous of all the citrus fruits. When I want to lend my fragrances a radiant smile (and I often do), I use mandarin essence. The advantage with Colognes is that they are made for the "layering" of fragrances. Mandarin Parfum Cologne is formulated to be both simple and sophisticated. It can be used for its own, but it is also compatible with all fragrances and gives them the smile that you want to have on a specific day. What's more, it is long lasting. So, smile! You smell good!"The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Miss_U Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Miss_U: an absence that becomes presence. As Need_U is a message from the perfume to the skin, I need you, Miss_U is a declaration from the skin to the perfume: a silent or whispered but yet powerful shout, I miss you.Miss_U is the need to wear a merge of sensuality and caresses, the desire to be enwrapped into ambery, animal notes and touched by warm woods and vanilla. Again, and again. If it’s true that beauty stems from the experience we have lived, it is equally true that the desire of what has been, goes beyond a single moment and let an emotion to be eternal. Miss_ U aims to capture the emotion of the absence in a mysterious and unique perfume, as an elusive and intangible animal.The perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo MyLO Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A charming and sunny fragrance inspired by the White Lily, one of the most beloved flowers in perfumery. A White Lily heart, surrounded by fruity, floral and soft notes, draws a smile on the face of whoever wears this fragrance. A warm base, rich in persuasive notes, strengthens the floral notes and leaves its trace on the skin. An addictive fragrance, My Laboratorio Olfattivo, My LO, MyLO.Sparkling fruity top notes perfectly blend with a floral heart of white lily, iris, jasmine and rose. This fruity floral accord leads then to a soft base of benzoin, vanilla, white amber and musk.The perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Need_U Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: I need you, Need_U. A few simple words to describe an extreme and strong need. In this case, the perfume’s need for skin to express itself, to tell its story, its intentions. No blotters, no clothes. Just the skin.When this encounter happens, Need_U releases all its seductive power. In the opening, the citrus notes of Lemon and the rosy note of Pink Pepper dance with Hedione HC, creating a pure jasmine scent, while White Flowers and Sea Sprays lay down on a base of White Musks and fascinating molecules like Ambroxan. Molecules that adhere to the skin, just like a dress, staging a matching exchange: perfume and skin, skin and perfume. Need_U is a unisex fragrance, an unlimited and universal love message.The perfumer: Marie Duchêne

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Need_U Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: symbol of change and strength, hair has always been an instrument of beauty and sensuality. For us, it was essential that we created a product that could both enhance this very important weapon of seduction as well as make it smell great. Aromatic veils envelope the hair, thanks to the spray bottle that gently deposits the product over the tresses. It contains the following active ingredients: alcohol of natural origin, which is extracted from molasses or wheat, whose presence in the formula guarantees a dry and silky touch; conditioning agents that, creating a protective film, envelope the hair, leaving it flowing and easy to comb. Its invisible formula envelopes the hair with a delicate fragrance and enhances it without weighing it down, leaving it soft and silky. Thanks to the practical and elegant portable bottle, Hair Mist will become the sensual and discreet way to emphasize your femininity that you can’t live without.How to use: spray with sweeping gestures onto dry or wet hair. It dissolves in just a few seconds. This fragrance is the musky floreal Need_U, with its delicate sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nektar Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "The first inspiration for this perfume was a beautiful trip to Wadi Darbat, in the South of Oman: a unique place in the Middle East, a lush and very diversified region from a botanical point of view. Indeed, a peculiar treasure belongs to this region: the Sidr Tree. An ancient tree from the Ziziphus family, which produces beautiful red fruits and amazing flowers. Thanks to these flowers, local bees produce the most rich, exclusive, characteristic honey you can ever imagine. I had the chance to spend a few days there with a botanist and an "Incense farmer", and I came back from this trip with the inspiration for Sidr Valley. I created a perfume which captures the different facets of Sidr Honey and its natural surroundings" - Pierre Constantin Guéros"When I received the first samples of the fragrance I was ravished by its personality and by the quality of its composition. Full of softness and creativity, Nektar recalls honey without being overwhelming, while drawing a distinctive character from its intense notes" - Roberto DragoThe perfumer: Pierre Guéros

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nektar Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: "The first inspiration for this perfume was a beautiful trip to Wadi Darbat, in the South of Oman: a unique place in the Middle East, a lush and very diversified region from a botanical point of view. Indeed, a peculiar treasure belongs to this region: the Sidr Tree. An ancient tree from the Ziziphus family, which produces beautiful red fruits and amazing flowers. Thanks to these flowers, local bees produce the most rich, exclusive, characteristic honey you can ever imagine. I had the chance to spend a few days there with a botanist and an "Incense farmer", and I came back from this trip with the inspiration for Sidr Valley. I created a perfume which captures the different facets of Sidr Honey and its natural surroundings" - Pierre Constantin Guéros"When I received the first samples of the fragrance I was ravished by its personality and by the quality of its composition. Full of softness and creativity, Nektar recalls honey without being overwhelming, while drawing a distinctive character from its intense notes" - Roberto DragoThe perfumer: Pierre Guéros

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nerosa Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "Nerosa is a perfume realized with David Maruitte in 2011, but at that time we believed that Laboratorio Olfattivo was not yet ready to launch a fragrance like this. Today instead, Nerosa can perfectly enter in our Black Collection, thanks to the depth, wealth and strength of its formula. A fragrance whose energy is noticeable and whose enveloping sillage is strong." - Roberto DragoA sublime Saffron opens this fragrance before giving way to a powerful Rose that uses Oud, Amber, Sandalwood and leather notes still maintaining its passionateness and leaving an intriguing trail of perfume behind you. A scent rich of natural raw materials to express its several facets.The perfumer: David Maruitte

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nerotic Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Hypnotic, sensual, sexual, erotic, nerotic... Nerotic. Nerotic is a charming and addictive perfume: it drags you into a very emotional journey. The idea was to create a scent which stuns the senses thanks to a composition both elegant and intriguing: just like a black dress with a special detail.Woody, ambery, dry... Nerotic is a stunning fragrance, charming whoever wears it or just smells it. The dynamic top notes mingle both with the dry and masculine notes of woods, leather and smoke and with the more feminine notes of amber, making this scent perfectly unisex.The perfumer: Cécile Zarokian

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nirmal Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A candid tissue that softly grazes the skin. The white color that becomes perfume of sweetness, serenity and quiet. Imagining a cloud of candid notes that spread in the air, the Nose has drawn a fragrance from the soft lines, accented by soft tones and accords. A perfume in which clear feelings and positive thoughts are mixed.Nirmal in hindi means "pure, immaculate." The original idea, transformed then in a fragrance by the Nose, was to create a perfume that was sincere and delicate as a loving caress. A simple and unforgettable perfume at the same time. To realize this dream the Nose has worked on a poudré base of sweet notes. In this way the impalpable being of the perfume penetrates in the skin to reach the heart of whom has chosen his wake. Soft and fluffy signs dissolve in a base of sweet leather.The perfumer: Marie Duchêne

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nun Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: By this palindrome word, the Ancient Egyptian meant the primordial water, in other words the God Nun. According to the legend, this water gave birth to the Lotus, a flower which was used to hide into the water during the night, to open up again at the sunshine. While blossoming out the flower revealed the Sun God Atum. Hence the symbolism of the Sun God, of rebirth. This fragrance arises from the Nun and opens up at the sunshine, while its scented molecules spread out into the air. It’s a tribute to this iconic, symbolic flower.The fragrance opens with evident citrus notes, in which pear reveals its sweetness joining a heart of blossoming lotus, jasmine and ylang ylang. Woods, amber and musk play the end notes of this scented accord.The perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Nun Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: A symbol of change and strength, hair has always been an instrument of beauty and sensuality. For us, it was essential that we created a product that could both enhance this very important weapon of seduction as well as make it smell great. Aromatic veils envelope the hair, thanks to the spray bottle that gently deposits the product over the tresses. It contains the following active ingredients: alcohol of natural origin, which is extracted from molasses or wheat, whose presence in the formula guarantees a dry and silky touch; conditioning agents that, creating a protective film, envelope the hair, leaving it flowing and easy to comb. Its invisible formula envelopes the hair with a delicate fragrance and enhances it without weighing it down, leaving it soft and silky. Thanks to the practical and elegant portable bottle, Hair Mist will become the sensual and discreet way to emphasize your femininity that you can’t live without.How to use: spray with sweeping gestures onto dry or wet hair. It dissolves in just a few seconds. This fragrance is the fruity floral Nun, symbol of rebirth and change.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Oud in White Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: “This fragrance was born from a specific request from Daniela Caon. She had long asked me for a Jasmine Oud perfume, and I found the request immediately fascinating. Combining the hypnotic and seductive power of jasmine with the multifaceted power of Oud. Julien Rasquinet, whom I have always admired, seemed perfect for this challenge. I find the final result splendid.” - Roberto Drago“I wanted to create a harmonious interaction between the indolic floral notes and a powerful oud with leathery notes. This duality gives life to a captivating fragrance that creates a balance between the wild beauty of jasmine and the depth of oud.” - Julien RasquinetWhispers of Jasmine Oud. A precious union of the finest elements of nature. An opening with pear skin, ginger, and raspberry leads to a heart of sensual and intoxicating jasmine. The elegance of cedar wood then meets the delicate touch of osmanthus and reveals an enchanting leathery scent. In the drydown, the fragrance delves into a deep resinous duo of labdanum and sandalwood, with a structured oud that shines like dawn. A refined signature that envelops in a timeless embrace of floral beauty and woody mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Patchouliful Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A King, sitting on his throne, white haired and white bearded, whit the crown on his head but with a flowery shirt, a pareo and wearing flip-flops. This is "Patchouliful", that means in Urban Dictionary "more than beautiful"; a royal patchouli, bright, preserving its hippie spirit but giving a different vision of it, less earthy; in the style of Laboratorio Olfattivo.Patchouliful is a perfume in constant evolution, in continuous movement, where the heart of patchouli, wound by iris and flower of frangipane, is lifted at first by the fizzy top notes of bergamot, of cinnamon and of clove, and then lie down on a base of musks, cedarwood and cistus. A fragrant symphony whereby every single ingredient is an instrument that contributes to the whole, curving out its space. A perfume that doesn’t lose its identity but transforms it, with an alternation of unforgettable perfumed notes.The perfumer: Cécile Zarokian

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Pompelmo Cologne 100 ml
listings.description: " Pompelmo has taken my olfactory journey inspired to Italian Citruses to the end. Born in Asia, where considered a sacred fruit to be offered to Gods, Grapefruit, as most citrus fruits, first appeared in Spain, in Seville, around the XII-XIII century during the Arab domination. Probably, one of the greatest citruses, I particularly appreciate Grapefruit for its bitter flavour. Unlike sweet scents which I find to be obvious and uninspiring, bitter represents, in my opinion, one of the brightest scents. This may be the result of my Italian background, where several beverages celebrate bitterness. To make Pompelmo a unique and different fragrance, I have worked on both the lively and sour freshness of Grapefruit, while stressing its bitter scent."The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Rosamunda Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Elegant in the sunlight, passionate when the night comes down. A rose difficult to be imprisoned in just one definition. Provocative and carnal like those rebel roses on the hair of the feminine characters of Gabriel Garçia Marquez but at the same time extremely fragrant and sumptuous, wrapped in a neoclassical brightness, like in the paintings by Sir Lawrence Alma-Tadema.A large quantity of Bulgarian and Turkish roses and long hours of distillation were necessary to get the aching soul of this creation, a fragrance in which the seductive power of rose is brought to fever pitch and its being classic is corrupted with a high percentage of patchouli. Around this heart beating for passion, illuminated by green lymph of rose, a scented scenario outlines: golden spices, ancient woods and animal notes with an aphrodisiac imprint. An impalpable landscape that thanks to the ability of Marie Duchêne appears unknown to the eyes and unexplored to the nose. Rosamunda is a rose that is worthy of adoration, a rose for which a celebratory altar was built, an altar covered by oud, the sovereign wood from which an essence with an immortal appeal, as the one of the queen of the flowers, is extracted.The perfumer: Marie Duchêne

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Sacreste Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "Sacreste comes out from the study of another perfume that I have been trying to realize for eight years. Two years ago, I received a trial fragrance by Luca Maffei which was characterized by an incense note I really like. We have been working on that note, finishing it and making it sensual until we arrived at the final project, that I completely love." - Roberto DragoA complex and rich formula, created to give voice to two precious incense notes which immediately tie with Cistus, Elemi and other spicy ingredients which appear on the top notes and on a woody musky base. A sensual and profound incense: a perfume with character.The perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Salina Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: For the creation of this perfume, we decided to cross Mediterranean Sea to arrive at Salina Island, a scrap of Trinacria land, set in Eolie archipelago and surrounded by a sapphire-blue sea! This pearl of Mediterranean Sea, is the ideal scenery for the creation of a fragrance, that smells of sea, sun, sand, salt under the skin and… freedom.Shells, starfishes, hotsand and salty instead of usual fragrances used in perfumery, the olfactory pyramid of Salina adorns itself with sea water glares and sunny nuances. Salina is foaming and aquatic but hot too; salty and sweet at the same time; light and embracing. Following the evolution of Salina is like deciding to perform a stroll in a desert seaside, when the sun isn’t still gone beyond the horizon. Through the use of Salina, the sense of smell acquires powers that generally belong to sight, touch and taste. This fragrance is a total sensorial experience that evokes what your mind can’t imagine: the sea taste, the green of pine maritime forest and costal scrub; the sun blinding sparkle, reflecting itself over the water; the childish play of footprints over the sand, deleted by waves, and the warmth of the sun over the skin…The perfumer: Marie Duchêne

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Tantrico Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "«What is more noble for a perfumer than Sandal attar? Without doubt it is the most precious essential oil in the history of perfumery, with a refined elegance, an unparalleled sensuality and an intimacy that I invite you to try"An indisputable symbol of spirituality and a medium of communication between the land and the divine for many civilizations, if we think of Sandalwood, we cannot but refer to its sensuality which is released in the contact between this raw material and the skin. In Tantrico, the velvety character of Sandalwood is tickled by the aromatic touch of Sage, Juniper and Cypress creating a jus in perfect balance between discretion and sensuality that binds to the skin immediately, creating a persistent but intimate aura.The perfumer: Lucien Ferrero

listings.description: Someone says that the linden scent encourages human relationships, donating comfort and well-being. Tiglio Mirabilis, a fragrance that encloses all the pleasure, peace and quiet that linden blooms spread with their early summer scent, will enrich the Laboratorio in Fiore collection.The Perfumer Luca Maffei has made spices and flowers dance together with a gentle, soft woody and musky base, conveying a feeling of positive energy, typical of a summer day. It seems as linden, with its heartshaped leaves, is destined to share a joyous and romantic message for something magic that is about to come and that will last forever.The perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Tonkade Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "And the ones who were seen dancing were thought to be insane by those who could not hear the music." - Friedrich NietzscheTonkade, was created on the basis of an imaginary dance, a sensual ritual that alternates sweetness and mystery. Ingredients that, just like the sinuous movements of dancers, appear, twirl and then disappear, giving rise to a choral performance that remains engraved in the heart and mind.The fragrance, which is revealed as soon as the bottle is opened, features the floral notes of Neroli, the spicy notes of Cardamom and the soft notes of the Tonka Bean. A warm heart of Cedar, Vanilla and Patchouli announces a background characterised by dry amber woods that, combined once again with the coils of the Tonka Bean, make this fragrance intriguing and mysterious. It’s addictive.The perfumer: Marie Duchêne

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Tuberosis Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "On a pleasant autumn evening, in the golden light, the cold suddenly swept over me. Winter would be upon us at dawn. Opening the front door, I turned to look one last time at the last stem of the tuberose flowers, a gift from a summer that had survived, thinking that in the morning I would go and pick it up to get drunk for a few days more on its smell. Since then, at a time when artificial lights respond to the night, the tuberose spreads with its soft voice a scent of jasmine, plum and spices. It is a whisper, like a breeze, that will not tire. And every night, around midnight, its voice goes out, so we can wait for the same moment the next day. Its smell is like his life, programmed. There is something in this flower of the figure of Shéhérazade that every night tells a story of escaping death. She did it so well that her story, still alive, has become a perfume."The perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Underground Vibes Intense Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: For this new fragrance, Laboratorio Olfattivo inaugurates a new collaboration with a master perfumer known for his very original olfactory signature, Antoine Lie. This perfume is an ode to creativity, a fragrance capable of surprising. Underground Vibes takes us to little-explored places to give us an unforgettable olfactory journey."The inspiration for this perfume was to represent the smell of raves, underground parties in many cities. The electric and hallucinatory atmosphere of secret gatherings, post-industrial places, and underground parking lots. I wanted to represent, in the form of a perfume, the evocative scents of products linked to artificial paradises circulating in these places. A concentration of elements related to a psychotropic experience."Perfumer: Antoine Lie.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Vanagloria Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: "For the Master's Collection, I wanted to create a perfume that expresses all the richness of Vanilla and its multiple facets. This creation is built around an LMR Vanilla bean of sublime quality, of which I have amplified the most subtle tones. This Bourbon Vanilla, grown in the heart of the Indian Ocean, is extracted using CO2, a cold extraction technique that reveals the full spectrum of its gourmand, floral, leathery and spicy notes. Its leathery character is reinforced by saffron and its addictiveness by the tonka bean, while the enveloping layers of incense add the texture of a mystical aura."The perfumer: Dominique Ropion

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Vanhera Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Vanhera: a dark Vanilla, an unexpected fragrance that recalls intriguing and unclear sensations. A journey around one of the most iconic perfumery's notes. A Vanilla perfume, not the usual Vanilla fragrance where just sweet notes are emphasized. A battle, a conflict among ingredients.n Vanhera, a Madagascar Vanilla absolute tries to find a place in a universe of ingredients that want to suppress it. Vanhera is surrounded, almost besieged, by spicy notes of Pepper, Cardamom, Cinnamon; it is embraced by warm notes of Sandalwood and Cashmeran and it is “stained” by Karmawood, Timbersilk and ambery notes. Nevertheless, the Vanilla absolute arises and makes its presence felt, conquering heart and soul of whoever smells itThe perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Vetyverso Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "From every trip, I have always brought back an olfactory memory of the places visited. From a trip to the Antilles, I can recall the memory of their olfactory power: on the slopes of the volcanoes grow the roots of Vetiver, with its virile and woody notes. Here the mornings shine with the freshness of citrus fruits and, little by little, the air vibrates with noble and precious spicy scents. It was from these first memories that I built Vetyverso: a fragrance with a decisive and intriguing trail"The noble root of Vetiver, which has always been known for its beneficial properties, famed for its capability to ward off negative energy, an essence very much in vogue in the seventies and eighties, returns to express all its elegance in Vetyverso. The green and yet at the same time woody character of Vetiver is illuminated by citrus scents and made sparkling by spicy notes forming a perfect fragrance to be worn by man but also by women who are seeking an olfactory surprise on their skin.The perfumer: Lucien Ferrero

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Aqua Zenzero Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fiery score, in which ginger shines as bright as ever.Aqua Zenzero is a whirlwind of spices that sweeps you away. At the top, the spicy freshness of ginger is enhanced by notes of cardamom, and the sharpness of the pepper. Then, heart notes of cinnamon and nutmeg radiate with a powerful heat. Finally, this spicy symphony is softened by a hint of jasmine, on a base of musk and wood (vetiver, sandalwood).

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Army of Lovers Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: "One rainy night in the 90's summer, I put a disc on the turntable, and the magic begins. The dangerously eccentric and furiously glamorous feeling in the air that night struck to my very heart. Since then not a day passes without my listening to Army of Lovers. To use this name for one of my favorite perfumes was an obvious choice. I waited for the right moment and the perfect blend. Today I have it."Just like the band's melodies and their charismatic leader Alexander Bard, ARMY OF LOVERS is what would call a baroque perfume, as a jeweler would say "a precious stone with an unexpected form"ARMY OF LOVERS is musk cypress based, very much a « skin » perfume which mixes the strong notes of coriander, oak moss and patchouli.

Plum exalts its fruity facets, while cinnamon sets the spicy notes ablaze. Base notes of oudh wood and sandalwood entwine with a Palo Santo cord to intoxicate you evermore.

This refreshing, powdery cocoon with aldehydic notes will stay with you all night long, flaunting the musky sensuality of the fragrance.

listings.description: Under lively and sparkling top notes of lemon, mint and lime, a luminous heart vibrates, with its blend of white flowers and geranium. The elegance of a radiant simplicity, where the bitter and herbaceous freshness of the top meets the warmth of wood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Dulce Pear Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A hymn to the joys of Italy A tribute to Laurent Mazzone's origins, Dulce Pear gives us a little taste of the charms of Italy. A plunge into the heart of the orchards, in a country where la dolce vita is regarded as an art. A fruity floral scent chiselled around notes of sensual pear that melt before you like sun-drenched fruit on a sunny day. . Enhanced by fresh notes of green apple, the pear reveals its soft and sweet flesh, held together by a hint of musk. A powdery, silky veil of iris and ambrette expose the soft, velvety skin of the fruit. A promise of voluptuousness, unfolding on a base of musk, cedar and brown sugar with caramelised accents.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Epine Mortelle Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Experience the thrill of a lifetime with Epine Mortelleus le grand frisson avec Epine Immortelle.Under the petals, thorns... Under the fresh citrus fruits, a red, biting rose blossoms. Like the exhilarating thunderbolts of a passionate affair. Under the sweetness of the magnolia notes, a woody rose wrapped in frankincense burns. Like a hurricane that sweeps everything in its trail, tinged with vetiver and patchouli. Epine Mortelle takes you in the throes of a passionate, obsessive and tormented love story.  An indelible passion, a consuming flame that never goes out.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Fil d’Or N°1 Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A liqueur-like, woody, amber trail.A sexy, sophisticated blend of scents, like a silky blouse against your bare skin. An intoxicating elixir that draws its forbidden taste from the warm notes of rum, tobacco and davana, a herb with syrupy liqueur overtones. Vanilla and labdanum add voluptuous heart notes to Fil d'Or N°1, while pink berries and oak lend a touch of sophistication.30% Concentration

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Fil d’Or N°2 Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A floral, woody and spicy scent that exudes elegance. Dare to take elegance further with a touch of eccentricity.Like a fine velvet garment, Fil d'Or N°2's trail glides over the skin with refined sensuality. A sculpted trail, chiselled from noble materials, where the opulence of Damask rose blends with the carnal essence of Sambac jasmine. The rare qualities of the osmanthus absolute instil a sense of mystery. A floral, spicy accord whose impeccable base lies on a woody bed tinged with precious agarwood.25% Concentration

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Fil d’Or N°3 Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A woody, rich, enveloping fragrance. The gentle caress of cashmere in a bottle.Endlessly soft, Fil d'N°3 wraps you in sweet luxury. A fragrance you dream of slipping into like a fine cashmere jumper. One of those wardrobe essentials you always come back to, a comforting trail. A woody accord, spun with dreamwood, a new material that enhances the rich, creamy nuances of majestic sandalwood, wrapped in cedar, vanilla and musk.25% Concentration

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Kingdom of Dreams Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The dancing flame of the candle and the free incense scrolls hypnotize you and you plunge into a state of trance and ecstasy. KINGDOM OF DREAMS is a real addiction transporting you to a dreamy and fantasy universe. Abandon yourself and let yourself be transported to the kingdom of all desires.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Kingkydise Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A playful and carnal fragrance. As sexy as a mischievous smile, its apparent freshness will lure you into its trap. A feast for the senses, bound by luscious heart notes of rose and lychee. Fiery base notes, tinged with musk and wood, wrap you in a sensual embrace. Unequivocally unisex, a libertine fragrance that overturns genre conventions to plunge us into an exhilarating, intimate world.Exploding top notes, enhanced by the spiciness of Sichuan Pepper, offer a glimpse of the fleshy fullness hidden beneath the bitter freshness of grapefruit. At the heart, rose essence unfolds its full, slightly metallic nuances, while lychee stirs up desire with its fruity accents. Matcha tea stretches the bitterness of the top, while iris envelops the composition with its velvety touch.  Base notes reveal the well-rounded sensuality of the fragrance, featuring sandalwood and musk, for a slightly gourmand touch.

listings.description: At the edge of an enchanted forest, vibrant notes of black currant vibrate, opening wide the doors to this lush garden. A riot of flowers with fleshy petals, still dripping with dew, give off heady scents.A paradise for the senses, where freesia, jasmine and orange blossom are an invitation to voluptuousness. Radiant by day, the white flowers reveal their magnetism at nightfall, when their fragrance becomes hypnotic, like a love potion.An adventurous journey among woody and amber notes that transport you to the garden of desires. An oasis of peace that makes you dream, where generous woods of sandalwood and cashmere come together in perfect harmony. Reminiscent of a heavenly dream, La Nuit des Fleurs spreads the promise of an eternal spring with its sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Lavande Noire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A natural lavender, bursting with sunshine, like a walk through the fields.  A soothing trail that exalts the plant's herbal freshness and underlines its sweetness with notes of balsam. A hint of rum adds an addictive touch to the generous lavender. At the base, frankincense makes the blend vibrate, adding a kind of contemporary charm to this timeless scent.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Lost Paradise Extrait de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: A one-way trip to an intense and inspiring lost paradise inspired Laurent Mazzone in the creation of this enchanting and intoxicating symphony.. A fascinating adventure, with hints of flowers, amber and leather, will immerse you in a lush jungle where white flowers intertwine with resins and woods.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Malefic Tattoo Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An elixir of sensuality that takes us straight to the gates of the Orient.A marriage of ancestral resins, blending incense, papyrus and styrax, in a bewitching trail.  Around the precious Oud wood, the volutes of sandalwood and patchouli float on a velvet base tinted with wood and amber scent.  All this is enhanced by the moiré and spicy scent of saffron.  A hypnotic and shimmering spell.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Neroli Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A melody that sways between the soft freshness of neroli and the bewitching honeyed notes of the orange blossom absolute. Refreshed by the green accents of blackcurrant and angelica in the top notes, this fragrance reveals it’s radiant and voluptuous side. A carnal dimension heightened by the enticing fullness of peach and musk notes.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Patchouly Boheme Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: All things mystical, sensual and haunting. In layers of precious wood, intoxicating herbs and spices. Seeking warm, comforting confusion, it’s a shadow game and it’s circling all around. Hints of tobacco, leather, Resin Tolu and Tonka beans.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Princesse de Coeur Extrait de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Underneath the tender opening, a woody undertone resonates: the dark and bewitching notes of patchouli. A sophisticated, chypre facet dresses you in one effortless move, just like the perfect accessory would. A base of amber wood anchors the fragrance, while the cashmeran makes it melt in your skin. A perfume with a generous soul, in the image of the extraordinary woman who inspired it, S.A.S. Princess Stephanie of Monaco. Her Highness took part in the creation of this fragrance to support her foundation Fight Aids Monaco, which will receive the funds raised by the first eight hundred bottles sold as a donation.

listings.description: Playing with precious, modern materials, Pure Sensual Orchid lavishly unleashes its heart notes. A smooth, rich cocktail, where the sumptuousness of almond and heliotrope meet the subtle elegance of peony and white cedar. Fresh beans unveil their fleshy vanilla in all its sexiness. Amber wood prolongs the spell until dawn.An intoxicating score if ever there was one, Pure Sensual Orchid takes the very essence of the original to the extreme: pure sensuality.

listings.description: Located near the charming town of bonifacio, at the southernmost tip of corsica, lies sperone - a small corner of paradise. With its white sand beaches, turquoise sea, and dry, fragrant air, sperone is a sensory delight. The scents of the maquis - a blend of aromatic herbs, labdanum cistus, thyme, and immortelle - fill the air and add to the allure of this enchanting place.A charming slice of paradise can be found at the southernmost tip of corsica - sperone. When the land breeze picks up in the evening, the fragrances of the maquis are heightened, and the bushes of labdanum cistus and immortelles release their scents, both lively, warm, and sensual. At this point, one can simply relax and be soothed by the gentle lapping of the waves against the rocks.

Then on a Vanilla background, TINHARÉ, sensual and addictive, lets express itself an intoxicating and addictive wake.A Woody Amber trail with sweet scents of Red Mandarin and Vanilla Wood which recount the sweet tropical languor of the Bahia Islands. listings.rawTitle: Ligne St Barth Islander Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the story of Bay rum : a story about man and perfume In the 16th century, sailors discovered the leaves of the West Indian Bay tree, named Pimenta racemosa, a small tree native to the West Indies, also known as Bay St Thomas. When rubbed on the skin, its dry leaves released a highly fragrant oil – an excellent way to freshen up and perfume oneself...While Caribbean farmers were shipping sugar to Europe, a few enterprising slaves discovered in these same sugar-cane plantations that fermented molasses (a by-product of sugar) could be turned into a sweetened alcoholic beverage. Brewers then adopted the original recipe, distilled in order to intensify its alcoholic content, creating the famous rum. Later, an ingenious sailor from Virgin Islands came up with the idea to infuse the leaves and extract their essential oils.. Bay rum was born.. The islanders gradually added spices, citrus zest, cinnamon and more to this cologne to adapt it to their tastes and soon it found its way into pampering rituals as part of a massage or after shaving.Created in the West Indies, this fragrance became very successful throughout the world. Initially in vogue in New York among American barbers, and very popular with men, it was even introduced to the royal courts of Europe. Today, bay rum is still greatly appreciated by the people of the Caribbean islands (from Bermuda to the Bahamas, Barbados to the Virgin Islands).. Ligne St Barth has sought to preserve this beautiful Caribbean tradition while adding a touch of modernity to create an authentic fragrance.. The top notes have been preserved (lime, vetiver, West Indian Bay leaf paired with an old Martinique rum), with the addition of Guatemalan cardamom – the queen of spices. Its base notes reveal Caribbean guaiac wood, Tabacum Havana and Cedrus atlantica.

listings.rawTitle: Ligne St Barth L’Original Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A delicately lemony, virile and spicy note, on a base of salty sea spray.With accords developed around lavender, rosemary and lime, alongside elegant aromatic notes of anise and tropical orange blossom, our eau de parfum perfectly evokes the caribbean lifestyle... A breath of sea breeze on the skin, offering up a sensation of freshness and well-being. The l’original eau de parfum is the perfect embodiment of the authentic st barthélemy man. The humour, charm, self-confidence and discreet elegance of a classical, vibrant and timeless fragrance is revealed, faithful to the dna of ligne st barth.

listings.rawTitle: Ligne St Barth Vanille West Indies Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The sweet, creamy fragrance is a homage to Caribbean vanilla, which was treasured in Creole culture. This perfume from Ligne St Barth underlines its sensuous aura: creamy caramel and a hint of orchid invite us to enjoy life’s full sweetness.Concentration 50%

listings.rawTitle: Ligne St Barth Vetiver Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Fresh, light, green and clear : an elegant, sensual and sophisticated Eau de Parfum.The inspiration for a Vetiver fragrance was born in Haiti, famous Caribbean island and leading exporter of Vetiver essential oil to the world. Haitian Vetiver is cultivated on plantations in the south of the island, in the Cayes region. The precious essential oil extracted from its roots reveals a woody, earthy, smoky and vegetal fragrance. These notes have been faithfully restored in the Vétiver Eau de Parfum. Vétiver fragrance was born. . A sparkling and tangy accord of citrus fruits such as lemon, bitter orange and mandarin, warmed with ginger, coriander, pepper and Jamaican Pepper, brings sensuality and refinement. . Fresh and fleeting notes combined with woody and zesty scents make this creation one we never tire of discovering over and over again.

The heart has been associated with love, passion, emotion and romance for centuries, with Cupid's arrow piercing the heart being a well-known image in art and literature. The heart is the source of our deepest emotions and desires, or that it is the place where our truest self resides. Ame du Cœur is love, the soul of the heart. listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Esco Pazzo Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: Esco Pazzo was an exercise in patience and perseverance. Lorenzo Pazzaglia envisioned the fragrance perfectly in his mind’s eye but bringing it to life was an entirely different challenge. He persisted, almost stubbornly, refusing to give up. And he succeeded: the idea became a reality. The dazzling opening of lemon, cedar, bergamot and grapefruit, along with pepper, creates a brilliant burst of freshness, introducing a spicy aromatic heart. The dry down unveils a velvety base of leather, tobacco, and amber.Esco Pazzo is a modern take on the classic structure of fougère fragrances, enriched with oriental hints and amber nuances. More than fifty raw ingredients are skilfully blended to create this refined, elegant and versatile fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Gasoleather Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: "The sound of the motorcycle speeding from the city to the depths of a somewhat corrupted nature. The unmistakable roar, the breath of 6-cylinder engines, like felines transitioning from a muted purr to a powerful growl. Gasoline dripping onto the leather jacket and the smoke, mixed with metallic plastic from the urban air, slowly sliding between the arms of forest paths filled with aromatic, balsamic, and resinous scents.. An undaunted heart that beats despite everything.. A deafening noise that tears through the silence of normality.. A deep scratch on the numb skin.. The roar of thunder ripping through the night." - Antea DevonSpeed, luxury, the smell of fine leather perceived as soon as you get behind the wheel… all of this is Gasoleather, a strong and impactful fragrance where luxurious Florentine leather meets the bold scents of engines, providing a pleasant adrenaline rush and letting us fully savor the luxury of a sports car, the most beautiful one we could imagine.Gasoleather is a fragrance for free, strong souls who want to leave an indelible mark on anyone they meet.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Pax Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: Pax is an olfactory self-portrait used by Lorenzo Pazzaglia to reveal his true self, his culinary art, and his personality. Interwoven, contrasting notes come together to depict the many facets of a multifaceted individual. The effervescent and welcoming opening of citrus and pepper leads to a heart of fruity notes, their sweetness balanced by crystalline incense. Precious woods and leather provide an unexpected backdrop to a bouquet of white flowers with fruity and spicy nuances. Each note, each raw ingredient used, carries a hidden symbol and serves as a key.Pax is the immense HEART of Lorenzo Pazzaglia.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Sex Sea Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: The sky turns a reddish hue as it plunges into the sea. The heart smolders with mixed feelings, fading into the eyes of lovers who savor poetry. Mint and Bergamot dance barefoot on a beach bathed in ozone and myrtle; this is how making love on a bed of white flowers becomes an ode to life, which can be arid at times, like patchouli, salty like algae, but also sweet like vanilla and as crisp as caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Speachless Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: If Speachless were a song, it would definitely be a rock track – bold, exuberant, and full of energy… notes that powerfully expand in every direction. An unforgettable melody that pulls us into the joy of living – lively, sweet, and edgy all at once. A bright citrus opening sets the stage for juicy peach, blending with daring and sharp cannabis accords and the freshness of vetiver, creating a truly unique blend. Follow the trail, because Speachless doesn’t need words: it’s a thrilling experience, an explosion of freedom that sweeps you into a whirlwind of emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Sugar Kisses Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: What could be sweeter than the smile of a little girl happy about her gift? A gift made from the heart, the big heart of Lorenzo Pazzaglia: a perfume, to little Sveva, on October 12, her eighth birthday.A gourmand fragrance that portrays with its harmonious olfactory symphony the most beautiful and pure characteristics of childhood: milk flowers, a sweet orange peel and a delicate vanilla give way to cocoa flowers, chocolate, cream flowers, becoming velvety and even more delicious thanks to tonka bean and toasted hazelnut. The drydown is soft and sugary, thanks to base notes including brown sugar, caramel, toffee and musks.To go back to childhood and see that wonderful smile appear on our face, wrapped in the memory of the most innocent and purest times. A little girl blowing a kiss from her little hand in thanks, a direct and sincere gesture that fills the heart with tenderness: this is Sugar Kisses.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Summer Hammer Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: "I yearn for a fruity elixir to caress my skin. I yearn to inhale the graceful essence of rum-infused pineapple while resting on a bed of musk-scented white flowers. I yearn to recount tales of tropical lands where mangoes thrive and amber-scented breezes drift. I anoint myself with sensuous, velvety coconut milk cream before the crystal-clear sea. Spray me in the harshest of winters and dream; dream of endless, sun-kissed beaches, brimming with promise." - Antea DevonSummer in a bottle to relish all year round, no matter where you are, even when it’s cold outside and warm temperatures are a distant dream. A refreshing, juicy mango piña colada with added kick of warm, tropical vibes, bolstered by a fresh floral arrangement and a sturdy foundation with green notes, enriched with creamy sandalwood. An instantly, playful fragrance, crafted to convey happiness, light-heartedness and a zest for life!

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Sun-gria Extrait de Parfum 28 ml
listings.description: The summer to be experienced.Sun-gria is an olfactory symphony that projects into a picture overflowing with life: a fresh and juicy opening, given by the blood orange and citrus fruits, with a sprinkled with spices, it is submerged by a hot and intense heart composed of peach, blackcurrant, apple, raspberry and red wine. The drydown is sweet and sensual, with woods and vanilla covered with cane sugar which will make everything irresistible and create a magnetic trail.An exchange of glances, the emotion that runs through the back, running at breakneck speed hand in hand, stopping and feeling the warmth and sweetness of carefreeness inside, lulled by a Latin melody. A warm and sensual cloud: Sun-gria is one of those fragrances so enveloping that it enters us, giving us serenity and well-being. Life is a summer. Live it. Always.

A sea that embraces us with its warm hug, creating unique emotions. The fresh and balsamic touch of mint combines with the liveliness of citrus fruits, giving way to the saltiness of marine notes and myrtle, which merge in a surprising play of contrasts with the sweetness of a careful selection of vanillas. Van Sea is an invitation to dream, a dance of olfactory notes that takes us beyond the everyday.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Arabican Rose Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Arabican Rose enchants the senses, transporting with its intriguing magic and sophisticated elegance to a charming landscape, typical of oriental gardens.The opening of Arabican Rose is a lively dance of fresh and fruity notes. The essential rose oil harmoniously blends its depth with the reassuring sweetness of almond aroma, creating a welcoming and inviting atmosphere. Raspberry adds a sparkling touch, hinting at the elegance to come. At the heart of this fragrance, we find the queen of flowers once again, the rose, in all its beauty and majesty. Accompanied by notes of precious coffee, the rose unleashes its full scent, creating a rich and seductive floral bouquet that leaves an indelible mark. The enveloping sweetness of vanilla blends, in the base, with the coffee aroma, creating a sensual atmosphere. Sandalwood, together with patchouli, adds creaminess, depth, and mystery.Arabican Rose is a sensory experience that transports to a world of luxury and timeless beauty.Nose: Marie Duchêne

A seductive mix of sea, salt, vanilla and wood, enriched with a touch of jasmine to give harmony and elegance to the composition.Inside each package you will find a plantable card: a small thought to make a flower bloom and make a contribution to enhancing the planet.Perfumer: David Maruitte

A journey in which vanilla is accompanied by sweet praline and talcum powdery notes that rest on a resinous base that leaves behind a fascinating trail.Inside each package you will find a plantable card: a small thought to make a flower bloom and make a contribution to enhancing the planet.Perfumer: Marie Duchene

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Vanilla Park Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Vanilla Park is the promise of a magical and vibrant journey into the world of the amusement park, where each note transports us to a realm of sweetness and timeless joy, a place where the art of scent merges with the essence of nature.A fragrance that combines woody and floral notes in its opening, then merges into a sensual and soft heart rich in absolute vanilla. The exotic note of coconut milk introduces us to the base of the fragrance, where benzoin and styrax provide depth and warmth, while the cotton candy accord adds that lively and caressing touch at the same time. For all those who do not forget they were children...Nose: Lucien Ferrero

Hints of Patchouli and Benzoin enrich the base of this citrus floral formula, giving body and persistence to the fragrance.Inside each package you will find a plantable card: a small thought to make a flower bloom and make a contribution to enhancing the planet.Perfumer: Marie Duchene

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Vanille de Minuit Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: At midnight, anything is possible. Even a Vanilla fragrance can become perfect for a man to wear. Vanille de Minuit, a unisex fragrance that captures the essence of the night with a harmony of warm and sensual notes. An olfactory symphony that combines the enveloping sweetness of vanilla, the depth of sandalwood, the robustness of leather, the refinement of saffron, and the richness of benzoin.Vanille de Minuit opens with a leather accord that immediately gives a bold and assertive nuance, while sandalwood envelops with its creaminess, adding depth to the composition. In the heart, an engaging vanilla seduces immediately before unfolding into the spicy and sophisticated notes of saffron, which give the fragrance an exotic and mysterious touch. This connection between head and heart creates an intriguing contrast that makes this composition unique in its kind. Finally, benzoin completes the bouquet with its balsamic and slightly vanillic notes, giving the fragrance an elegant and captivating persistence.Vanille de Minuit is a perfect fragrance for any occasion, capable of turning a special evening into an indelible memory.Nose: Marie Duchêne

listings.description: The representation of a soft, warm coffee that releases its bitter scent to reveal a delicate gourmand, milky and voluptuous aroma, with sandalwood notes and rich cocoa flavours with a touch of audacious cardamom.Inside each package you will find a plantable card: a small thought to make a flower bloom and make a contribution to enhancing the planet.Perfumer: Delphine Lebeau

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Vicious Cacao Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A tasty fragrance, which is an absolute delicacy for connoisseurs. An emotional trip through memories and a soft and intriguing caress on the skin. Its ingredients remind of those of a cake, enhanced by noble flowers and enveloping resins: Raspberry and Rose Pepper; Narcissus and Jasmine associated to a precious Cocoa Absolute; Salty Caramel and Saffron. The result is a fascinating perfume that lives on contrasts and seduces with its ability to balance them.Inside each package you will find a plantable card: a small thought to make a flower bloom and make a contribution to enhancing the planet.Perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Vicious Cacao Eau de Parfum 1.2 ml
