listings.rawTitle: Majouri Bohemian Tea Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Freedom—an opening of the senses into new ideas, fantastic dreams and pure aromatic delight. The fragrance is a sensorial immersion, a Green Tea uplift that moves the spirit across eras, continents, and cultures.Wildly poetic, earthy yet absolutely refined, BOHEMIAN TEA is incredibly well-traveled, full of freedom and vitality. Profoundly Eastern with its Green Tea core accord, BOHEMIAN TEA voyages to Southern Europe through citrus notes of bergamot and mandarin as well as orris, derived from a wild root in Italy that emits a scent similar to violets. Orange blossom from North Africa, cardamon from Guatemala, BOHEMIAN TEA is worldly. A base note of guaiac wood, which is often called the ‘tree of life’ in Native American culture, adds depth and intrigue with its olfactive touch of burning leaves.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Charming Tuberose Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The charms of a Diva. One of the most powerful floral notes available to perfumers, Tuberose lets herself be known. Her fragrance is a contrasting mix of bold presence and hidden mystery.She starts sweet and ends on a soft note, but the heart of her song is luminous and dramatic. At the heart of this blend, a generous bouquet of floral icons, like an operatic trio: Tuberose, jasmine and gardenia. Altogether they lend the perfume deep inner radiance. Unapologetically feminine, her entry and exit express a softer feminine ideal: CHARMING TUBEROSE opens gently with coconut and cinnamon, leaving with an incredibly long-lasting trail of vanilla and vetiver. Comforting, she ends as delicately as she began.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Crazy in Love Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Falling in love happens once in a lifetime, perhaps twice, and it is incredible and crazy.Through unexpected and hypnotic accords, MAJOURI captures this total breakdown of our barriers and total build-up of connections—a feeling so intense it compels us to proclaim our love to the world.Sweet and tart in its opening, rich and delectable in its heart with seductive musk to last, CRAZY IN LOVE is the experience of wonderful madness, the state of losing control—for love.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Gold Noir Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: A spark of sensuality, when Oriental mysteries meet French refinement.Opulence distilled. GOLD NOIR is an artistic, audacious olfactive expression. A reverie of ancient cultural luxuries across light and shadow. A juicy plum at the heart of GOLD NOIR makes it a very real and sensual scent experience. GOLD NOIR captures an opulent Arabic sensibility through the prism of French savoir-faire. The result is a portrait of Arabian refinement with fresh perspective but authentic voice. And a touch of inimitable style, a touch of noir.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Imperial Vanilla Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Queen of spices, a symbol of luxury and prestige, Vanilla stands out with unparalleled refinement. All aspects of vanilla’s infinite sweetness and elegancy are explored in IMPERIAL VANILLA. A profound gourmand indulgence, a blend of art and culture, this fragrance is a creature comfort par excellence where the finer things in life are given free reign. Brown sugar in the opening notes resound throughout: it accents the sweeter side of rose and jasmine floral blooms, and adds to the richness of Vanilla, caramel, and tonka bean absolute, which altogether draw out the opulent trail of IMPERIAL VANILLA. Regally indulge in soft and sweet.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Jour 11 Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Feeling both foreign and welcomed, surrounded by the precious ingredients of a spice market that seduce the senses as the sun rises in the east. A modern voyage East by Cyrill Rolland.JOUR 11 transports. To another place, another time, another scented world filled with multi-faceted oriental reveries and spicy highs. Cyrill Rolland structured the JOUR 11 blend like a discovery: vibrant and new in its opening, sensual at its heart, warm and enveloping when it is at last fully known. With cashmeran, vetiver and raspberry finishing its trail, JOUR 11 is addictive like a culture can be: known, but not known, authentic but modern with so much to explore and endless intrigue.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Jour 21 Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Two awaited days of the year—the solstices reaching their peak, with an air of opulence.Universal, quiet, yet deeply felt experiences; solstices mark the yearly shifts between two seasons, two worlds, two distinct moods. Created by perfumer Wessel-Jan Kos, JOUR 21 captures the transitional space of these special moments of the year.Sensual and enveloping. JOUR 21’s opening is a round, sweetly luminous orange. It develops with blooms of jasmine florals while moss, spices and woods let earthiness rise. Through olfactive expression, JOUR 21 goes to the essence of earth meeting sun rays.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Jour 3 Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The power of memory—to transport, to dream, and to motivate.Created by perfumer Marie-Patricia Hurel as a personal expression of a universal experience, this woody unisex scent touches the subconscious.Outside of time—violet, dry wood and musk travel beyond the instant. The distinctive composition of JOUR 3 blends with the skin for a soft and diffuse effect. Its opening notes of bergamot and violet unfold into fragrant raspberry and a dry wood, rich with character, as if from another era. A base of amber and musk anchor the scent in time to write an olfactive memory, a future pleasure to remember. When memories awaken, to take us by surprise, for a moment of pleasurable return.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Jour 9 Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Carpe Diem. Instead of looking for happiness, living it. French Perfumer Jennifer Jambon invested a sense of confidence in life in this creation, sparked by a desire to invite others to be present in the moment.Generous, warming, true—this woodsy and spicy blend resonates trust and sincerity.  Notes of plum open JOUR 9, evoking pleasures and joy, while oud at its base adds just the right amount of depth. Featuring orris, a truly exceptional perfume ingredient more costly than gold, it recalls the preciousness of sharing moments of joy.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Noor Neroli Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: “Noor”, in Arabic, means light. NOOR NEROLI is an intense, almost sharp, olfactive interpretation of light. Sensations of clear sun, sharp citrus and a sea breeze passing through a private Mediterranean courtyard. Luminous and pure. The Essence of Neroli is derived from the fragrant orange blossoms of the Bitter Orange Tree—one of the rare plants to bear fruit and blooms at the same time. It is an iconic presence across the Mediterranean basin, with the scent of Neroli constantly blending with the sea air and the sensation of strong sun. NOOR NEROLI is a burst of citrus dancing around this Neroli, clarified by calming floral and herbal essences with a trio of musk, sandalwood and greyamber to make the luminosity endure.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Oriental Soul Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The charm of a destination, the direction of a soul led by magnificent and refined woods, agarwood and kyara.In an increasingly international world, there are physical roots and spiritual ones, the ones we are given and the one we create. ORIENTAL SOUL expresses the path of an internal destination. For MAJOURI founder and creative director Hadi Masmoum, whose origins are in the Eastern Mediterranean, the charm of Arabia is this perfume’s source. The scent of Damascene Roses lifts the generous open-air courtyards of his youth, and anchors ORIENTAL SOUL at its heart. Across its many facets, it is signed with incredible agarwood and kyara. A voyage elsewhere, and home.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Secret Love Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: To our Romantic souls. When love is a state of mind, the way we see the world, the way we romanticize a closeness and allow our imagination to create its own stories. It’s those fleeting glances that stir us, the dream of a touch that lingers, the beauty of a love that feels real, even if it remains entirely ours.A hidden garden of delights of fruits and flowers, hypnotic thoughts and dreams. SECRET LOVE, a uniquely feminine fragrance, is all about a love becoming that exists in whispers and wishes. A joyful and radiant opening filled with exuberant mandarin blossom, blackberry, and kiwi evokes the thrill of possibility, like the first stirrings of a romantic daydream. Its intense floral bouquet features orchid accords and freesia, amplified with deep sensuality in its long-lasting sillage. SECRET LOVE is not about revealing everything—it’s about savoring the beauty of seen and unseen, expressed and eternally secret.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Signature Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: SIGNATURE is a timeless mark, an homage to the art and beauty of Oriental expression. Like a line of Arabic calligraphy, it leaves a lasting impression, structured by strength, grace, and elegance. The air is filled with warm yet spicy aromas. In the distance, incense softly burns, blending with the smoky richness of myrrh. Intense woods and spices make a generous presence be known, respected, and remembered. A signature that transcends time and space, resonating deeply with all those who encounter its trail.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Silky Sandalwood Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: A ritual of elegance. Sandalwood captivates. Its softness, sensuality, woody and warm character exert an irresistible influence on the subconscious. Evocative of ancient religious rituals, it is rooted in a mesmerizing spirituality and uplifting gentle strength.SILKY SANDALWOOD highlights Sandalwood’s smooth facets by surrounding it with a wreath of woody accords: cedarwood, amber and myrrh, which add warmth and calm. Incredibly soft, the perfume SILKY SANDALWOOD is also voluptuous yet honors the sacredness and strength of Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri Sweet Ambrette Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The delights of her sweetness, nature sparkles in the musk of Ambrette seed.Lightness and depth, fruits and florals, innocence and experience. SWEET AMBRETTE explores the olfactive nature of Ambrette seed, one of the rarest and most precious ingredients on a perfumer’s palette. Unlike the vast majority of musk used in perfumery today, Ambrette seed is of natural and vegetal origin, suggesting its sweet, flowery and warming aspects. The light-hearted sweetness of bergamot transitions seamlessly into the sweet side of Ambrette seed surrounded by a luscious pear and an amber veil for compositional depth and an unexpected sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri The One and Only Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Charisma in its purest form—bold, unpredictable and utterly irresistible. What remains is an ideal, a crystallization of his character and undeniable presence.THE ONE AND ONLY is an impertinent woody and citrus addiction. So few fragrances can craft such an inviting whole from elements so wildly different. A fruity surge of bergamot, lemon and mandarin starts, only to end with a sumptuous melting of cedarwood, musk and vanilla. Between fresh and warm, floral and aromatic, citrus and spice—there is everything and only one thing in this perfume: a character of contrasts. Impossible to avoid, yet always leaving others wanting more.

listings.rawTitle: Majouri White Rose Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Like an iconic photograph, a fresh and conceptual portrait of Rose. A sense of aesthetic appreciation, when light falls upon a bouquet of white petals for a perfect harmony with its shadows.She is the grande dame of perfume; everyone knows Rose, but rarely in white. The redder the Rose, the more intense her scent but white Roses are arguably more captivating, with delicate undertones of musk, violet and lemon. WHITE ROSE magnifies these hidden charms, exploring the subtler side of Rose. Lemon and white floral notes uplift her nature, complemented by tuberose, another white flower, and a final accent of white musk. WHITE ROSE is MAJOURI’s homage to the intensely feminine aspects of Rose rarely seen. With the softer tonalities of its yellow to white petals, there are secrets in the shadows.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Bagheera Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Bagheera represents the time of the day when the sun reaches its zenith, and the most enlightened interaction between man and animal. While penetrating deeply into the jungle to reach the middle part of the island, they accidentally wake a panther from its slumber. Instinctively they start to run, but the panther runs around them, then along them, then eventually in front. The animal turns his head to indicate a change of direction and guides them with aloof temper to a waterfall in the northern part of the island. Feel like caressing the big black cat shoulder.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum God Speed Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A deliberately dosed blend of exotic pepper extracts and vulcanized incense with hints of rose absolute on a base of rich amber.. A soul booster that serves as a reminder to face life with grit, poise, and determination.A deliberately dosed blend of exotic pepper extracts and vulcanized incense with hints of rose absolute on a base of rich amber.. A soul booster that serves as a reminder to face life with grit, poise, and determination. Inspired by the old English way of wishing someone a successful and safe voyage, Godspeed is a wish for you to embark on your life’s path with courage, poise, and determination.. The perfume pyramid symbolizes these very aspects of a successful journey: the top notes are strong and energizing. The middle notes are warm and refined. The base notes are rich and grounded.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Here Come the Son Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A shining warm take on the fougere, playing with sweet notes of ambrette, orange flower absolute, iris butter and soft sandalwood. Evokes a feeling of rebelliousness and a fearless self belief.Here Comes The Son is a creation that started as an experiment in Kristian’s private laboratory in 2018.The perfumer Cristiano Canali was then appointed to continue the development, with the goal of challenging the common fougere as we know it today. Disregarding the egalitarian nature of Nordic Countries known as “The Law of Jante”, Here Comes the Son encourages a fearless self belief.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Paradiso Super Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A cocooning musky floral of imaginary accords tinted by jasmine and tonka absolute.A testament to the power of imagination that unlocks all possibilities.. Paradiso Super is minimalistic yet otherworldly, with a soft and comforting aura of warmth enveloping the senses.. The concept was to use few materials, leaving out all the unnecessary, to evoke a feeling of comfort, sensuality, and wonder.It can be a source of solace and a way to escape the stresses of the outside world, providing a safe and warm cocoon in which to retreat.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Paradiso Super Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: A cocooning musky floral of imaginary accords tinted by jasmine and tonka absolute.A testament to the power of imagination that unlocks all possibilities.. Paradiso Super is minimalistic yet otherworldly, with a soft and comforting aura of warmth enveloping the senses.. The concept was to use few materials, leaving out all the unnecessary, to evoke a feeling of comfort, sensuality, and wonder.It can be a source of solace and a way to escape the stresses of the outside world, providing a safe and warm cocoon in which to retreat.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Psychotrope Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A metallic bite (saffron) opens Psychotrope, but any danger in edges is curbed by cypress & cedar’s sweet airs and the nutty heat of pimento dusted resins (elemi and ambergris). Incense and sandalwood interweave to bring an effervescence to this adrenaline-inducing cocktail. Gurjan balsam is crucial to the scent’s play-on-skin, a honey-black elixir that fills in the empty. Interprets the hallucinogenic effects that hallucinogenic substances provoke in humans. Spaces of this kaleidoscope vision. Psychotrope will broaden your eyes… and mind.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Safariyah Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Safari imparts the morning hours, as a female beauty wakes up her male companion up by kissing him and kindly slapping his face. A musky smell of mangos and red tangerine from her breath lingers upon his sandy face, while the drops from the morning dew slides off the leaves on a magnolia bush. They discover sufficient supplies of tropical fruit as they wander into jungle right behind the cast away beach. Sweet as unexpected morning kisses.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Shameless Seducer Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The clue to seductive charm may manifest in contrasts rather than pure sweetness, and here we are: this elegant musk-iris fragrance opens with a “lime-fraiche” accord contrasted by sensual strong animalic notes. The heart notes consist of a human skin accord. Aquatic blue (Italian citrus, aldehydes) lights up your synesthetic screen upon first sniff, but is swiftly undercut by a funk (cumin) that’s spiked with something fresh (ambrette seeds). Like deliciously salty sweat shameless seducer recalls moist skin, the epidermis rendered lovingly by notes of mimosa and iris. A final dry down reveals civet and musk, mimicking the complex multi-tonal heat of the body, perspiration dried on. For all of its unmistakably human qualities shameless seducer never goes ferile; instead it invites you to reach out and touch, or taste, the skin it lives in.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Tigre du Bengale Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Initially, this scent is all subtle, roasted spice (cardamom and juniper), a wreath of aromatics adorning the opening of this alluring fragrance. A velveteen tobacco produces a purring warmth, the central hearth glowing at the heart of tiger. Myrrh burns close by, it’s gilded haze lifting to reveal sweet labdanum and earthy patchouli. Castoreum slinks, a lone animal guarding the periphery of this property. Tigre du Bengale is a mysterious but inviting entity: enter, and abandon caution.

listings.rawTitle: Malbrum Wildfire Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Wildfire exemplifies the blue hour and suggests the renowned role of the male to harness huge bonfires in the set of dawn. It can also be interpreted as the flaming desire within men to survive, to make love and to keep the feminine counterpart at bay. The scent marks the end of a story by painting an olfactory picture of the place where he provides shelter on the opposite side of the island from where they woke. He makes love to her and his male odours layers onto the fumes of the bonfire glowing throughout the night.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Alcove Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Somewhere in Asia - At twilight, the Sandalwood Pavilion comes to life - Performed by Karine Chevallier - 2024.Secret scene: the story of the Sassanid king, Bahram Gur (who ruled from 420 to 438 AD). The king had an architect build seven domed pavilions for each of his seven beautiful wives from different parts of the world. The Sassanid king Bahram Gur sits with a princess in the sandalwood pavilion, surrounded by courtiers who entertain him with food, music, and dance...Alcove captures the very essence of sophistication and luxury. Sandalwood, with its intrinsically beautiful scent, is the main character in this opulent creation. However, this fragrance does not settle for simply staying grounded. It desires to fly, to reach new heights of olfactory pleasure. This is achieved by skillfully blending it with other carefully selected ingredients, each adding its own unique quality to the overall composition. Alcove is a symphony of refinement, capturing the richness and complexity of sandalwood in all its splendor. It is a fragrance that demands attention, leaving a lasting impression on all who encounter it.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Catherine Eau de Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: A confident woman. She is aware that fashion fades but style is timeless.Imagine a fragrance that captures the essence of a dewy morning, reminiscent of a grassy field. The air is fresh and damp, signaling the start of a new day. It’s as if the grass and leaves are still glistening with moisture, evoking a sensation of juicy sweetness, like freshly peeled pears and damp fingertips.This fragrance opens with an herbaceous blend of green grass and violet leaves, creating a lush and verdant atmosphere. The bitterness of rhubarb adds contrast, while a hint of sweetness rounds out the composition, balancing the green notes perfectly.Embodying independence and freedom, this scent is approachable and inviting. Picture a woman in a timeless tuxedo, exuding confidence and elegance, embracing life with joy and spontaneity.Adding a touch of sophistication and femininity is the impression of a gardenia tucked into her tuxedo lapel. This subtle yet significant detail mirrors the elegance and grace of the woman wearing it. This fragrance is a green floral symphony, reflecting nature’s beauty and the confident allure of the woman who wears it.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Diana Eau de Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: Off the beaten path, in the forest. With the silent company of your loyal dog. Plucking wild flowers and chips of tree bark. Sometimes, the perfume of nature is the perfect fragrance.Inspired by the goddess Diana, this fragrance embodies a powerful, independent woman who values her freedom. Opening with notes of Mediterranean scrubland, it evokes the vast, open spaces of Diana’s domain, with clean and fresh undertones reminiscent of her ritualistic bathing, an act of self-care and reverence for her body. The inclusion of berries adds a sensual allure, while a fruity touch hints at indulgence. Just as Diana was admired by Actaeon, this perfume exudes an irresistible allure, radiating beauty and charm that captivates all. A woody base signifies the unwavering character of this formidable woman, with a sensual, animalic touch of musk evoking the untamed femininity of Diana’s animal companions, the stag or the hound. Lavender, present both in the opening and the base, brings a coumarin tone, slightly honeyed and sweetly tobacco-like. Fruity geranium, with hints of rose, enhances the complex bouquet. A rose-scented molecule derived from lychee, combined with a touch of lactones, creates a harmonious blend of floral and fruity notes, evoking the lush undergrowth where Diana roams.Experience the refined sensuality of clean skin, warm skin, and naked skin. This fragrance encapsulates the essence of a sophisticated, strong woman—an embodiment of Diana herself.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Dolceacqua Eau de Parfum 10 ml

Do not hide your scars, show them with pride. "

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano L’Attesa Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: The soft lights seem to fondle the wrinkled sound of the old vinyl disc,and play hide-and-seek in the warm embrace of the jazz singer’s voice.The wide french-window is opened on the terrace. Outside, only the cicadas shrill drowning and the warm summer breeze. On the tea-table, a nosegay of freshly plucked flowers, flooding the room with a cocktail of smells and a bright colour palette. You uncork a champagne bottle and fill the two flutes. The unmistakable flavour of yeast hovers in the air. You settle into the couch, to enjoy this moment, and take a good look around – every single detail is simply perfect.You then close your eyes, breathe deeply, listen to the sound of her steps on the stairs. Can’t help smiling. You wish these moments would never end.There comes a knock on the door.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Love Kills Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: The rose of love is in full bloom.Act III scene III. "Tonight she is Imogene ... and tomorrow she will be Juliet"LOVE ... What can a lover's perfume represent better than a scarlet flower? Love. Oh, love! Lover. Oh, Lover "The Bard wondered ... What's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet.... KILLS Because unfortunately behind every story of true love there could be a tragedy ending. The rose of love had dried up. Only one night has passed, it seems almost a thousand years. Squeeze the dry rose in your fist. There will be nothing left but some dust. And a beautiful, melancholy reminder of how sweet this love story has been withered too quickly.

listings.description: With Oud Oil, has been enhanced the animalic and sensual atmosphere of the original creation, so to get a carnal rose more narcotic.With Love Kills, we explored all the facets of rose, its freshness almost litchi-like and the more fleshly, sensual ones. Here, I chose to emphasize the darkest, richest and most precious notes of the flower with the Oud and the Vanilla to intensify this sensuality and animality as the first drop touches the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Luci ed ombre Eau de Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: You are peaceful and untroubled. You feel like you were between a barley field and a thick wood, where no sunbeam can penetrate. There is a blinding light, everything seems calm and quiet. Out of a sudden a shiver runs down your back. You realize that such an enticing scene has a gloomy facet, intriguing and mysterious. It is the night meeting the day, the embrace between light and shadow. The breeze in your hair and the warm and humid breathe of the wolf down your neck. You don’t know any longer neither where you are, nor where you long to be. The dark side is irresistibly fascinating, stronger than any fears and uneasiness it produces.. A fresh, energetic, inebriating perfume.. And a dark, animalic incense.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Madeleine Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: "Le donne di Masque" collection.. “Angelina means a lot to me. First of all, it was the name of my mother. And from my mother I inherited the passion for travels and for nice afternoon teas in fancy patisserie. So it was almost natural – when I started traveling frequently to Paris – to feel a strong attraction for this place in Rue de Rivoli. Every single business trip in the Ville Lumiere could not end without a stop at our favourite delicatessen place. And most of the times I ended up eating a chestnut dessert that my mother would cook for me when I was a kid, the Mont Blanc!”. - Alessandro BrunStopping at the legendary tearoom – like famous artists and fashion designers did since the turn of the XX Century – means turning back time, bringing back sweet memories that the talented Fanny Bal (the nose behind the creation of Madeleine) skilfully managed to capture in a sweet floral creation that will not pass unnoticed. Like a charming girl, sipping hot chocolate in Rue de Rivoli.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Ray-Flection Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: An alien flower, warmed by the light that he himself radiated, melting became honeyAct IV Scene II. A dream. A flower, with an incredibly intense scent. Huge. Gigantic. Not a normal flower, the kind you can find on earth. This flower was emitting a surprisingly bright light. As time went by the light became more and more dazzling and the flower began to melt dripping like honey from a rich and juicy honeycomb.. "For this new opera scene we decided to create an 'alien flower', a floral scent that has never been smelled before."

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Ribot Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Deauville, Normandy - The first morning at the racetrack, performed by Antoine Lie - 2023.It’s early morning, the grass at the racetrack is still covered with dew. Seas of hay to feed the horses. The jockey saddles his racehorse and prepares for the race. Not far, the sea. At Port Deauville, bored tourists, frozen to the bone, sip their coffee inside the bistro... And the fishermen silently fold their nets after a successful night’s catch.The fragrance opens with a fresh and very natural top note (CO2 extract of pink pepper from Réunion), with green and aromatic accents (oil of Salvia sclarea Grand Cru France - saffron extract Grand Cru Kashmir India - rosemary oil from Morocco) that pave the way for a captivating effect of the hay accord, which will be at the heart of the scene. The hay (ultrasonic extract of Hay 'Crau' Grand Cru France) develops warm and powdery sensations, with a tobacco-like sweetness, almost fermented, in a balance between gourmand and animalic territories. A touch of Indian sambac jasmine is found at the heart of the fragrance. At the base, the leather accord is perfectly balanced with the opulent resinous combination of Laos benzoin resinoid and Somali myrrh oil.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Romanza Eau de Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: Daylight is breaking in. What time is it? The Green Fairy inspired throughout your nightlong endeavours and now you’re done. Your beautiful subject is still there facing you. …such a beautiful poser… So well dressed, so carefully groomed, so irresistibly debonair, …beautiful and intoxicating… as intoxicating as the indolic smell of the flowers in full bloom, coming from the garden. So weird – only yesterday you were just friends. Bees hopping from one flower to another, perpetuating the amazing circle of life. Butterflies in your stomach. What is going on? What is this vertigo? Overwhelming attraction, stirring you up.. Still you are not in love – yet.. A delightful Italian word describes all this sublimely: Innamoramento.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Russian Tea Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Out there, the snow-covered Nevsky Prospekt, and a sumptuous Art Noveau building. Inside, a large bookstore. And, on the first floor, an elegant cafè. As water is poured in the cup, the infusion unleashes its most characteristic notes. Black tea, heavy and intense. A floral note, sharp and biting. And that unmistakably dry and smoky aftertaste given by the caravanserai campfires, meant to keep the precious tea cargo dry in the never-ending journey through Siberia. The fresh mint leaves give a pleasant fresh touch to the hot water. A teaspoon of raspberry preserve sweetens, without altering it, the bitter aftertaste of leather and birch. We sip it slowly, gazing out of the wide window, towards the beautiful cathedral of Our Lady of Kazan and beyond. The Russian Tea Ritual today carried us to an unexpected journey in remote lands, full of mystery and fascination.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Russian Tea Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Julien Rasquinet conceived a new, oud-soaked Russian Tea.I chose to work with the Oud Oil from LMR’s producer in Vietnam for its unique mystical woody facet. This ingredient adds an animalic, comfortable and sensual oriental undertone to my creation.. I took all the characteristic ingredients of Russian Tea and intensified them with the Oud.. By changing the afternoon tea by a midnight tea with a Smoke accord and a Smoked Leather, I wanted Russian Oud to convey this deeply mysterious woody addiction.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Sleight of Fern Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Sleight of Fern has been created in respect to the historic construction of Fougère fragrances, in line with the most deep, unique and recognizable notes of the classic formulations, which are the ones that also enhance a Chypre signature.We worked on this new composition with the aim of making it elegant and distinctive, sensual, addictive and very sophisticated. A new fragrance that brings comfort and souvenirs of our forefathers, as well as modernity and unexpected combinations.Tuberose and Narcissus play fatal attraction in the heart of Sleight of Fern, bringing depth, complexity and a very attractive sensuality to the minty and rosy Geranium. This mesmerizing floral heart opens with crispy citrus, spices and aromatic herbs that gravitate on top to showcase the most pleasant and modern facets of French Lavender. This unique scented journey gently leads with confidence to a stylish, vibrating and refined woody leathery base, where birch wood echoes with leathery red thyme and oregan on top: the circle is squared!

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Tango Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Whispers all around you, the party is merry. The soft music in the background gets gradually louder. A crescendo. A glass, another glass. Ron y miel. Inebriating, amber nectar. Inebriating as the smell of the blooming jasmine, carried along by the warm summer gusts. A crescendo. You meet her gaze – she whispers a couple of words. You spot it – it is Lunfardo. Your forehead drenched with sweat. Salt melts in the sugar of the liquor. The shuffling Gotan rhythm makes you brave, the night and the tango are on your side. A crescendo. Deafening summons. The air gets even hotter. You are aware it will hurt you. Yet you can’t resist. listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Tango Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tango Oud is a whole new interpretation of Tango, created for the new Masque Milano’s Ruby Collection: it is an even richer and more opulent version than the original one. The vibrant opening, enhanced with sparkling spices such as pink pepper and cardamom as well as warmer spices like cinnamon, leads to a deeply intensified floral heart where an inebriating, creamy Jasmine dances with a thick, velvety Centifolia Rose absolute.. The patchouli note was facetted to become more modern, powerful and longlasting. But what truly gives its depth, strength and character to this fragrance is the introduction of Oud Aquilaria malaccensis, the most precious of all Ouds. Its woody, leathery, animalic notes, enhanced by animalic, sensual and ambery Ambraro- me, and strengthened by a sharp and vibrant amber woody note, make this Tango wilder than ever…The type of Oud used in Tango Oud (Aquilaria malaccensis) is considered to be the most precious Oud in the world. It grows and is distilled in the region of Sylhet in Bangladesh, on the border with Assam, which is the historical birthplace of Oud. It is particularly woody and leathery compared to other ouds, with animalic and spicy facets, and has incomparable depth, power and elegance.” Cécile Zarokian

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Terralba Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: You are in such a transition area in which the smells of shrubs and the heath mingle intimately (and indistinguishably) with the saline odour of the sea. You walk cautiously on the rocks of the medium pathway leading to the beach, following – almost chasing – the sound of the waves, finding your way through the thick vegetation. It is a narrow and steep pathway. You touch the branches of the bushes. A bent branch bleeds a dense and sticky resinous liquid, whose strong and bitter odour doesn’t want to leave your skin. And – in front of you – deep blue. The horizon expands and you abandon yourself to the sounds and the view of the mighty ocean sea.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Times Square Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: New York stinks.It stinks of cheap harsh tobacco and dense exhaust gas. The traffic jam seems endless. And stinks of hot rubber and stale steam. People are weird. The fashionista lady with the glowing-green stilettos orders a huge pretzel.  And stinks of lurid street-food of any sort. Cinnamon and fries. Mustard and caramel. The cherry of the whore's bloody-red lipstick melts with the strawberry of her chewing-gum. The side alleys are just garbage and urine.But find your way through the crowd of bachelorettes waiting for the male-strip show, and it will be a flood of tuberose and carnation. I feel like having a walk tonight. Go get my crab cakes and a burger. And breathe the city miasmas while reaching the place. Oh I love this city.How do I love it.

listings.rawTitle: Masque Milano Vaiana Eau de Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: There are places in the world where all you need to be elegant is a sundress and a large, waxy flower on your ear.Vaiana is inspired by a woman on a Polynesian beach, surrounded by lush tropical vegetation. As the day ends, the scent of coconut palms, tiaré flowers, and Tahitian gardenia (monoi) fills the air. Vaiana feels the warmth of the sun on her skin, cooled by the gentle ocean breeze as she sips a tropical fruit and lime cocktail. The fragrance of sunscreen mingles with the salty sea air, and the breeze carries the sweet aroma of tiaré flowers and lush vegetation.Vaiana embraces life, surrounded by nature and the open air, always on the move. Her wet, tousled hair reflects her carefree attitude. She values comfort and ease over perfection. She enjoys the company of friends, experimenting with ethnic cuisines, and exploring new music. Open to cultural influences, Vaiana is sensitive to the world around her.Her elegance is effortless and innate, not rehearsed or forced. Vaiana embodies a carefree elegance, a natural grace that comes from within. The Tiaré flower, the national emblem of French Polynesia, is worn by Polynesians on the ear daily. Wearing it on the right side signifies being single and searching for love.The tiaré is also used to produce monoi, a traditional scented oil for cosmetic and ritual purposes. Monoi is precious to Polynesians, playing an important role in ceremonies and beauty treatments.

listings.description: The souls of Passion Island are creative, dreamy, always seeking exotic landscapes. They walk through a paradise where desire and fantasy merge. On this solitary island, every breeze and every golden sunbeam carries the promise of pleasure. In this place, reality fades away – only passion and freedom remain. A sensual escape where it’s easy to lose oneself in the warm and intoxicating embrace of the island. Let Passion Island awaken your deepest desires and transport you to a realm where every fantasy comes to life. The citrus notes of lemon and bergamot open the fragrance, wrapped in the warmth of sun-drenched sands. At its heart, tropical scents like mango and pineapple emerge, adding a sweet and exotic touch. listings.rawTitle: Milano Fragranze Neon Lights Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With the new chapter of Milano Fragranze, we invite you to immerse yourself in the stories and sensations of Milan’s nightlife in the ’80s and ’90s. The fragrance, capturing the energy, glamour, and revolutionary spirit of those times, is inspired by neon lights, intoxicating rhythms, and the electric atmosphere of the era. In the distance, the neon sign lights up, marking the start of a night full of possibilities. The anticipation of entering, the question of who will be admitted, is ever present.The selection at the entrance creates a safe haven for all, granting access only to those who have the look, attitude, atmosphere, and desire to belong, to truly be part of it. This perfume transports you to a time when music, fashion, and freedom collided in the most unforgettable way.The fragrance’s top notes are a vibrant blend of bergamot, cardamom, and coriander, enhanced by the warmth of clove oil, immersing you in a glamorous atmosphere, and the exotic richness of ylang-ylang. The heart notes are a burst of strawberries and tuberose. Strawberry represents desire, freedom, fantasy, the luxury of being able to ask for anything you want. Tuberose embodies exuberance, excess, and addiction: the ultimate Diva, regardless of whether you are a man or a woman. The warm, amber, and gourmand base notes give you the feeling of being in a large, welcoming family where you can have fun.Perfumer: Nathalie Festhauer

listings.rawTitle: Milano Fragranze Piazza Affari Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In Roman times, where today the Mezzanotte palace is located, the Roman theater of Milan stood. The history of the stock exchange building, known as Palazzo Mezzanotte, began in 1927 when the Mezzanotte began the surveys for the construction of the new construction site which opened in 1929 but which suffered interruptions and continuous slowdowns due to the discovery of the remains of the aforementioned Roman theater. The building, with an extension of 6450 square meters, was inaugurated in October 1932. in 2010 in the center of the square a sculpture entitled L.O.V.E., symbol of freedom, hatred, revenge, eternity, was placed. The work, inaugurated during the great recession, was also interpreted as a portesta against the world of finance symbolized by the Stock Exchange and was at the center of a controversy that arose precisely because of the offensive nature of the gesture it depicted.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Ambre Eau de Parfum 75 ml

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Ambre Eau de Parfum 1 ml

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Aqua Lotus Eau de Parfum 90+7.5 ml
listings.description: The impressions: Coolness, Dream, Vivacity, Meditation, Shore.Acqua Lotus takes you far away, evokes escape, space, infinity. With a sparkling grace, he knows how to play on the wave of tenderness and impetuosity like no other. On the edge of the landscape, it takes you far away, evokes escape, space, infinity... With a sparkling grace, he knows like no other how to play on the wave of tenderness and impetuosity, between surf and deep waters... A wandering freshness that cannot be told, since it is its force that seizes us and surprises us. Acqua Lotus is Célia's tribute to her grandfather, the third generation of the House. listings.rawTitle: Molinard Bambou Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Bamboo transports you and animates you with its vegetal and exotic notes, full of freshness and softness. An ode to Asian countries, an encounter with the majesty of bamboo forests, an unwavering symbol of tenacity, combining elegance and resistance. Bamboo, transports you and animates you with its vegetal and exotic notes filled with freshness and softness. A round and light fragrance, carried by an envelopment of cedar wood and sandalwood, fine harmony between tenacity and simplicity.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Bel Air Eau de Toilette 75 ml
listings.description: A floral flight of a thousand fragrances from the Pays de Grasse. Bel Air, in a contemporary interpretation, exalts the most exquisite flowers of Grasse in a sumptuous, luminous bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Campus Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Wooded, gourmet.A bit of a rebel, Campus is enigmatic. Its fruity start is asserted on a melting Lavender, before freeing itself on woody notes, infinitely sensual.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Cher Wood Eau de Parfum 90+7.5 ml
listings.description: Sensual, bewitching, enigmatic. Traversing time along the road less traveled, it is warm, willful, luxuriant, and radiant. Cher Wood exudes the charm of gypsy whimsy, a woodland prince that cherishes freedom. Loyal to its graceful expression, evolving with each day. The expression of who we are, or who we long to be.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Chypre Charnel Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Unravel the mystery of seduction with this fascinating new accord, a sensual, floral-fruity chypre, bewitching and carnal, like a second skin.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Chypre Charnel Eau de Parfum 1 ml
listings.description: Unravel the mystery of seduction with this fascinating new accord, a sensual, floral-fruity chypre, bewitching and carnal, like a second skin.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Citrus Noir Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Kalamansi is a small exotic fruit also known as the Philippine Lime. It's a hybrid born from the fusion of two types of citrus fruits that the they give a rich and multifaceted scent.. Kalamansi plays a predominant role that it mixes in an exotic cocktail made of elemi citrus notes, lemon and bergamot.. The woody notes of cypress and vetiver give strength and vigor to the heart that lights up with smoky tones in the background of fiery incense.. An infusion of precious and original raw materials, sparkling and fascinating.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Cuir Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Cuir stimulates the senses with cutting-edge, contemporary notes. This unexpected, provocative, addictive scent achieves the perfect accord between the perfumer's unmatched audacity and the visionary maturity of leather.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Cuir Eau de Parfum 1 ml
listings.description: Cuir stimulates the senses with cutting-edge, contemporary notes. This unexpected, provocative, addictive scent achieves the perfect accord between the perfumer's unmatched audacity and the visionary maturity of leather.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Figue Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Experience the sweet delights of this fleshy, sun-kissed fruit. A rich, fruity fig note spreads over the green, sparkling scent of fig leaf. A sensual, addictive scent that envelops you in the free-and-easy warmth of Mediterranean life.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Fleur d’Oranger Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Explorethe very soul of the orange blossom in Fleur d’Oranger, a singular scent paletteto enchant the senses. Sparkling petitgrain from the bitter orange tree isswathed in a neroli floral accord before unfurling across an orange blossommellowed with musky magnetism.The orange blossom, symbol of a sweet and gentle way of life, shares itssultry, indescribably delectable freshness in Fleur d’Oranger.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Gingembre Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The roots of ginger have been used since ancient times, for over 5,000 years for its known stimulating properties and invigorating. In China it is a native plant and often a branch of its roots is used as a gift for well wishes to the newlyweds.. Gingembre, Molinard's ginger fragrance, is the result of the union of refreshing notes of bergamot and mandarin and the effervescence of the spicy notes of ginger and nutmeg. An amber sillage of musks gives a romantic touch that fades into a warm and sensual hug.. An infusion of raw materials full of promise.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Habanita Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Habanita, created in 1921, is an icon of French perfumery. The oriental, woody-floral signature of this timeless and legendary perfume is a bewitching olfactory kaleidoscope. An elixir that brings out the unique beauty of each woman who wears it: enigmatic, sensual, and sophisticated, with inimitable style.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Habanita Eau de Parfum 1 ml
listings.description: Habanita, created in 1921, is an icon of French perfumery. The oriental, woody-floral signature of this timeless and legendary perfume is a bewitching olfactory kaleidoscope. listings.rawTitle: Molinard Habanita l’Esprit Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Sensual, like the scent of skin, and undeniably Habanita; the legendary perfume in a new interpretation with musky, carnal spirit.. This new facet of Habanita is ethereal and luminous, discreetly revealing its true nature, at once assertive and mysterious!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Habanita l’Esprit Eau de Parfum 1.5 ml
listings.description: Sensual, like the scent of skin, and undeniably Habanita; the legendary perfume in a new interpretation with musky, carnal spirit.. This new facet of Habanita is ethereal and luminous, discreetly revealing its true nature, at once assertive and mysterious!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Iles d’Or Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: To those with the pluck to explore, the Iles d’Or, lost ‘twixt the Mediterranean’s azure waters and the southern coasts of Provence,  offer a sensory waltz, a dreamy dance in three-four time. With the first step onto land, time stands still and the Mediterranean archipelago reveals its treasure map. Intuition, emotion, imagination, and perception are the cardinal points of its compass rose.. Guided by the perfumes of the dense Provençal maquis, the explorer takes the roads less traveled, brushing fingertips across lavender, sarsaparilla, and heather. Further on, sun-kissed fruit trees sing a siren song of temptation, delicious delights, enchantment.. A synesthetic stroll to the rhythm of the lapping waves beside hidden creeks as yet unexplored. Linger in the lush wilds of these paradisiacal islands, where each intimate moment with nature is earned.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Iris Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: If the greatest riches are often the simplest and most authentic, the iris is certainly one of them.A material of emotions, it transports you into an olfactory poem with a thousand facets... A succession of sensations, a freedom of interpretation, a testimony to one of the most beautiful essences in perfumery.With its color, the flower pays tribute to the House of Molinard, a demonstration of admiration and delicacy, a precious symbol of violet and rose fragrances that evolves into a hymn of musky, woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Iris Ardent Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Evocations: warm, sensual, bold, enveloping.Enter the dance with this incandescent score, featuring sensual, flamboyant notes... This new powdery floral accord is provocative and exhilarating. Subtly angelic, slightly mystical, completely ecstatic, let yourself be carried away by the harmonious combination of amber, musk and vetiver.Succumb to the powerful, exhilarating Iris Ardent.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Jasmin Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Floral, Musky, WoodyJasmin transports us to the gardens of our childhood. It embodies the expression of a poetic, delicate and luxuriant nature. This unique, powdered, single note floral fragrance is orchetrated atound the starry flower. An irresistible moment of freshness ans serenity.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Lavande Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Nicknamed the blue gold, lavender embodies the soul of the sunny fields of Provence summers!  Travel to the heart of the scrubland...With an ephemeral bust of freshness, an aromatic breath of lavender unfurls in a floral, woody heart, before blossoming fully over mellow, musky notes. Discover Lavande, a soft, enveloping, tenderly reassuring lavender that transports you instantly to the sunlit French countryside, to the floral heart of Provence.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Le Rêve Nirmala Eau de Toilette 75 ml
listings.description: A dream of delicious delights.. The scent’s gourmand notes of praline, sugared almond, and chocolate trigger instant desire, to then blend with sparkling citrus (bergamot, mandarin orange), creating a luscious olfactory bonbon. An extravagant bouquet (magnolia, rose, orchid, violet) blooms across a delightfully oriental, musky base, embodying a light, carefree world, the new world of Nirmala!Romantically stylish, the supremely feminine flacon is a faithful replica of its elder, a celebration of young women – and those who intend to remain so.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Madrigal Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Madrigal embodies the irresistible man! His warm, enveloping wake captivates the audience. His poetic writing with subtle notes of incense is a true enchantment of the senses. A powerful fragrance for a gentleman in the air of time!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Méditerranée Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: No matter the destination, the sea is never far off, generously offering its waters, such that you may dive deep into every journey. Travel to the Mediterranean - our sea, encircled by a land of sun-drenched scents.Its marine departure from calone, which looks like sea spray, lets itself be carried away by floral and solar notes of tiare, rose and immortelle to finally flourish on a delicately woody and musky background.A raw-material infusion, in memory of the Mediterranean basin!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Mirea Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Under the generous sun of the Riviera, Miréa reveals a gourmand explosion associated with the sweetness of fruits. A name with an allegorical allure signs an olfactory delight, a true enchantment of the senses!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard MM Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Fearless in every way, MM is daring! Its spicy, amber trail embodies the strength of the man who leads his destiny with confidence.. Refined, always at the cutting edge of elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Nirmala Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The romantic getaway.. An ode to love, Nirmala brings a profusion of scented images to the mind’s eye, a delectable journey through exotic flowers and tropical fruits that immediately sweeps you to faraway horizons. Chic and timeless, this carnal elixir is wrapped in a sparkling “diamond” jewel, a bottle that serves as a veritable declaration of love, crystallizing moments of pure joy.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Osmanthus Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The Flower of the Rising Sun!. The blooms of osmanthus, also known as sweet olive, exude sweet,fruity, leathery notes. In its creation bearing the blossom’s name, Molinard presents a surprising twist, blending the intoxicating floral notes of jasmine and tuberose with an irresistibly velvety duet of iris powder and apricot.. A sensuously carnal creation brimming with insouciance and freedom!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Oud Magnétique Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Woody, leathery, spicy.Oud Magnétique leaves a sillage drenched in incontrovertible character. The lavish, animal top note blends instantly with the provocative aura of oud. Woody potency thrums with a dashing floral heart before unfurling over infinitely addictive leathery notes. An artistic opus.Stylish opulence with an overdose of sensuality!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Patchouli Intense Eau de Parfum 75 ml

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Rose Émois Eau de Parfum 90+7.5 ml

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Rose Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Romantic par excellence, the Queen of the Flowers of Grasse confers elegance and voluptuousness to the one who wears it.Sensual and voluptuous, this fragrant bud embodies today's femininity with graceful notes of joie de vivre.Discover its inimitable and subtle fragrance. Rose de Molinard sublimates the favorite flower of perfumers with a touch of sparkling audacity.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Santal Insolent Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Mystical inspiration in the heart of the sacred forests of India.... In Santal Insolent, the precious wood with velvety notes is contrasted with spicy tonalities of cardamom and pepper to finally stretch delicately on a leathery amber background.. A creation tinged with mystery and insolence with oriental and woody harmonies.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Secret Sucre Eau de Parfum 90+7.5 ml

A woman's fragrance, yes, but also an expression of confident sensuality, of both fervor and subtlety.  Exploring the realm of love and the senses, promising the skin the bliss of tactile treasures yet to come.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Thé Basilic Eau de Parfum 75 ml

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Vetiver Eau de Parfum 75 ml

Our modern floral-fruity fragrance evokes a blooming forest where the bellflower reigns supreme. Let’s walk together.

Joyous bundles of down create blissful warmth, scented with silvery musk and cossetting vanilla. Nourish your senses with a pure, olfactive union.Pure. Gentle. Comforting.Seek cocooning tranquillity in this balance of enlivening elemi, soothing musk and sensual benzoin. A unique milk accord in this Eau de Parfum imparts nostalgic, intimate warmth – ideal for the most chic and calm souls.

Hypnotic.A hypnotic Eau de Parfum sumptuously blooming with spicy saffron, velvety rose and opulent oudh accord. Its signature note of dark patchouli Sulawesi brings sophisticated depth, which we’ve sustainably sourced from Sulawesia, Indonesia, for its intensity and high quality.

listings.description: Trading stories and time-honoured traditions, cultivated through scent. An enlivening trail of bergamot, furling bunches of dark tobacco leaves and spicy, rich nutmeg – warm and distinguished in a single glance. Resinous cedarwood and sensual Peruvian balsam add a complex tinge. Enrich your presence; mature the senses with seasoned depth.Profound. Earthy. Cultivated.A robust, woody fragrance matures the senses with complex notes of smoky tobacco, sensual Peruvian balsam and enlivening ginger in this seasoned Eau de Parfum – an elegant and refined choice for cultivated traditionalists.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Wild Mint & Lavandin Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: A brisk walk in a cool forest, captured in our fresh aromatic Eau de Toilette; inhale a tonic of wild mint emboldened by distinctive lavandin – a more intense variety of lavender, sustainably sourced from Provence – while sensuous orris root infuses contemporary flair before settling into a deep base of tonka bean.The rush of a crystal clear, cool forest stream; a shady bank of shrubs, stalks and bushes. Fresh, wild mint fills the air; a stimulating yet soothing tonic. Warm orris root and creamy nutmeg are grounded by deep tonka bean, tinged with powerfully aromatic lavandin. Meet the wild with the refined; naturally enliven your spirits.

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Blow up Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "There are several elements and moments in the film blow up that resonated with me deeply and that prompted me to create an olfactive response. From repeating textures of wood in the photographer's car and loft, antiques, chemicals in the dark room, dusty feathers, green leaves in the park and marijuana. However, the moment that resonated with me most and served as an inspiration for this fragrance is the scene with the oil painting. The oil painting becomes a metaphor - reality vs fantasy. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Colour of Pomegranate Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Splash of water. Clean body. Clean Mind. Clean life. Black gold warms the indifferent heart. Rituals without Warmth. Wanderer between cultures did you ever see a thorn between two Roses. Ecstatic drops of pomegranatejuice seeping from the lips of monks autumn in armenia. Homecoming searching for ourselves in each Other. We see our shadows burned inch by inch into poems. Today is the last day that i'm using words."The air is thick with the scent of white roses, that weave through your senses like a delicate white lace; unfolding like a page from a mystical manuscript, illuminated with vibrant colors and enigmatic symbols. The taste of ripe pomegranates lingers on your tongue, sweet yet tangibly bitter, a metaphor for the complexities of creative existence. With every heartbeat, you’re drawn into a dance of poetic visuals, a celebration of life and artistry." - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Daisies Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "I got inspired by the characters colourful acts of rebellion; daisies the scent, opens up with an orchestra of green, fruity and edible notes that capture the opulence and gluttony of bourgeois culture.The heart has a society of sweets and florals that decay in a dramatic and witty twist of wood, leather and opoponax resin in the base. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Dolls Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance carried by vivid, extravagant colours and an irrealistic story about uncompromising love: all consuming and bordering insanity. A heavy perfume, based on animalistic notes interrupted by the subtle and light smell of snow; so repulsive in smell, so attractive in colours, so irreal.

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Dreamers Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "A scent with strong '60s elements that responds to specific moments of voyeurism, sexual experimentation and youth. The beautiful smell of bathroom rituals and the innocence of youth experimental and sensual like qualities; there is something intense and cool in it! " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Duke of Burgundy Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: " I wanted to get the sensuality of the film in this fragrance - very feminine oriented. The idea was to get this soft sensual odour. Very musky, clean with a slight touch of shoe polish (bubble scene, waxing). There‘s something fruity in it that gives the scent a sensual warm sex feeling. The lingerie, the underwear... There‘s something silky, cool and smooth in it! " - Mark Buxton.

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Enter the Void Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "A transcendental and darkly erotic fragrance with a surprising herbal green aromatic top note. The fragrance sparks like the neon lights illuminating the alley ways of the tokyo underworld. Think sexy, sensual, psychedelic and addictive " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Io Sono l’Amore Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A first exchange of glances, a sweet handshake, no looking back, yet stealing a glance. A first bite of paradise, an unstoppable torrent from a dangerous joy. Meticulously organized lives unravel, both sensorially and socially. The threads begin to stretch. Greedy bees climbing on bodies to sip their salty nectar. You and I are intertwined with the unspoiled and innocent nature. Unthinkable without you, we must carry on!

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit La Haine Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "A calm yet confrontational scent; that traces your neck like a sharp cold blade with buchu sulfur, metallic bloody notes and cold aldehydes. There is a feeling that something is going to happen with burnt rubber, cold cedar notes creating a concrete effect, combined with birch tar, leather and bay oil.Dying out on a cold, damp cellar smell with cedar atlas, dark musk and moss. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Melancholia Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "Plain tragedy of existence: drawn on notes of violette leaf and lily of the valley and grounded by clearwood and incense pyrogenee,  the innocent moment of recognition arrives both too soon and too late;  producing a feeling of being out of time in the sense of being late but also out of sync or out of tempo.  The realization of this vertiginous experience of our present moment of loss and being lost appears to be looming  when it is already too late. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Mood indigo Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "A film carried by jazz music, i like this ambience. The flowers play a strong role (water lily). The film which starts gay and luminous and becomes very dark! The fragrance is based on dark woody notes with a lot of incense, which represents the jazz music for me. There is a short passage where you smell the light. The chamomile and red pepper give rhythm and moments to the accord " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Parasite Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "Parasite tells a story that takes the complicated feelings that the indentured worker have for their employers and conducts it into a veritable symphony of respect and contempt. It opens up with a fresh cut grass note and goes over in a shower of freesia and lily of the valley as the smiles twist into grimaces when the real world splatters across the manicured lawn.. The richness of patchouli and the smoky guaiac wood expresses the tender musing on familial love that emerges and the bitter all too late realisation that you can’t buy home. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit Single Man Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "It is the gay man that got me curious, troubled by ordinary grief and haunted by joy, a man apart and yet like any other; followed by numbness, routine, sorrow and perhaps another kind of awakening. It is a fragrance based on a variety of woody notes such as violet wood, cashmere wood, mahogany and cedarwood; that reflects the man who constructs or reconstructs a personality to bear the weight of loss and whom society will not permit to grieve." - Mark Buxton.

listings.rawTitle: Moth and Rabbit The Lobster Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "The cinematography inspired me to render a scenery, landscape and feeling of a couple in a forest. A location where two people are restricted to love, yet fall in love. In the coldness; wind, damp wood, lake and forest leaves they find warmth. In the danger and darkness; the animal and bloody undertones they find comfort and light. This is a fragrance that is ultimately herbal, green, wet, dark, animal and woody,  and twisted with a bouquet of wild flowers to represent the society they left, the new one they found and will soon leave again. " - Mark Buxton

listings.rawTitle: Nasomatto Absinth Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: "I start by doing something, but at a certain point it starts making choices by itself. It is the process that interests and guides me. I like the feeling that i'm losing control and i'm not the only one making the choice. My main intentions is to create something that is alive and can tell new things. I want my perfumes to have an existence of their own, not being enslaved solely by the meanings i gave.". The fragrance aims to evoke degrees of hysteria. It is the result of a research process to stimulate irresponsible behavior.Absinth is the most luxurious type of madness. Writer's forbidden delight. Escapism through giggles straight into the center of hysteria where the true meaning of life lies. A masterpiece is finished during the most profound moment of delirium, accompanied by a sip of absinthe, after which one sees the things as they actually are. What is the value of life anyway? Life is worth living while enjoying and laughing as much as possible. Attention: the content of this bottle is extremely irresponsible and a bit hysteric.Motivated by everything that makes giggle, the packaging is a message on its own and an invitation to try. The cap of the Absinth bottle is made out of olive wood.

I want my perfumes to have an existence of their own, not being enslaved solely by the meanings i gave.". It is the result of a quest to evoke the powerful and mighty whisper of an olfactory stirring, which magically rejoins the nothing and the everything.Russians often say: "Поговорим по душam" meaning let's talk soul to soul. This procedure usually requires a bottle of liquor and a genuine engagement in lengthy discussions about life, love, history, politics, and philosophy. The souls of the participants are rejoined with the spirits.Baraonda is a spirit in a perfume bottle. A delicate and costly creation that blends the taste and the smell of a single malt whiskey, lucid dreaming, and reality, burning Russian Red, personal actions, and reactions. It is a sensory hurricane that surrounds one with a mixture of hot and aromatic notes and the scent of old barrels, leaving with a fruity aftertaste.Being inspired by Venedikt Yerofeyev's book "Moscow-Petushki", Baraonda captures the essence of this journey through Moscow Stations. It is an incomparable poem that has no brakes nor limits and an ode to all drinkable, alcoholic, and the clouded but joyful aftermaths.Attention: In this perfume, The Nose used the most costly alcohol and only high-quality natural ingredients to encourage a raw taste sensation. This fragrance may cause effects on thinking skills, like problem-solving, attention, and memory. You might get carried away, but the brave ones should have a taste.Inspired by Moscow and the Russian Red shade, the packaging is itself a message and an invitation to try. Baraonda's bottle cap is composed of a mix of different types of cork from Portugal and Italy.

I want my perfumes to have an existence of their own, not being enslaved solely by the meanings i gave.". Fragrance is a senseless and unfortunate creation caused by misjudgment.The expectations we have are usually unmet, and we are often disappointed. Blamage is about the failure and the acknowledgement of it. It is about the renewal of one's mindset. The mistakes we make are the keys to open the doors of progress. We try and we fail but we don't give up.This fragrance is about accepting and moving on. Sometimes, the greatest works of art happen by mistake. listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Cerana Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Cerana is the olfactory memory of a journey across Asia: from the Philippines to Bali, from Vietnam to Thailand, and on to Malaysia. Mango, savored in every form, proved to be an irresistible muse, giving birth to a sunny and indulgent composition. The name Cerana honors the bee responsible for pollinating mango flowers, an invisible link between nature and fragrance.Perfumer: Julien Rasquinet.

listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Étoile de Bali Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In Bali, a flower island, there are nearly 42,000 plant species including 20,000 different orchids. Flowers are very present in the decoration of temples, statues and monuments. They are also used as offerings in religious ceremonies.The Rain of Flowers is a ritual of sprinkling floral waters. Flower petals, such as jasmine, gardenia, lily, freesia and hibiscus, are infused in fresh water.Thus, this ritual brings softness and radiance to the faces of Balinese women. Etoile de Bali, is inspired by this ritual, offering a floral fragrance blending freesia and lily flowers supported by notes of sandalwood. Let yourself be invaded by this rain of flowers! This fragrance will make you shine like a star with the power of attraction that anyone who crosses your path has.Perfumer: Serge De Oliveira, Robertet

listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Melipona Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Vanilla comes from Mexico where the Aztecs used it to soften the bitterness of chocolate. There were numerous European attempts to cultivate pods outside their original cradle. Louis XIV fell in love with it and wanted to cultivate it on Bourbon Island, in Reunion. But all attempts under his reign failed. No one knew how to fertilize vanilla outside its native area. Europeans were unaware that the Mexican Melipona bee was responsible for pollination. Indeed, thanks to it, the orchid provides a long green fruit commonly called vanilla pod.Gourmet and suave, Melipona is a fragrance that opens elegantly with woody and vanilla notes and gives way to oriental and amber notes in the base.Perfumer: Serge De Oliveira, Robertet

listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Secret du Nil Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This fragrance is inspired by the Nile in Egypt, the origin of the source of which still remains a mystery. Cradle of civilizations, it is the source of a fertile land where we find an abundance of fruit trees and fields of flowers. The bee, the royal symbol of ancient Egypt, was born for the pharaohs from the tears of the sun god Ra. Its honey was a drink for newlyweds, hence the expression “honeymoon”. Honey was also widely used in pharmacopoeia as well as in embalming rituals.Secret du Nil is a fragrance that is both gourmand and floral with citrus notes such as bergamot, orange blossom and neroli and with oriental notes of almond, vanilla and musk. Deliciously seductive and enveloping, Secret du Nil warms the soul to savor its days.Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur, Robertet

listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Suprême Nectar Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Suprême Nectar is a fragrance with almond as its main note. Originally from Western Asia, the almond tree has been cultivated for 5000 years. Between February and March, the buds open and form magnificent white and light pink flowers.While the trees flower, honey bees collect pollen and nectar in the orchards. When bees go from one tree to another, they pollinate the almond blossoms along the way. The almond tree is an excellent honey plant, rich in nectar and pollen. Each fertilized flower will give birth to an almond.Perfumer: Amandine Galliano, Robertet

A touch of enveloping elegance.The sophisticated pleasure of a concentrate of unbridled leather, which explodes from the first second, inlaid with a hypnotic harmony of spicy accords, smoky facets and exquisite balsamic nuances. An incandescent fusion of Pink Pepper, Nutmeg, Bergamot and Saffron Flower creates an ode to the light that radiates and permeates the notes of Suede. Richer with the soft and silky hints of Iris and Rosewood, more immoderate with Labdanum and Cardamom. While warm woods and cinnamon flare up between Patchouli and Vetiver, wrapped in deep and mysterious notes of Cypriol and Gurjum balm. A touch of enveloping elegance. The sophisticated ease of a second skin on.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Osmanto Shock Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The infinite vertigo of the Osmanthus flower unleashes a highly narcotic emotional wave, beyond the floral. An overdose of bliss and bold beauty.The infinite vertigo of the Osmanthus flower unleashes an emotional wave between contrasts and affinities with sweet and spicy notes, warm and deliciously fruity, in a strongly narcotic blend, beyond the floral. The nectar of White Peach, Sweet Orange and Pink Pepper, plunges into a sensual sea of Jasmine, Osmanthus absolute, White Rose and Cananga. On the bottom Oriental Woods and Ambretta seeds, between creamy touches of Tonka Bean and Vanilla, seal a journey towards absolute pleasure. Which becomes obsession, rapture, greed. An overdose of bliss and bold beauty.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Queen of the Sea Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The sensation of floating on the sea, immersed in fresh, green and crystalline waters. The regenerating essence of infinity and freedom.A nectar of citrus and bright flowers in a gust of sea breeze. The regenerating breath and the green shades of fresh and crystalline waters envelop the senses with visual, tactile and harmonious nuances. Time stops and the mind wanders, enraptured by the exquisite essence of infinity, in the arms of a liquid Queen. The petals of Rose, Magnolia and Geranium, sprinkled with brackish dew, float languidly, like bodies relaxing on the water's edge. An embrace that lingers in the deep wake of Precious Woods, Amber, Patchouli and Musk. The hypnotic quintessence of the sea revisited by New Notes.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Rosa Limone Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From the unprecedented marriage between Rose and Lemon, an eclectic blend is born, with contrasting shades of sublime vitality.From the unprecedented marriage between Rose and Lemon an eclectic note is born, with contrasting and sublime nuances, between effervescence and voluptuousness. Pure vitality in a liquid state. Emphasized by a sparkle of citrus and sparkling marine notes, a sumptuous Damask Rose floats in the sun, invigorating a heart of Jasmine, Geranium and Ylang Ylang. It evokes summer in an aquatic garden, where languid corollas of light mix with precious woods and intersect with Ambretta seeds and Patchouli, captivating the senses to the core.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Talco Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The touch of a baby's white, soft and fragrant skin. A regressive and innocent scent, which evokes the tender love and the subtle grace of a caress.A precious bouquet of Jasmine, Rose and Ylang Ylang, infused in Bergamot, explodes in a soft cloud of Iris and Talc. Expertly blended with Tonka Bean and a delicious touch of Vanilla, it is wrapped in the white breath of Musk, to literally drive the senses crazy, endlessly. A new balance between delicacy and persistence that we would like to never end.

listings.rawTitle: Nicolai Baikal Leather Intense Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The leather accord of Baïkal Leather Intense is made precious by two woody and smoky notes: the essence of Gaiac wood and Siberian birch. The top notes of spicy citrus fruits with yuzu combined with pepper and saffron evolve into a floral-powdery heart based on Florentine iris butter and centifolia rose which make the particularly sensual leather note. Tonka bean and white musk seal this aristocratic fragrance that evokes the glories of the Russian imperial era.Do not forget: For this unmistakable perfume Patricia de Nicolai was inspired by the mythical journey on the Trans-Siberian crossing endless birch forests.

listings.rawTitle: Nicolai Caravanserail Intense Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Towards the Levant: the desert adventure begins. A link between several lands, Caravansérail Intense is a stopover at the crossing of the coffee and spice roads. A historic site of hospitality not far from arid deserts, pioneer explorers and traveling souls are welcomed by a hot, addictive traditional coffee whose swirls reveal the fresh facets of cardamom seeds. Fruity, sweet notes enhance this divine mixture delicately sprinkled with cinnamon and cloves, while a duo of patchouli heart and sandalwood provides a woody intensity. Finally the powerful sandstorm of dry amber notes highlights immortelle, vanilla and tonka bean.
