listings.rawTitle: Nicolai Coffret Discovery Set 3x15 ml
listings.description: This is a 3 sprays 15 ml set box:Pavlova: A daring, innovative scent inspired by the lightness and delicacy of the famous dessert of the same name, Pavlova is a celebration of sweetness and freshness, evoking the grace of a dance between sweet and sour flavours. Pavlova’s theatrical opening is an invitation to discover the tangy gourmet notes of sparkling pineapple, passion fruit and coconut, creating an unapologetic sense of the exotic. There is also a raspberry note whose rich, fruity nuances have a surprising depth. This sweet and slightly bitter red berry adds a fascinating intricacy, balancing the lightness of other fruity notes such as peach. Pavlova is a fragrance enhanced by a combination of woody notes like cedar and sandalwood, a reassuring contrast to the light, fruity notes. Vanilla and musk harmoniously entwine to sign this original composition recalling the airy, melting meringue of the Pavlova. A sparkling sensory experience evoking joy, youth and freedom, Pavlova is a nod to the limitless creativity of perfumery.Macaron Bourbon: Macaron Bourbon is an exquisite, fragrant creation, an ode to sensuality and sophistication. From the very beginning Macaron Bourbon seduces you with a gourmand note of bitter almond with a sweet rum facet, softened by caramel, whose smooth, comforting sweetness creates a veil of delight on the skin. Cinnamon and clove intertwine, offering a spicy warmth reminiscent of spellbinding aromas of pastry coming out of the oven. Davana, its nuances both sweet and slightly tart, adds a fruity and high-quality aspect. Macaron Bourbon also reveals an intoxicating mix of patchouli, vanilla and tonka beans, creating an addictive velvety feel. This smooth, powerful combination is enhanced by the subtle presence of rose which adds an elegant, refined floral touch, perfectly balancing the indulgent, sweet notes. Macaron Bourbon is a tribute to the art of pastry-making and the sophistication of perfumery, evoking an irresistible elegance and a guilty pleasure.Saint Honoré: A captivating perfume inspired by the delicacy and sophistication of the famous French pastry, Saint-Honoré is an invitation to happiness. With its refreshing character, the perfume is unveiled by bergamot opening like a sunrise on a garden of citrus trees – a citrus note skillfully enhanced by a spicy touch of pepper. A symbol of purity and beauty, orange blossom brings a floral sweetness transporting us to the heart of a flowering orchard. Hazelnut, with its warm roundness and a milky chord, recalls childhood memories of freshly made pastries. The lingering trail of the perfume is a deep, rich balance in which musk pairs with vanilla to offer a creamy, enveloping texture. With its bittersweet nuances, the tonka bean adds a fascinating complexity and a last hint of sweetness. Saint-Honoré is an olfactory experience inviting you on a unique sensory journey blending nostalgia, modernity, and indulgence.

Riviera Verbena is a bright, luminous and invigorating breath of natural elegance that is true to the Nicolai signature.

listings.description: Rose Oud opens with a rich and opulent red rose. Initially fruity and spicy in which the oud mixes with finesse. The power of oud in these creations had to be put at the service of precious notes of the French tradition such as amber, rose or lavender.

listings.rawTitle: Nicolai Saint Honoré Intense Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: A captivating perfume inspired by the delicacy and sophistication of the famous French pastry, Saint-Honoré is an invitation to happiness. With its refreshing character, the perfume is unveiled by bergamot opening like a sunrise on a garden of citrus trees – a citrus note skillfully enhanced by a spicy touch of pepper.A symbol of purity and beauty, orange blossom brings a floral sweetness transporting us to the heart of a flowering orchard. Hazelnut, with its warm roundness and a milky chord, recalls childhood memories of freshly made pastries.The lingering trail of the perfume is a deep, rich balance in which musk pairs with vanilla to offer a creamy, enveloping texture. With its bittersweet nuances, the tonka bean adds a fascinating complexity and a last hint of sweetness.Saint-Honoré is an olfactory experience inviting you on a unique sensory journey blending nostalgia, modernity, and indulgence.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 1001 Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The idea of 1001 is precisely this sense of continuity, of waiting, of seduction by words. Nobody gives a better idea of the power of seductive story-telling than Scheherazade, the heroine in Arabian nights, who managed to enchant the man who wanted to kill her with her 1001 tales.The main player in this fragrance is papyrus, the writing medium par excellence, since the dawn of civilisation and through to relatively recent times. The fragrance opens on a lively, bright note, with the fresh spices of elemi, fresh ginger and pink pepper interwoven with the juiciness of red tea, reflecting the optimism and patience of this woman who tells wonderful stories, night after night. The middle accord releases carnal and feminine rose. There is the curcuma absolute that, together with saffron, warms its sensual floral heart.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 A’ Grazia Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: "San Gennaro, pensaci tu!"In this fragrance I tried to create the sensations of the color red, but also with the suggestions of a human body and the intense emotions that go from the earth to the sky. The heart of the perfume is an intense and warm rose, with hints of metallic accents in the spicy opening, fruity and gourmand elements in the development of the structure, and a very deep woody base. I wanted to create an enveloping experience full of pathos.

Powdery heart notes of the fragrance remind the atmosphere of Cafe in such a realistic way.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Casta Diva Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Energising, rejuvenating and magnetic, this perfume will turn a woman into a real star: whether it's a party, a cocktail, or a special occasion, a heavenly aura of romantic charm and the fragrance of osmanthus will pervade the imagination and the senses of those around her.Castadiva vibrates like a heavenly voice. The pure, floral notes of Egyptian jasmine, neroli and ylang-ylang rise towards a deep blue sky in a swirl of green and fruity notes, exploding up high with frangipani and osmanthus. This intoxicating olfactory vocalise reaches its climax and maintains it with a warm oak moss base, softened by ambergris, while white musk and vanilla seal this ensemble with a sensual yet reassuring harmony that is never excessive.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Castelli di Sabbia Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The game in which almost all of us immersed ourselves when we were children becomes an allegory of human soul. The third fragrance of paradiso perduto refers to sand castles, very difficult to build but very easy to destroy. As adults, the game of castles continues, turning into the possibility of seeing them shatter when you aim too high, just like castles in the air.Beneath the joyful joy and commitment of a very long job hides the awareness of the ephemeral: we build, we plan, we build carefully the image that we want to give of ourselves, idealizing our personality and our performances, and then suddenly a gust of wind takes everything away, crumbling the castle as reality does with dreams.. An invitation to be brave again believing in the most authentic part of ourselves, and to realize our dreams placing solid rock foundations at the base of them.. "Some dreams can only be realized if you are brave. Are rational people really the most reasonable? This fragrance is an invitation to make your dreams bigger. Without being afraid of failing. Its enveloping but luminous formula opens with sugary notes of dates, a fruit that grows even in the driest deserts, that does not fear sandstorms and hot winds. A symbol of great strength and perseverance. Sand castles built on solid foundations do not collapse at the first gust of wind."

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Estroverso Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Dozens of ingredients, which integrate to become a perfect harmony: the sparkling explosion of citrusy notes of lemon, orange, tangerine, bergamot and limette blended with aromatic notes of rosemary, go through the artemisia, building its structure on cedar wood, vetiver and getting even more character with patchouli to be integrated at the base with musk and ambery notes. A complex blend, carefully chosen, stubbornly studied, severely tested and  finally combined with estro.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Fougère Nobile Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Fougère means "fern" but,actually, it is created in 1882 by Paul Parquet, consisting of bergamot, lavender, geranium or violet leaves, coumarin (tonka bean), vetiver and oak moss. This timeless elegance is enhanced in our Fougère in a different, more modern interpretation with a more constructed olfactory pyramid: a link with the tradition to build a better future.. "A fougère accord that was avant-garde for its time. With aquatic top notes, sparkling and evocative of sparkling water and bitter soda, to enhance his positive vision of the future.. A fougère accord that symbolizes his devotion to family, because it recalls nature as a refuge, with its notes of natural origin.. A fougère accord that, born at the end of the 19th century with the appearance of two innovative fragrances by two famous fashion houses, would only become successful in the 1960s and, from a progressive facet, would become a contemporary classic. This highlights his openness to the world, his interest in realities other than Italy.. A fougère accord to demonstrate his great charm and his predisposition to seek out the detail that made him attractive. He is a man who stands out for his sophistication. He wears no one else's perfume, highlighting his individuality, his courage, and his strong personality, which many women are attracted to.. Finally, a fougère accord for his connection to tradition. The past serves as a guide, so as to build a better future. A past made up of olfactory evocations such as tobacco, the smell of shaving cream, notes of vanilla, and tonka bean."

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Il Colore del Vento Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: “A certain amount of difficulty is helpful to man: in order to rise, kites need headwind, not tailwind.” - Goethe.“The color of the wind” is a fragrance dedicated to those who, with the same persistence as kites, color the sky against the wind, but it is also an invitation to let yourself be carried away, to lift your feet off the ground, and to give value to the string that keeps our flight stable: those (rare) people whose run allows us to gain the right momentum to take off. A kite flies, yes, but we make it fly, we keep its unstable balance to ensure that its string doesn't snap and we don't lose it: we entrust it to the wind but without letting it go, almost as if we wanted to fly away to other worlds, escape reality, but perhaps return with a different perspective on life itself. Do not be afraid: having the wind against you only scares those who are afraid of flying. Be kites yourselves, color the sky and the wind, the clouds, and above all, your life.The fragrance notes are deliberately designed to awaken the child inside us, perhaps asleep, but unlike an adult, the child dares, risks, and challenges the headwind even with a little recklessness to lift off in flight with the mind and color the sky. The spicy top notes represent the headwind that may frighten us, but which pushes us upwards. In the heart, the notes of champagne and coffee belong to the world of adults, becoming sweeter with vanilla, caramel, and butter.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Il Giardino delle Delizie Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The second fragrance brings us to "the Garden of earthly delights" by Hieronymus Bosh , exhibited at El Prado museum in Madrid. This triptych is considered a masterpiece of surrealism for its complex symbolism: humanity is represented, according to the Christian doctrine of the Middle Ages, with all its vices and its perversions in a satirical representation of men’s sins.On the external panels, visible only when the Triptych is closed, in the upper part God appears in the act of creation: the world is represented like a transparent sphere. Once opened it reveals its great beauty.. Paradiso Perduto’s fragrance took inspiration from the central panel , where pleasures and love are represented: exotic animals symbolizing lust, a crowd of nude figures some of them in erotic abandon, others in a chrysalis stage are fed by birds that carry cherries and strawberries in their beaks, considered fruits with aphrodisiac properties. In the third panel the scene turns into a demonic concert: musical instruments become means to inflict suffering and pain. An olfactory representation of the contrasts present in the triptych.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 La Danza delle Libellule Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: It’s created according to aromatherapy for a pampering effect for hardest days.“The dance of dragonflies” is an operetta by Franz Lehar and it’s a kind of invitation to take life a little bit less seriously.Dukes, Counts, castels, lush gardens and magnificent dresses, jolly trips and idle pastimes, romantic encounters and love intrigues... A fragrance to devote to yourself, when femininity cries out, claiming some time for frivolousness, cuddles and the gentle insouciance that all women deserve. With this spirit, La danza delle libellule, brings all the lightness necessary to soothe even the most troubled hearts.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 La Dea Bendata Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Everything can be translated into numbers, and in Naples they know how it works, but obviously they have to be the right ones, the ones with whom you hope to receive the kiss of La Dea Bendata (=Lady Luck) , also because it is said that she can’t see very well. A fragrance that could attract good luck in every way and that can give you the winning numbers, who knows?According to Neapolitan tradition, for every dream there is a number and every number has its own meaning. With every purchase of La Dea Bendata perfume you will receive a magnet made by Neapolitan artisans with a randomly assigned number.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 La Stanza delle Bambole Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Children experience life with dolls and puppets. Attended, pampered and loved dolls, a projection of daily life placed in a fantasy world created ad hoc by a childish imagination. But in this relationship with the doll there is also the mischief of a little girl who explores the world of adults, who communicates with an inanimated thing, she acts like an adult and builds her personality by freely expressing of her unconscious thoughts, hidden visions, also exorcising her own inner monsters.A strong connection that grows over time: time after time, the first doll is replaced by an other one with the features of an adult woman that becomes a model to imitate. So the doll can become for the adult, men and women as well, an object to pour on their love, something that fills their emotional emptiness...or paradoxically to go back to childhood, even if now they are adults!. “The clash between real and unreal creates a totally surreal world. The inspiration simply had to be transcribed into a definitive formula. Thus was born the doll’s room, a flowery perfume, falsely innocent, softly sensual, bursting like a whispered scream. ”

But he also wanted it to recall that sometimes another person may simply capture us with a look that leaves in our memory the fragrance of a stupefying substance.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Malvs Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Hiding a secret! There is nothing more natural, since no one, not even science, can ever delve into our minds and hearts.. Even lie detectors are not infallible. Hidden and shocking truths lie undisturbed in our subconscious, forcing us to manipulate reality to make it perfect in the eyes of others. Behind the illusion of knowing others and revealing ourselves through images and words posted on social media, there is clear evidence that what we write or read is a reflection of what we would like to be and not what we really are. Evil lurks within each of us, and we keep it in check: envy, cowardice, contempt, and hatred can lead us, if exacerbated, to unimaginable and unspeakable acts. The secret remains hidden in a treasure chest within us and only comes out when we talk to ourselves in front of a mirror: because we cannot escape from ourselves. Unless a tempting devil frees the secret from its chains. Malvs is a combination of sacred notes (incense) and profane notes (apple) that blend together in a surprising way.

Unless a tempting devil frees the secret from its chains. Malvs is a combination of sacred notes (incense) and profane notes (apple) that blend together in a surprising way.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Muschio 20 Nobile Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: A new formulation for a new interpretation of Musk according to Nobile 1942. Musk 20 Nobile transforms the musky notes already present in its predecessor, Musk Nobile, giving them a unique olfactory nuance. A Musk 2.0 for the 20th anniversary of the brand.The fragrance opens with musk notes. Sweet and fruity notes of Peach, Medlar, and citrusy notes of Bergamot give a certain freshness and harmony to the top notes. The delicate fruity aspect of Peach extends into the heart notes, where a bouquet of white flowers emerges, composed of Freesia and Cotton Flowers, with nuances of Osmanthus and a Tulip accord that blend into the musky component that embraces the entire olfactory pyramid. The base is rich in white musks with a sweet and enveloping character that blends with soft and velvety Sandalwood; to enhance and enrich the base, cotton candy and amber notes complete the creation, providing a true olfactory amplification. The musks in this creation play an important role: they create a certain sinuosity and fluidity and have a full-range impact, acting as a connecting thread that unifies the creation, giving it substance and tridimensionality/depth, leaving a soft, sweet character.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Perdizione Eau de Parfum 15 ml

It is the same fragrance we scented on a summer night far, far away.The elegant, feminine jasmine perfectly blends with the Musk. listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Pontevecchio Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Pontevecchio ( in English: “old bridge”). It’s the most important bridge in Florence with its historical jewelry and leather workshop.A symbol of italian culture and the greatest, “magnificent” heritage of De Medici’s family.It was thanks to Caterina De Medici that the art of perfumery approached in the French court in light of the elegant practice she acquired growing up and living in Florence. Iris from Florence is the main protagonist of the fragrance and evokes the spirit of a man such as one of Nobile’s family: living with courage , a man with history and captivated by beauty and passion.The fragrance was created in 2005 but in 2013 it became a Fragranza Suprema and then an Extrait de Parfum with an increasement of concentration that soothed woods and incense and gave more emphasis to geranium and the dustier notes of iris.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Pontevecchio Woman Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: It is a bold yet sweet fragrance for refined women, with interplays of iridescent olfactory tones, from majestic Florentine Iris to Bulgarian rose and Indian Jasmine, coming together in a whirl of ever-changing emotions. Bergamot and mandarin make it dynamic, while coriander seeds add a peculiar touch. Without creating any hierarchies between olfactory notes, each of them may surprise you by prevailing over the others, so the base notes of white moss, amber wood and sandalwood are always ready to interact with other ingredients, adapting to the mood of a strong woman who is also sweet and sensitive, with a timeless style.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Pontevecchio Woman Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: In the magic atmosphere of a place linked to the “magnificent” Florence of Dè Medici, a perfume with evocative name were born. Iris from Florence is again the protagonist of the fragrance but in a delightfully and feminine expression. Caterina de’ Medici, cleverly, wore perfume on her gloves and body: in this way she avoided the odors of other people, who did not wash regularly at that time in history.This custom was invented by Renato Bianco (or, as the French say: René le Florentin) who was her personal and of trusted perfumer and, not surprisingly, he followed her to the court in France upon her marriage. He invented specifically for Caterina many ways to carry perfume around: including fragrant pomegranates, a particular jewel shaped like a sphere that could be worn around the neck or on the belt.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Rudis Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The representation of the sword's wood was then countered by an accord between leather, and  rose with geranium which combined evokes a metallic helmet. However, the scent had to represent this man who, contemptuous of danger, sets out to regain his life, crossing the threshold of the arena. The gladiator would drink himself into a stupor before a fight, with wine made from grape juice and fermented fruit, which we found again in this perfume with marc note, blended with bergamot, dried fruits and fruity notes to deliver courage. Saffron gives personality to the heart, cedarwood makes it precious, cloves put something more in the mix. The final patchouli seals the masculinity of an exhausted gladiator, employing its last efforts to win. Vetiver and helicrysium makes the victory reachable, like a musky and incense-smell dream.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Shamal Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Shamal is dedicated to perseverance. The inspiration comes from the character of the pearl fisherman. The pearl fisherman is lying on his back and enjoying the view of the starry sky. It's his turn to watch, pirates can attack at any time. The fisherman is lulled by the lapping of the waves. A sound that takes him to his childhood, caressed by the Shamal, the wind that has relentlessly shaped the dunes in the deserts. While the Shamal blows, sweet but incessant, bringing with it the scent of the dates mixed with the burning incense, the pearl fisherman lies there blissfully, savoring fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Aqua de Dora Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Aqua de Dora is a refreshing summer fragrance for men.My family and I went on a summer vacation to Öland Island in 2020. Öland is the second largest island in Sweden, separated from the mainland by the Kalmar Strait. The island is located in the Baltic Sea.In Öland, you smell the scent of the sea and the wood of trees, and when the rain touches the soil another magnificent smell spreads around. Since then, I decided to innovate a perfume inspired by the natural beauty of Öland. It took me nine months of dedicated work to compose this fresh perfume that combines the scent of fresh citrus and the sea. The natural and sea scents are complemented by a dry, warm, and woody Cashmeran and pine resin.Men who wear Aqua de Dora feel their magnanimity and confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Dorasima Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Dorasima is a special and unique scent inspired by the Swedish holiday of Midsommar. The name comes from the Latin phrase Lacrima Doris, which means "tears of a goddess" tears of joy love and happiness.In Sweden, the longest day of the year marks the beginning of Midsommar, a festival celebrated by friends and families alike, gathering around Maypole, singing songs, and dancing to celebrate the joy of life. One such gathering was marked by Dorasima arrival. It was the epitome of grace, elegance and coziness, carrying the scent that mesmerized everyone around.Everyone's soul was taken away as they felt its Floral notes combined with Fruity aromas that complimented each other in harmony with Woody undertones of Cedarwood, Sandalwood and Agarwood. A deep Musk reverberated at its core while Vanilla tones brought in the warmth, surrounded by the leathery scent enriched with Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Dux Orientis Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Ibrahim was no ordinary perfumer, he was a dreamer, a historian of scents, and a custodian of cultural heritage. His fascination with the tales of kings and conquerors led him to an extraordinary discovery in the pages of Eastern history, the legend of Odaenathus, the King of Kings of the East.Inspired by Odaenathus's remarkable journey, Ibrahim embarked on a quest to encapsulate the spirit of the king in the form of a perfume. It was to be a sensory odyssey, a tribute to the golden sands of Palmyra and the indomitable spirit of its people.. The fragrance journey begins with a symphony of citrusy fruits dancing forth, a vibrant homage to the sun-kissed lands of Palmyra. Bergamot, cantaloupe, mandarin orange, and tangelo dance together in harmony, painting a picture of liquid sunshine on golden sands. The top notes are a celebration of energy and vitality, a prelude to the aromatic voyage that lay ahead.As the journey unfolds, the heart of the perfume reveals deeper layers, a testament to the king's profound connection to both sea and land. Seaweed, green nard, and litchi blossoms emerge, each note a brushstroke painting the portrait of a ruler whose reach spanned across vast oceans and fertile plains.When Dux Orientis journey reaches its crescendo, the base notes emerge to cast a spell of enchantment. Ambroxan, musk, and natural Oud form the soul of the perfume, each note weaving a tale of its own. Musk, with its ancient allure, whispered of relaxation and rejuvenation, while Oud, with its mystical essence, beckons the mind to a state of tranquility and inner strength, like a whisper from centuries past, speaking of power and spirituality steeped in tradition.Dux Orientis is more than a mere fragrance; it is a journey through time and space to a realm where empires rise and fall, and where legends are born. It is a perfume for the dreamers, the adventurers, and the seekers of greatness, a scent that beckons you to walk in the footsteps of kings and queens, to embrace the grandeur of a bygone era.In every spritz of Dux Orientis, the legacy of Odaenathus lives on, a reminder that greatness is not just a destination but a state of mind, an eternal flame that burns bright in the hearts of those who dare to dream.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Dux Orientis Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Emanuele Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Emanuele, an alluring perfume, draws its inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. Imagined by a visionary perfumer, Ibrahim Al Zouabi, who strolled through the marbled corridors just a year ago, this fragrance is a harmonious blend of timeless sophistication and modern allure. Emanuele opens with a burst of Turkish rose and tuberose, like a blooming garden within the splendid gallery, leading into a heart of delicate Italian florals, reminiscent of the stunning mosaics that adorn the gallery's walls. Capturing the elegance of Milan and the enduring beauty of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Emanuele invites you to experience the timeless charm of this Milanese landmark through the art of fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Forever Love Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the heart of the enchanting Swedish countryside, where meadows meet tranquil lakes, there exists a fragrance that captures the essence of pure and enduring love. Pana Dora Sweden's Forever Love perfume is a poetic ode to love's timelessness, weaving a fragrant tale that unfolds like a romance amidst nature.It opens with a burst of citrus and blossoms, like the first rays of love's awakening. The heart of the fragrance evokes the delicate dance of passion, with an array of blossoms, fruits, and aromatic herbs that mirror the complexities of love. As the scent lingers, it settles into warm, woody notes, embodying the lasting promise of a love that endures. Forever Love by Pana Dora Sweden: a fragrant tribute to a love that transcends time, capturing the essence of an enduring, eternal bond.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Grand Musk Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Hundreds of Years ago, Perfumers discovered that some of Animal Pheromones enhance the coherence of their Fragrances. Musk, that is extracted from the Musk deer, has become the definition of vast array of animal scents. Grand Musk is inspired from the vigor of wild life, Rural intimacy as the grand Forests engulfed with Mist. Grand Musk is an earthly, organic, woody and animalistic Fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Imperial Wood Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Imperial Wood is the fragrance of the Sweden rustic life. It is a revolutionary Extrait De Parfum that contains the highest concentration of aromatic compounds. The high concentration of the perfume is not the only reason that contributes to its uniqueness but also its wonderful composition. For the first time, someone composes the natural cocoa smell and the Indonesian agarwood, which is barely noticeable in most of the perfumes. The top notes contain Damask rose, thyme, tobacco leaves, and a touch of woody-spicy saffron. The smell of Frankincense speaks for itself in addition to cardamom, cinnamon sticks, tonka combined with vanilla, and cocoa. All these magical smells are topped off with a final touch of sandalwood. While the base note of the perfume is the Indonesian agarwood, leather, and amber wood.The perfumer Ibrahim Al Zouabi inspired Imperial Wood composition from the traditional Sweden rustic life in the seventeenth century. Especially their banquets which contained cocoa cake combined with a lot of cardamom and spices. The availability of the various type of spices and natural flowers were essential in the Swedish community at that time. These ingredients were used on pleasant and bitter occasions. The Imperial Wood expresses these scenes with a fragrance that takes you to a magnificent era.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Kropp & Själ Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The body and soulKropp & Själ, translated into body and soul, is a gift for the body and sets deep into the soul. The Swedish culture has always had a passionate interest of healing the body and the soul, by finding treasures provided by nature and combining them in the perfect way to achieve a final product with healing power. This perfume is rich with the wonders of nature, and takes you on an intimate journey deep into the Swedish nature. The sultry notes of Kropp & Själ activates all your senses and leaves you with an attractive scent. This bottle of perfection contains magnificent ingredients such as amber, vanilla, musk, saffron, jasmine, cardamom and many other delightful components, which will heal you from the inside.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Majestic Amber Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Majestic Amber embodies the grandeur and luxury its name suggests. Crafted by the niche house Pana Dora Sweden, this perfume is a symphony of rich, opulent notes, creating an unforgettable sensory experience. Majestic Amber resonates emotionally with those who seek a fragrance that evolves beautifully over time, offering an experience both empowering and comforting. It’s perfect for special occasions or whenever you want to feel your most majestic. The warm, woody, and sweet notes create a sense of comfort and coziness, making it ideal for cooler weather or evening wear. Luxurious ingredients like saffron, ambergris, and tuberose add a touch of opulence, ensuring the wearer feels both sophisticated and refined, regardless of gender.Imagine a sun-drenched palace courtyard. The air is filled with the intoxicating aroma of blooming flowers and warm spices. This is the opening of Majestic Amber, a fragrance that transports you to a world of elegance and refinement. A burst of pink pepper and nutmeg is both invigorating and captivating, setting the stage with a vibrant, spicy allure. The subtle, powdery elegance of orris root and the delicate sweetness of violet add a refined touch, while saffron introduces a warm, exotic nuance that hints at the luxurious depth of the fragrance. As the top notes gently fade, the complex and sensual heart of Majestic Amber reveals itself. The creamy richness of tuberose and the fresh, citrusy brightness of orange blossom create a lush, floral bouquet that is both comforting and sophisticated. The soft, woody embrace of cashmere wood, combined with the earthy, marine-like essence of ambergris and the balsamic freshness of fir resin, adds layers of depth and warmth. The fragrance concludes with a rich, luxurious base and a lasting impression that is both warm and grounding. Papyrus and dry wood provide a grounding element, while vanilla and leather add a touch of comfort, sweetness, and sophistication. Benzoin, cedar, and ambroxan contribute to the overall warmth and depth of the fragrance. Oakmoss brings an earthy, green touch, rounding out the fragrance with a natural, grounded feel.As the final notes of Majestic Amber linger in the air, they weave a tapestry of memories and emotions, leaving an indelible mark on the soul. This fragrance, with its regal composition, transcends time and place. Majestic Amber is a testament to the art of perfumery, evoking a sense of majesty and elegance with every breath. Whether worn for a special occasion or as a daily indulgence, this fragrance is a reminder that true luxury lies in the details—in the moments that make life extraordinary. Majestic Amber: a scent for those who dare to dream and desire the extraordinary.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Moonlight Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Embrace the Moonlight and let your dreams take flight!Moonlight perfume is a magical elixir that transports you to the enchanting Nordic nights, where the moon's radiance outshone all others. It is a fragrance that captures the essence of those ancient northern landscapes, where wildflowers and crisp air filled the night with their invigorating aromas, and where untold tales and wonders were hidden in every shadow.Upon opening the bottle of Moonlight, you are greeted by a burst of invigorating freshness, akin to a brisk breeze sweeping through the Scandinavian fjords, mirroring the vibrant life that thrived in those ancient forests. You feel a surge of vitality and joy, as if you were embarking on a journey of discovery through the wilderness. You'll detect the juicy notes of lingonberry and wild blueberries, mingling with the sweet and tangy scents of vanilla, honey.As you spray Moonlight on your skin, you are enveloped by a warm and sensual embrace, reminiscent of a cozy Nordic cabin bathed in the silvery glow of the moonlight. You'll sense the rich and decadent notes of amber, birchwood, and musk, creating a harmonious contrast with the fruity freshness and evoking a timeless allure that stirs memories of ancient sagas. The amber glows like the aurora borealis, reflecting the magnificence of the northern lights. The birchwood adds a touch of mystique and intrigue, hinting at the tales woven under the stars. The musk adds a sense of sophistication, making you feel irresistible and alluring.Moonlight is more than just a fragrance; it's a vessel of dreams, encapsulating the spirit of Nordic nights in every drop, where the moonlight was the wellspring of magic and inspiration. It's a story that unfolds with every application, a tale of beauty and enigma, of adventure and romance, of dreams and fantasies. Allow it to carry you to a realm where the moonlight weaves stories and scents into an enchanting symphony. With its fruity freshness, warm sensuality, and notes of amber, birchwood, and musk, MoonLight is your ticket to the most captivating place in history and the allure of Scandinavian nights.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Opuluxe Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Opuluxe crafted by the niche house Pana Dora Sweden is a scent that embodies the name's promises of opulence and luxury, and the spirit of nobility, honor, and the gracious gentleman. This perfume is a tribute to the modern man who values tradition, integrity, and the superior things in life.The fragrance begins with a bold declaration of strength and vitality. The spicy warmth of saffron and the fresh, green aroma of basil evoke a sense of noble vigor and readiness for adventure. Vetiver and clary sage ground this vibrant start with an earthy, steadfast presence, symbolizing the unwavering honor and integrity of a true gentleman. The exotic and spicy nuances of myrrh and coriander add an air of mystery and intrigue, hinting at the depth of character and wisdom. Brazilian rosewood introduces a touch of sweetness and floral elegance, softening the initial intensity and reflecting the sophisticated charm of the wearer.As the fragrance evolves, the heart notes bring warmth and comfort, much like the embrace of a trusted friend. Osmanthus offers a fruity, apricot-like aroma, while cinnamon adds a cozy, spicy touch. This stage feels inviting and enveloping, embodying the gentleman’s protective and nurturing nature. Thyme and carnation enhance the complexity and depth, evoking a sense of natural beauty and timeless elegance, resembling the chivalrous deeds of a knight. This heart of the fragrance is where the true character of Opuluxe shines, revealing the warmth and strength that lie beneath the surface.The fragrance concludes with a rich and luxurious base and revealing the true essence of Opuluxe. Mineral notes add a unique, earthy strength, while suede brings a soft, luxurious touch. This combination feels both grounding and sophisticated, symbolizing the grace of a man of honor. Musk and timur add a sensual, warm quality, enhancing the overall depth and richness of the fragrance. They evoke feelings of intimacy and allure, reflecting the magnetic presence of a true gentleman. The sweet, resinous aroma of benzoin and the earthy, woody scent of oakmoss create a harmonious balance, adding a sense of inviting aura and nostalgia, reminiscent of timeless traditions. The final notes of castoreum and sandalwood bring a rich, leathery, and creamy woodiness, leaving a lasting impression of strength, sophistication, and a touch of elegance.Opuluxe is more than just a perfume; it's a statement. It's a declaration of values and a celebration of the modern gentleman. This perfume is a tribute to the modern gentleman who values gallantry, honor, and manhood. It's a fragrance that inspires, empowers, and elevates the man who aspires to the highest standards of character and style.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Orchestra Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Orchestra is a fragrance that truly lives up to its name, inviting you to experience a harmonious blend of emotions and sensations. Each note plays its part in creating a rich and multi-layered fragrance experience, just as a symphony is masterfully composed of various instruments playing together in perfect harmony.Orchestra blends different scents to create a unified, captivating experience. It’s a fragrance that evokes a sense of grandeur, sophistication, and timeless elegance, much like a classic orchestral masterpiece.The opening notes of nutmeg, bergamot, and davana create a velvety, vibrant, and energetic overture, setting the stage for a captivating performance. The middle notes of rosemary, vetiver, and leather offer a more introspective intermezzo, a moment of contemplation and depth. The base notes of agarwood, vanilla, white musk, and cardamom bring the fragrance to a triumphant finale—a rich, warm, and enduring conclusion.Imagine wearing this fragrance on a cool autumn evening. The warm, sweet, hearty, and spicy notes surround you in a comforting embrace, while the leather and woody elements add a touch of luxury. It’s a perfume that suggests a sense of control, maturity, and sophisticated taste. Each note is carefully selected to contribute to the overall harmony, making it a true masterpiece from Pana Dora Sweden.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Oud Republic Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the heart of a crisp Scandinavian winter night, where the fire crackled and ancient myths came to life, master perfumer Ibrahim Al Zouabi embarked on an olfactory journey inspired by the rarity and allure of Oud, which he lovingly referred to as "liquid gold." In the cozy embrace of his hearth, he envisioned a warm fragrance designed to melt away stress, calm the heartbeat, restore inner peace, and spark the flames of happiness, drawing inspiration from the regal scents that adorned princes, kings, and nobles of the Middle Ages.Oud Republic was born from Ibrahim's desire to create an Oud fragrance unlike any other. The exquisite blend of jasmine and saffron, paired with Bulgarian roses and amber, blended seamlessly with Oud, musk, and vanilla. This composition transported the wearer to a sensual, imaginative, and magnetic space, capturing the essence of Scandinavian refinement. In "Oud Republic", the house of Pana Dora crafted an extraordinary woody masterpiece, a bridge between Nordic elegance and modern charm, an olfactory story of captivating allure and timeless nobility.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Patchouli Dust Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Amidst the serene embrace of the Swedish wilderness, Patchouli Dust by Pana Dora Sweden emerges as a fragrant revelation, an embodiment of the untamed beauty that surrounds it. This perfume captures the essence of an earthy, smoky serenity, akin to standing amidst the woods after a gentle rain shower. The scent, a meticulous blend of earthy notes, is reminiscent of damp soil, reminiscent of a thriving forest floor, and the subtle smokiness of charred wood, reminiscent of a cozy cabin hearth. As you wear Patchouli Dust, you're transported to the heart of nature's embrace, where the essence of Patchouli, with its deep, smoky character, and the warm, embracing Tonka notes, merge seamlessly. Patchouli Dust envelops you in the soul of nature, offering a unique sensory experience that awakens your connection to the wild landscape. This fragrance is an invitation to immerse yourself in the rugged elegance of nature, leaving a lasting impression that is uniquely its own, a touch of untamed beauty that you can carry with you wherever you go. It's a journey into the heart of the Swedish wilderness, encapsulated in a bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Scandic Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the heart of Scandinavia, where the air is brisk, and the landscapes are painted with serene beauty, lies the inspiration for a remarkable fragrance "Scandic" by Pana Dora. Scandic, a fragrance born of the Nordic spirit, weaves a narrative of nature's beauty and the timeless allure of the region, and evokes a sense of serenity, purity, and elegance.As the first light of dawn breaks over the fjords, a gentle breeze carries the aquatic freshness of myrtle and water hyacinth. The air is filled with the calming aroma of lavender, mingling with the fruity sweetness of peach, passion fruit, and raspberry. This symphony of top notes awakens the senses, evoking feelings of joy and vitality. It adds a playful and energetic vibe, much like a refreshing morning walk along the Nordic coast.As the day progresses, the fragrance deepens, revealing the sophisticated beauty of the Nordic landscape. Imagine strolling through a secluded Scandinavian garden, where the delicate petals of Bulgarian rose dance in the breeze, evoking a sense of love and passion. The spicy warmth of cassia and the scent of carnation add depth and intrigue, creating an atmosphere of romantic elegance. This is the essence of Scandic’s middle notes, capturing the timeless charm of nature’s finest blooms.As the sun sets and the cool evening air settles in, Scandic reveals its comforting base notes. The clean, soft scent of white musk and heliotrope wraps around you like a luxurious wool blanket. The smoky, woody aroma of birch and labdanum adds a touch of mystery, while camphor introduces a cool, complex note. Finally, the sweet warmth of honey lingers, evoking a sense of coziness and sensuality. It’s like sitting by a crackling fireplace on a cool evening in a Nordic cabin, feeling safe and content.Scandic is a journey of emotions, beginning with the invigorating freshness of its top notes, transitioning to the romantic sophistication of its heart, and culminating in the comforting embrace of its base. Scandic tells a story of refined simplicity and timeless allure. It’s a fragrance that captures the spirit of Scandinavia, ideal for those who appreciate the harmonious blend of nature and elegance. With each spritz of Scandic, you embark on a sensory adventure, experiencing the serene landscapes and elegant charm of the Nordic world, all encapsulated in a single, exceptional fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Swedish Wood Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sweden's dense forestsSweden was distinguished in the seventeenth century by its wonderful dense forest that still characterizes it today. This forest danced with the fertile land of Sweden to generate types of flowers and woods that crept into our group, emitting a scent that expresses the beauty of the Swedish geographical nature.In this fragrance, Bulgarian roses were mixed with pink pepper and ended with a base consisting of oud and patchouli in addition to the distinctive and penetrating caperpol oil, to form for us in the end a distinctive mixture of woods and natural roses that was hidden within these wonderful dense forests. You can try a sprinkle of this fragrance to bring with it the beautiful past, ancient originality and longing for nature.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Velvet Iris Eau de Parfum 15 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden XVI Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Royal fragrancePerhaps the most important characteristic of the seventeenth century is the proliferation of huge palaces and their construction in a manner that expresses the paradise of life. With fine detail for a palace Drottningholm in Stockholm An icon of beauty and the veining of its marble columns, and the beauty and elegance of the paintings that decorate it.This fragrance came to extend beauty in its own way, so its unique composition represented by patchouli, woods and coriander invites a spiritual visit about the nobility of this wonderful palace.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Anniversario Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Born in 2020 to celebrate the 500th anniversary anniversario di Raffaello, Anniversario is an elegant and persistent fragrance, which evokes the idea of ​​a Californian cake. In smelling it, the nose tries to distinguish the fruity tones that emerge in the first place, while the imagination crosses the lively color of strawberries, blueberries and raspberries. This sensation is enveloped by an intoxicating warm and amber composition, almost exotic, which pervades us and is difficult to forget.Fragrance characterized by top notes, which refer to red fruits: Strawberry, Blueberry, with Coconut and Peach. A real joyful triumph to evoke the euphoria of a festive event. A note of saffron does not escape the opening of the composition. At the heart of the perfume are placed the Rose, the Jasmine and the Heliotrope, which give an oriental touch. On the bottom reveal Gray Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood and White Musk, which are mixed with a rare Patchouli from the Gayo region north of Sumatra and a light touch of Cambodian-Thai Oud from the Trat region, to give overall a particular, marked and persistent character.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Auris Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Freshness and mystery. A fragrance with citrus and sparkling tones, intense and persistent, which tells the energy of the discovery of something extraordinary ... amazement, power and mystery!

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Dolce Passione Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: There are elements that we consider aphrodisiacs, they are so engaging and penetrating. This is the case for chocolate and truffles, the main elements of this fragrance, where, by communicating with each other, they create unexplored agreements so as to lead the initial gustatory path towards an unexpected elegance. Sublime expression of sweetness and desire, the distinctive characters of every love story.Dark chocolate, enhanced with the precious taste of white truffle. A complex and fascinating heart of hazelnut, honey, vanilla, strawberry and plum over a base of tonka bean and white musk. Hidden and elegant flowers, almost imperceptible among the heart notes, an incredible concentration of seduction!

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Il Giardino Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: It is the olfactory photo of a place, il giardino di Trastevere, secret meeting place of Raffaello and Margherita. Wet walls and ivy, an old fruit tree, in the distance a flowery bouquet and the rarefaction of the scent of burnt wood from the oven.A fragrance with a green and musky soul where the notes of vetiver are blending with wood wrapped in ivy. A slight hint of fruit tells of an old pear tree.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Nerone Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: In the Domus Aurea Raffaello encounters the extraordinary in the grotesques, perceives the genius and recklessness of whoever thought of them. There was behind those representations a young man madly in love with art, histrionic and controversial, born 1500 years earlier. That man is none other than Nero, Ancient Rome's most controversial Roman emperor. A strong and extraordinary man. This is how this fragrance is, extraordinary, because it is brilliant and outside the rules.In this essence "excesses and madness" are exalted with the use of raw materials, often in "overdoses". This is the case for the fruity and sugary accord that accompanies the entire composition... and for the warm, sweet and animalic base.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Notte d’Amore Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: It is the story of a night of love and passion, where two bodies come together one last time and forever. Two souls who promise each other eternal love, unrelated to time. A unique blend of feelings and smells.In the fragrance, green notes and distant hints of citrus are only the prelude to what will arrive shortly thereafter: a brilliant mix of oud, amber, which almost seems to merge with the smell of the skin. To tell a passion that is consumed and then rarefied towards the sky and in the air. Fresh and passionate notes at the same time, or perhaps one after the other.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma O Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: An irresistible and unique fragrance, perfect for those who fearlessly combine elegance and excess. Eternity is drawn in a perfect circle. Like the oculus of the Pantheon, opening towards infinity, O is a whirlwind of enveloping sensations, a timeless harmony. The beginning is sparkling, like a toast suspended between dream and reality, where pink pepper awakens the senses and rosé champagne dances on the skin with its luminous bubbles. In the heart, sensuality takes shape through a warm and unexpected mix of jasmine, rose, black cherry, and tequila. The base is warmth, it is fulfillment: notes of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla whisper a velvety, refined, and persistent caress.

listings.rawTitle: Pantheon Roma Raffaello Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: He is a very refined and eclectic genius, at the same time strong and concrete. Profile of an artist who has made elegance the hallmark of his work. The grace of his stroke has left an indelible mark on the history of art. Raffaello he is an attractive, elegant and passionate man who has fully lived his love story.The processing of the fragrance moves on two levels: a pure absinthe distillate and a mix of pepper, leather, teak wood and tonka bean. On the first level the artist and its vibrations (absinthe), the second one tells of its vigor (leather, pepper, teak and tonka), with a scent in the background that recalls color pigments.

Its composition features a blend of rare and noble ingredients which revisit the tradition of 18th century French perfume making.Its dazzling freshness and herbal top notes quickly yield a warm and smooth sense of leather with a symphony of precious woods. Soft and sweet, escorted by saffron, its praline accord is an ultra-contemporary spin on the mythical oudwood.Agarwood emerges in this veil of contrasts and imprints the skin with luminous refinement for endur-ing comfort. A privilege that is all about sensation.Best time to wear: All day long, from morning to evening.

listings.description: Herod is personified by its blend of diverse notes, exuding a smoky vanilla scent. This eau de parfum opens on spicy top notes of cinnamon and pepper to then show its powerful heart of tobacco leaf, incense, ciste and osmanthus. An elegant and discernible perfume, for both men and women, it is the epitome of old-world sophistication.Best time to wear: to warm up in sophistication, during fall and winter.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Kalan Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Intense and subtle at once, Kalan is an olfactory signature that surprises with a sparkling opening, blending black pepper and spices with fresh notes of blood orange. The Parfums de Marly eau de parfum is anchored with a heart of orange blossom and lavender, and while it evolves, facets of white sandalwood unfold and drape into notes of moss and precious wood. The result is an olfactory narrative that is round with clear, seductive top notes and simultaneously an immediately discernible base. The harmony between the materials and the accords creates this olfactory music that is the signature of Kalan.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: For nomadic lifestyles. The Layton eau de parfum travel set is unforgettable thanks to its addictive presence and unique appeal. It is for the gentleman who is looking for an exhilarating fragrance that fits within the great lineage of Parfums de Marly. Its fragrant, sensual and mighty olfactory narrative makes it a must-have companion for travel.Layton is a fragrance which captures the essence of the debonair. This floral and oriental fragrance with an intense olfactory signature opens with bergamot and its tangy passion, while lavender and geranium blend into a fresh note, chic and chivalrous all at once. The intensity of the eau de parfum is further amplified by amber, enhanced by the natural elegance of pink pepper. Distinguished and addictive, Layton’s character is further carried by vanilla and precious woods, which develop through an intriguing note of caramelized coffee.Best time to wear: all day long, from morning to evening, especially during the colder months.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Presenting a subtle balance of citrus and aromatic notes on a woody base, this eau de parfum exudes a fresh, sensual and refined scent in an ocean blue bottle that will be remembered. Amongst the top notes, scents of bergamot and mandarin sublimate through a touch of aromatic water to offer a unique combination. The heart notes give Percival its character and depth through a blend of natural jasmine, violet and geranium, overlapping with lavender, coriander and cinnamon. On the skin, musk mixes with pepper, absolute balsam fir and, to give emphasis, woody spices are revealed at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Perseus Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Perseus is a luminous and refreshing creation, combined with a long-lasting sillage. The fragrance is characterized by a grapefruit citrus accord and a vetiver heart that come to life the moment they meet. The former immediately invigorates, its freshness electrifying the skin. At the same time the earthy facet of the vetiver is revealed, refined, comforting and sensual. Perseus’s trail is further enriched by ambergris and long-lasting dry woods.Perseus evokes early morning at the royal residence of Marly, at the moment when the sun’s first rays waken the château, warm its gardens and make its fountains sparkle. A sun-kissed perfume, it celebrates the radiance of citrus. A unique morning ritual for a day of endless sunshine.Best time to wear: in the morning for a boost of energy to last an entire summer's day.

listings.rawTitle: Parle Moi de Parfum Haute Provence 89 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: We all have a memory in Provence, child or adult, this region is synonymous with lightness, letting go and holidays. Haute Provence / 89 is our tribute to it.The beauty of its lavender fields perfectly aligned as far as the eye can see. A plant which by its flower alone floods a region and colors it for eternity. It is the most beautiful thing, its simplicity renders the superfluous old-fashioned and makes it an icon which crosses the world.. Lavender is the star here, the melons and watermelons bring sunshine and make it seductive, a hint of Narcissus, bewitching. If there were only one, this note would be the signature.

listings.rawTitle: Parle Moi de Parfum Orris Tattoo Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A return to the hallmarks of classic perfumery, a tribute to one of its rarest natural ingredients: iris.Florists love its gorgeous flowers, but we’re all about the root, left to grow deep underground for three years before being dried for another three years. It’s then ground up and transformed into iris butter, probably the most expensive butter you’ll ever encounter!Orris Tattoo is a permanent scented reminder, a universal symbol, a unique self-expression like an invisible tattoo that withstands the test of time.

listings.rawTitle: Parle Moi de Parfum Papyrus Oud Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Reminiscence of the past? Rather of the future. Papyrus Oud / 71 is a meeting point between two spaces of time.A reminder of a major success that our perfumer released in 2003, Papyrus Oud / 71 is the future of this accord, the modernized past, the student surpassing the master, an inimitable neo-retro by none other than Michel Almairac.. Geographically, let us say culturally, this creation is the perfect meeting point between the Middle East and the West. The spiritual tradition of incense and precious woods, including Papyrus, emblem of Lower Egypt and the Renaissance, is the highlight, worked with the subtle delicacy of Western accords.. A stroll on the Nile with a view of the Eiffel Tower. An oriental palace in the heart of Hyde Park. Let your mind transport you into this unique journey.

listings.description: Dry and fresh like a fine gin, sharp like the best British humour. Lemon, black pepper and pine create an elegant, lively eau de toilette. Originally crafted for the Duke of Marlborough, it still retains a distinctive and unmistakable character.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Empressa Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Endymion Eau de Cologne 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Endymion Concentré Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A classic elegance worthy of Zeus’s most captivating son: intense, magnetic and irresistible. A spark of bergamot dances over suede, coffee and geranium, creating an Eau de Parfum destined to leave its mark through time.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Highgrove Bouquet Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Juniper Sling Eau de Toilette 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Quercus Eau de Cologne 100 ml

[travel notes]Balsamir is a rich and enveloping fragrance that celebrates the opulence of myrrh, resins, and high-quality balms. A refined and contemporary oriental-amber fragrance, where the richness of Myrrh, Opoponax, Tolu Balsam, and Tonka Bean blends with the deep intensity of Cedarwood and Fir Balsam, leaving an indelible trail.

listings.rawTitle: Perris Monte Carlo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Bergamotto Di Calabria contains the precious material called the Bergamot sponge. The extraction is still done manually. First the fruit is sliced in half and the pulp is manually removed with a special incurved knife. Then the rind is compressed on a natural sponge in a circular motion to collect the essence. The essence accumulated is the most delicate and complex and resembles a fruity and floral note of jasmine. A return to the origins and to the traditional techniques to seize the best raw materials and enriching them with a drop of modernity, a composition that encloses the freshness of bergamot making it, after a long working process, persistent and energetic.

listings.rawTitle: Perris Monte Carlo Encens Sacré Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Incense, the ancient essence of the soul, has traversed the millennia, suspended between earth and sky. In the rituals of the earliest civilizations, it burned as a sacred offering, carrying dreams and prayers towards the divine. We retraced the paths of incense and chose the most peculiar quality for us, sourced from Somalia. Its scent captivated, pervaded, and intoxicated us...” (travel notes)The essence of incense comes from the resin of the Boswellia carterii tree. The best quality comes from Somalia. The harvesting period runs from November to February; during this time, the tree bark is incised to allow the resin to drip. After a few days, the resin hardens, forming gum, which is then ready for essential oil extraction.ENCENS SACRÉ was born from the quest for a sublime balance between two olfactory nuances of incense: the essence extracted by distillation, with a sweet, mineral, balsamic note, and the essence obtained through high-temperature distillation, which offers the true impression of burnt incense, paying homage to the ancient art of fumigation. Supporting this duality is a floral heart of Moroccan Rose and Jasmine, and a warm base of Amber, Patchouli, and Sandalwood.A complex, intimate, meditative fragrance.”

listings.rawTitle: Perris Monte Carlo Vanille de Tahiti Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Native to Central America, the Vanilla plant belongs to the orchid family. It was a popular aphrodisiac in Mexico. In Peru and Ecuador, women would spread it under their arms as a balm. Vanilla Tahitensis is the most precious of the many varieties of Vanilla.The Vanilla Tahitensis is also unique in botanical terms. The fruit ripens on the plant without any intervention from humans, spontaneously developing its warm, sweet, exotic notes.Vanille de Tahiti Extrait de Parfum reveals all our passion for this sublime ingredient, here even more inebriating thanks to the union with the absolute of Ylang Ylang and Champaca and especially with the absolute of Magnolia which gives a unique sillage. The base is enveloping with Sandalwood, Amber and Musk.The absolute of Vanilla and Magnolia derives from an innovative, modern process known as supercritical CO2,  which guarantees the utmost purity and preserving all the olfactive nuances.

listings.rawTitle: Perris Monte Carlo Vetiver Java Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Two things strike us as we walk through the green tea plantations of ancient Java: the cone of the Kawa Ijen volcano and the vetiver bushes. Their long roots reinforce the pathways: they are the reason we came here, for the earthy, almost ashy note that makes this vetiver a unique olfactory experience. Vetiver: it sounds so French, but the name is deceptive. Vettiveru is actually the Tamil word for a plant whose long roots are also prized as a textile material. After extraction and distillation, they produce an amber-coloured essential oil. Its origins take us back to southern India, but we wanted our Perris Monte Carlo Vetiver to be a truly special fragrance experience. After sampling the most commonly used varieties from the Antilles, Haiti and Bourbon, we travelled to ancient Java. The largest, most populous island in the Sunda archipelago still has something of its mysterious aura. Perhaps because the great active volcanoes are so close at hand: it is certainly true that Java vetiver does not share the clean simplicity of its closest relatives. By contrast, it is pungent, sharp, smoky and almost burnt, with unexpected green, floral and spicy hints. Our Vetiver fragrance is perfect for anyone searching for elegantly charismatic notes: an intense, woody heart that opens out into light, floral notes.

listings.description: Love at first sniff..Regal and high class….  Harmony of noble ingredients to pay tribute to its greatness… Lavender infused ın juicy fruits. Framed in a luxurıous bed of oud and a dose of the most unique and multifaceted of all notes. agarwood; smoothly blended to perfection.

listings.rawTitle: Régalien Istanbul Nazen Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Watch the white lilies in the palace gardens heralding the arrival of spring.When spring comes, the season of poets comes as the tuberose flowers bloom in every part of the palace. They both spread the beautiful scents in palaces and heralds the arrival of spring. We were inspired by this fragrance heritage for Nazen which carries the naive aroma of tuberoses and white flowers. Nazen, with an extremely attractive and noticeable fragrance, has the vivid energy of spring when nature awakens and the elegance of palace flowers.

listings.rawTitle: Régalien Istanbul Sah Extrait de Parfum 80 ml

The Shah reveals the glimmer of ancient leaders on an oriental note.

listings.rawTitle: Régalien Istanbul Vanity Oud Extrait de Parfum 80 ml

The sweet note of the coffee blossom mingles with the bitterness of almond, evoking precious olfactory emotions. A hint of vanilla on an undertone of wood and ambergris is released at sunset.

listings.rawTitle: Rephase Ocean Wave Eau de Parfum 85 ml
listings.description: Ocean Wave is an alluring and captivating perfume to experience and to love.An intense sea breeze mingles with the intoxicating aromas of myrtle and Litsea Cubeba, through the sparkling and seductive fragrance of neroli blossom and rare, elegant notes of violet. It blends with amber and warm wood at the heart of the Earth, before gradually re-evoking the freshness of the sea from which it originates.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Atomica Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: There is an explosive energy that shapes the depths of the urban landscape, a cacophony of distortion and vertigo. The city lights, the concrete expanse, all a symphony of black and grey. Arise Atomica, a disorienting scent that stings and soothes – inebriates and agitates. Here is the energy and flow of the metropolis, a daring challenge to push ourselves beyond our limits.Atomica opens with an explosive jolt of elemi oil and ginger generating an incense-like effect that is both resinous and peppery. Atomica then unveils a combustive heart of cypriol and olibanum that lend spicy, exotic accords; vetiver and cedarwood add earthiness. At its base, guaiac, musk and amber give Atomica its unforgettable evocativeness.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Bandit Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In 1944, Robert Piguet created a daring couture collection, which was based on a “Bad Boy” concept. Just at the end of the second World War, Piguet’s shows featured models sporting villain masks and brandishing toy revolvers and swords. The scent accompanying this air of avant-garde mischief was Bandit, a composition created by perfume icon, Germaine Cellier, renowned for her bold and distinctive creations.Bandit is a renowned classic. Cellier used dark notes of leather, the greenness of moss and smoky woods, to give the scent its rich and unforgettable character. Accented with verdant galbanum and hints of orange-blossom, Bandit is certainly the “enfant terrible” of the Piguet fragrance collection. Jasmine and patchouli lend an exotic twist while leather and oak moss provide a thorny crown.Bandit is a fragrance composition light years ahead of its time - a perfumer’s perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Bois Noir Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This avant-garde elixir combines warm woods with rich balsam. The blend opens with facets of gaiac and cedar woods.  Heart notes include warm sandalwood and patchouli. The drydown features the richness of balsam.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Cravache Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Classic Cravache has been reimagined for today's astute fragrance aficionado taking this traditional aromatic blend and adding a modern addictive twist to its universal appeal.Opening with bitter orange and green bergamot that intertwines with green mandarin and petitgrain, the new formula immediately brings the wearer to the edge. Sweet jasmine and aromatic sage are then balanced to equilibrium with saffron and rich orris, nodding to this scent's heart-whipping effect. The ultimate secret weapon - a yearning, crystalized lavender - is grounded by sensual leather, luscious vetiver, and deep patchouli for an unforgettable finish.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Fracas Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Fracas, with its opulent tuberose and jasmine accord, clings to the skin like a silky veil. Unlike traditional florals, however, it is dark and luscious, speaking more of a boudoir than a garden party. Conceived as a seductive perfume, it smolders. When the initial brightness of orange blossom gives way to the plush tuberose, Fracas reveals its sensuous side. The richness and complexity of this perfume are enhanced by accents of sandalwood and musk. Difficult to resist, impossible to forget.Fracas de Robert Piguet Parfum Vaporisateur is a redesigned interpretation of the classic bottle. Topped with a jeweled cap and elegantly presented in a pedestal coffret, this warm, dark floral is absolutely irresistible.
