listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Fracas Eau Fraîche 25 ml
listings.description: Introducing the modern and youthful reimagining of a timeless classic – Fracas Eau Fraîche. Inspired by the iconic fragrance that revolutionized the industry in 1948, this contemporary interpretation brings a new dimension to the legendary Fracas collection.Fracas Eau Fraîche captures the essence of its predecessor’s allure while catering to the tastes of a new generation. The fragrance opens with a burst of vibrant and zesty citrus notes, immediately setting a lively and energetic tone. As it evolves, a playful blend of soft florals, including a delicate rendition of tuberose and jasmine, takes center stage. The result is a lighter, more effervescent bouquet that dances on the skin with youthful exuberance.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet L’Entier Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With a swirling current of fragrant energy, L'Entier de Robert Piguet clutches its wearer in a brine-y cascade. Boundless and endless, it captures and seduces with unabashed vivacity. A whirlpool of the terrestrial and atmospheric, the scent paints a vivid world of fulfillment and wanting all in a gentle gust. In its heady orbit, L'Entier plays a magician’s game; a mesmerizing presence in raucous invisibility.L'Entier de Robert Piguet is a complex brew of water-y accords, salted bergamot, deep woods and resins. It opens with and airy sea spray that is at once ozonic and Earthy. A mulch-like orris grounds the salty-ness at the scent’s heart while clary sage and palmarosa oil give roundness. The scent lingers in a warm base of sandalwood, oud Laos and gentle vanilla. Hints of coumarin and tonka leave a seductive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Luxury Fracas Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The coveted jewel in the crown of Piguet’s glittering collection, 1948 game-changer Fracas, is a long-time trendsetter. Here, legendary perfumer, Germaine Cellier, sought to create a scent that would make its wearer feel like a bombshell; one that would leave an unsettling effect on everyone that encountered it.With unmistakable and unrivaled opulent tuberose and jasmine accords, this lush and creamy concoction clings to a woman’s skin and warms with her unique chemistry. Unlike many traditional white florals, Fracas is dark and luscious. Rich accents of sandalwood and delicate musk enhance the brilliance and complexity.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Oud, a rare resin released by Aquilaria tree species, has a fragrance of such haunting beauty that it has inspired many legends and stories. Robert Piguet Parfums creates its own fairytale by weaving an opulent tapestry of oud and precious aromatics.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Oud Delice Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From its bright beginning, Oud Délice creates a mouthwatering effect with caramelized amber, miel de Provence and fig. The luscious palette then lingers into Oud Piguet a proprietary blend of resins and woods. Indonesian Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver lay a warm path to the scent’s foundation-an exotic recipe for yearning.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Petit Fracas Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Petit Fracas de Robert Piguet is like an infusion of whimsy and playfulness.. With roots of an audacious air, inspired by the iconic Fracas, Petit Fracas’ gentle sweet twists make for a fresh, youthful, and feminine charmer.. Flirtatious “Petit” opens with notes of fresh citrus and pear that lead to a vintage heart of tuberose and white flowers.. Musk and sandalwood warm toward the scent’s finale just before a subtle burst of sinful chocolate lays down an irresistible surprise.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Rue Du Cirque Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Wet pavements, the smell of macarons, vibrant nights and lazy mornings, this is loving Paris. A stone's throw from the Champs-Élysées, Rue du Cirque resonates with a romantic melody. Small flower shops, hidden cafes and jazz clubs… For Robert Piguet, Rue du Cirque is a special place, where he opened his first atelier and began to express his creative genius. Love in Paris is unique, intense. For Piguet, Rue du Cirque was where the magic began; for the wearer, it is the place where love begins…

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet V Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Formerly known as “Visa”, the fragrance was originally created in 1947 as a celebration of travel and exploration punctuated by the end of World War 2, V was re-introduced in 2007 and has quickly regained its classic followers.V de Robert Piguet opens with an initial exotic sweetness of ylang-ylang that embraces luscious bergamot and pear. Sumptuous layers of rose, white peach and cinnamon unfold in the warm heart, hinting at the scent’s sultry demeanor. In an unforgettable finale, the juxtaposition of milky sandalwood and gourmand leather evokes a tempting delicacy.Faithful to Robert Piguet’s original concept, but with a few new charms of its own, V de Robert Piguet is exciting and seductive like an unexpected romantic journey.

listings.rawTitle: Robert Piguet Zazen Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Still and silent as if defined by mindfulness, Zazen is a fragrance of tranquility, a welcome pilgrimage toward calm and contentment. Effusing softly like the gentle sound of bamboo flutes, Zazen's accords meld seamlessly, quieting the mind and positing a moment of profound clarity.From its heady top of saffron, Zazen imbues an Earthy warmth as it mingles with subtle tartness of mandarin and apple. The scent's heart is a silent explosion of rice, green violet, and orange blossom which immediately captures the wearer, delivering a sense of stillness and serenity. At its base, musk, tonka, and amber conjures a seductive skin-like smoothness.

listings.rawTitle: Rose & Co Manchester Gentleman Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With its refined elegance, Gentleman opens a new chapter in the Rose & Co. Manchester history. Just as in 1948 the famous Rose & Co. cologne was created by a Manchester aviator driven by the desire for a happy life, also in 2022 the desire for redemption is the inspiration for this new fragrance, destined to become an icon for the Gentleman of the 21st century.The modern Gentleman is a man of contemporary elegance and great savoir-faire. He wears an extraordinary perfume, which leaves an intense and sensual trail.The new Gentleman perfume by Rose & Co. Manchester is presented in the iconic bottle with soft lines, made of Italian glass.The famous jute weave and gold-colored details are enriched by a very trendy Navy blue. Tradition and innovation meet in this unmistakable perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Rose & Co Manchester Rose & Co Manchester Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: A perfume that embodies the values of the true man, who cares about his identity and who knows how to get what he wants, without fear and without giving up his ideals. An elegant and timeless style that characterizes the wearer of this extraordinary perfume.. Rose & Co. Manchester is a skilful blend of fragrant essences that give life to an intense and citrusy bouquet with a bitter note for a man who loves to stand out and does not want to be forgotten. Rose & Co. Manchester, an exclusive and slightly aristocratic perfume, whose top notes are embellished with citrus essential oils followed by a touch of aromatic rosemary. The heart notes are dominated by refined floral essences of rose and orange blossom. The base notes, so-called memory, are musky and amber with the enveloping tonka bean to seal an allure of elegance and uniqueness.

listings.rawTitle: Rose & Co Manchester Rose & Co Manchester Splash Eau de Toilette 400 ml
listings.description: A perfume that embodies the values of the true man, who cares about his identity and who knows how to get what he wants, without fear and without giving up his ideals. An elegant and timeless style that characterizes the wearer of this extraordinary perfume.. Rose & Co. Manchester is a skilful blend of fragrant essences that give life to an intense and citrusy bouquet with a bitter note for a man who loves to stand out and does not want to be forgotten. Rose & Co. Manchester, an exclusive and slightly aristocratic perfume, whose top notes are embellished with citrus essential oils followed by a touch of aromatic rosemary. The heart notes are dominated by refined floral essences of rose and orange blossom. The base notes, so-called memory, are musky and amber with the enveloping tonka bean to seal an allure of elegance and uniqueness.

listings.rawTitle: Rose et Marius Une Sieste Dans la Bastide Ensoleillée Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: This spring floral eau de parfum is an ode to wild flowers and joie de vivre. A fresh creation with green accents of hyacinth, violet leaves mixed with the wet vivacity of oak moss and crumpled leaves of basil and canapa sativa. In the heart, the notes of rose petals, jasmine and lily of the valley bells reveal delicacy and femininity in its fragrant trail.Close your eyes. Imagine a summer siesta in your country house in Provence. The bed streaked with shadows and light, the linen curtains flying in the breeze curtains that flutter in the breeze and caress your skin. The windows open on the garden of Rose and Marius and the fragrances that saturate the air with floral and sunny notes. Experience the wonder of a summer in Provence through this exceptional fragrance that makes you happy.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Blue Mai Tai Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A playful and refreshing cocktail welcomes you on a Polynesian beach. Light and dark rum blend in a heart of orange curaçao and davana absolute. Patchouli and soft orgeat syrup pamper your holiday in paradise.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The taste of a salty oyster with exquisite sea nuances captivates the senses. The caress of a provocative coconut adds an exotic note. The ambiance is warmed by incense, amber, and vanilla, creating a enveloping atmosphere. What else?

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: The taste of a salty oyster with exquisite sea nuances captivates the senses. The caress of a provocative coconut adds an exotic note. The ambiance is warmed by incense, amber, and vanilla, creating a enveloping atmosphere. What else?

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Bananita Intense Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From the unmistakable trail of Cocoyser, where coconut and oysters meet, comes a fruity and tropical variation: the mini green banana — fresh, tangy, and radiant.A bold twist that transports the marine heart of Cocoyser to a tropical, sun-drenched, and sensual island.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Bananita Intense Eau de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: From the unmistakable trail of Cocoyser, where coconut and oysters meet, comes a fruity and tropical variation: the mini green banana — fresh, tangy, and radiant.A bold twist that transports the marine heart of Cocoyser to a tropical, sun-drenched, and sensual island.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Carambola intense Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sparkling like a tropical star. Star fruit opens brightly with lemon blossom and a salty hint that recalls sun-kissed skin. In the heart, coconut milk, ylang-ylang, and vanilla orchid glide over the skin like a velvety embrace. The base, enveloping and creamy, blends amber woods, cedarwood, and a whisper of incense.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Moorea Guava intense Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Ripe guava and mandarin blend with the freshness of ginger. The heart pulses with coconut, oyster, and jasmine, touched by a hint of ylang ylang. At the base, the skin warms with patchouli, vanilla, ambergris, and white musks. Moorea Guava is a tropical plunge into fruit, sensuality, and golden light.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Cocoyster Moorea Guava intense Eau de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: Ripe guava and mandarin blend with the freshness of ginger. The heart pulses with coconut, oyster, and jasmine, touched by a hint of ylang ylang. At the base, the skin warms with patchouli, vanilla, ambergris, and white musks. Moorea Guava is a tropical plunge into fruit, sensuality, and golden light.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Delicious Bay Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The magic of a night in Dubai and the marvellous view overlooking the bay... The skyline's shimmering golden lights reflect in the water, creating a warm, voluptuous and sensual atmosphere that blends with the salty, dark notes of the sea.An explosion of harmonious Bergamot blends with Violet petals, while the overdose of Calone creates an enveloping wave.In the heart, the sweetness of golden honey and a succulent date intertwine with spicy saffron and mysterious white Oud. In the base, Sandalwood and Patchouli are combined with Vanilla, Golden Amber and the delicacy of Pecan Nut.The result is a Sensual, Gourmand and Marine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Sparkling Tamarind Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sparkling waves in a sea of pure joy: Sparkling Tamarind releases its vivacity through an olfactory accord that vibrates with cheerfulness and vitality, imparting an immediate sense of well-being. The effervescence of the cola accord is enriched by sparkling lime nuances, while tamarind, unexpected and intriguing, emerges as an exotic protagonist, amplified by an explosion of spices that accentuate its lively and surprising character. At the base, baobab wood reveals a magnetic and enveloping trail, a drydown that invites you to immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere, filled with lasting emotions and sensations.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Strawberry Pool Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A pool amidst the infinite shades of turquoise offers a breathtaking view of the Polynesian landscape. A cup of red strawberries delights the palate. Ambrette seeds and solar notes frame a moment of absolute relaxation.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Tropylang Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Tropylang is an immersion in a lush tropical forest, an explosion of fruits and flowers. The juicy scents of passion fruit and mango intertwine with the enveloping sensuality of ylang ylang, creating a surprising olfactory symphony that leads to an unforgettable journey.

listings.rawTitle: Salum Parfums Vanilla Monsoon Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A monsoon sweeps across the island: a completely new and disruptive accord, the Monsoon Accord, wrapped in the refined sweetness of vanilla flower. Juicy peach notes, bright orange blossom, and drops of velvety cocoa intertwine to create the perfect storm, an unexpected encounter of fragrances that will captivate and envelop you in a whirlwind of emotions.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Forbidden Words Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The spice of the forbidden, the uninhibited. Smells of liberty, to revel in the pleasure of indulging our deepest desires. The boundless rapture of forbidden romance and secret moonlight trysts.Leather, patchouli and amber in the base combine with decadent oudh and vanilla at the heart. The smoky and spicy notes of tobacco and pink peppercorn are balanced by lime tantalise at the top.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Forbidden Words Bombay Gourmand Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sasva revisit Forbidden Words with a tantalising Gourmand twist that takes you through the pulsating heart of Bandra’s allure. Decadence, lust and hopes fill every breath and the bars are enveloped with the smell of smoke and a boozy dessert sonority. The night reigns supreme and every gaze leads to a deeper abyss of pleasure.The heart of this fragrance lies in the interplay between the Oudh, Salted Caramel Accord and Vanilla which are danced around by a variety of oriental gourmand notes. Sweet Orange and Rose evoke Indian sweets while Patchouli, Davana and Labdanum create an airy, woody base that balances the gourmand sensuality of the fragrance.Perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Fruit du Paradis Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fruity tribute to the magnificence of fertility. The freshness of the sea breeze from amidst an orchard. Smells of the sun, the sea and the richness of pome-granates, mangoes and citrus fruits.A burst of citrus, followed by the sweetness of mangoes and pomegranates—nostalgic tributes to an Indian summer. A powdery base of sandalwood and vetiver compliment the fruit accords subtly, making them sing.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Garden of Youth Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A floral bouquet of signature aromatic Indian flowers. The fragrant balms of an Indian garden in the heart of spring. A world of youth, freshness and dreams.A sun-drenched, heady base of vanilla, amber and leathery notes, leads to an orchestra of floral notes led by the captivating smell of champak, tuberose and the rangoon creeper.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Junoon Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the passion and idealistic devotion of love depicted in the Persian poet Nizami’s ‘Leili va Majnoon’. A love that, in its madness, purifies the soul, giving birth to nobility, and reaching the Sufi ideal of a higher spiritual consciousness.The silky accords of saffron, patchouli and rose, with the depth of labdanum and lavender depict the simultaneous pain and bliss of love. The woodiness of Oudh, cedarwood and musk depict sleepless nights and endless dreams.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Le Notti di Goa Palolem Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With its own unique blend, this perfume captures the essence of Palolem Beach and its bohemian ethos. With notes inspired by the salty sea breeze, sun-kissed sands, and tropical florals, Palolem transports you to the serene atmosphere of this iconic Goan destination. The fragrance evokes images of colorful beach shacks, swaying palm trees, and the carefree spirit of travelers from around the world. Whether you're lounging in a hammock, taking a dip in the turquoise waters, or dancing under the stars at a beach party, Palolem perfume brings the essence of this bohemian paradise to life. This is a perfume that evokes freedom, adventure, and the simple joys of life by the sea. A citrusy boozy dive into the sea with the accords of Old Monk Rum, Orange and Mandarin blends with a signature blend of Indian spices such as Cardamom, Cinnamon and Vanilla Bourbon Extract. Exotic Indian flowers such as Champaka, jasmine and Carnation combine with marine accords and lavender form the heart of this fragrance while the deep signature Amber 84 De Laire extract which is exclusive to Symrise Fine Fragrances illuminates the base along with woody accords of Cedarwood, Moss, Balsam, Musk and Benzoin.Perfumer: Ping Lei Ling

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Le Notti di Goa Shanti Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With its blend of refreshing fruity notes, invigorating green accents, and hints of sea breeze, Shanthi transports you to a tranquil solitude amidst Goa's vibrant landscape. Inspired by the rejuvenating ambiance of sun-drenched beaches and swaying palm trees, Shanthi evokes a sense of peace and tranquillity. This fragrance invites you to unwind, breathe in the fresh coastal air, and immerse yourself in the natural peace and beauty of Goa's sedentary paradise.The fresh burst of mint, pink pepper and cardamom guide you to a lusciously fruity overture of pineapple and mango enveloped by marine accords. The patchouli and labdanum offer a subtle depth to the smell of a fruity cocktail by the Goan sea. Perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Light of the Earth Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: I want to connect with the universe and plunge into the heart of existence, reconnecting with the formless aspects of being, to seek the profundity of the elements.A burst of saffron, balanced by cardamom and orange bitters, lends an airiness, leading to a powdery vetiver and amber to create the perfume’s heart, boasting timelessness and mysticism complimented by a woody dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Moha Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A sultry morning walk across the sun soaked spice bazaars of Old Mylapore. The sweet shops and temple sweet offerings of vanilla, caramel and lime combine with the Madurai malli (jasmine) on women's hair to create a luscious voluptuousness. The South Indian filter coffee in the bazaar cafes combines with the smell of burning sandalwood and cigarette smoke that rub off on the sweat soaked bodies under the sultry sunshine.The rich decadent sweetness of vanilla and caramel combines with the overtures of coffee and chestnut to create a delicious gourmand heart to this fragrance. The smoky base of burning Sandalwood, Musk and Amber create a sultry heat and airiness to the fragrance that speaks of the sensuousness of a hot sunny morning in Mylapore, Chennai.Perfumer: Hamid Merati-Kashani

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Reverie de la Rose Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A dreamscape of Indian festivals and rituals. The smell  of the mystical and ecstatic, combining to create the ambience of timeless ceremonies that celebrate aboundance and joy.The dreamlike Gulaab (rose) at the core combines with celebration flowers— lotus and jasmine. Amber and leather make the earthy base, juxtaposed by spicy saffron, cardamom and cinnamon at the top.

listings.rawTitle: Sasva Saaqi Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Saaqui by Sasva is a unisex fragrance from the oriental vanilla family.Perfumer: Chris Maurice

listings.rawTitle: Sensatio Paris Black Sesame Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: David and Sacha share a cherished memory. “Black Sesame is the fragrance that takes us back to our childhood, our own Madeleine de Proust. In our minds, the memory of our mother preparing a delicious brioche, filled with chocolate and sprinkled with toasted sesame, remains ever vivid. The intoxicating aroma wafting from the oven filled us with a sense of wonder for that delightful treat, inspiring the creation of Black Sesame.” Rediscover childhood memories and immerse yourself in the delicate essence of this fragrance. Perfumer: Serge De Oliveira, Robertet.

listings.rawTitle: Sensatio Paris Cumbawa Wood Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for the creation of this essence comes from Sacha’s masterful use of Cumbawa in his recipes. Cumbawa is a citrus fruit similar to lime, with a highly wrinkled and irregularly bumpy green rind. Originally from Asia, it has long been cultivated in the coastal regions of northern Madagascar. Cumbawa offers a delicate bitterness and acidity. Its zest is widely used in cooking to enhance a variety of sweet and savory dishes, elevating their flavors. Fresh and mysterious, the fragrance reveals sparkling citrus notes, offering an irresistible intensity and lasting power. Perfumer: Serge De Oliveira, Robertet.

listings.rawTitle: Sensatio Paris Golden Pistachio Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Pistachio is a unique delicacy that Sacha explores in the kitchen, skillfully transforming it in all its variations. His favorite recipe is “praline,” made with the prized green pistachios from Bronte, water, and sugar. The rich and creamy aroma of pistachio filling the kitchen inspired Sacha and David to bring it into the world of perfumery, capturing the essence of this delicacy within an original and multi-faceted fragrance. Perfumer: Manon Coen, Robertet.

listings.rawTitle: Sensatio Paris Hypnotic Flower Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: “Hypnotic Flower is the olfactory imprint that has marked our journeys through Asia, a memory encapsulating all the floral notes that have enchanted our senses. Along our path, our sense of smell was captivated by mysterious and seductive floral fragrances. The lush vegetation, dotted with countless flowers, mesmerized us, gifting us with a moment of pure well-being that will remain etched in our memory.” This fragrance transports us to the heart of a flourishing garden, where the seductive scents of jasmine, tuberose, rose, and orange blossom blend in a harmonious explosion of aromas. Perfumer: Manon Coen, Robertet.

listings.rawTitle: Sense of Scent Amber Mayfair Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Amber Mayfair is a contemporary tribute to the timeless elegance of British tailoring roots. A modern reinterpretation of amber, wrapped in an intense and seductive signature fragrance that embodies the spirit and sophistication of London.An explosion of instinct and refinement comes alive with the spicy energy of Black Pepper and the luminous resin of Elemi, paving the way to a floral and vibrant heart. The velvety delicacy of Magnolia and the cyprian elegance of Iris intertwine in a surprising contrast with the sensual and resinous tones of Labdanum and Benzoin.Finally, the trail settles on a warm and enveloping base: Amber blends with the bold character of Cedarwood, the earthy intensity of Patchouli, and the deep nuances of Musk. An irresistible olfactory journey that captivates and fascinates from the very first moment.

listings.rawTitle: Sense of Scent Leathedor Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Leatherdor is an olfactory journey through the thousand nuances of leather: deep, elegant, mysterious. A fragrance that wraps around like a glove of the finest suede, caressing the skin with discreet sensuality and natural sophistication.The luminous opening of Bergamot awakens the senses with a fresh and vibrant touch, while the floral heart of Jasmine intertwines with the exotic sweetness of Passion Fruit, creating an intriguing and sophisticated contrast. To close, a warm and enveloping base of Amber and Vetiver evokes the velvety softness of white suede, leaving an intense and unforgettable trail.

listings.rawTitle: Sense of Scent London’s Calling Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: London’s Calling captures the true spirit of London: a city of timeless elegance, unexpected encounters, and vibrant cultural diversity. A fragrance that seems to capture the suspended atmosphere of an exclusive London club, where the past converses with the present.The opening is a play of contrasts: spicy Saffron meets the enveloping sweetness of Vanilla, while Mandarin adds a fruity and luminous freshness. The heart thickens into a deeper, more sensual trail, with notes of Leather and Amber that provide structure, warmth, and personality.London’s Calling is a contemporary classic, elegant and cosmopolitan, perfect for those who live the dynamism of the 21st century with style without giving up the refinement of British tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Sense of Scent Teatime Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Teatime is a refined tribute to the most iconic ritual of British tradition. A timeless fragrance built around the warm and enveloping notes of tea and rare spices, evoking tales of distant journeys that animated the salons of the English aristocracy.The opening is bright and delicately citrusy, thanks to the meeting of Italian Bergamot and Mandarin. The heart reveals the elegant depth of Lily of the Valley, while the soft milky nuances wrap the senses in a velvety caress. The base, noble and enveloping, combines Musk and Sandalwood, giving rhythm and depth to a composition that invites slowing down and living every moment with grace and awareness.Teatime is the scent of an afternoon among porcelain, whispered conversations, and eternal traditions.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Born From Fire Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fiery and intense sweetness, an exotic and seductive magma that releases the volcanic soul of a lush archipelago born from fire and eruptions.The warm tropical vanilla ignites with spicy notes and luxurious woods wrapped in sweet, spicy nuances, recreating the scent of the legendary black sand beach of Honolokani on the island of Maui.A magmatic soul burns deep within Maui and escapes through its volcanoes, reminding the world of nature's magnificence. Born from fire and set in the heart of the Pacific Ocean, the Hawaiian islands are sculptures of beauty, shaped by the restless and wild spirit flowing beneath the surface. The art of magma creates a black stretch of sand, surrounded by emerald palms and kissed by the sapphire sea. Maui, the daughter of flames, revealed the color of her primordial essence by painting Honolokani black.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Camouflage Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A selection of the finest woods in the world recreates the evocative atmospheres of the Middle East, painting the night of Dubai. The magnificence of Oud vibrates in the extraordinary presence of sandalwood and ebony, softening it and giving it a silky, elegant texture. The rose from Morocco blends into the woods, making Camouflage an intriguing and mysterious fragrance like the night.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Don’t Ask Me Permission Eau de Parfum 7.5 ml
listings.description: An infusion of bold beauty and brazen femininity that pours into the pleasure of the wild nights of Rio de Janeiro. Unavoidably surrender to the rhythm of Carioca and the most libertine passions.The exotic and transgressive spirit of Brazil intoxicates the air with a sensual elixir of passion fruit and ylang-ylang, merging with a magnetic oriental accord of amber, sandalwood, and Cachaca.

listings.description: Sweet and creamy, with its green accents and sugary nuances, it instills well-being and evokes the nature of the Mediterranean. A tribute to Sardinia, an island that enchants with the beauty of its untouched beaches, wild landscapes, and unforgettable sunsets.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Fico Nero Eau de Parfum 1.4 ml

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Leisure in Paradise Eau de Parfum 7.5 ml
listings.description: The time for leisure, doing nothing, and pleasure. Caribbean beaches, white sand, creamy coconut, and languid vanilla. Nothing better to enjoy the perfect vacation!Leisure in Paradise is the warm Caribbean breeze blowing over the beaches of Cuba; saturated with the delicious scents of sunscreen and juicy fruit.

listings.description: A soft cloud of sugar and almonds that envelops the senses like the sweetness of a gentle caress on the face. The undisputed star of refined Sicilian pastry, it intoxicates the mind with its soft, delicious notes.This fragrance transports you to the workshop of a Sicilian maître pâtissier during the creation of his almond-based confections.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Moorea Eau de Parfum 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin 3007 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Son Venïn 3007 is a sophisticated and feminine blend that is composed of fresh orange blossom mixed with some powdery notes and an addictive white bouquet of white jasmine, revealed in some soft touches of vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin Ambr Super Solid perfume 3 g
listings.description: Ambr Super is a pure and clean interpretation of amber and woody notes. Inspired by cultivated purist young Scandinavian skin, Euphoria and The Knife. Balancing between the intimacy of a skin perfume and the strength of the warm amber notes with epic ISO E-Super.. How to use: for successful diffusion, apply the solid perfume on your pulse points, where your body gives off the most heat: on your wrists, at inside your elbows, at the base of your neck, behind your ears and your cleavage. Avoid contact with eyes. To ensure skin compability test product on a small patch of skin. If irritation occurs discontinue use and seek ­medical advice. Store below 21°C / 70°F. Please recycle. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children.

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin Ambr Super Eau de Parfum 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin Le Voleur Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: LE VOLEUR is an elegant and seductive scent, that mingle together the freshness of a white bouquet and modern iris with sensual incense and gaïac wood.

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin Pain Nouveau Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Son Venïn PAIN NOUVEAU, meaning “New Bread,” is a bold statement, a reinvention of how we think about bread, both in life and in scent. Expect luxurious, creative, and contemporary. Earthy warmth bread, the sweetness of ripe figs, and the grounding elegance of fine woods, creating an olfactory experience that is both familiar and groundbreaking.

listings.rawTitle: Son Venin Posthume Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: POSTHUME is the scent of Nordic heritage, thousands of years of cold climate and extreme nature. Tar from our sacred buildings, texture from the nature that surrounds us. We created a sensory reenactment of our heritage. This is where we come from; this is our inherent creature.POSTHUME is the winner in the independent category of The Art and Olfaction Awards 2020.

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard 3D sul Duomo Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The inspiration is the neon structure by Lucio Fontana, a work created for the Milan Triennale in 1951, the reconstruction that we can now find at the Museo del Novecento. The fluorescence of the masterpiece makes it visible even during metropolitan nights as a fixed appointment in Piazza Duomo, for those who love the unstoppable city frenzy even at night.Visiting the Museo del Novecento it is almost automatic to be nose up in front of the famous installation. The work, hanging from an all-black ceiling, ranges in all possible dimensions and is reflected in the large windows of the room overlooking Piazza Duomo.The reflection creates a new artistic composition that inspires the name of this fragrance: 3D SUL DUOMO, the three-dimensional neon structure hovers right on the highest spire of the Duomo.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Black & White Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: Unique, Understated, Enduring. This fragrance, filled with contrasts, captures all the senses, just like the work it represents. Black & white, softness and solidity, closure and openness… It is a material fragrance with raw aldehydic hints, and the candid softness of musk surrounded by bitter black notes of styrax that recall the scent of ink.A fragrance inspired by the work «MONUMENT WITH STANDING BEAST» by Jean Dubuffet opposite the James R. Thompson Center in the Chicago Loop community area. The artist is a proponent of Art Brut, free and spontaneous art, and thus celebrates the aesthetic potential of primitive and childlike languages. This graphic fiberglass sculpture is made up of four shapes that represent an animal, a tree, an architectural form and a portal.. Perfumer: Luca Maffei

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Bosco Sospeso Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The vertical nature densification is the protagonist of this fragrance, which takes its inspiration from the most innovative and visionary places in the city: green souls suspended in the frenzy of Milan.A breathtaking plant show, where the light filters only through the leaves of the plants; it is the shadow scent. New dimensions are explored through the simple observation of these contemporary architectural structures. The concept of nature is taken to another level, or rather, it is stretched towards the sky. The green of spring or the coppery tones of autumn harmonize perfectly with the celestial vault and the modern technique of architecture, creating a completely inimitable combination of materials and textures.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Cuoio di Thaon Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The perfume is inspired by Via Thaon di Revel in Milan, a road that passes right in the center of the motors district, a very particular area in the La Fontana district.Here you can find shops, clubs, workshops, events and much more related to the roaring world of motors, in particular of historic motorcycles. Not far from these environments, places such as barbershops and vintage barbershops offer services to all men who want to be pampered.The world of motors is also increasingly fascinating a female audience with a determined and unleashed character. The fragrance is also proposed for women who love two wheels.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Infinite Square Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The expression of what connects people enclosed in a structure with a sunny and fruity tone. The fragrance describes the Liverpool Street area, and its dominant colors are red and bright mirror steel that reflects its surroundings. A tribute to femininity, the perfume interprets an accumulation of spheres connected to each other by a curved line, which expand infinitely in three dimensions with a sense of suspension and lightness.In Infinite Square the various notes interact with each other in a playful way, with a structure that becomes more full-bodied as the minutes go by, manifesting a woody modernity.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Menta sui Navigli Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The essence of this last fragrance is dedicated to the atmosphere of the Navigli's club, characterized by the sonority of the colored and perfumed glasses of the most diverse drinks; compositions flavored with aromatic notes and red fruits that refresh the hot summer evenings of Milan.A context with a young and informal allure, in which one is inserted into the whirlwind of true life on the Navigli. The frenetic existence of the metropolis remains suspended between a sunset and a sunrise that is still far away.The space slows down its images and resumes its breath only with the noise of the bottles of alcohol that mixes with cheerful essences. The caps leave as the opening piece of music for an evening that has just begun. To all this a touch of mint cannot be missing.Perfumer: Morgane Collinot - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Milano Centrale Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: The perfume takes its cue from the national and international movements that take place every day in the Milano Centrale station, symbol of the Lombard industrial capital, with a thousandA mixture of ethnic groups lost in the madness of Central. The urban place understood as a place of exchange not only of looks, ideas, cultures, art and fashion but also of olfactory visions that mix in a single style and desire, that of an inevitably universal perfume.The Central station is no longer cold, we find ourselves in a single intimacy, for a moment we connect to others. In an individualistic and frenetic society, this perfume knows how to create a relationship between those who, in the rush of a business trip, only touch each other between one track and another. Wanderers are no longer strangers, distances are shortened, the large spaces of the ultra-modern cities of the world suddenly shrink. Travelers accompanied by this perfume already imagine themselves projected towards the next destination.The fragrance was also created for those who do not frequent this Milanese "non-place", because it allows - once worn - to jump from any other city to the Central Station and... to drink a cup of espresso on the fly.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Red Flamingo Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: Explosive, Intriguing, SurprisingAn explosion of crisp, lively notes of mandarin embodies the vertical development of this work. They are slowly joined by gentle, elegant notes of Taif rose, which represent the sinuous nature of the sculpture. Unexpected and unmistakable saffron emerges, giving a colourful vibrancy to the majestic Flamingo that stands out among the many monochrome skyscrapers.A fragrance inspired by the work «FLAMINGO» by Alexander Calder, an iconic red sculpture that dominates Kluczynski Square in Chicago. Its flowing lines and geometric form blend harmoniously, while its bold colour is striking.Perfumer: Arthur Marrast

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Silver Cloud Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: Bright, dynamic, timeless.A game of mirrors in which changing incense reflections appear.A bright, cold, round and reflective structure. Representing the cold brightness is lavender associated with juniper berries. The discreet presence of the tonka bean expresses the round and soft shapes of the sculpture. Finally, as in a game of mirrors, changing reflections of incense appear.A fragrance inspired by the work «CLOUD GATE» by Anish Kapoor, the stainless steel work in Millenium Park in Chicago. Kapoor declares that the work «collects the spectator into itself». A mirror of oneself and the other, both private and collective, Cloud Gate is an inclusive work that invites public participation.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour – Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Sunday Street Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: A contrast between the brightness of the top and the depth of the bottom highlights the intertwining of cultures that characterizes the urban context of the artistic area of Whitechapel, with its intense yellow colour. Sunday Street describes an afternoon spent observing passers-by at the subway station, capturing human outlines and materializing them in a rich artistic collage. At the heart of the fragrance are different and intense faces, reinterpreted in intriguing and colorful expressionistic portraits.The composition evokes a sweet and welcoming solidity, which allows you to recognize yourself in the diversity of the elements of contemporary living together.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Step Aboard Transitions Gate Hair fragrance 150 ml
listings.description: Monochrome and grayscale expression of a repeated urban rhythm given by the continuous movement of people passing through Canary Wharf, this fragrance reflects the new London that looks to the future.A modern olfactory image that wants to convey the feeling of a video montage that presents the gloomy and out of focus London landscape, made of fumes and mists, between futuristic architectures in iron and blue glass. The non-stop movements in this area with a British style and dominated by business are the protagonists of a video installation on the human flow on the subway over the passage of time.Perfumer: Bertrand Duchaufour - Grasse, France

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas 2022 Generation Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Oud Golden Boy”After a visit to Qatar, Stephane Humbert Lucas was impressed of how its capital was changing so fast. Art complexes and skyscrapers built by the world’s finest architect. Yet, despite the international appearance of its development, the place was determined to keep its strong heritage.SHL imagined in 2012 a fragrance where, 10 years later, the ancestral customs would join the modern world. A whole generation is getting ready and excited. It rises to a bridge where the young people’ s perception and belief bind together. 2022, vibrant and intense perfume. The modern fruity note of Black Currant and the freshness of Yuzu contrast with the strength of traditional Cambodian Oud. Sublimated with spices and balsamic notes, this fragrance represents Audacity, Power and Modernity.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Black Gemstone Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "Tribute to the Black Stone"Black Gemstone is a respectful reference to the sacred Black Stone located in the Grand Mosque of Mecca. A mineral fragrance, with a deep character, powerful and spiritual, evoking the number 7, so dear to its creator.A fragrance inspired from Pierre Soulages’ works on the reflection of light out of the black color. The perfume is a brewed essence of Myrrh with woody notes of an unique blend of 3 Cedars and a hint of lemon. Tender as clay, the scent is petrified by the incense. Purpoted to have fallen from Heaven, pilgrims circle 7 times around.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Crying of Evil Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A dark, hypnotic, and deeply sensual perfume, Crying of Evil is a fragrance that captures the most mysterious and magnetic side of the human soul. It is not just a simple composition: it is an intense, almost cinematic experience.. The opening is rich and enveloping, with spicy and slightly sweet notes that immediately create an intriguing aura. The heart develops into a warm and resinous trail, where oriental accords and balsamic nuances elegantly blend. A deep, ambery, and woody base emerges at the drydown, with dark and sensual touches that linger on the skin for hours.. It is a bold, luxurious, and unconventional fragrance, designed for those who love to stand out and leave their mark. Perfect for evening wear or special occasions, when you want to convey confidence, charisma, and an almost enigmatic charm.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas God of Fire Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: God of Fire is inspired from the legend of Xiuhtecuhtli, God of fire, day and light in the Aztec mythology. Creator of all life, he is the mother and father of all Gods. He is the personification of light in the darkness, warmth in coldness and life in death. As a patron of kings and warriors, he is shown carrying a turquoise serpent around him and wearing a crown and ornaments made of a Turquoise blue stones.Symbol of power and wiseness, God of Fire is an exquisite fragrance where fresh and exotic notes hide an outstanding warm character. His incredible strength, leads him to rule the volcanos, his Oud heart burns intensely like a shamanic experience, leaving you regenerated and full of confidence.

listings.description: God of Fire is inspired from the legend of Xiuhtecuhtli, God of fire, day and light in the Aztec mythology. Creator of all life, he is the mother and father of all Gods. He is the personification of light in the darkness, warmth in coldness and life in death. As a patron of kings and warriors, he is shown carrying a turquoise serpent around him and wearing a crown and ornaments made of a Turquoise blue stones.Symbol of power and wiseness, God of Fire is an exquisite fragrance where fresh and exotic notes hide an outstanding warm character. His incredible strength, leads him to rule the volcanos, his Oud heart burns intensely like a shamanic experience, leaving you regenerated and full of confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Isra & Miraj Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “The Seventh Sky”To celebrate the 7 year anniversary of the 777 collection, Stephane Humbert Lucas Paris reconnects with its original inspiration and emphasizes on spirituality and wonders of the East. A meticulous work, where the know-how of the french perfumery dedicates itself to three mythic ingredients of great oriental perfumes, Amber, Musk and Oud.Isra & Miraj, sublime story of Orient, tells about a night trip under the moonlight and the ascension to the 7th sky. This fragrance is the interpretation of a spiritual and initiatory trip leading to the promise of hope, peace and personal fulfillment. A quest of absolute where, sky after sky, the most precious raw materials are layered to create a perfume that aims to perfection.Voluntary sensual and carnal, the fragrance reveals an intense balm of Amber dressed with a magnetic heliotrope flower. The white and brown Musks give an immediate sensation of a second skin. The excellence of a subtly dosed natural Oud introduces woody and animalic notes to perfect an intense sillage and a deep character.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Khôl de Bahreïn Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “The Art of Seduction”Khôl de Bahreïn is a glamourous fragrance that refers to the Khôl, an ancient cosmetic eye used by the Egyptian pharaos and queens and still worn by women in Middle East.A fantastic sensation of makeup for this seductive perfume, with powdery notes of Violet and a splendid Iris from Florence. A tribute to the elegance underlined by the warm notes of Amber and unctuous Nougat. A subtle and intimate ambery fragrance, a gracious weapon of seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Lady White Snake Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Lady White Snake is inpired from an ancient Chinese legend of a serpent Goddess who, after meditating for a thousand years to harness the energies of the universe, takes human form. Yet immortal and endowed with great powers, the goddess yearned for one more thing: human love.The old Chinese tales tell us that all things can grow and change. A stone can become a plant. A plant can become an animal. An animal can become a human. A human can become a God. Just like that, a snake can become a woman.Synonymous with purity and femininity, Lady White Snake is a delicious bouquet of white flowers that take us to that feeling of pure love. Complex and unexpected with its ever-changing trail, this addictive and sensual fragrance is a call to the pleasures of the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Mortal Skin Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "Venomous Sandalwood”Mortal Skin is inspired by the art of seduction and imagines the snake’s pursuit of its prey in three acts.Charming, elegant, mysterious, the snake so majestically represented on the bottle, slowly approaches its victim and hypnotizes with its diamond eyes and breathtaking charisma. Its desire is vibrant, the danger is approaching and the seduction is taking place. The snake then rears up to strike in a flash and its black venom spreads. A suffocating heat mingles with the icy cold and paralyses its prey. Captivating and addictive, it’s too late to escape, Mortal Skin has us completely in its grip and sublimely takes our lives.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Ô Hira Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “The Hulk of Amber”Ô Hira, evokes the story of the Prophet Muhammad seeking refuge in a cave upon Mount Hira in top of Mecca. Using the most precious ingredients, the «diamond of the collection» as called by the author, is a result of years of dedicated work. Stéphane Humbert Lucas introduces the fragrance as a fossilized Amber and aims to express a primitive and noble odour. The composition is based on tone upon tone construction, a layering of Amber, Leather and woody notes, headed by a superb pyrogenic Styrax. The scent, simultaneously strong and gentle, quickly unveil impressions of earth, salpetre, Amber and Cinnamon. The core is solid and based on Tonka bean, Torrefied Vanilla and Musk.

A deep and sincere woody and smoky fragrance exquisitely finished with three types of roses : rose from Morocco, Grasse and Bulgaria. A fragrance for the Oud lovers.

A pure being that inspired Stephane Humbert Lucas to create a white fragrance made with white raw materials.Like a Cleopatra milk bath, the fragrance is exquisitely creamy and soapy with notes of Sandalwood, White Musk and Iris. The impression of whiteness is sublimated by a delicate Jasmine and a subtle White Tea. A fragrance for angels and Goddesses that walk among us, or those that simply glow with the aura of purity.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Panthea Iris Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Absolute Divine”In Greek mythology, Iris was the messenger of the gods and bearer of good news through rainbows. As a symbol, Stephane Humbert Lucas has chosen the iris to dress Panthea, the Persian Goddess of the 777 collection. It is enhanced by Iris absolute, one of the most precious and expensive ingredients in perfumery.Patience, quality, refinement…Panthea Iris won’t disappoint Iris absolute lovers. This perfume rises to the level of divine. A rare elegance with a distinguished character. A sparkling start with notes of Bergamot and Tangerine from Italy, accompanies a refreshing and pristine white Tea. A blue and white silken veil adorn the fragrance. The Tonka absolute enhances the subtle Sandalwood and Patchouli to boost the powdery and sophisticated facets of intense Iris. Powerful with its sillage, it is with softness and sensuality that the scent evolves on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Pink Boa Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Pink Boa is inspired by the backstage hustle and bustle of a famous cabaret on the Champs-Élysées.Pink Boa is a tangy pink swirl where a fragrant snake will embrace you with its powdery trail, bringing with it the aromas of summer. This gourmand snake is made of blackcurrant and rosemary, it’s sweet and delicate taste of raspberry is combined with an extremely cold vodka accord.Eventually, its trail gives way to addictive notes of musk with warm and sensual sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Sand Dance Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sand Dance is inspired by the most sensual dance movements of the Kalbelia dancers, a nomadic people from Rajahstan, the land of kings in northern India and the gateway to the Orient.The women, wearing sublime black and multicoloured dresses with jewels, undulate gracefully and supplely like snakes. They twirl to the sound of the musicians who follow them in their inspiration until they reach a state of trance that provokes great emotion.Sand Dance is a sensational performance in the heart of the desert, where the burning wind carries in its wake a breath of spices. A captivating fragrance, made of warm and sweet notes of Cacao, with a hypnotic beauty and charm.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Sea my Love Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sea My Love draws inspiration from the mysterious depths and unfathomable secrets of the ocean, revealing the legend of the Sea Serpent, a fascinating creature and guardian of the great abyss. In the deep seabed where the sunlight is lost, its scales glow with an ethereal glow, reflecting the age-old secrets that even the waves dare not whisper. As the sun sets, immersing the horizon in a spectacle of blue and golden reflections, the sea seems to hold its breath. Suddenly a vibration, of such intensity, that it can only come from the force of the beast that dominates it. The great Sea Serpent emerges, cleaving through the water and foam with hypnotic grace. It moves majestically, its movements awakening the most powerful currents, evoking underwater storms and swirls of forgotten emotions. A blink and he disappears. His presence lasts only a moment. He plunges back into the mystery of the deep, taking with him the deepest secrets of the oceans to best protect his kingdom from prying eyes. Myth or reality? He will never risk his freedom.Sea My Love is a fragrance in which brute force, light and refinement play with currents and headwinds. Leather, animal sugar, jasmine, salted mandarin, musky amber: combinations of new and intense notes that speak to us of Love, Majesty, Emancipation and Power.

listings.description: The sun has just set on the horizon. The sky is on fire. The sea with its ephemeral reflections is sublime. The sound of waves accompanies lovers on the shore and thoughts are lost in dreams of eternity. Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow is a sensual and voluptuous version of Soleil de Jeddah.An original opening of mandarin and incense fumes swirls around before settling on a leathery vanilla. At the heart of the work, orchid weaves refined lianas around the mythical iris with the secret hope of taming it. In front of the beauty of Sumatran Benzoin, Amber majestically bursts forth and blows its last golden gleams to reach the night.Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow, a magnificent and captivating fragrance that releases a sumptuous trail.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Soleil de Jeddah l’Original Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “A Touch of Gold”In the heart of the desert, the ochre and golden dunes sparkle under the sun at its zenith. The sky is adorned in gold and glitter. The intense and overwhelming heat envelops the adventurous souls and transcends them to become one. A suspended moment in the heart of the Orient.A fragrance as luminous as the sun it was named after. Amber is adorned with a sublime Florence iris with powdery facets and reveals its strong character with deep leather notes. A fragrance that gives the divine sensation of a radiant aura with a powerful and sophisticated trail. A must for lovers of oriental fragrances.

The freshness of a coconut sherbet contrasts with the sweet facets of Ylang Ylang while the addictive sweetness of sunny amber and vanilla absolute, sublimates the gourmand undertones.Soleil de Jeddah Mango Kiss, an irresistibly gourmand fragrance that gives great satisfaction.

listings.description: “The Long Journey”Taklamakan is named after one of the biggest desert in the world on the Silk Road. The merchants from Europe would pass north or south of the desert, bringing back with them the most beautiful fabrics, jewels and spices from the Orient.Like the shifting sands that compose it, Taklamakan is hot and dry. The perfume is a journey where the Patchouli from India meets the smoky Vanilla, the Resins and the Incense on the ancient Spice Route. It eventually falls in love with the Cedar from China in this deep and powerful fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Abu Dhabi Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Incredibly long-lasting, noticeable even after multiple washes” claim many who have used it. A seductive and luxurious fragrance, evoking the allure of an Arabian perfume cloud.Abu Dhabi perfectly encapsulates the essence of this grand city. A seductive, luxurious, and rich Arabian scent that remains irresistible even in the scorching heat of the Emirates. Its sweetness comes from amber and vanilla, which blend harmoniously with the woody, oud notes. Tonka bean, warm spices, and saffron add complexity, while the Bulgarian rose makes it exceptionally captivating and unique. This special fragrance lingers for hours, drawing an enchanting scent cloud behind you. Suitable for all four seasons and unisex, Abu Dhabi works equally well for men and women. On men, the woody and oud notes take the lead, while on women, the sweet, rose-infused notes stand out more. This masterpiece is one of our best-selling unisex and Arabian-inspired perfumes.When we Europeans hear "sweet," we often think of vanilla, and this isn’t a coincidence. Vanilla, alongside amber, is what gives Abu Dhabi its sweet, alluring appeal. The best vanilla for use in perfumes comes from Vanilla planifolia, Vanilla pompona, and Vanilla tahitiensis. Indigenous peoples in Mexico used this plant even before the discovery of the Americas, primarily to sweeten cocoa. Today, Madagascar is the largest producer of vanilla, accounting for around 80% of global production. Vanilla’s scent is deep, complex, sweet, and inviting, with subtle earthy undertones.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Caesar Ultra Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sensual elegance wrapped in luxury, with silky musk, iris, and magnolia making this fragrance truly special. You'll leave a lasting impression wherever you go!Caesar Ultra captures the sensual essence of three-year-aged patchouli in a luxurious fragrance. As this creation is centered around patchouli, its warm, slightly earthy spiciness emerges in the top notes. The heart reveals silky musk, iris, and the exotic floral charm of magnolia, elevating the fragrance to a new level of sophistication. This masterpiece finishes with saffron, amber, and woody undertones, creating a fragrance that is anything but ordinary. The long-lasting scent and impressive sillage ensure that you leave an unforgettable mark wherever you go. This perfume is designed for those who are driven, purposeful, and ready to create something extraordinary.In Hungarian, "patchouli" often brings to mind the "cheap perfumes of our grandmothers," but in reality, it’s an extraordinary plant native to Southeast Asia. Like many Southeast Asian plants, it not only possesses a unique fragrance but also medicinal properties. Its distinct scent is sweetly exotic and green, with strong earthy, slightly herbal, and balsamic nuances. The patchouli used in Caesar Ultra is aged for three years before use, enhancing its distinctive characteristics.

The heart reveals silky musk, iris, and the exotic floral charm of magnolia, elevating the fragrance to a new level of sophistication. This masterpiece finishes with saffron, amber, and woody undertones, creating a fragrance that is anything but ordinary. The long-lasting scent and impressive sillage ensure that you leave an unforgettable mark wherever you go. This perfume is designed for those who are driven, purposeful, and ready to create something extraordinary.In Hungarian, "patchouli" often brings to mind the "cheap perfumes of our grandmothers," but in reality, it’s an extraordinary plant native to Southeast Asia. Like many Southeast Asian plants, it not only possesses a unique fragrance but also medicinal properties. Its distinct scent is sweetly exotic and green, with strong earthy, slightly herbal, and balsamic nuances. The patchouli used in Caesar Ultra is aged for three years before use, enhancing its distinctive characteristics.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Coco Loco Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of a lively, cheerful, and passionate woman; an exotic wonder that evokes the tropics yet is incredibly passionate.This fragrance is bursting with life! It perfectly suits the sweetest women, who are inherently attractive. Those who bustle about, making life sweet for them, are passionate and filled with smiles, adventure, exploration, and enthusiasm in their everyday lives. As the name suggests, the exotic scent of coconut dominates, paired with a hint of summery "beach vibes," sweet vanilla notes, and softened by tropical fruity and powdery undertones. An exotic wonder that undoubtedly captures men's attention, as it is sweet and desirable. Perfect for parties, dates, and joyful everyday experiences! Suitable for all seasons, but undoubtedly shines brightest in summer!A unique ingredient in Coco Loco is heliotrope (Heliotropium arborescens), known for its vibrant purple flowers, originating from Peru. This highly decorative plant has a sweet scent and was a favorite garden flower in Victorian England. Its fragrance is sweet and vanilla-like, with distinct almond undertones.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Endless Love Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The romantic charm of eternal love creates a mystical atmosphere with its marine notes. Soft, sensual, and radiating happiness.Endless Love is a captivating women’s fragrance that exudes freshness and lightness, making it perfect for summer days. It’s the feminine counterpart to our Endless Sea men's fragrance, drawing inspiration from the infinite ocean’s power and the romantic allure of eternal love. The scent is defined by the refreshing essence of bergamot and marine notes. The citrus notes awaken the senses and fill each day with energy, while the marine accords create a mystical atmosphere, as if you were walking along the endless seaside, dancing with the ocean breeze. Vanilla, musk, and amber add sweet richness, creating a soft, sensual experience that radiates joy and happiness. The lively pink pepper gives the fragrance a vibrant touch, while jasmine enhances the feeling of femininity and grace. Endless Love captures the carefree freshness of summer while evoking a romantic and sensual mood. Let this unique and enchanting fragrance sweep you away and turn your everyday life into an extraordinary adventure!The Convallaria majalis, or lily of the valley, is a small white flower native to the temperate forests of Europe and Asia. Despite its inviting fragrance, the plant is highly toxic and can be lethal in moderate quantities. Its scent is distinctly floral, with greenish, soapy, and sweet nuances. This note is also featured prominently in the following products: Caesar, Coco Loco, Colors, Immortalis, Siren, The Wolf.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Endless Sea Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The fragrance that boasts incredible longevity, deep and mysterious elegance, sporty energy, and irresistible masculine allure.Endless Sea, or "infinite ocean," represents its name perfectly, the scent feels endless, just like the sea itself, offering astonishing longevity even with marine notes. It’s a deep, mysterious fragrance that exudes the same balance and perfection you feel standing on the shore, gazing into the infinite horizon of the ocean, experiencing those indescribably special moments. The musk blends harmoniously with lemon and Sicilian bergamot, while the sweet amber, masculine sandalwood, and mossy notes add a striking appeal. It balances elegance, sportiness, and masculine seduction, making it perfect for any occasion. Few fragrances can claim to have both 10/10 sillage and longevity, especially with fresh, marine elements, but Endless Sea achieves this thanks to its outstandingly high-quality ingredients. Perfect for all four seasons, morning or evening, it’s destined to be a "love-at-first-scent" experience!The bergamot is what brings Endless Sea its refreshing quality, even though it’s not purely dominated by freshness. Citrus bergamia, a plant native to Southeast Asia and now cultivated in Southern Italy and Sicily, belongs to the citrus family. It's also widely used in traditional medicine for treating surgical scars, eczema, and acne. In the culinary world, it is famously used to flavor Earl Grey tea. Its scent is citrusy, bitter, and tart with a subtle elegance, a hint of spice, and complex fruity and aromatic nuances.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Flamingo Fizz Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Unique and mesmerizing, Flamingo Fizz is a vibrant and uplifting fragrance filled with life and energy that enchants everyone!Flamingo Fizz is a truly special and captivating perfume. With its unique and exciting ingredients, it creates a fragrance that exudes vibrancy and energy. The blend of grapefruit, berry fruits, and the fizz of champagne immediately enchants the senses. Orange blossom, jasmine, and rose further enhance its sensuality, while amber and musk add mysterious depth to the scent. Designed for women who love life's sparkling moments and are always ready for new challenges, Flamingo Fizz is a versatile fragrance that encapsulates all the joys of summer. Yet, don’t let the seasons limit you—its sweet notes make it perfect for the cooler months as well. Let this fragrance accompany you on all of life’s adventures, making every moment unforgettable. Experience the effervescence of life with Flamingo Fizz!One of the standout characteristics of this fragrance is the champagne note, with its citrusy, fizzy, fruity, and spicy scent. However, what truly makes Flamingo Fizz radiant is the orange blossom (Citrus aurantium) and musk. The lightness of Flamingo Fizz comes from vetiver (Chrysopogon zizanioides), also known as khus. Different types of vetiver from various parts of the world vary significantly in their aroma. Haitian vetiver, which can also be found in Lake Balaton, is particularly pure and ethereal, unlike Javanese vetiver, which offers more smoky and dusty tones. Vetiver is generally described as earthy, woody, and green.

listings.description: Luxury and the modern urban lifestyle that draws attention to the fragrance wearer. Vibrant and exciting, deep and rich, instantly enchanting.Khalifa, a luxury fragrance inspired by Dubai. It reflects the harmony of luxury and modern urban living, infused with the richness and elegance of Arab culture. The dominance of woody and leather notes immediately draws attention to the fragrance wearer. Oud is an essential component of Eastern-style fragrances, lending a sweet, smoky aroma to the perfume. Its scent is distinctive, fresh, balsamic, slightly green, woody, and spicy, with a fruity top note.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Khamzat Smesh Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Smells good before you smesh somebody.”The well-known word "Smesh" is often used by Khamzat in his fights, and wherever this word is mentioned, Khamzat's infinite and incredible dominance appears, something viewers may have never seen before in MMA history.The perfume has been crafted in the same way—extremely stylish and dominant. It’s a scent that gives you the immense power to achieve your set goals! Alongside cedarwood, the hot spices ensure that the fire within the wearer never goes out. The notes of vanilla and tonka bean make it attractive, while the blood orange adds a truly explosive and unique character.The fragrance's special feature is the essential oil of neroli, or bitter orange (Citrus aurantium subsp. amara) flower (Citrus aurantium). It is a distinctive spice in the sweet called “Persian kiss.” Its aroma is characteristic—oriental, citrusy, light, slightly bitter, with hints of orange and honey flower, along with aromatic green shades.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest La Bohéme Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The juniper berry and pink pepper make it particularly attractive and exciting. Its fragrance notes evoke a sense of richness and magnificence. A meticulously crafted creation.A very pleasant, fresh, and vibrant scent. Not overly aromatic or intrusive, rather very balanced and sporty, yet undoubtedly wearable for a date, thanks to the captivating qualities brought by the juniper berry and pink pepper. Typically, spring scents are not intense and lack longevity, but La Bohéme stands out as it holds up well in daily wear, with its fresh scent reminiscent of "Gin Tonic" accompanying you all day. Just as golf is a favorite sport among businessmen and associated with wealth, La Bohéme’s fragrance notes create an impression of richness and magnificence. It’s certain that you won’t often encounter a scent like this, as its meticulously crafted design deviates from conventional perfumes while remaining easy to love. It’s more suited as a daytime fragrance, particularly in spring and summer, as it blossoms best then, but it can also be worn in autumn and even winter.One special fragrance note of La Bohéme is juniper berry, which happens to originate from Hungary, making it one of our greatest pride. The common juniper (Juniperus communis) is the only type of juniper found in Hungary. Its ripe, dark bluish-black, waxy, shiny, and meaty berry (galbulus) is larger than black pepper. The scent of juniper berry (Juniperi fructus) is fresh, balsamic, with subtle pine nuances. It is known as a distinctive flavoring for meat dishes, pickles, and beverages, and was also used as one of the components for embalming in ancient Egypt.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Lake Balaton Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: As fresh and airy as a gentle breeze from Lake Balaton, caressing both faces and souls alike, a journey rich in memories.Experience a new dimension of freshness and the magic of memories! Not only is the scent special, but its packaging tells a story, too. The painting featured on the box has been passed down through three generations! The artwork was painted by Szabolcs Szerencsés’ great-grandfather in Balatonboglár in 1940. Now, this magical image not only decorates their family home but also enchants everyone who encounters our Lake Balaton fragrance. This perfume is a truly irresistible and exclusive creation. It is notable not only for its release in Hungary but also for debuting simultaneously in Italy, the USA, and Latin America as our country's new pride.As fresh and airy as a gentle Balaton breeze, it touches the face and soul alike. The first sensation comes from the radiant freshness of grapefruit, followed by the delicate notes of moss, amber, and saffron. Jasmine evokes the romantic nights of a Balaton summer, while the earthy, green scent of nagarmotha takes your imagination to the reeds of the southern shore. Lake Balaton is not just a perfume but a journey rich in memories, reminding every Hungarian of the famous Balaton region and evoking countless beautiful moments.One of the key fragrance notes in Lake Balaton is vetiver (Chrysopogon zizanioides), also known as kusafű in Hungarian. Different varieties of vetiver from various parts of the world differ greatly in aroma. The vetiver from Haiti, used in our Lake Balaton fragrance, is exceptionally pure and ethereal, unlike other vetivers, such as the Javanese variety, which tends to have a smokier and dustier feel. Generally, vetiver can be described as earthy, woody, and green.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Memories Gold Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The intertwining of honey and caramel makes it sweet, special, and sensual. So enticing that you’d want to take a bite. It captivates completely!The charm of gourmand sweetness captured in a bottle. Memories Gold is the sister fragrance of our Memories perfume, yet it is even sweeter, more gourmand, and unique. Its main ingredients are honey and caramel, which together bring sensuality and a soft touch to the fragrance. The magic of sweetness lies in the interplay of these two scent notes, which is so enticing that you’d want to take a bite. The sweet, delectable scent of vanilla and milk deepens its character, while iris lends an elegant, floral touch, enhancing its complexity. The fragrance is completed by the pure and sweet aromas of cedarwood and musk, harmoniously balanced with the spiciness of tonka bean, making it a long-lasting, elegant experience that accompanies the wearer throughout the day. This extraordinary gourmand composition is not just a fragrance; it’s a sweet memory that enchants and remains unforgettable.One of the most prominent notes in our Memories Gold fragrance is caramel. This distinctive scent is sweet, sensual, and rich, featuring creamy, buttery lactonic notes that enrich gourmet perfumes and add sweetness to the floral notes in the composition. The story of caramel as a sweetness dates back to 17th-century America, although references to consuming caramel-like sweets can be found in ancient North Indian texts, where the tradition of boiling milk, butter, and cane sugar has existed for millennia. This scent note is also prominently present in the following products: Amber & Woods, Candy, Memories, Noble, Passion.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Morocco Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of abundance, evoking beautiful landscapes that we could explore either on camelback or stylishly in a Mercedes SUV. The fragrance of wealth, abundance, and generosity.Imagine a wealthy Arab businessman, a sheikh who has traveled to Europe, blending both Arabic and European scent notes in his perfume. The rich, refined, sweet scent with warm spices is distinctly Eastern, yet it beautifully intertwines with almond and walnut. The Morocco scent cloud brings to mind warm hospitality, abundance, and beautiful landscapes, which we could explore on camelback or stylishly in a Mercedes SUV, whether in Morocco, Dubai, Bahrain, or some exclusive Arab resort. The scent of wealth, abundance, and generosity. It’s distinctly business-like but also a perfect complement for a date. This confident and masculine fragrance will undoubtedly elevate your everyday life.One of the special fragrance notes in Morocco is Indian sandalwood (Santalum album), which originates from India. Its distinctive woody-spicy aroma is known to many as the "scent of Eastern shops," as sandalwood is used in crafting statues in India and is often the base scent of traditional incense. In medicine, it has been used for millennia for its antiseptic, diuretic, and pain-relieving properties in both Indian Ayurvedic medicine and Chinese medicine. Its aroma is characterized by woody, milky, soft, creamy, sweet, and rich spicy notes with fresh undertones.

listings.description: The scent of unbroken elegance that conveys confidence and sophistication. The fragrance of Secret Desire Iris is abstract and inspiring.Secret Desire Iris blends powdery, vanilla, and amber base notes crowned with iris, caramel, and patchouli, creating a truly attractive and striking scent. This fragrance opens a new horizon in the world of unisex scents, perfectly suited for both men and women. One thing is certain: this is not a fragrance for "beginners"! It is recommended for those who have been collecting perfumes for a long time and appreciate a unique, extraordinary olfactory experience. Many testers agree that this scent embodies French luxury. With an immense fragrance cloud and outstanding longevity, you can be sure it will accompany you throughout your entire day. The scent of unbroken elegance conveys confidence and sophistication. Perfect for women on a date and essential for men on a special journey, as the world of Secret Desire Iris is abstract and inspiring. We guarantee it will be the perfect companion for all your important moments!What makes Secret Desire Iris truly attractive is the iris (Iris), known in Hungarian as nőszirom. In the world of perfumery, the plant's stem and root are most often utilized, which has an earthy, woody, powdery scent, slightly reminiscent of cooked carrots. However, in this composition, we experience the scent of its flower, which is simultaneously purple, soft, powdery, and easily recognizable.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Siren Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that will sweep every man off his feet! The fresh mango and vibrant bergamot combine for an irresistible, sexy allure. It’s elegant, luxurious, and seductive.Siren embodies playfulness and sensuality, captivating everyone around. At first, you’ll be enveloped in the fresh and juicy scent of mango and bergamot, which is beautifully complemented by the softness of jasmine. Sweetness comes from the vanilla and sandalwood, while the creamy incense adds a layer of depth and sensuality. Sexy, enticing, and seductive—this fragrance is perfect for intimate moments, enhancing the best in both partners!The fruity essence of Siren comes primarily from the mango, a tropical fruit native to the Indian subcontinent (Mangifera indica). Known as one of India’s treasures, its fragrance is luscious, juicy, and tropical with hints of peach and pine. Interestingly, mango is also used in medicine for its high vitamin and mineral content.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Siren Extrait de Parfum 2 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that will sweep every man off his feet! The fresh mango and vibrant bergamot combine for an irresistible, sexy allure.
