listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Soho Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The vibrant energy of a modern metropolis, which is soft and sophisticated, yet spicy, mystical, and balanced.Soho is a captivating and pulsating fragrance that embodies the vibrant energy of a modern metropolis. At the heart of the scent are tonka bean, vanilla, and coconut, which together create a seductive harmony. The tonka bean caresses the senses with its warm and sweet spiciness, while the sweet notes of vanilla and coconut add a refined and soft touch to the fragrance. Nutmeg, agarwood, and musk contribute to the character of the scent, further enhancing Soho's uniqueness. The spicy notes of nutmeg bring liveliness, while agarwood creates a mystical and woody dimension. Sandalwood adds an earthy, woody base that reflects the balance between urban life and nature. Soho is not just a fragrance; it’s an adventure where urban life meets nature, creating an unforgettable experience.The Canarium resin found in Soho, medically known as "elemi" (Canarium luzonicum), is a fresh, citrus-scented ingredient produced by the plant beneath its bark. Freshly, it resembles thick, crystalline honey, but it later solidifies. It belongs to the family of balsam trees, making it a relative of Juniperus thurifera (from which frankincense is made) and the Somali balsam tree (Commiphora myrrha), from which myrrh is produced.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Whoosh Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A dominant breeze, the fragrance of iconic stars. Elegant, intelligent, refined, and attractive. Very characterful, specifically intense, and long-lasting.This is a very intriguing and special scent. At first, it is fruity and sweet; however, this won’t be your first experience with the perfume, as it perfectly blends Madagascar vanilla with powdery, slightly citrus, and animalic notes, creating the sensation of Whoosh (meaning "breeze"). It can be described as overwhelming. A dominant breeze that enchants.It is a complex, luxurious fragrance, but not of the "cheap celebrity" type; rather, it embodies the essence of iconic stars who stand out from the crowd not through scandal, but through their captivating charisma. Elegant, intelligent, refined, and attractive—this is SUPERZ. Whoosh! An absolute four-season fragrance that works beautifully both day and night. A very characterful, “love” perfume that is specifically intense and long-lasting. We wholeheartedly recommend it, as it is a creation that is loved by many!"Filled with ripe fruits," is the initial thought, but behind the fruity notes, we discover amber, one of the base notes of Whoosh. Originally, amber is the fragrant, dense, grayish (sometimes black) intestinal secretion of the sperm whale (Physeter macrocephalus), which serves to protect the organism's intestinal wall. Processed amber has been a staple in perfumery for millennia.However, in the case of SUPERZ, the amber used is a blend of several plant resins, created from labdanum (Cistus ladanifer), Siam benzoin (Styrax benzoin) resin, and vanilla. It is a classically oriental scent that is extremely persistent. Its aroma is sweet, resinous, warm-toned, and inviting. Laypeople sometimes incorrectly translate the English word "amber" as "borostyán," which means "amberstone," but the fragrance note has little to do with the mineral. This fragrance note is also prominently featured in the following products: Abu Dhabi, Amber & Woods, Morocco, Royal Oud.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Whoosh Extrait de Parfum 2 ml

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Attar Perfume Oil 5 ml
listings.description: The Tauer attar speaks in Arabian language; it is undiluted perfume oil and needs the skin's warmth to bloom. The fragrance is dark, leathery, animalic.Creamy sandalwood from Mysore balances an arab wood accord. Jasmin absolute from Egypt adds a floral undertone. Earthy vetiver oil from Java and black cistus oil from Spain add to the arcoamatic aura of the attar.The Tauer attar blooms and lasts on skin but follows the tradition: An attar always comes with an element of modesty.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Au Coeur du Désert Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The heart of the Maghreb desert. The enchantment of infinite space. Sublime, woody, oriental, balsamic.It is the metamorphose of L’air du désert marocain into a luxurious extrait de parfum. The richness of the extrait concentration accentuates the sublime elegance and natural beauty of warm woody amber notes. Au Coeur Du Désert builds on L'air du désert marocain, but it is a refined extrait de parfum, with a revised formula, and a generous hand with expensive notes.If perfumery is art, AU COEUR DU DÉSERT is a statue carved out of sun beaten timber, softened with a gloss of aged patchouli, and a patina of ambergris, coming to life with a balsamic glow.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Cologne du Maghreb Cologne 50 ml
listings.description: All natural. All botanical. One of our most precious offerings: the COLOGNE DU MAGHREB. Essential oils, absolutes, resins and love go into this cologne. Not more not less. Like all colognes, it is made to exist in the moment. A refreshing homage to the Maghreb. With its freshness it is one of our best choices for springtime.This cologne is crafted in the very traditional way of cologne making: it is rich in citrus oils and builds on contrasting notes of lavender, clary sage and rosemary. The COLOGNE DU MAGHREB, however, adds a Moroccan twist with vibrant cedar wood from the High Atlas, dark vetiver from Java, erotic orange blossom absolute and exotic labdanum, in balance with Moroccan rose absolute and Bulgarian rose oil. Refreshing, invigorating and addicting: try it after showering on our shirt...You will love it!

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Golestan Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A striking and sophisticated experience of gracefully blended flowers blooming in timeless manner in a colorful place. The garden greets you with first impressions of fresh citrus and rich ylang. Rose absolute from Bulgaria softens exuberant doses of white flower absolutes: sensual jasmine, lustful tuberose and erotic orange blossom. The exuberant complexion of these natural absolutes gives rise to an abundant and dynamic floral perfume. The base is rich, with creamy patchouli and amber notes blended into sweet and soft woods. Golestan refers the seductive classics, yet it is an uncompromising modern and original perfume. It comes as long lasting extrait de parfum."It all started when I visited the Louvre in Paris in 2020. There I stumbled over a section that I never visited before although I was in the Louvre a couple of times. The section was all about Persian empires and history. A revelation! I was mesmerized by the grandeur, by the statues, and the cultural heritage, spanning more than 5000 years. I began to discover more, reading books and I ended up discovering the palace with the name of Golestan in Teheran in pictures. The palace, also known as the Rose Garden Palace, built in the 16th century, with its ornamental and figurative paintings on tiles, was pure inspiration. Golestan literally translates to city of flowers or garden of flowers. Although I could not travel to Iran so far, I created a perfume that brings me there. It is an invitation to breathe the perfumed air of a flower garden, in freedom." Andy Tauer

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Heraud Elixir Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: One of the central pillars in the perfume formula is the double distilled extract of COCOA beans from the Ivory Coast. Very hard to get, not available every year, produced in smaller batches: HERAUD might not be available at all times."The inspiration behind HERAUD came from a deep desire to create a truly unique fragrance. I aimed to craft a fragrance centred around rich cacao extracts, taking it beyond the usual gourmand scents. I wanted to make a perfume that’s both delicious and sophisticated, combining the comforting sweetness of gourmand notes with a modern touch and timeless appeal. Using high-quality cacao extracts as the core, I achieved a luxurious aroma that lasts all day. I wanted this fragrance to be warm and ambery, wrapping you in a cozy scent that’s perfect for any occasion. Its long-lasting nature ensures that the delightful mix of sweet and bitter cacao, along with hints of vanilla and bourbon bergamot, stays with you throughout the day. The idea was to balance modern and classic elements, offering a unique scent that’s both familiar and refreshingly new. I wanted it to be a celebration of gourmand indulgence, carefully crafted to be beyond the ordinary. The addition of bourbon bergamot adds a fresh, slightly citrusy edge, enhancing the complexity of the fragrance. To further enhance the scent, I incorporated woody notes that are dry and crisp, providing a perfect balance to the ambergris and musky undertones. These woody notes give the perfume a grouding effect, adding depth and sophistication without overpowering the gourmand elements. The result is a multifaceted and intriguing fragrance that evolves beautifully on the skin."

listings.rawTitle: Tauer L’Air des Alpes Suisses Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: L'Air Des Alpes Suisses is not only hand filled and labelled in Switzerland, but also inspired by the beauty of the Swiss mountains.The top notes are fresh like a breeze from treeless mountain summits: rough granite ground, the cool air from the glacier, and bitter alpine herbsThe heart notes are fresh, green with hints of spices. Floral delicacies such as the red Alpine lily bloom on lush meadows, powdery, spicy, green.The base notes are inspired by alpine forests on cliffy slopes: the woody warmth of timber, larch and beech, with the sweet amber perfume of dry earth in the sun. notes are inspired by alpine forests on cliffy slopes: the woody warmth of timber, larch and beech, with the sweet amber perfume of dry earth in the sun.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer L’Oudh Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: L'oudh is a fragrance that builds around a natural oudh essential oil from Laos. There is no olfactory pyramid as the fragrance is not composed around head, heart and body notes. L'oudh accord, with natural oudh and cypriol , to name two ingredients, is central to the fragrance.Unique.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 02 L’Air du Désert Marocain Eau de Toilette 50 ml
listings.description: Powerful, sensual and pure. Lying on the bed, watching the moon rising over the sandy hills of the Saharan desert, he dreamt the fragrance of a Moroccan night. A perfume that has become a classic. Enjoy it all year round: we love it especially in springtime.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 03 Lonestar Memories Eau de Toilette 50 ml
listings.description: An ode on birchtar: True and unique, rich and lasting The scent of a lonesome rider, wearing old jeans and leather jacket, after a long day on the horse in the dry woods, preparing his coffee on the open, smoky fire.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 05 Incense Extrême Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Minimalist, intense, clear. A perfume built around a natural CO2 extract of Boswellia serrata, aka incense; it captures the roughness of the climate of the semi desert where Boswellia trees thrives. It is translucent like the first whiff of incense smoke from Boswellia resin on red gleaming coal. Yet, it is crisp like a night in the desert.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 06 Incense Rosé Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Vibrant, rich, mysterious. Incense rosé is an elegant oriental fragrance, imagine a flying oriental carpet with floating rose petals, passing through smoking frankincense, sprinkled rose and citrus notes, and landing on dark balsamic resins.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 09 Orange Star Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fresh take on citrus. Discover a rich citrus fragrance with a clean orange flower in its heart, and a soft elegant base that seems to last forever. The fresh citrus notes bloom the nicest in springtime. Enjoy!

listings.rawTitle: Tauer PHI Une Rose de Kandahar Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Une rose de Kandahar is part of the Collectibles lines."We try to produce it as regularly as we can, but due to the rare rose oil from Afghanistan that is hard to source we cannot guarantee that it is available all the time."Phi is a luxurious scent, inspired by a natural extract of roses produced in Afghanistan's rose region, Nangarhar. This rose oil is extremely rare and of highest quality. Inspired by these roses, growing in a dry and rough land, Phi is a rare gem, complementing contrasting lines, rich in natural raw materials that add depth and authenticity.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Phtaloblue Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Surrender to an eau de parfum encapsulating the nativeness and briskness of a day at the sea. Phtaloblue is fresh and bright with elegant citrus and herbaceous notes , and at the same time rich and deep with balsamic woody and floral accords. Phtaloblue will accompanying you through your day redefining the aquatic genre.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Sundowner Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Surrender to the darkness of the night with a boozy cocktail and a good dose of velvet smoky happiness with the last sun on your cheeks. And here some ingredients that actually make a difference and render Sundowner a harmonious experience: tobacco absolute, cocoa abs and patchouli essential oil, rose absolute and orange peel oil. These naturals, together with bergamot oil and cinnamon essential oil, make up more than 30% of the composition. Inspiration: The eau de parfum came by awe-inspiring moments when the sun reaches the horizon. Imagine sitting on the terrace on Elephantine Island in the middle of the river Nile near Aswan, enjoying the warmth of the evening sun, with your cocktail glass bursting in orange glitter. There is tobacco in the air. The sun disappears behind the horizon and the air is freshening up with cozy woody sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Abraj Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Strong and powerful like the steel and concrete that builds the iconic Dubai skyline. Dubai Abraj is a symphony of strength, innovation and modernity. A bold combination of energetic bergamot and lavender that is offset by mysterious red rose, geranium, patchouli, sandal and woody notes.The fragrance is held in a glass bottle with an embellished window to the bottle, akin to the skyscrapers of glass and metal, and with a bejeweled silver cap. The bottle is slipped into a titanium leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Ajyal Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: AJYAL is an aromatic ode to generations past, present, and future, inspired by the Ghaf, the tree symbolizing fortitude that stands majestic and unwavering in the aridity of the desert.The bottle is decorated with a yellow and blue tapestry that recalls the eternal dance of day and night and pays homage to the radiant embrace of the sun.With each note Dubai Ajyal tells the stories of resilience and optimism that run through the veins of this legendary land, inviting everyone to join in its fragrant symphony.Ajyal captures the positive spirit of past, present and future generations to evoke optimism, energy and joy. It opens with fresh notes of bergamot and plum that lead to a heart of delicate cherry blossom and lavender, then settles to a base of cedarwood and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Bahar Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The deep notes of vanilla, amber, rose and jasmine mirror the depths of the seas, while the lighter notes of lime, lemon, marine and aquatic notes are reminiscent of its cool breeze. This aquatic-woody scent awakens you to wonder and possibility.The fragrance is held in a glass bottle that mirrors the tranquility of the ocean, pristine white in colour and carved to emulate the rolling of the waves. The bottle is slipped into a white leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Diwan Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Welcome to the Diwan. The scent of Bakhoor emanates from the Mabkhara, greeting you as you enter. This is the famed royal hospitality of Dubai.You feel welcome at the Diwan where incense and Ubar Luban play the soft notes to the dominant scents of coffee with the moderating influence of frankincense signifying openness and harmony.. Diwan is showcased in a lacquered wooden display case that opens up to reveal the fragrance inside. Each display case holds the Second Generation story in a drawer at the bottom. Diwan holds court in a deep maroon display case with a contrasting gold monogram pattern.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Fakhama Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dubai Fakhama encapsulates all that is luxurious. A mesmerizing fragrance that blends the finest selection of roses; including Turkish rose and Bulgarian rose. Roses are one of the most beautiful and praised flowers, valued for centuries and this fragrance is blended with oud, rich vanilla and vetiver, an aphrodisiac which lends a gourmand aroma. Then completed by the base notes of amber, incense, leather and oakmoss.The fragrance is held in a glass bottle and is adorned with crystals, and is true opulence. A bejeweled metallic black cap accentuates the lavish luxury of Fakhama. The bottle is slipped into a black leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Majalis Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The mingling fragrances of heady qahwa (Arabic coffee) and dates mixed with heavenly royal pure rose Taif, cardamom, musk bring to life the rich and full-bodied scent of Dubai Majalis. Rich like the feel of Persian rugs and intricate patterns, Dubai Majalis is the flying carpet to take you on a sensory journey of Arabian hospitality. A truly unique and breakthrough fragrance.The fragrance is held in a glass bottle with an embellished handwoven carpet on the bottle, with textured metal decor resembling the majalis, and with a bejewelled matte rose gold cap. The bottle is slipped into a bordeaux leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Meydan Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dubai Meydan is a leathery oriental fragrance inspired by the nobility of the Arabian stallion and the royal green fields of the playground. The exhilarating fragrance of Dubai Meydan is a symphony of grapefruit and bergamot top notes, with middle notes of tobacco, agarwood and cedarwood with romantic undertones of leather and vetiver.The fragrance is held in a regal green leather with a striking golden embellishment of a horse-shoe, an accessory typical to the horses of Arabia that gallop majestically across the playground. The bottle is slipped into a green leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Oud Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that talks about mankind’s achievement, and the strength of his ambition. A mystical blend of incense, fresh woody, orchid, lily of the valley, rose, leathery, tobacco and pure natural Indian agarwood, this scent is a reflection of the orient.The fragrance is held in an elegant bottle with a sheath of fine wood, with embellishments in brown, and a bejewelled cap, that mirrors the woody fragrance. The bottle is slipped into a brown leather finish pouch and held within a cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Rimal Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: There is a certain magic that reigns among the dunes. You can feel it in the air. The warm notes of saffron, cinnamon, incense, leather, labdanum and agarwood overwhelm you, while the floral notes of rose and ylang-ylang seduce you.The fragrance is housed in a glass bottle with a warm gold accessory representing the glittering sands of the desert, with gold embellishments and a jeweled gold cap. The bottle is placed in a bag with a golden leather finish and kept in a box with a padded frame.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Roeya Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Your window to tomorrow's world is a potent mix of elegant notes that ups the ante on your vision of the future. Think top notes like neroli, cashmeran and mandarin, with oud, ambergris, ambrette and fir at the base. Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac are a few of the lilting middle notes that play with the senses. Always one step ahead of the curve, the progression of the scent - all at once, woody, spicy, floral, ambery - is inspired by the sands of time.This fragrance comes enveloped in a joyous orange band punctuated with windows into a glass bottle and crowned with a cover of carved chrome. This glass bottle shines with Arabic calligraphy that speaks of Roeya in an artful geometric pattern. Housed in a futuristic orange pouch, the bottle is held within an enigmatic orange cushioned frame box.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Turath Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: As you travel across the land, it’s ancient culture seeps into you, enriching you with the poetic beauty of the Mu’allaqat, the narrative splendour of the One Thousand and One Nights and the enchanting flavours of Arabian cuisine. The fragrance is the pristine essence of bergamot, rose damascene, jasmine and vanilla blended with the earthy flavours of patchouli and leather, enhanced with the mesmerizing scents of ambergris and smoky notes.The fragrance is presented in an exquisitely-designed bottle portraying the tapestry of tradition and crowned with an elegant bejewelled gold metallic cap intricately embossed with the patterned logo of the House of Nabeel. The bottle is housed in a pouch crafted from blue leather, placed inside a blue leather box showcasing a gold-brushed frame.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Abbrivio Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The term “abbrivio” in the world of boating refers to the inertial motion of a boat. When a boat begins to move, its engines must first overcome an immense inertia generated by the weight and shape of the boat itself, immersed in the water. Let’s imagine the sails of Telea unfurling, inflating and pulling the mast fixed to its deck, thanks to the maximum wind power, but in moments that sometimes seem eternal, nothing happens, and the boat remains still. Then, suddenly, and with its own time, not controlled by man, the boat generates movement. This thrust is the abbrivio: difficult to initiate, but almost unstoppable once it starts. There is increasing and decreasing abbrivio, both forces coming from the same mother, and with which the good sailor must reckon to navigate safely. Abbrivio is a magic of motion that has always fascinated sailors for its beauty, never fully revealed and evolving each time, capricious depending on the meteorological and marine conditions.Every boat has its own soul and therefore its own abbrivio, which can never be the same as any other. A kind of unique, inimitable fingerprint, just as the creation it inspires is unique and inimitable. This magical, unpredictable, mysterious, and inexplicable force is fully contained in the bottle of the “Stelle Marine” Collection. Just like the unstoppable force of abbrivio, controllable only by expert hands, this creation reveals itself to the deep connoisseurs of the art of perfumery.Abbrivio opens with a fresh, sparkling fruity bouquet, thanks to the effusion of Brazilian Orange with Black Currant from the Dolomites and Romagna Strawberry, enhanced by the aromatic scent of Mediterranean Santolina. The unpredictable, evolving top notes settle into an even more excited and untamed heart where, from the start, the seductive force of Grey Amber is felt, combined with the contrast of Coumarin and Adriatic Seaweed, softened by the smoothness of Amazonian Tonka Bean and Cuban Cane Sugar. The base of this mysterious creation takes deep roots in the assertive notes of Atlas Cedar and Singapore Patchouli, reinforced by the royal presence of Tuscan Oak and Australian Sandalwood, then enhanced by the seductive combination of Romanian Oak Moss and Musk. Abbrivio contains the mysterious force of movement generated by dark forces that reverberate in the splash of water like magical effluents capable of seducing and captivating those who are not afraid to venture into the coral blue of life.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Adhil Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The second fragrance in the Assoluto collection is Adhil, a renowned star in the Andromeda constellation. The stylistic and creative principle is always based on the extreme, almost tightrope-walking pursuit of exploring the boundaries of Andromeda and its continuous evolutions, in order to create a new, original, and unique composition, crafted with raw materials as rare as they are precious. The balance of tensions felt in this creation is breathtaking, like a warm summer evening breeze. The dissonant yet harmonious blend of royal jasmine with star anise opens the door to the imagination for those who possess the mad wisdom to wear this nectar, echoing dreamlike evocations, supported by the strength of sandalwood, oakmoss, and the lingering resonance of heliotrope and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Afrodite Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation was inspired by a wonderful Mediterranean landscape, surrounded by white beaches and tall cliffs that plunge into the transparent and foamy waters of the sea on the island of Cyprus, where the myth of the goddess Aphrodite originates. The beautiful goddess represents the wild and unstoppable power of love, passion, and seduction, capable of uniting in a deep embrace elements of different natures, such as man and woman, strength and gentleness, passion and sweetness, able to captivate and lead hearts to the most unrestrained and unspoken feelings.Camped around a large bonfire, on the plateau next to the ruins of Paphos where Aphrodite first appeared, we find ourselves before an expanse of crystalline and deep blue sea, surrounded by the seductive and intoxicating scents of a lush and wild nature, as alluring and captivating as the beautiful Aphrodite. Our minds are captivated by such wonder, and our senses are carried away, almost in ecstasy, by the lively sound of wood crackling in the fire.The creation opens with a spicy floral fragrance, with a hypnotic and mysterious touch. The Lilac flower embraces pink peppercorn, then softly settles into the strong sweetness of Vanilla Berries, accentuated by White Peach and White Currant. This bouquet immediately captivates and leads into the most hidden place of one’s self, where an ancestral and primitive strength is rediscovered, firmly rooted in the opulence of magical and enchanting flowers like Tuberose Absolute, contrasted with Neroli and Iris, sweetened by Lily of the Valley and Geranium that wrap the precious pheromone of seduction. A subtle yet powerful weapon capable of ruling the heart of those around us. The fragrance is grounded on a robust base of woods, with Patchouli reigning as a powerful aphrodisiac and Ebony, softened by the delicacy of Sandalwood and White Musk, highlighted by the sweat note of Ambergris that releases a powerful love pheromone. The instinct for seductive charm is enclosed in this precious extract of oblivion and ecstasy.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Akragas Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation was born from the moving inspiration during a long journey in Italy, searching for the scent of salt and its infinite facets. The beautiful country is surrounded by the sea, rich with precious salt, and this element has always fostered the development of civilizations. Salt has many facets and is not only derived from sea evaporation but also extracted from the famous salt mines, of which Sicily is particularly rich.Akragas was the ancient name of the present-day Agrigento, a famous city in southern Sicily, enchanting for its natural beauty and the stunning Valley of the Temples, an invaluable heritage admired since the times of Magna Graecia, perfectly preserved to this day. The Greek poet Pindar referred to Agrakas as the "most beautiful city in the world," and it is to this breathtaking beauty that this creation is inspired.Agrigento, in its long history, has known the influences of various peoples, from the Magna Grecians to the Carthaginians, from the Arabs to the Normans, gathering all the cultural facets capable of coexisting in harmony and serenity, offering us a beauty that teaches us all. Akragas aims to tell the story of this crossroads of cultures and wonders through the salt from its most famous mine, immersed in Mediterranean scrubland and enchanting landscapes.The creation opens with a pungent bouquet that immediately evokes the Mediterranean scrub, where we notice the Myrtle of Sicily and Mediterranean Seaweed, intensely embraced by the typical citrus fruits of the island, with the royal Grapefruit and the unmistakable softness of Neroli standing out. This head settles on a heart as strong as the Sicilian land, robust and generous, where the Salt from the Agrigento Mine becomes the dominant and resonating note, enhanced by Atlas Cedar, strongly aromatic with Red Thyme and Bulgarian Geranium. The entire creation is based on a powerful and aromatic base, capable of echoing the breezes of the Sicilian sea, thanks to Benzoin, carried by Musk, in contrast to Singapore Patchouli and Madagascar Vanilla Berries. The spirit of the wonder of the Girgenti lands in a drop of salty and fascinating perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Al Contrario Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Tiziana Terenzi collection has always been inspired by journeys and experiences lived around the fire. The beautiful and powerful moment when the soul stops, as if suspended, and approaches the absolute to capture the moment of wonder. Distant places experienced with the spirit of the traveler in search of inner growth. Each stop is a moment to climb a new step of the ladder of knowledge that leads to wisdom and true richness.Al Contrario tells the return journey from these paths, one of the most beautiful and intimate moments for the traveler: the nostalgic moment for the beauties that have been left behind, while at the same time full of eager emotion for the loved ones who will be waiting at the hearth of the home, the crackling fire awaiting them. As you get closer to home, slowly, the places become familiar and friendly. In the distance, the green hills appear, with their gentle slopes. The plants, the cultivated fields, and the fruits that this wonderful place knows how to offer. You recognize the tree you climbed as a child and the old farmhouse with dim lights from the half-open windows. After the curve, suddenly, the sea greets you with its gentle lapping. Finally home, finally love, and the fire in the hearth warms the heart and rhythmically tells the story of the adventure that has just ended.An intimate fragrance, just like the feeling of the wanderer returning. A fragrance dedicated to those who truly understand the essence of travel and life. It’s not for everyone to know how to return, just as this precious essence is not for everyone, created with the delicate balance, almost nostalgic feeling of „saudade,“ between the sweetness of vanilla and the counterpoint of malt and cocoa seeds. Light yet deep, reflected in the captivating presence of precious woods like ebony, which form its roots. A journey of the one who returns, and is again ready to embark on the path that life offers us every day in its everyday wonder.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Alioth Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The stylistic exploration at the boundaries of artistic perfumery by Tiziana and Paolo continues, pushing the horizon into spaces never before explored by the alchemy of emotion. The journey leads to the Ursa constellation, traversing its olfactory pyramid, deconstructing and expanding it to unveil new, thrilling sensory vibrations. A path rich in discoveries and precious pauses, guided by the trail of the now-unfindable oils from the Terenzi library, with over 50 years of distillation. Precious raw materials, as valuable as an absolute.The brightest star in the Ursa Major constellation is called Alioth, shining brilliantly in the sky. This magnificent celestial body, four times the size of the sun, radiates its intense and luminous light into the infinite cosmos and has inspired the creation that enriches the *Stelle di Luna Assoluto* collection. Following the most extreme innovative research yet deeply rooted in the oldest and most precious perfumery tradition, the creative genius of Tiziana and Paolo has given birth to a new star in the firmament of beauty. Thanks to the masterful use of extraordinarily rare raw materials, now impossible to find and priceless, this creation shines brightly, ready to captivate from the very first breath of life.The composition opens with delicate hints of rare spices, preserved for decades in the Terenzi library. Leading the way is the precious Saffron from Sardinia, considered the finest in the world, contrasted by the freshness of black and green Pepper, softened by the caress of Cardamom. At the heart of the fragrance pulses a radiant essence, patiently matured for over fifty years: the Absolute of Bulgarian Rose, requiring 1,000 petals to extract a single drop of this nectar—one of the most aphrodisiac scents on the planet—wrapped in the sensual echoes of Ylang-Ylang, sustained by the mysterious power of Cypriol from Rhodes. This opulent and sensual heart plunges into an eternal embrace, lingering on the skin: the precious Oud from India blended with that from the forests of Cambodia, harmonized with Madagascar Vanilla, intensified by Ambergris and Musk aged for over 50 years.Alioth is a creation that encapsulates the expertise of three generations of Italian perfumers, crafted from natural raw materials of inestimable value, as they are now unique and impossible to find. An exclusive luxury, reserved for a select few who can fully appreciate the beauty of being absolutely and irreversibly one of a kind.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Andromeda Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: We first encountered Andromeda, wrapped in Her infinite beauty thanks to the trail of bright and fascinating stars, during a trek in the Sibillini Mountains, located in a little-known area of our beautiful country, but no less captivating for that, in search of a natural and spontaneous event that can be considered a true miracle of Mother Nature. In fact, on these silent mountains, every year there is a ritual that seems almost supernatural: the blooming. Between late May and the first days of July, the Castelluccio plateau witnesses this particularly important event. For several weeks, the chromatic monotony of the pasture is broken by a mosaic of colors, with variations of shades ranging from ochre yellow to red. Although the "Fiorita" festival takes place on the third and last Sunday of June, there is no exact day to admire this enchanting spectacle. Every year, everything is dependent on the climatic trends of the season, and one must know how to search for it because, like our perfume, it is not revealed to everyone.The floral species that tint the Pian Grande and Pian Perduto during this period are countless. Walking along the trails, we can encounter: gentian, daffodils, violets, poppies, buttercups, asphodels, Eugeniae violets, clovers, sorrels, and much more. During this walking journey along the trails of Pian Perduto, in the utmost silence, respectful of the surrounding lush nature, one becomes intoxicated with scents and colors that fill not only the eyes but also the heart and soul. During the summer nights, at the Spartan camp around a crackling bonfire, the gaze drifts far away through that glowing red fire, and with it, the soul begins a flight towards a vast sky, full of twinkling stars.A citrusy and fresh bouquet releases effervescent fragrances counterpointed by Ylang Ylang and Water Jasmine. A delicate freshness sensation wraps you and accompanies you throughout the day. A fragrance with a reserved personality, yet at the same time decisive, ignited by the memory of pear nectar and White Heliotrope, then enveloped by the sweetness of powdered sugar, cocoa, and milk. The strength of these places is enclosed in this precious vial of nectar from a dream to relive every time it is worn.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Andromeda Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with the regenerative caress of nature. Keratin is a crucial molecule for healthy hair with regenerative properties, but being of animal origin, it poses objective environmental sustainability concerns. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is one of the core drivers behind every strategic decision, as all our commercial actions are rooted in eco-sustainability and social responsibility. This led our research into previously unexplored territory in search of plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, capable of delivering the same benefits as animal keratin—without harming the planet. The discovery was astonishing: not only did we find plant-based keratin, but scientific studies and certified lab tests proved that this rare and valuable plant molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than its animal counterpart.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Arethusa Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The most carefree and joyful stop on this incredible journey is the beautiful Sicily, where History, Art, and Nature intertwine in an enchanting sea of emotions. Wild beaches, ancient ruins, squares surrounded by baroque palaces frame this Mediterranean place that embodies one of the most mysterious and at the same time oldest Italian beauties.In the precious perfume extract are encapsulated all the vibrant sounds of Sicily. You will find the delicious fruits paired with wild flowers with sublime fragrances, then reverberating into the fragrant woods of Mediterranean shrub plants, harmoniously contrasted with the spices surrounding Syracuse and the beautiful island of Ortigia.This creation was a journey to the origin, but immediately after, thinking about it, it was a vertigo of dreams that characterizes the graceful spirit of a cool midsummer night, in front of a bonfire by the sea, singing and playing the guitar with travel companions and with those we always carry in our hearts even if physically far away.Aretusa is a character from Greek mythology, daughter of Nereus and Doris. The god Alpheus, son of the god Ocean, fell in love with her while spying on her as she bathed naked. However, Aretusa escaped his advances, fleeing to the island of Ortigia, in Syracuse, where the goddess Artemis transformed her into a spring. Zeus, moved by Alpheus' pain, turned him into a river, allowing him, from the Peloponnese in Greece, to travel all the way across the Ionian Sea to reunite with his beloved spring. The myth still lives today on the island of Ortigia thanks to the so-called Aretusa Fountain, a body of water that flows into the Porto Grande of Syracuse.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Arrakis Attar 13 ml
listings.description: The final result is an exclusive, water-based Terenzi formula with natural molecules, offering your hair a delicately perfumed wellness treatment that is also ideal for the most delicate and luxurious fabrics. Thanks to its special formula containing Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff agents, it keeps hair beautifully scented while nourishing it with new, sustainable natural ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens hair (clinical studies show an 85% increase in resistance) and improves elasticity (with an 8% boost), while the anti-dandruff component significantly reduces flaking and prevents unsightly scalp residue on clothing. Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is a true revolution in hair wellness: with each application, your hair is enveloped in a fragrance of extraordinary intensity and projection, while receiving a revitalizing, regenerative treatment that helps prevent dandruff formation.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Arrakis Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The journey continues through the stars of the constellations that define the journey of memory for Paolo and Tiziana. Drops of emotion encapsulated in the Luna collection that expands into the deepest cosmos, meeting the brightest and most remote stars, exploring new frontiers in artistic perfumery, chasing the dream of Icarus, transforming childhood fantasies into feathered wings.Arrakis is a binary star in the constellation of Draco, inspiring the exploration of the luminous variables of the same olfactory pyramid, gifting us new light and unpredictable emotions. Like the star that inspires it, composed of two opposing and equal stars, this fragrance has two souls with contrasting intensities that can only be revealed to the most profound connoisseurs and experts.The creation opens with an explosion of precious and refined citrus fruits, where the powerful grapefruit from the Conca d’Oro of Sicily resonates. A precious fruit that grows on a tree called the "tree of paradise" for its exclusive and rare properties. Echoing this essence, we find other citrus fruits like Calabria Bergamot and Sorrento lemon, precious molecules from the exclusive Terenzi library. The citrus soul embraces the herbs with an earthy tone, where we recognize the wild spirit of Thyme and Rosemary, softened by the notes of Osmanthus flower from Japan and Yellow Saffron from Sicily. The head leaps into a warm exotic embrace, where the precious Vetiver from Tahiti emphasizes the notes of Virginia Tobacco, leaving its trace pushed by Red Indian Patchouli woods and Guaiac wood from the Antilles. The creation is based on a vertigo of woods and oriental notes capable of providing an incredible persistence to the citrus top notes. Here we sense the Tonka Bean from Mato Grosso, Brazil, paired with Ambergris and Musk, which blends with the intense and powerful strength of Cambodian Oudh. Arrakis is a fragrance with unexpected light and dark contrasts and a seductive strength that will not let you go unnoticed, thanks to its intense projection in a starry trail.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Atlantis is a legendary and mysterious island, the myth of which was first mentioned by Plato in his dialogues Timaeus (17-27) and Critias, in the 4th century BC. According to Plato's account, Atlantis was a naval power located "beyond the Pillars of Hercules" and sank "in a single day and night of misfortune" due to Poseidon's intervention. For centuries, this legend has nourished the imagination of men, representing the marvelous and mysterious things lost, but for us, the discovery of Atlantis also represents the longest journey and the most fascinating adventure one can undertake: the journey into our deepest and submerged self.Diving into the most primal and animalistic emotions, into the irrational part of our being of which we are unaware, in the place where scents live and express themselves in their magical language. The discovery and acceptance of our submerged self is a challenge to be faced in our mature age when we have the courage to dive into new experiences, to listen without fear to the voice of our inner world, to meet our deepest shadows and lights. Do not be afraid, listen to the enchanting song of the sirens because, according to Cicero, this song in the Homeric epic is a promise of knowledge: Odysseus was not attracted to the sweetness of their sound, but by the insatiable desire to learn.Dive into the salty water, listen to your skin and let your sense of smell guide you to communicate with your deepest and unknown self. You will find the way if you first have the courage to get lost. “Make the unconscious conscious, or it will direct your life and you will call it fate” – Carl Gustav Jung.The fragrance opens with sparkling and seductive notes, the wonderful Bergamot from Calabria, also called green gold, gives this first impression a strong Italian identity. The ancient rose accompanies it, enriching it with intense and elegant scents, complemented by the soft and sweet embrace of passion fruit. The heart warms in sophisticated seduction with the captivating aroma of Narcissus, which enhances the power of the flower of sin with its carnal and intoxicating trail, the unmistakable and hypnotic aroma of tuberose. In the Renaissance, young girls were forbidden to smell its narcotic fragrance so as not to “fall into temptation.” A similar prohibition was also applied in India, where its name ki rani means “courtesan of the night,” as this flower emits its scent after sunset and it was believed that its fragrance could plunge one into a sentimental oblivion from which it was impossible to escape. This beautiful tuberose, queen of the meadows, is the most exquisite we have encountered in many years of work, and “...its fragrance, like vital beats, seems to ignite the magnetic ardor of dormant love.” – Mark André Raffalovic. The warm, sun-filled fruits accompany this conscious vertigo of the senses, sustained and harmonized by a rich base of Musk combined with the gentle power of Ambergris and the warm sweetness of Benzoin.This wonderful fragrance is contained in a symbolic bottle, on which a marine creature wraps itself, crafted using the ancient goldsmith technique of granulation, which, when touched, gives a tactile pleasure to the fingertips and can only be conquered by immersing oneself in salty water. A sensory experience that preludes the joy of a sweet surrender to the most mysterious and powerful carnal pleasure: that of our mind.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Bianco Puro Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This magical creation originates from a magical place, deeply rooted in the oldest tradition of the Bel Paese and its wonderful coasts. Tropea is one of Italy's most beautiful places, and the town is perched on a pure white rock that characterizes the entire landscape. The beaches with their dazzling white sand mirror the azure and crystal-clear sea, varied by the thousand hues of the sky. The reflection of the sun on the white sands and the large rock Tropea rests on paints the entire landscape in a Pure White that takes the breath away from the traveler, especially when reaching the city by sea.Tiziana and Paolo, on one of their sailing trips with the family boat, along with Grandpa Guglielmo and Father Evelino, find themselves sailing in the deep south of the Mediterranean, among the Aeolian Islands, where the famous Stromboli Volcano island predominates. On this occasion, they encountered for the first time this coast, known since ancient times for its divine and hypnotic beauty, called the Costa degli Dei, because of the purity and intensity of the white that each corner is composed of, known as Pure White. During a night bonfire on the beach, under the spell of a white moon, the city of Tropea appears in its enchanting and wild beauty. From the beach, you can admire its wonderful architecture created by the joining hand of nature and man, where huge rocks and dazzling white sand support white buildings and houses, beneath a cobalt blue sky full of stars. In the distance, Stromboli Volcano makes its dominating presence felt with tremors and rumblings.With the same mysterious and unreal atmosphere of the place, this creation reveals itself exclusively to those capable of understanding its absolute and acrobatic power. The creation opens with an unusual yet powerful citrus bouquet. Immediately, the intense and delicate effusions of the typical citrus fruits from southern Italy are felt, with the famous clementine mandarin and the precious bergamot of Calabria embraced by the singular Sorrento lemon. This heady and effervescent start rests on an opulent and hypnotic bed of precious spices and exotic fruits, where the soft "sounds" of cloves and saffron clearly echo, counterpointed by the "hesperides" notes of Italian lavender and the sweetness of caramel paired with the unusual and juicy orange mango. The base of this creation embeds itself firmly in the heart with incredible strength, becoming the heart and soul of the fragrance itself, like a never-before-experienced perfumery catharsis. A complex symphony of rare and precious woods resonates in unison to generate a power never before felt, where we clearly discover red patchouli and brown sandalwood from distant India, paired with Tahitian vetiver. These precious woods are embraced in turn by the rare and unmistakable Black Oud from Cambodia. The original wood symphony, able to support the entire pyramid by itself because of how strong and precious they are, is emphasized by the royal strength of Myrrh and softened by the gourmet delicacy of vanilla berries, enhanced by the subtle power of Musk.Tradition tells us that once the Pure White of Tropea is known, the experience of colors will never be the same again, just as the world of perfumes will never be the same once the effusion of this precious and exclusive creation is experienced: the essence that defines the scent of white!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Bigia Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation comes from the creativity of Grandpa Gumìn and is dedicated to Donna Luigia, his beloved wife. Through it, he wants to celebrate the woman with whom he founded Cereria Terenzi in 1968, and in it, he tells the wonder of her powerful, sweet, and strong personality through a unique essence like hers!Bigia, as Grandpa lovingly called her, knew how to infuse strength, serenity, and confidence in life into every person. She had the gift of making anyone who was near her feel safe, for she had a big heart and a generosity that is not of this world.Today, Bigia Anniversary, born from a classic family recipe, explores new boundaries with the addition of innovative molecules, taking a step towards the artistic reinterpretation of a timeless classic. Saffron rests on a bed of white oud macerated for 20 years with Bulgarian rose absolute, giving the creation a magical, sensual touch with extraordinary lasting power. The precious ambers chase the fruity notes of our beautiful Italy, embraced in the heart of wild flowers.As with all the perfumes in the collection, this extract is also unisex. A refined and highly valuable composition with supreme quality ingredients. A fragrance with a royal and timeless touch, inspired by the aristocratic tradition of Italian luxury perfumery, where precious and rare musky notes echo, with strong contrasts of supreme quality rose absolute. The regal and precious fragrance that was once used only for grand occasions and the most important ceremonies, around great bonfires like at weddings and illuminated firework displays of gala parties. Today, it becomes an innovative and defining fragrance, dedicated to those who love to stand out in the utmost subtle elegance, with incomparable class and style, for those who don’t need loud appearances to be noticed, because their unique and inimitable fragrance trail speaks for them.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Borea Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation comes from the memory of a journey to one of Italy's most romantic and flowery cities, Sanremo, famous for its wonderful climate and the breezes of its generous Sea overlooking the Gulf of Tigullio, where it is beautiful to lose oneself in front of such infinite blue. The beautiful city of Flowers, as it is nicknamed, is surrounded by many terraces used to cultivate all known species of flowers, such as jasmine, magnolia, lily of the valley, freesia, roses of various species, and the precious white tuberose, absolutely precious and almost unique. The magical city is surrounded by very high mountains called Maritime Alps, capable of giving a special climate to the place and enclosing the beauty of the immensity of the high peaks and the vastness of the sea.Sanremo is also known for several villas with extravagant and unique architecture, with Italian gardens full of opulent, rare, and fragrant flowers. Precious hedges form love labyrinths where effluents of seduction echo in the air. Among them, one villa, the most beautiful and magical, is called Borea, a magnificent and royal construction, with a garden full of rare and precious flowers, where there is an enchanted labyrinth. Venturing into the path of this labyrinth, following the fascinating olfactory paths, illuminated by blazing bonfires of glowing wood, cleverly placed to confuse the distracted traveler but to assist the experienced cosmonaut, one is captured in a powerful whirlwind, where the seduction of the perfumes leads to ecstasy, without leaving any way out for those who walk through it.The head opens with unusual and bizarre notes, just like the brilliant mind that designed these gardens, where the exotic sweetness of coconut resonates, accompanied by pear combined with juicy plum, in contrast to the gentle bitterness of almond. The unique and innovative head rests on a bed made of millions of precious flower petals, just like in the Garden of Eden. The heart is indeed the true essence of this creation, where the sweetness and hypnotic seduction of jasmine marry with the irresistible attraction of tuberose, enriched by the strength of the bouquet led by freesia and musk rose, in contrast with lily of the valley, black magnolia, which only blooms once every two years, and white iris. The entire creation is supported by solid foundations ensuring bases on precious woods, including Indian sandalwood and oak moss; however, sweetened by the delicacy of vanilla, emphasized by the deafening silence of Musk.Borea is a one-way journey into an enchanted labyrinth that will leave no escape for those who wish to wear it, but above all, it will transform those who wear it into an unforgettable presence, just as a stop in Sanremo, the land of flowers, music, and love, is unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Borelli Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The intergalactic journey of Tiziana and Paolo continues in their quest to discover the celestial emotions born from magical stellar fires. Stars are luminous flames that shine across the celestial vault, illuminating our nights. Particularly fascinating and legendary are comets, capable of bringing gifts of joy, hope, and fortune to humanity—to those who have the eyes to see them.This wonderful creation is inspired by the famous Borelli Comet, a celestial body composed mainly of ice and stardust, traveling through our solar system in an elliptical orbit. Its most distinctive feature is its luminous tail, which increases in intensity and iridescence as it nears the Sun during its journey. Its asymmetrical shape enhances its beauty even further, with a periodic passage that varies over time due to the gravitational influence of Jupiter on its orbit. This makes the comet’s journey even more mysterious and its next appearance unpredictable, but today, we can enjoy its magical influence through this creation! Comets have long been the subject of many legends, associated with extraordinary events and auspicious changes for humanity. In the same way, this creation radiates all its magic and power, emphasizing a positive energy and an irresistible charm to those who wear it.The fragrance opens with an elegant and seductive floral bouquet, accentuated by citrus notes. Alongside the Bergamot from Reggio Calabria and Sicilian Mandarin, we find the tropical vibration of Indian Frangipani, opulently enriched by the seductive power of natural citrus Aldehydes. This generous top note rests upon an equally rich and captivating heart, where hypnotic Mexican Tuberose embraces the alluring blend of Bulgarian Rose and Ylang-Ylang, enhanced by the lasting presence of Italian Violet and Lily of the Valley. The base of this magical seduction potion is built on delicate and precious woods, where Tuscan Birch and African Ebony immediately stand out, refined by the subtle aura of Musk, with echoes of Australian Sandalwood and Madagascan Vanilla. Borelli is the perfume of the Comet that will grant you the power of seduction and timeless elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cas Attar 13 ml
listings.description: The creation contained in this precious Bohemian crystal vial is named after the famous star known as Cas: "which means the divine hand." A star of variable intensity capable of emitting different light and hiding itself from distracted eyes, showing itself only in its full magnificence to the experienced explorers, to those with the soul to see and not just to look absentmindedly, to those who can project their inner self beyond appearances. Just like the star after which this precious essence is named, it reveals itself and illuminates only the true experts and lovers of the refined: the connoisseurs of unique and artistic perfumes.As in the stylistic project of the Attar, Paolo and Tiziana deconstructed the olfactory pyramid of the famous fragrance Cassiopea to search for new hyperboles in the journey towards infinite beauty, building new harmonic and stylistic balances of the molecules, in order to chart a new course in the search for beauty.Thus, we find a “variable” beauty of intensity, because it is a beauty that remains hidden until the fateful moment of its most powerful and luminous explosion; a beauty that reveals itself in the sensual dance reverberated by the own light that only it knows how to magically generate. The music starts softly, and the dance of spices begins slow, almost silent and light like a caress of the divine hand, guided by the regal character of black pepper stretched across a bed of pink pepper, enriched by the powerful counterpoint of the precious green pepper. A symphony in crescendo, unleashed by the thunderous echo of the spices now laid on the solid woods of Oud and Birch, amalgamated in counterpoints of sweetness and strength, thanks to the precise action of the vanilla berries and the olfactory power of grey amber and Musk.It takes a very refined and sensitive soul to fully understand the artistic construction of this creation, which reveals its full beauty only after days of careful observation!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cas Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the constellation Cassiopea comes Cas. A star of variable intensity, capable of emitting different light and hiding from distracted eyes, revealing itself only in its full magnificence to the experienced explorers, to those who have the soul to see and not just to look carelessly, to those who know how to project their inner self beyond appearances. Just like the star from which this precious essence takes its name, it too reveals itself and illuminates only the true experts and lovers of the refined: to the connoisseurs of unique and artistic perfumes.As happens in the stylistic project of the Attar, Paolo and Tiziana have deconstructed the olfactory pyramid of the famous fragrance Cassiopea, to seek new hyperboles in the journey towards infinite beauty, creating new harmonic and stylistic balances of molecules, in order to design a new route in the search for beauty. Thus, we find a “variable” beauty of intensity, because it is a beauty that remains hidden until the fateful moment of its most powerful and luminous explosion; a beauty that is revealed in the sensual dance reverberated by the light it can magically generate. The music starts softly, and the dance of spices begins slowly, almost silently and lightly like a caress of the divine hand, guided by the regal character of black pepper spread over a bed of pink pepper, enriched by the powerful counterpoint of the precious green pepper. A symphony in crescendo, unleashed by the roaring echo of spices now resting on solid woods of Oud and Birch, blended in counterpoints of sweetness and strength, thanks to the precise action of vanilla beans and the olfactory power of gray amber and Musk. It takes a very refined and sensitive soul to fully understand the artistic construction of this creation, which reveals itself in all its beauty only after days of careful observation!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Casanova Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The most romantic stop on this wonderful journey is Venice, where the fire of seduction still burns today in the chimneys of stunning 18th-century palaces, mysterious homes with an unchanging charm, frequented by the famous Casanova, whose presence can still be felt if one pays attention to the small signs. The memory of a winter evening trip to Venice during the famous Carnival, created by the inspiration of a mysterious and ethereal Muse, like the City of the Doges. A night intoxicated by the scents in the air, warmed by the effluvia of bonfires that light up the alleys and Piazza San Marco. A dance of sensory emotions, accompanied by a beautiful and mysterious Lady, with her face hidden by a precious golden mask, just like the bottle that encloses this precious and secret essence. Surrendering is the only defense against such seduction.This fragrance tells the story of places of beauty and seduction, through its complex and evolving structure, with guidance from the rare and precious grey amber. A subtle journey through the places of a city that inspires love and eroticism, through the paths described by Casanova in his memoirs: memories of romantic adventures set against the breathtaking backdrop of a city so ethereal, it seems suspended on water.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This composition stems from a journey to the paternal vacation home, where, accompanied by the whole family, Tiziana and I spent happy days running through the woods, listening to Grandpa’s stories about plants and flowers, playing at recognizing them by their scent. None of us at that time could have imagined that one day this game would become our passion and our “profession.”At the foot of Mount Catria lies a small village with 1000 souls called Frontone. The peace of the place is only interrupted by the thousand fragrances of flowers and plants surrounding the entire valley. Not far away is the Avellana Spring, a place of meditation and silence that gives the journey the spiritual flavor of seeking. Our little house was protected by the Castle of Frontone, a border fortification guarding the land that the Romans crossed to reach the Adriatic, and the last fortress of the Montefeltro Duchy in the 15th and 16th centuries. A place rich in history and wonders, in the midst of which we played happily. Climbing to the highest tower of the castle, set in a magnificent landscape, one could see the massive Monte Nerone all the way to the state of San Marino, while on the opposite side the view plunged into the blue of the Adriatic. After dinner, under the glow of a large, yellow moon, we played on the tower, illuminated by blazing braziers under a sparkling starry sky.Here then is the perfume extract with a bright and sparkling character that becomes timeless, just like the constellation that gives it its name. This ethereal and white essence, like the scorching midday that accompanies us between reality and fantasy, is almost magically able to release soft and light fragrances, thanks to its top notes characterized by Passion Fruit and Cassis, while being persistent and lasting thanks to the strength of the Melilotus flower, lily, and daffodil.This perfume is the tale of a dream that tells of a wonderful journey, on the wings of fantasy, of the eternal child who lives within us, lived on a warm summer night counting shooting stars. A flight to exotic and unknown places where magical beings live in enchanted, fragrant forests. Here then is the meeting with fairies and elves of bright colors and wonderful fragrances, gathered and fixed forever in this precious nectar of fantasy. A timeless perfume that never stops speaking of love and gratitude.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with the regenerative caress of nature. Keratin is a crucial molecule for healthy hair with regenerative properties, but being of animal origin, it poses objective environmental sustainability concerns. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is one of the core drivers behind every strategic decision, as all our commercial actions are rooted in eco-sustainability and social responsibility. This led our research into previously unexplored territory in search of plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, capable of delivering the same benefits as animal keratin—without harming the planet. The discovery was astonishing: not only did we find plant-based keratin, but scientific studies and certified lab tests proved that this rare and valuable plant molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than its animal counterpart.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Chi Extrait de Parfum 13 ml
listings.description: Paolo and Tiziana's intergalactic journey continues as they explore the stars that make up the constellations of the Luna collection. The journey around the beauty of artistic perfumery, in an expression capable of transforming beauty into wonder, through the reverberation of its original pyramid amplified towards brighter and shinier echoes of a new pyramid, also offering ample space to the art of layering.“Chi” is one of the brightest stars in the constellation of Ursa Major, from which the fragrance Ursa draws inspiration. A fragrance where we recognize a rare and precious acrobatic balance between Oudh and Vetiver, enriched with elegant elements typical of 1920s Italian perfumery.The fragrance opens with an unexpected sweet and gourmet bouquet, where the Guatemala coffee bean echoes with the Piemontese almond, contrasted with the scent of Turkish milk and caramel. This sweet and alluring top settles onto a sinuous heart, rich and powerful, capable of captivating with its robust fragility, where the sweetness of Haitian Vanilla Bean resonates, interwoven with Indian Patchouli, ready to bring forth the strength of Cambodian Oudh, contrasted for the first time with the rare white Alba truffle and its precious, generous earth. At the base of the composition, to guarantee an extraordinary and complex blend of precious woods, Indian Oudh serves as the main pillar of this innovative and irreverent creation, embraced by Cypress and Turkish Caramel, always rendered smooth and intriguing thanks to the aphrodisiac effects of Madagascar Tonka Bean, contrasted with Vanilla Flowers, also from Madagascar.“Chi” represents an adventurous journey in the acrobatic balance between some of the world’s most precious and rare olfactory elements. A creation that will leave no one indifferent, just like the mysterious star from which it takes its name and inspiration. “Chi” is the fragrance that will be recognized, for better or worse, because it is inimitable and unique, just like the white truffle it is made of.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Chi Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
