listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Chimaera Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This unforgettable journey begins by sailing in the Gulf of Fethiye, known in history as the "homeland of light and fire," stopping at an incredible and surreal stop in Olympos, where, from the belly of the mountain, enormous tongues of fire emerge, visible from the sea on warm summer nights. Like Phoenician sailors, carried by the Maltemi wind, we set course for the ruins of the Lycian Civilization, among pristine bays and hills covered in pines that descend to the sea, surrounded by slopes rich in thyme, sage, bay laurel, and the rare günlük, "incense trees" almost extinct, which scent the air in an explosion of essences and breathtaking colors.A fragrance of wild and lush nature, both sweet and warm, emphasized by the intense smell of melted caramel coming from the small mountain foot camps, where rest is sought before the climb. This fragrance reverberates strongly in the air and reflects in the blue of the sea, passing through the ruins of the ancient city until it reaches the lighthouse of Cape Gelidonya, which stands solitary in a place rich in history and legends. The tensions and attractions of this union of elements, fire and water, have been captured and trapped in a perfume extract made with the rarest and most precious natural raw materials. This unspoiled, rugged, and wild land contains all the splendor and power of the Mediterranean, which from its belly, like an ancient Greek deity, spits supernatural and magical fire, bringing the Chimera to life.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Chiron Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: One of the most imposing comets in our solar system is Chiron, the prototype of the centaur class, bright, flaming, and beautiful! Always surrounded by many mysteries, the comet Chiron carries with it, on every pass across the sky, its precious cargo of good fortune and positive influence. Precious gifts carried by the comet and left available to the world, suspended between heaven and earth in a magical place, destined only for those who have the soul to „listen“ to the fragrance and the eyes to „see“ the celestial music that emanates from it. Thanks to this disposition of the heart, it will be possible to cross the magical bridge that connects the world to the stars, gifting fortune and wonder to the bold and experienced explorers of beauty!This very connection, this „bridge“ that unites the worlds, inspired the creation of Paolo and Tiziana for the new Comet Chiron. A bridge between olfactory molecules capable of generating a luminous seduction, an enticing force, and at the same time an irresistible sweetness! An acrobatic intergalactic journey, through the seductive wonders of vanilla notes, both in berries and in flowers, embraced by the stimulating and seductive scents of the finest tobaccos, with „blonde“ and aromatic leaves.The creation opens with a seductive explosion of Haitian Vanilla Flowers, emphasized by the aphrodisiac strength of Musk and Tonka Bean. This powerful yet gentle head crosses a „bridge“ suspended on the leaves of luxurious and golden tobaccos, where Kentucky Tobacco and Virginia Tobacco dominate, supported by the alluring strength of magical Ambergris, an exclusive molecule from the Terenzi Brothers' library. A now distinctive and unique mark of the family tradition for three generations. The powerful and booming heart lands on a bed of Madagascar Vanilla Berries, sweet and comforting, just like a calm and well-protected harbor after a long journey across the ocean, enriched with the scents of precious woods like Indian Sandalwood, White Oudh, vigorous and fresh, and balsamic Palo Santo from Brazil.The Comet Chiron will bring as a gift a mysterious and elegant world, intense and deep, with aromatic and seductive echoes for those who can grasp its hidden secrets! A creation that will leave an indelible emotional mark on the hearts of those who listen to it, thanks to its sweet hypnotic power.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cubia Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In nautical jargon, the “eyes of Cubia” refer to the hole located in the bow area of the ship, through which both the anchor chain and the mooring ropes pass. Cubies have been present since ancient times, used by the Romans on “trabaccoli”, small sailing vessels used both for transporting people and for fishing in the upper Adriatic Sea. Around the cubies, the holes through which the anchor chains pass, concentric circles were painted, resembling the shape of eyes. These eyes were drawn on the bow of the boat because it was believed that eyes could guide the boat and navigation along the correct routes, avoiding traps and dangers. This tradition has been passed down over time to the present day.In the town of Cattolica, land of the sea, to remember and celebrate these ancient maritime traditions, the eyes of Cubia have become the emblem of the city. Cubia is an apotropaic symbol of good luck, to protect the vessel, wishing good fortune and prosperity to sailors. The creation, inspired by this ancient good luck charm, also contains the magical power of auspicious blessings. The opulent emotion of feeling happy, because by inhaling its scents, the full strength of the sweetness of protection from a supernatural hand that shields and pampers us is released.The fragrance opens with a bouquet of citrus fruits, where the Lemon from Sorrento and the Bergamot from Calabria echo, embraced by Brazilian Orange. This sparkling head rests on the sweet taste of Romagna Peaches, counterpointed by the pungent scent of Black Currant. The sweet and opulent composition is grounded in rare and precious woods, such as the famous Atlas Cedar from North Africa, embraced by the seductive strength of Indonesian Patchouli and Indian Sandalwood. The Cubia fragrance will envelop you in an aura of sweet protection, just like it does for the ships of our Sea.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Delox Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation is inspired by a sailing journey around the islands of the Greek Cyclades archipelago and contains in its bouquet all the colors and flavors of the southernmost and most authentic Mediterranean. The carefree summer, full of intoxicating scents carried in by the “Meltemi” (a typical wind in these latitudes), with its warm and sensual embrace, is magically captured in this fragrance inspired by the unspoiled and ancient beauty of the Mediterranean. The intense smell of coffee, prepared in the traditional “moka” (a typical coffee-making tool), spreads in the clear morning air, crossed by the shimmering light reflected on the sea, and immediately the gaze is drawn towards that endless blue, surrounded by fragrant plants and flowers, made even sweeter and more seductive by the distant glow of honey and sweet amber resin. Precious essences preserved in fine glass bottles, recalling the ancient grandeur of the island, still present through its famous ruins from the time of Apollo, where Odysseus landed during his epic adventures.The hypnotic strength of white hyacinth, combined with the opulence of royal iris and ecstasy rose, is enveloped by notes of oppopomax and roasted coffee, resting on precious notes of amber and powder, softened by honey notes. All of it is accentuated by the power of Lebanese cedarwood. It is beautiful to wake up wrapped in the wonder of discovery, following the footsteps of our past to see our future reflected in them.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Delox Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to scent your hair with nature’s regenerative touch. Keratin is a crucial molecule for the health of our hair, known for its regenerative properties, yet its animal origin poses objective environmental sustainability concerns. For Cereria Terenzi, environmental impact is a core principle in strategic decision-making, with all commercial activities guided by the philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility. This is why our research ventured into unexplored areas, discovering plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, offering the same benefits as animal keratin without harming the planet. Our discovery was astonishing: not only did we find plant-based keratin, but scientific studies and certified laboratory tests revealed that this rare botanical molecule is at least 20 times more potent and regenerative than animal-derived keratin. The final result is an exclusive Terenzi formula made from water and natural molecules that provides delicately scented wellness for your hair—also suitable for the finest and most delicate fabrics. Thanks to its special formula containing Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff, it keeps your hair fragranced while nourishing it with new natural, sustainable ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens the hair (clinical studies show an 85% increase in resistance) and enhances elasticity (+8%), while the anti-dandruff component significantly reduces flaking and prevents scalp residue from appearing on clothing. Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is a true revolution for the wellness of your hair: each application delivers a powerful, long-lasting scent while regenerating and protecting against dandruff.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Deriva Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the world of navigation, the term "Deriva" refers to the movement of a boat without a course, drifting at the mercy of the waves and currents. An uncontrolled movement, thus the loss of control over our will, without a clear destination, floating towards an unknown place. This journey, sometimes relaxed like on sunny days, without wind and in calm seas, or at other times impetuous and adrenaline-filled, amid the fury of the storm and waves, abandoned, almost happily resigned, to the mercy of external events, are the two faces of the same seductive coin that inspires the navigator and explorer to move away from the shore, leaving the safe harbor of their knowledge, to embark on a journey towards oblivion and wonder, through unknown adventures and challenges. The safe zones of what we know give way to the discovery of the mystery that both terrifies and attracts us.Imagine we are aboard our beloved "Telea" in the middle of the sea, in the deep blue, so far from the mainland that we can no longer see the coastline. With the naked eye, nothing appears around us. We are alone in the middle of the ocean when, suddenly, the wind completely stops and everything around us takes on an unreal calm. We have entered a calm patch and it is no longer possible to steer our boat. We no longer hear the creaking of the rigging fighting the force of the wind or the slapping of the hull cutting through the waves. Everything falls silent and takes on a new dimension; no muscle or thought can resist this oblivion. We drift slowly, indeed, allowing life to permeate our soul. Sometimes you need to surrender to life in order to fully live it, just as when drifting in the middle of the sea toward the unknown. This sensual surrender to the flow of events is contained in this perfume called Deriva, the emblem of losing oneself completely in the oblivion of our most secret and unconfessable passions.The creation opens with an acrobatic and mysterious chord, where aromatic notes intertwine with citrus notes. Here are the echoes of precious citrus fruits like Bergamot from Reggio Calabria and Lemon from Sorrento, paired with the counterpoint of Bulgarian Lavender and Zanzibar Cardamom, softened by the sugary smoothness of Brazilian Pineapple. This floating head surrenders to a seductive and exciting heart, where the echoes of flowers like Egyptian Geranium and Italian Gardenia mix silently with the aromatic notes of Peruvian Pink Pepper, accentuated by the rebellious spirit of Singapore Patchouli and the sour sweetness of Russian Raspberry. The entire creation is supported by a solid base, where the spicy aromatic foundations gain strength from the scent of Virginia Tobacco Leaves, mixed with the robust, aphrodisiac sweet echoes of Madagascar Vanilla Pods and Colombian Tonka Beans, emphasized by the reverberations of precious woods like Australian Sandalwood and Italian Rosewood. Deriva encapsulates in a precious drop of perfume the spirit of knowing how to lose oneself in the whirlwind of our passions and emotions, without fear or regret of getting lost in oblivion, because sometimes letting go without resistance is the only way to discover the great beauty of life, the essence of existence.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Dioniso Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This fragrance was born from a memorable journey to the Eternal City: Rome, the capital of the world since antiquity. A magical place that captures the heart in a whirlwind of emotions and scents, full of beauties and wonders that still take the breath away of the wandering visitor.On a warm late summer evening, walking on the millennia-old cobblestones of the Imperial Forums towards the Colosseum, enveloped in the intoxicating beauty of one of the world's oldest cities, rich in history and legends, we stumbled upon a group of actors sitting around a small bonfire. They were preparing a play dedicated to the mask of Dionysus, an enigmatic and alluring deity, irreverent and bold, capable of mocking any order and convention. Exuberant and beyond conventions, like this fragrance, it shook consciences, shattered principles and inhibitions, leading men, in a delirious whirlpool, back to their primordial state of purity. The essence of ecstasy, intoxication, and the liberation of the senses, as the perpetual engine of life and its flow, that is, existence understood in its absolute sense, the frantic current of life that permeates everything. Dionysus embodies both the masculine and feminine nature in its absolute sense, a contradiction and tension, blending both the divine and animalistic nature, both the tragic and comic spirit. A mystical delirium ignited by the primordial and instinctive spark present in every living being, sometimes dormant but never entirely suffocated in each of us. With this precious essence, that spark can become lightning and ignite the irrepressible spirit of life that dwells in us.The creation encapsulates this enigmatic spirit of absolution, emphasizing the contradictions expressed in the delirium of joy. It opens with a distinct and striking note of the rarest Ambergris, surrounded by ancient Musk that releases the precious pheromone of seduction, then smoothly and swiftly sliding towards the heart of the creation, a powerful tool of attraction, again accentuated by Ambergris softened by notes of Tahitian Vanilla and enriched by the hypnotic power of Jasmine and Lily of the Valley. The entire composition is based on powerful and seductive base notes as the only structure connected to its head by the relentless Ambergris combined with Musk, solidly linked to the precious Black Oud and Vanilla from Madagascar paired with the pheromone of attraction that will leave no escape for anyone who crosses your trail of seduction and joy. A collection of exclusive, priceless essences, limited to a few specimens per year, destined for connoisseurs of beauty and refinement, with a spirit ready to live the emotion of life with the courage of success and unmatched inner strength. A fragrance for a few privileged ones who know how to appreciate being unique and away from the usual patterns. A drop of liquid emotion for a nectar of the Gods.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Draco Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This journey begins in one of the most incredible and mysterious places in Italy—or perhaps it would be better to say hidden: Matera, known as the city of the Sassi, due to the peculiarity and uniqueness of its historic center. Carved and built along the Gravina di Matera, a deep gorge that divides the territory in two, the Sassi di Matera, the ancient districts of the city, stretch across two small valleys facing east, slightly lower than the surrounding land, separated by the rocky spur of the Civita. This enviable position has made the city virtually invisible to its enemies for millennia, allowing it to pass through centuries of history almost unscathed. The Sasso Barisano, facing northwest on the edge of the cliff, if we take the Civita as a reference—the heart of the old town—is the richest in sculpted portals and decorations that conceal its underground core. The Sasso Caveoso, on the other hand, faces south and is arranged like a Roman amphitheater, with cave dwellings cascading down in steps. It possibly takes its name from quarries and classical theaters. Together, they form the ancient urban nucleus of Matera, recognized by UNESCO as a cultural landscape. A place that, more than any other visited, could resemble an inhabited Moon—the one we dreamed of exploring as children. In this perfume extract lies precisely that dream that each of us has cherished at least once in our lives: living on the Moon. Sheltered in these cave dwellings, hand-carved into the hard rock hundreds of years ago, warmed by the welcoming fireplace and the lively hearth, this perfume was born—a fragrance with a strong and resolute character, as unyielding as the stone that shapes this hidden land! From a small window overlooking the valley, a gigantic red moon appears. Due to the perspective effect, it seemed almost within reach. By opening one's palm upward, one had the real sensation of being able to hold the mysterious satellite. From this moving experience, a perfume extract with a dark character was born, just like the phenomenon described. A fragrance that, at first encounter, seems almost charming and delicate, but a moment later, captivates you forever. A scent that lingers for days after being worn—hidden like the city of the Sassi, yet unexpectedly emerging in all its full splendor. Even today, this creation amazes us because each time it brings a new emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Draconis Extrait de Parfum 13 ml
listings.description: Draconis is the most Sun-like star known in the celestial system, forever shrouded in the mystery of life around it, which scientists worldwide are still searching for today. A magical and mysterious star, just like the fragrance it inspires.From the olfactory pyramid of Draco comes another Moon Star from the Tiziana Terenzi collection, exploring the infinite wonders of the countless combinations of its precious natural molecules! A breathtaking balance between contrasting yet complementary scents, opening with sparkling and fresh top notes, characterized by powerful Calabrian Bergamot and precious Sicilian Grapefruit, enriched by Matera Lemon and Basilicata Neroli. This citrusy and floral top note unusually embraces the spices, where echoes of Alpine Juniper blend with Black Pepper and the rarest Green Pepper, mixed with the opulent suaveness of Bourbon Geranium. At the base of this bold and irreverent creation, capable of shifting tone with astonishing intensity and acceleration, we find the precious and rare essence of Olibanum paired with Madagascar Vetiver and Red Patchouli from Sri Lanka, enhanced by the aphrodisiac power of Ambergris and the famous Musk from the Terenzi library.Draconis is a mysterious and profound fragrance that requires skilled noses to be discovered and understood. It takes true experts willing to dedicate time to listening to it because it will not reveal its mysteries to everyone. Like the Sun that the star represents, it will keep its world of wonder hidden from most, and only a few privileged souls will fully grasp its beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Draconis Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Draconis is the most Sun-like star known in the celestial system, forever shrouded in the mystery of life around it, which scientists worldwide are still searching for today. listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The third chapter of the Assoluto collection is Dubhe, a star rich in history and secrets from the Ursa Major constellation. Dubhe was once the North Star in ancient times and will be again around the year 20500, due to the precession of the equinoxes. A constant search for its own identity for this magical star, just as it is in the continuous, stylistic, and creative quest of Tiziana Terenzi, to explore the depths of a fragrance already complex and irreverent like Ursa from the Luna Collection.An unforgettable composition is born, cryptic, perhaps indecipherable, but with a regal and strong character, determined, wild, yet sweet and refined at the same time. A perfume created with raw materials that have been jealously and secretly kept in the olfactory library of the Terenzi family for over 50 years; oils of inestimable value that, thanks to slow maceration and long aging of the rarest molecules contained within them, release effluves that only time and the patience of those who know how to wait an entire lifetime can offer. The cosmic space and the absolute silence that floats between the bright stars have reflected on us for millennia, and will continue to do so. The beauty of the moment is enclosed in this jewel vial, in a drop of absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The most intense journey into the “Sacred Fire” of the soul, in search of true fulfillment, suspended in the weightlessness of absolute beauty. A captivating and mystical aroma, rich in originality and strong personality. This perfume was created on the most touching and profound day of our lives, in a creative delirium inspired by the force of eternal and surreal emotions. The emotion and transformation of those moments are enclosed in an indelible and cathartic memory that defines the spiritual passage from being a boy to suddenly becoming a man.A fragrance that, at first encounter, shakes and even shocks, like a punch to the face, thanks to the power of its top notes filled with frankincense olibanum. But immediately afterward, it slowly unfolds into an embrace of love and inner awareness, exalted by the white floral notes, the mystical power of Bakhoor, and precious woods. In that instant, one perceives the immortal energy of the love of a dear one merging with our soul, in a religion of remembrance that bestows newfound confidence and immortal strength.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Foconero Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The creation contained in the black bottle of the classic collection is inspired by a journey to one of Italy’s most beautiful gulfs. A place rich in history and poetry, music and traditions, with an infinite and almost disarming beauty that leaves every traveler breathless, with the desire to never leave. Paolo and Tiziana’s stop tells the story of this magical land—beautiful and wild, full of contradictions and fragility, but also rich in strength and generosity, just like the precious fragrance inspired by it. We are in the Gulf of Sorrento, sailing among its beautiful islands that characterize it and make it unique in the world. Suddenly, the profile of Capri appears, and not far away, Procida and the mythical Ischia.The fragrance is inspired by the fresh, salty nights spent on a road trip through this land of centuries-old tradition, with strong and decisive flavors as well as celestial and paradisiacal scents. The essence of the fire lit on a deep black night, atop the Zaro cliff at Punta Caruso on the island of Ischia, overlooking the sea with a gaze toward the Gulf. A night without lights, darker than the deepest black, illuminated only by the crackling of the bonfire and the glow of the crackling embers that break the silence of nature; around Paolo and Tiziana, a cool and fragrant breeze rises, collecting all the scents of this Mediterranean scrubland filled with beauty and history.First, you perceive the famous Sorrento citrus fruits, with lemons and bergamots, counterpointed by thyme spices resting on juniper berries and medicinal lavender. The heart beats strongly with the notes of refined and precious flowers like Ylang-Ylang and Hyacinth, expertly paired with the irreverent Cardamom and the sweet white Lily of the Valley. The touch of the salty smell coming from the sea blends the fragrance into a unique sense of freshness, based on the strength of the mix with powerful woods like Sandalwood, Cuban Cedar, and precious red Patchouli, blended with Oak Moss. A precious fragrance that will make you fly over the sea’s surface, with enveloping and seductive notes—fresh, generous yet warm and gentle at the same time; a sensual and seductive creation, simply as beautiful as the immeasurable beauty of nature and our splendid Italy. In this precious flask is contained all the emotion of a night in the Gulf of Sorrento, inhaling the salty emotion of the Mistral wind, with the background notes of the famous *O Sole Mio*... Wear this fragrance, close your eyes, and look at your inner beauty!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Foconero Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with the regenerative caress of nature. Keratin is a crucial molecule for healthy hair with regenerative properties, but since it is of animal origin, it presents objective environmental sustainability concerns. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is a fundamental driver of our strategic decisions, as all of our commercial actions are rooted in the philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Gemini Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The magical journey of children Paolo and Tiziana, together with their beloved grandfather Guglielmo, continues as they gaze at the night sky from the ridgelines of the hills of their homeland, warmed by a crackling fire on an early spring night. The crisp, bracing air reddened their cheeks when suddenly, majestic and mysterious, the beautiful Gemini constellation appeared. Guglielmo, pointing wisely to its brightest stars, began telling the mythological story that has inspired mankind since the dawn of time. This creation captures the very essence of those born under the sign of Gemini, and of all who possess an open mind, curious and determined, full of creativity, enchanted by hedonism and beauty, lovers of aesthetics in all forms, pursuing style and expression, and gifted with communication and wit – just like Geminis. The Gemini sign is marked by a dual personality, often even triple or multiple, so strong is the creative energy within these individuals. They adapt effortlessly to situations not because they are flexible or compromising, but because they are firmly grounded in their principles. The Gemini essence embodies this explosive force, highlighting an irrepressible joy for life and a constant search for beauty. In a single drop of perfume lies the liveliness and energy of free spirits – like Geminis – celebrating the captivating duality and refined aesthetic balance between elegance and timeless style. Gemini opens with an enveloping and elegant floral bouquet, featuring Bulgarian Rose and Bulgarian Lavender, contrasted by the power of Iranian Saffron and Clary Sage. This sparkling top note melts smoothly into an intense and vigorous heart, the true soul of the fragrance, where spicy and sharp notes arise in an innovative stylistic duality: Nutmeg from Granada and Omani Incense merge in a complex, profound harmony. Mexican Tagetes brings a charming sweetness to the heart of the creation, while Indian Sambac Jasmine fuses delicately with the precious Indian Cypriol UP, delivering the most seductive and sensual elegance. The entire creation is built once again on a strong dichotomy and contrast where warm and spicy notes chase each other in a swirl of evocative and captivating emotions, thanks to Singapore Patchouli intertwined with refined Tuscan Oakmoss, supported by the alluring power of magical Ambergris and Haitian Vetiver. Gemini is a fragrance dedicated to those who radiate vibrancy and energy, or who are seeking an explosion of elegance and timeless seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The result is an exclusive Terenzi formula based on water and natural molecules that ensures delicately perfumed hair care, ideal even for the most delicate and precious fabrics. Thanks to its special formula with Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff complex, it keeps your hair beautifully scented while nourishing it with new, sustainable natural ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens the hair (clinical studies show an 85% increase in resistance) and enhances elasticity (an 8% increase), while the anti-dandruff ingredient significantly reduces dandruff and prevents visible scalp residue on clothing.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest breakthrough in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with the regenerative caress of nature. Keratin is an important molecule for hair health, with regenerative properties, but being of animal origin, it has objective environmental sustainability limitations. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is one of the fundamental drivers in our strategic decisions, as all our commercial activities are guided by the philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Gumin Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This fragrance is dedicated to Guglielmo, the founder and pillar of the artisan house Cereria Terenzi, who, from generation to generation, continues his journey in search of wonder. The noblest and timeless fragrance of the collection. The most magical and powerful essence in the reflection of his memory. When, as children, Paolo and Tiziana would sense his scent echoing in the air, his strong presence announced the days of celebration and the euphoria of festivities. The powerful serenity of his hand that confidently guided us around the kitchen fire, radiant with sweets, or the crackling fire in the woods.A fragrance that speaks of sparkling love, reassuring sweetness, and a prelude to joy that announces the most beautiful celebration in the world: that of life. An extract dedicated to those who love to stand out with understated but decisive style, unique but refined, powerful but not egocentric. A fragrance that opens with rich harmonies of citrus fruits from the sunniest Italian orchards. Here, mandarin and bergamot blend with Sicilian oranges, offering subtle freshness with timeless elegance, because beauty is not fashion, but style. The citrus fruits rest on a bed of sweet fruits, such as pineapple, and delicate, sweet flowers like jasmine, violet, and rose bouquets, powerfully resonating with the unique power of amber. The stylistic construction gracefully rests on a powerful base of precious woods such as sandalwood and white oud, softened and enhanced by the vertical thrust of Musk. A fragrance that crosses the history of Italian luxury artistic perfumery, reinterpreted by craftsmanship and love, which only unique objects, made carefully by hand one by one, can offer to those who have the soul to appreciate them. A limited collection offered only to those who truly have the elect affinity to understand the timeless value of beauty and refined elegance, forever enclosed in the simplicity of a drop of liquid emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Halley Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Halley's comet is the most famous and brightest of the periodic comets known to date. It carries with it many mysteries, and in the common thought, it is also seen as the celestial element capable of influencing our earthly lives, just like this creation, which kindly offers it its name.The fragrance opens with a magical and delicate bouquet, but with a hypnotic and fatal scent, because once smelled, it will be impossible not to smell it again. The head resonates with fruits and precious flowers, where the Brazilian Passion Fruit echoes among many others, paired with Sorrento Lemon and Blackcurrant from Provence. To emphasize these fruity notes, the seduction of the Bulgarian Rose petal’s strength enters the picture. Such a rich and elegant head must have an even more intense and generous heart to highlight the multitude of nuances contained within. Here, among the flowers, we sense the decisive touch of Florence Iris, paired with the gentleness of Tuscan Hyacinth and the precious White Tuberose from Mexico. These precious flowers embrace the fresh tartness of Petitgrain and Hawaiian Hibiscus, softened by the sweetness of Peach and Raspberry from the Alps, spiced with Sri Lankan Cinnamon. A heart so complex and intricate needs a strong and characterful base to be emphasized and supported. We find the royal strength of noble woods like Laos Oud and Cuban Cedar, paired with the magical drop from the Terenzi family, consisting of Grey Amber and Musk.Halley is a fragrance with irresistible and fatal seductive power, capable of emitting a luminous and radiant trail, just like the famous comet that flutters across our skies.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Hyakutake Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The intergalactic journey of Tiziana and Paolo continues as they discover the celestial emotions produced by the magical star fires. Stars, in fact, are luminous fires that shine in the celestial dome, illuminating our nights. Of particular and legendary charm are the comets, capable of bringing with their light gifts of joy, hope, and fortune to humanity and to those who have the eyes to see them.The creation is inspired by the famous Comet Hyakutake, which passed near Earth on its endless journey in January 1996. Known for its long and brilliantly bright tail, it was discovered by a Japanese amateur astronomer, Yuji Hyakutake, causing great astonishment in the scientific community. Just like this fragrance dedicated to it, full of mystery and charm, it can only reveal itself to pure eyes, able to see where others do not look. In the darkness of the deepest night, a powerful light split the sky on that cold January day, and now this fragrance warms the heart of the wearer, giving them an aura of mystery and wild charm.Hyakutake opens with a "citrusy" accord dominated by the effervescence of Sorrento Lemon and Reggio Calabria Bergamot, enriched by the spicy notes of the refined Malabar Cardamom and the balsamic echoes of Greek Eucalyptus. The head folds lightly into an embrace offered by the heart of the creation, where the delicacy of the Italian Viola del Pensiero and the strength of the Tuscan Orris blend with the seductive union of Gray Amber and Omani Incense. The base is characterized by an acrobatic balance of woods, where the trilogy of Japanese Larch, Australian Sandalwood, and African Iroko resound powerfully, softened and highlighted by the scent of Virginia Tobacco and Haitian Vetiver. This creation carries with it a load of mystery and seductive elegance, capable of captivating and enchanting, seducing and conquering, but above all capable of warming the hearts with the joy of its aristocratic and timeless fragrance, because the irresistible charm is suspended in the timeline just like the comets that float in the celestial dome.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Ilba Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sailing through the crystal-clear waters of the Tyrrhenian Sea, the island of Elba reveals itself in all its majestic beauty. During one of their explorative journeys, Paolo and Tiziana were captivated by the timeless atmosphere of this island, steeped in legends, folk traditions, and a rare, precious natural landscape. Among the many stories shared by locals, one touched them deeply: the legend of Princess Alba and the knight Sabino, two souls in love but destined to part by divine will. The goddess Venus, guardian of their dreams, turned the island into their refuge, but their failure to honor her condemned their love to an eternity of torment. To this day, it is said that Alba’s call echoes through the Roman ruins of the Grottos of Portoferraio – a cry of hope that stirs the hearts of those who listen. Paulo Coelho once wrote: “I have learned that the world has a soul, and whoever understands that soul will understand the language of things.” These words seem to embody the very spirit of Elba, where every path, every breeze, every fruit of the land carries a deep and universal message. Paolo and Tiziana sought to capture the essence of this extraordinary place and its eternal love story, transforming it into a fragrance: Ilba. The fragrance was created as a tribute to this land and the legend that surrounds it – an essence that holds the sweetness of its fruits, the scent of its flowers, and the depth of its roots. Ilba is an olfactory journey that celebrates love, nature, and the magic of a timeless island. The fragrance opens with a bouquet evoking the gentle freshness of spring. Petals of Japanese Cherry Blossom blend with the softness of Tuscan Apricot Flower, while Indian Sambac Jasmine adds an exotic touch. Lavender and Juniper Leaves from the Island of Elba lend an herbaceous, aromatic note reminiscent of sea breezes. At its heart, Ilba reveals a sensual and fruity richness. Tuscan Peach Blossoms merge with juicy Red Cherries from Romagna, while Elba Magnolia adds sophisticated elegance. Hints of Musk and a whisper of fresh Oxygen evoke the purity of the island’s air, suspended between sea and sky. The base notes hold the primal strength of Elba. The woody intensity of Maremma Strawberry Tree blends with Tuscan Birch, Red Elm, and Juniper Wood from Elba. Grey Amber brings depth and sensuality, sealing the fragrance with an enveloping, persistent trail. Ilba is a seal of rare emotions – a journey into the deepest corners of the heart, where each note tells an eternal tale of nature and emotion.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Ixbeta Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Ixbeta was born from a night of magic and wonder, under a crystal-clear May sky. On that enchanted evening, Paolo and Tiziana gazed upon the blooming hills of their homeland, losing themselves in the silent dance of the Lynx constellation. In a dark region of the sky, where stars are shy and scarce, the star Beta shone with unexpected strength. From this celestial spectacle, the siblings drew the inspiration to create Ixbeta – a fragrance that embodies the brightness and resilience of a star fighting to shine in the darkness of night. Ixbeta is a tribute to those who never give up, to those who find their inner light even in the deepest darkness. Like the Beta star in the Lynx constellation, this fragrance shines with intensity and determination. It is an invitation to explore new olfactory combinations: Ixbeta can be layered with the other fragrances of the Lynx constellation, creating even more fascinating and surprising symphonies of light. Journeying to the Lynx constellation, one discovers the art of intergalactic layering through the star alchemy of perfumes inspired by the cosmos: Lince, Uxalpha, Ixbeta, and Lincys. The top notes of Ixbeta open with a burst of citrus freshness: Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Orange, and Sorrento Lemon intertwine their sunny essences, while Indian Cardamom adds a refined and intriguing spice. Red Currant from the Dolomites brings a lively, fruity touch. At the heart of the fragrance, Chilean Pink Pepper adds a vibrant and spicy nuance, harmonized by Himalayan Osmanthus with its warm and enveloping scent. African Geranium and Bulgarian Rose blend into an elegant and sophisticated floral bouquet. The delicate sweetness of Romagna Peach, Italian Violet, and Indian Jasmine, combined with the fruity freshness of Raspberry from the Dolomites, enchants the senses with a soft embrace. The base notes reveal a captivating and mysterious depth: Grey Amber brings a warm, resinous richness, while Tuscan Oak Moss and Brazilian Talc add a velvety and refined softness. Australian Sandalwood lends a creamy, woody note, while Cambodian Oudh, with its deep and earthy intensity, completes the composition with an exotic touch. Ixbeta is a sensory journey celebrating inner strength and the marvel of the universe. Each drop of this fragrance is a shooting star lighting the way, inviting us to discover the hidden light within each of us.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Kaff Attar 13 ml
listings.description: Tiziana TThe creation contained in this beautiful handmade crystal bottle is inspired by one of the brightest stars of the Cassiopeia constellation: Kaff, meaning “fertile oasis of palms”. Like an oasis, it envelops and regenerates us in a dive of harmony and cosmic fullness.Continuing the stylistic quest that began with the dreamlike journey through the constellations and then to the stars connected to them, the olfactory pyramid of Cassiopea is once again deconstructed and reformulated in an innovative and unique creation capable of pushing beyond all known stylistic boundaries. A tightrope journey led by the emotional vertigo triggered by the hypnotic opulence of white iris whipped by the citrus freshness of bergamot, but immediately counterpointed by the decisive and choral action of pink pepper and ginger.A balance of essences never experienced before generates this explosion of top notes that at first almost confuses, like a powerful narcotic, then captures in a dazzling whirlwind that gently rests—just as you think you might “faint”—on the scents of magnolia and Tuscan leather, all softened by the gentle caress of a bouquet of blue iris, orris, and the rare and precious grey amberThis unstoppable vertigo, as powerful as it is graceful, is rooted in mysterious aromatic bases of solid cedarwood and precious sandalwood, amplified by the unmistakable character of tonka bean. The star enclosed in this creation is as mysterious as it is fascinating, revealing itself only to the chosen souls capable of fully understanding the wonder of the most exclusive perfumery art—therefore reserved only for true fragrance connoisseurs.erenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is a true revolution in hair wellness: with each application, it delivers an extraordinary fragrant cloud of intensity and projection, while providing a regenerating and invigorating treatment that also helps prevent unsightly dandruff.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Kaff Attar 100 ml

Like an oasis, it envelops and regenerates us in a dive of harmony and cosmic fullness.Continuing the stylistic quest that began with the dreamlike journey through the constellations and then to the stars connected to them, the olfactory pyramid of Cassiopea is once again deconstructed and reformulated in an innovative and unique creation capable of pushing beyond all known stylistic boundaries. A tightrope journey led by the emotional vertigo triggered by the hypnotic opulence of white iris whipped by the citrus freshness of bergamot, but immediately counterpointed by the decisive and choral action of pink pepper and ginger.A balance of essences never experienced before generates this explosion of top notes that at first almost confuses, like a powerful narcotic, then captures in a dazzling whirlwind that gently rests—just as you think you might “faint”—on the scents of magnolia and Tuscan leather, all softened by the gentle caress of a bouquet of blue iris, orris, and the rare and precious grey amberThis unstoppable vertigo, as powerful as it is graceful, is rooted in mysterious aromatic bases of solid cedarwood and precious sandalwood, amplified by the unmistakable character of tonka bean.
