listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Kirkè Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: South of Rome lies an enchanted place, today a natural park, characterized by a landscape so rich that it takes the traveler’s breath away. A place of memory and a thousand faces, immersed between enormous sand dunes overlooking the sea and wild mountains, surrounded by forests and lush woods, bordered by the most flourishing Mediterranean scrub we have ever encountered, full of traces of great men and women of the past who have inhabited it. Walking along these ancient paths means immersing oneself in sinuous perfumes that echo new calls to memory, like the song of a siren or the melody that the sorceress Circe used to lure her victims, as told in the Odyssey of Ulysses.A sensual and warm fragrance, capable of transporting the soul to the beauty of the senses with seductive scents. A magical and sensual perfume, like the land and the sorceress who inspired it, characterized by a lush bouquet of sweet fruits such as Passion Fruit, Peach, and Pear, expertly blended with Raspberry and Blackcurrant. Seductive like a caress from Lily of the Valley and like a barefoot walk on the sand, warm thanks to the contrast of the unmistakable Heliotrope and powerful with the strength of Patchouli and Musk wood.Like one of the famous magic potions of the sorceress Circe, this extract enchants those who know how to wear it, leading them down mysterious paths to the discovery of a marvelous wonder, in an acrobatic evolution of emotions and inspirations locked in a magical filter, capable of leaving an endless trail of mystery and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Kirkè Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest breakthrough in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with the regenerative caress of nature. Keratin is an essential molecule for hair health with regenerative properties, yet being animal-derived, it has objective sustainability limits. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is a key strategic driver, as all our actions are based on eco‑sustainability and social responsibility.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Laudano Nero Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The most bohemian stop of this unforgettable journey takes us to the mythical Paris during a rainy autumn, but warmed by watercolor hues with sinuous and blurred strokes, like a painting by Renoir. The smell of rain beating on the slate roofs blends with the stone of the streets illuminated by dim lights. A small bonfire at an intersection in Montmartre warms musicians and street performers waiting for tourists after the rain. The magical atmosphere becomes intoxicated by precious and rare scents that echo the mysterious art of a timeless place. One of the most complex and intricate fragrance extracts in the collection, where all the seductive notes of anticonformity are encapsulated.A creation without compromises, just like the bohemians, indifferent to the thoughts of others, with a strong personality. A creation that can only be worn and truly understood by those who possess a spirit free from all influences and stylistic conformity. The uniqueness of the expression is immediately felt, with an unusual explosion of camphor that stuns like a glass of absinthe drunk in one go, an energetic counterpoint to the roundness of laudanum and cognac, anchored in the strength of precious woods, driven to the absolute by unfindable resins, reflected in the scent of slate and laurel, emphasized by the fire of the wet street. A black bottle as solid as a stone building contains the essence of artistic madness, unconstrained by any stylistic prejudice.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Leo Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Leo is a great zodiac constellation of the northern hemisphere, easily identifiable between December and June; in the northern hemisphere, its presence in the east after sunset signals the imminent arrival of spring, while in the southern hemisphere it becomes a typical constellation of late summer and autumn skies. Its unmistakable shape, cast into the heavens, immediately inspires strength and elegance, traits that are also confirmed in the astrological charts, where it is said that the Leo personality is generally endowed with great confidence and optimism, integrity, honesty, and loyalty; truly gifted with a natural leadership ability, the Leo stands out for its generosity and paternal instinct for protection, but also for admonition and command. A perfectionist and aesthete, it always seeks continuous self-improvement, equipping itself with great discipline and a spirit of sacrifice. With great passion and a fiery temperament, the Leo lives each experience to the fullest, putting all its soul and heart into it, convinced of the extraordinariness and uniqueness of the undertaking. The tendency to exaggerate in all areas is also a characteristic feature of the leonine psyche, driven by an exaggerated superego that, combined with its natural histrionic talents, makes it destined for the limelight.With this fragrance, we have celebrated the distinctive traits of Leo, inspired by the personality of Paolo, who was born under this zodiac sign and embodies the strengths and weaknesses of the Leo.The creation opens with an elegant and captivating bouquet where citrus fruits emerge with exciting brilliance, thanks to the shimmer of Brazilian Orange with South African Kumquat, embraced by Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Mandarin. This effervescent head rests on a base that becomes deep and sensual thanks to the hypnotic effluents of Indian Sambac Jasmine and precious Bulgarian Rose, softened by the freshness of Violet Leaves and the elegance of Italian Magnolia, driven by the erotic and mysterious allure of powerful Gray Amber blended with Ethiopian Myrrh. The base has strong and proud foundations, like the character of those born under the sign of Leo, where the powerful woods of Italian Oak, Lebanese Cedar, and Australian Sandalwood are accompanied by the aphrodisiac sweetness of Musk, softened by the unmistakable aromatic call of Siam Benzoin and the comforting gourmand sweetness of Amazonian Tonka Bean.Leo represents timeless elegance, beyond fashion; that seductive and irreverent charm, capable of conquering hearts and souls with its delicate and cheeky natural allure. On the wings of a style that transcends trends, in a dash of healthy, impertinent madness, because as Paolo always says, deep down, we are all a little “naughty by nature.”

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Leonis I Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Assoluto collection expands with an extraordinary essence: Leonis I, born from a distant star rising from the Leo constellation. This precious composition draws its roots from the strength and elegance of the Leo creation, boldly venturing into uncharted territories to craft a fragrance that is original and inimitable. The unique notes of this rare creation stem from an endless quest for rare and precious ingredients, combined into a magical symphony that would be difficult to imagine, even for the most refined minds. The harmonic tension of Leonis I stirs the boldest imagination, like a light yet piercing breeze that gently brushes the skin on starlit nights. Leonis I evokes the magic of the universe, offering a precious and dazzling experience – just like the jewel-like bottle that holds it – captivating the eyes and embracing the soul. This creation encapsulates ancient alchemy centered on three precious elements that have defined humanity’s journey along the incense route, from the Roman Empire to today. A stylistic journey through the discovery of precious Frankincense and Myrrh, once valued above gold, paired with regal Oudh. The fragrance opens with energizing and fresh top notes: a lively citrus symphony spreads with Brazilian Orange, blending with the exotic notes of Sicilian Saffron and the warmth of Davana, spiced with the pungent contrast of Black Pepper. This delicate balancing act of fresh and energetic notes rests on the deep and complex heart of the fragrance, where Nutmeg from Granada warmly wraps around Texan Cedarwood. The regal strength of Jordanian Myrrh enhances the mystical power of Omani Frankincense and Indian Cypriol, while Indian Jasmine adds a floral and profound nuance, enveloped by the charm of Cambodian Oudh. The entire composition is grounded in a base of Australian Sandalwood, seductively fused with magical Grey Amber, both completely wrapped in the sweetness of Madagascan Vanilla and the warmth of Benzoin. A gift of great value crafted for true connoisseurs of the fragrance universe – for only those capable of grasping the essence of the absolute can truly appreciate it.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Libra Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Libra is a zodiac constellation that reveals its majestic beauty from April to July in the northern hemisphere, while remaining visible for a few more months in the southern hemisphere. The best visibility occurs on beautiful spring days, when the daylight hours increase significantly, making the admiration of this constellation quite complicated and exclusive for experienced observers, because fully understanding all the facets of Libra requires great experience. Those born under the sign of Libra are known for their harmonious and balanced character, which allows them to get along with almost everyone. With a lively intellect, they can have interests in many fields, especially in the arts. They deeply love the sense of beauty in every form of artistic expression, from sculpture to painting, from music to dance, setting the standard of perfection based on impeccable aesthetic parameters. They strive to live in harmony, seeking it in every aspect of their life, and are sociable, flexible, and peaceful people who reject any form of violence by principle and never tolerate rudeness. They also love to stay fit, spending time caring for their inner and outer beauty, always in search of harmony: mens sana in corpore sano. In the zodiac, this is the most elegant and refined sign of all, endowed with adaptability and empathy. Naturally optimistic, it is easy for Libra to create relationships with others in the constant search for perfect balance. Capable and reliable in facing life's challenges, those born under the sign of Libra could take on any professional role, but their creative nature and exceptional talent often lead them to prefer an artistic and philanthropic career.With this creation, we wanted to celebrate the distinctive characteristics of Libra, inspired by the exuberant and sunny personality of Tiziana, who was born under the sign of Libra and fully embodies all the qualities of those born under this sign. The creation opens with an explosion of solar and effervescent joy, where Italian citrus fruits with bold fragrances echo, with the dominant notes of Sorrento lemon, Reggio Calabria bergamot, and Sicilian grapefruit, harmonized by the seductive counterpoint of tuberose and Bulgarian rose. This exuberant top note is accentuated by a generous and well-balanced heart, just like the sign that inspires the creation, where the gentle power of Atlas cedarwood is harmonized with the powerful sweetness of the precious Tuscan iris, surrounded by the aphrodisiac shimmer of grey amber and Indian sambac jasmine. The entire creation finds its strength in the influential and harmonious base, where Singapore patchouli wood embraces Madagascar vanilla flowers, highlighted by the celestial chorus formed by the combination of musk and Haitian vetiver, along with benzoin and oakmoss.Libra represents the harmony of beauty and the explosive joy of living under the sign of Dolce Vita Terenzi, inspired by the exuberant and talented Tiziana, because happiness is a moment that must be perpetuated forever.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Lillipur Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A stop on this journey took place in Nepal, in the ancient capital of the wonderful and mystical state of immateriality, in search of the most intimate and solitary spirituality. Nepal is a country where history, civilization, and myths intertwine, giving the traveler cosmic time to look into their soul and discover their deepest self. Lillipur is a spectacular gathering of temples, with the beautiful Golden Temple standing out among all. At every corner, there are large braziers burning incense and resins to aid meditation. Lillipur is considered one of the most spiritual areas on the planet!This extract was born from this journey, enclosed in a precious golden bottle, rich in the transcendence of the place. This extract represents the Mystical Fire of the soul and deep knowledge. The essence slowly reveals itself to the wearer, accompanying the traveler throughout the day in an intimate, ever-evolving sensory experience. Every breath of fragrance is a step toward one's true self.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Lince Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The result is an exclusive Terenzi formula based on water and natural molecules, delivering a gentle, scented wellness treatment for your hair—and also ideal for delicate fabrics. Thanks to its special formula with Phytokeratin and Anti‑Dandruff complex, it keeps hair beautifully scented while nourishing it with sustainable natural ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens hair (+85 % resistance increase clinically proven) and boosts elasticity (+8 %), while the anti‑dandruff component significantly reduces flaking and prevents scalp residue on clothing.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Lince Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary way to fragrance your hair with the regenerative touch of nature. Keratin is a vital molecule for hair health, known for its restorative properties. However, as it is of animal origin, it presents certain environmental sustainability challenges.At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production processes is a key factor guiding our decisions and strategies. We have built all our commercial actions around the philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility. This commitment led us to explore previously uncharted territory — plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact that possess the same benefits as animal keratin, without harming our planet.Our discovery was astonishing: not only did we find plant-derived keratin, but through scientific studies and certified laboratory tests, we confirmed that this rare and precious plant molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than its animal counterpart. The end result is an exclusive Terenzi formula, based on water and natural molecules, which provides a gentle, fragrant wellness effect for your hair, while also being perfect for delicate fabrics and garments.Thanks to its special formula containing Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff agents, it not only keeps your hair beautifully scented but also nourishes it with new natural and sustainable ingredients. Clinical studies demonstrate that Phytokeratin increases hair strength by 85% and elasticity by 8%, while the Anti-Dandruff component significantly reduces dandruff formation and prevents unpleasant scalp residue on clothing.Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is truly a revolution in hair wellness. With every application, your hair will be enveloped in a fragrance of extraordinary intensity and projection, while receiving a regenerating and invigorating treatment that also helps prevent the unsightly formation of dandruff.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Traveling towards the Lynx constellation, one encounters the brightest star of the group, called Lyncis. A very luminous and mysterious star, of intense color, yet sometimes invisible, although its presence can be felt, just like the essence of this creation, invisible but leaving a hypnotic and seductive trail around the wearer.From the precious and ancient Olfactory Library of the Terenzi Family, where oils and essences with over fifty years of maturation are jealously kept, some now simply impossible to find and priceless, others simply sublime, comes a new creation that is a gift for connoisseurs of artistic perfumery and those who wish to be absolutely unique. A production of a few hundred bottles worldwide for an olfactory experience of rare beauty.The fragrance opens with fresh and energizing top notes, where the sought-after Bergamot from Calabria stands out, paired with Mandarin and Grapefruit, both grown in Sicily, contrasted by the sparkling notes of Pink Pepper from Bolivia. The heart, which envelops the effervescent top, is rich and opulent thanks to the floral notes blended within. The Bulgarian Rose embraces the Grandiflora Jasmine and the Sicilian Orange Blossom. Then, by enchantment, the hypnotic seduction of the White Iris from Tuscany is perceived, paired with the precious and aphrodisiac Ambergris, stored in the family library ampoules for over fifty years. Such a rich and precious composition naturally requires a very powerful base, capable of supporting it and ensuring exceptional longevity, just as exceptional as the raw materials used for it. Thus, we immediately sense the delicate strength of Red Patchouli and Indian Sandalwood in the base opening, refined by the marine freshness of Lebanese Cedarwood and Tahitian Vetiver, before diving into the delicate strength of Tuscan Oak Moss and Brazilian Mato Grosso Tonka Bean.Lyncis is a luminous and sensual creation, capable of enchanting with its sparkling and precious trail, just like the jewel bottle that contains it, with its exclusive and unique projection of the raw materials that compose it.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Maremma Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The next stop on this wonderful journey speaks of Tuscany—the perhaps less romantic and well-known side of its rolling hills and Maremma valleys, rugged and strong like the men and women who live there, proud and regal like the horses that gallop tirelessly. It tells of camps in a wild and untouched land, alongside the Butteri and their splendid horses. The buttero is the traditional horseback herder of the Maremma. The name derives from the Greek boútoros (= one who prods oxen). With some approximation, this term can be considered the Italian equivalent of the American cowboy.The strength of this place is powerfully expressed in this perfume extract, highly complex and full of nuances. Rich in fruity and floral notes typical of this land, yet bold with leather and wood accords that give the composition incredible longevity. Encased in its black bottle is the entire charm of a wild and fascinating territory—a little-known corner of Italy, filled with wonders.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Mirach Attar 13 ml
listings.description: Mirach is one of the most well-known stars of the Andromeda constellation, particularly due to its incredibly large size, four times the size of the sun. For this unique characteristic, it is classified as a Red Giant capable of releasing huge spirals of fire that dance gracefully in the silent cosmos. This creation captures this powerful and gentle fire, making it dance on the skin with a sinuous and floating rhythm. A fire of distant echoes that chase and overtake each other, between the dazzling essentials of the purest beauty.The work begins with a subtle, almost silent vapor, and immediately opens with ethereal lightness the notes of Sicilian Neroli, paired with fragrant Damascus Rose and Italian Saffron, held in counterpoint by the strength of Nutmeg. The high spiral accord harmonizes with unison on a bed of Bulgarian and Musk Rose petals, resting on the powerful woods of Patchouli and White Oud, enveloped by the warmth of Sand (another famous and exclusive molecule from the Terenzi Olfactory Library), surrounded by the freshness of Davana with the ancient sensuality of Grey Amber. This incredible and acrobatic bouquet wraps itself in olfactory acrobatics following, or rather chasing, the base spiral that manages to make its precious notes rise and fall in continuous and unrepeatable evolutions, thanks to the sweetness of Madagascar Vanilla Beans combined with the hypnotic resin of Benzoin, firmly paired with the elegance of precious Cambodian Oud, sweetened by Indian Sandalwood. A becoming of passionate and seductive emotions in a hypnotizing fire spiral thanks to the regal touch of precious woods. A fragrance that will envelop you on an unforgettable journey in the eternal pursuit of the beauty of the fleeting moment.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Mirach Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Mirach is one of the most well-known stars in the Andromeda constellation, especially due to its incredibly large size, exceeding that of the Sun by four times. For this unique characteristic, it is classified as a Red Giant, capable of releasing enormous spirals of fire that gracefully dance in the silent cosmos. This creation captures this powerful yet gentle fire, making it dance upon the skin with a fluid and undulating rhythm. A fire of distant echoes that chase and surpass one another, amidst the essential splendor of the purest beauty.The composition opens with a subtle, almost silent vaporous quality, immediately revealing the ethereal lightness of Sicilian Neroli, the fragrant Damask Rose, and Italian Saffron, counterbalanced by the strength of Nutmeg. The high spiral accord harmonizes perfectly over a bed of Bulgarian and Musk Rose petals, resting on the powerful woods of Patchouli and White Oud, enveloped by the warmth of "Sabbia" (another famous and exclusive molecule from the Terenzi Olfactory Library), freshened by Davana and enriched by the ancestral sensuality of Grey Amber. This incredible and acrobatic bouquet swirls through olfactory pirouettes, following—or rather chasing—the base spiral, capable of elevating and lowering its precious scent notes in continuous and unrepeatable evolutions. This is made possible by the sweetness of Madagascar Vanilla Beans combined with the hypnotic resin of Benzoin, firmly linked to the elegance of precious Cambodian Oud, softened by Indian Sandalwood. A whirlwind of passionate and seductive emotions in a hypnotic fire spiral, crowned by the regal touch of precious woods. A fragrance that will envelop you in an unforgettable journey, eternally chasing the fleeting beauty of the moment.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Moro di Venezia Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A journey to the most mysterious city in beautiful Italy: Venice. A magical and enchanted place, made of narrow alleys, bridges, and canals, adorned with ancient palaces filled with fascinating and sometimes still secret history—a world that floats upon the sea, fragile yet strong, unique and inimitable, just like Terenzi’s fragrances, capable of carrying these ethereal and graceful emotions on an endless journey.Paolo and Tiziana often visited these places as children, accompanied by their family and grandparents, thanks to the proximity of their hometown to Venice. Journeys filled with emotions and carefree joy, experienced through the eyes of childhood, and now enclosed in the precious bottles of the Tiziana Terenzi Luna Special Collection.The vitality of the market during the day, the scent of spices, and the preparations for the magical spring ahead are the arabesque of images encapsulated in this fragrance, which opens with an explosion of citrus from Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Grapefruit, resting on a sweet bed of Cassis and Pineapple. In the refined union of violet and lily of the valley essences, embraced by the seductive burst of grandiflorum jasmine and the aphrodisiac warmth of amber, one can perceive the soul of this maritime city—the passage of time, the ancient majesty of its cathedrals, the love of sailors for the most noble and renowned city in the world: Venice. In a composition of freshness and lightness, as only spring can bring, emerge the bold notes of Hinoki wrapped in oakmoss, supported by the silent strength of musk, which enhances the sweetness of Madagascar vanilla beans. Moro di Venezia is the fragrance of a journey toward an unknown and mysterious Orient, a mirage filled with desires along the horizon of the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Nero Oudh Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation tells the story of a wonderful discovery made by Tiziana and Paolo during a fascinating childhood journey in a much-loved and unique Italian city: Milan. The discovery of the new moon, also known as the black moon. This lunar cycle symbolizes rebirth and is considered by many to be a good omen, a sign of prosperity and fortune for a bright future.Milan is the city that never sleeps, always active and industrious, constantly setting trends that soon become global fashion. The two children travel with their grandfather, who, as a young man, served in Milan as an officer of the Italian Cavalry. To their eyes, the city appears immense, intoxicating, and filled with bright lights that never stop pulsing, like the stars in the sky. The summer air is rich with scents and fragrances coming from every corner as they walk through the streets of Brera to the dome of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele. The grand historical buildings tower over the city, and behind their massive, fragrant wooden doors lie stories and mysteries locked away in fantastic secrets. And then, in the night, at the center of Piazza del Duomo, the black moon appears before their eyes for the first time. Immensely beautiful and elusive, just like the acrobatic alchemy of this unique and exclusive creation.The fragrance opens with the sparkling and precious intensity of Italian saffron, embraced by an intense bouquet of carefully selected petals. Bulgarian rose absolute and rose geranium blend with the exquisite magnolia, which blooms only once a year, macerated with ylang-ylang. Cypriol resins create a bridge to an intense and regal base, whose strong and tangible power comes from a combination of priceless woods preserved in the olfactory library of the Terenzi family. This persistent and elegant opening rests on a powerful and noble heart composed of the rarest root of aristocratic nobility, known as orris, surrounded by precious Cuban cedarwood and guaiac wood. Gurjum balsam resins connect to a deep and majestic base, built upon ancient, nearly priceless essences, meticulously safeguarded in the Terenzi family's olfactory library. Here, grey amber appears, followed by black Indian oud, then imperial musk aged for over 45 years, blended with red patchouli, softened by Tahitian vanilla flower and sandalwood bark. A fragrance that bestows rebirth, just like the new moon, carrying a rich legacy of fortune for those privileged enough to wear it. Because, as we always say, we do not choose the fragrance—fragrances choose us.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Orion Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: For this reason, our research has ventured into previously unexplored areas, toward plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, capable of having the same properties as animal keratin without harming our planet. Our discovery was astounding because not only did we find plant keratin, but through scientific studies and certified laboratory tests, we found that this precious and rare plant molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than animal keratin.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Orion Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest innovation in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with nature’s regenerative caress. Keratin is a vital molecule for hair health with regenerating properties, but as it is animal-derived, it presents objective environmental sustainability limits. At Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is a key driver in our strategic decision-making, with all our commercial actions guided by a philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility. That’s why our research ventured into unexplored territory to find plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, capable of replicating the properties of animal keratin without harming the planet. Our discovery was astonishing: not only did we find plant-based keratin, but scientific studies and certified lab tests revealed that this precious and rare botanical molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than its animal counterpart. The final result is an exclusive Terenzi formula made with water and natural molecules, delivering a gentle, fragrant wellness effect to your hair, while also being suitable for the most delicate fabrics and clothing. Thanks to its special formula, containing Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff agents, your hair stays beautifully scented and nourished by new, natural, and sustainable ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens the hair (clinical studies show an 85% increase in resistance) and enhances elasticity (an 8% increase), while the anti-dandruff complex significantly reduces flaking and prevents scalp residue from appearing on clothes. Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is a true revolution in hair wellness – with every application, your hair receives an extraordinary fragrance experience while benefiting from a regenerative and revitalising treatment that also helps prevent the unsightly formation of dandruff.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Orionis Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the Orion constellation comes one of the most wonderful journeys ever experienced, pursuing the olfactory library of the Terenzi family, to create a unique and irreplaceable Absolute. A limited edition fragrance due to the limited availability of priceless and unobtainable essences and molecules once they are finished. These are ingredients from the family library with over 50 years of maceration, some of which are completely prohibited today, but still usable naturally if one is well-known and has official proof of possession before 1968, as is the case with the Terenzi Brothers.A fragrance with an extremely high concentration, equal to 40% pure, natural, and extremely rare oils inspired by one of the brightest stars of the famous Orion constellation. From this olfactory pyramid begins a journey through new boundaries of artistic perfumery, where there are no limits or rules, only the desire to create wonder and beauty, just as the famous and beautiful star of the constellation, called Orionis, is wonderful and beautiful.The creation opens with a bold and unusual combination of the rare Saffron from Molise and the Frankincense Miramar, immediately diving into the true focal point of the fiery creation, just like the luminous star of Orion: the heart. This is an explosion of wonderful and powerful scents, where the precious and aphrodisiac Ambergris, a famous molecule jealously kept in the Terenzi library for over 50 years, stands out, skillfully blended with Musk and Red Patchouli from India. This expression of Italian luxury artistic perfumery rests solidly on a base of refined and very rare woods, where Tolu Balsam particularly stands out.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Orza Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Orza, from the verb “orzare.” Orzare means to turn the bow towards the direction of the wind. If one continues to orzare, the wind will blow in front of the boat, which will then change tack (the side from which the wind blows), thus executing a tack in nautical terms—a change of course and perspective. A new point of view, just like in this innovative creation that encapsulates all the elements of challenge and wonder. Change always contains wonder within it and carries a challenge, like the one faced when sailing upwind, sometimes reaching the very limit of going against the wind, only to set off again on a new course and a new beginning.The creation opens with an explosion of fruits, where Green Apple, Calabrian Mandarin, and Red Plum from Romagna stand out, enhanced by Coconut and Wild Berries such as Raspberries and Blackberries from the Dolomites. This fruity bouquet is surrounded by precious flowers like Mexican Magnolia and Himalayan Orchid, exuding a strong, sensual, and captivating fragrance. This vibrant opening gently settles on a sublime floral heart, where the joyful presence of Indian Jasmine and Lily of the Valley merges with the elegance of Bulgarian Rose. To support this bold olfactory pyramid, strong base notes are required, ensured by Australian Sandalwood, the power of Benzoin, and the warmth of Ambergris, all softened by the enveloping sweetness of White Musk and Madagascar Vanilla, skillfully blended with the gourmand touch of Caramel. Orza captures the spirit of change, in a sudden “tack” that embodies the thrill of challenge and the wonder of discovery, making every moment unique and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Osola Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Hidden among the majestic Alpine peaks and bathed by the crystal-clear waters of Lake Maggiore, the Val d’Ossola is a land where nature and tradition meet in perfect harmony. In this enchanted place, the earth holds a unique treasure: an Italian tea plantation, one of the largest in Europe, where a passion for craftsmanship merges with love for the land. During a stay at Lake Maggiore, Paolo and Tiziana paused to admire the breathtaking landscape, where time seemed to slow down and each breath was filled with the scent of the earth and its traditions. A local, hearing their conversation about the search for a unique ingredient for a new fragrance, led them to the tea plantation of Premosello. In this corner of paradise, Paolo and Tiziana were struck by the dedication and passion that infused every step of the tea-making process, from cultivating Camellia Sinensis to the artisanal care of every single leaf. This encounter inspired the creation of Osola – a fragrance that captures the essence of Val d’Ossola and celebrates the authenticity of its roots. Osola opens with bright and fresh notes, a tribute to the valley’s vibrant energy. Green and Black Tea from Verbano blend with the liveliness of Brazilian Petitgrain, Mandarin from Lake Maggiore, and Lemon from Sorrento. Touches of Coconut Milk and Brazilian Coconut provide a velvety creaminess that envelops the senses in a comforting embrace. At its heart, the fragrance becomes enveloping and sophisticated. Thai Ylang-Ylang and Mexican Tuberose intertwine with Orange Blossoms from Lake Maggiore, while Cedarwood from Lake Trasimeno adds a refined, woody depth. A note of Sicilian Almond enhances the composition with its warm and inviting sweetness. Osola’s base is a tribute to the strength and indescribable beauty of nature. Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar merges with Moss and Oakwood from Piedmont, while Grey Amber finishes the fragrance with a sensual, lasting trail – evoking the magic of Val d’Ossola with every breath. With Osola, every note becomes a poetic whisper, a weave of scents that tells the story of savoring life in its purest essence.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Pisces Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The magical and wondrous journey of Paolo and Tiziana in their quest to discover constellations and stars continues—this time with their grandfather Guglielmo as they explore Pisces. This is a constellation that is difficult to identify and often hides from the untrained eye. Perhaps the approaching spring equinox is the best time to observe it, so the Terenzi siblings climbed the hills of their beloved homeland, where the spirit of hedonistic beauty and the Dolce Vita grew ever stronger—just like the fire around which they sat to keep warm while gazing at the sky. At the time, they didn’t know yet that the values of beauty, joy of life, love of knowledge, and timeless elegance—the very foundations of the Dolce Vita—would become the cornerstones of their lives and their creative path. The fragrance Pisces is inspired by this marvelous constellation, embodying its deepest and most mysterious traits, and emphasizing the characteristics of those who, like people born under Pisces, have extreme sensitivity tied to the boundlessness of spirit and imagination. A world of wonder is painted in the notes of this perfume, reminding us that the magic of the sea and dreams converge in a single breath. A creation dedicated to those who are brilliant and unique, yet sensitive and romantic—timeless dreamers, for the style captured in this drop of perfume speaks not of fashion, but of a luxurious gesture suspended in time and aesthetics. Brilliant imagination combined with necessary chaos is encapsulated in this fragrance that stands out from the first impression, making our approach to life unique and unrepeatable. Pisces is a hymn to creativity, an enchanted tale that slowly reveals itself on the skin—a fragrance dedicated to endless stories and the fantastic worlds each of us creates, in an empathetic game that seduces and captivates, evoking powerful and unfamiliar emotions. The composition opens with precious Bulgarian Rose, skillfully embraced by Indian Davana, both enhanced by the effervescence and strength of Iranian Saffron, merged with the revitalizing freshness of Lemon from Sorrento. The bold and intense top rests on an equally generous and opulent heart, where Ceylon Coumarin adds a spicy touch, blending with the fougère nuances of Lavender from Lake Garda that unexpectedly flow into Indian Cypriol. The entire heart is upheld by the untamed strength of Patchouli from Singapore and Italian Leather, which together reach the alluring power of magical Grey Amber—a unique molecule from the Terenzi family’s olfactory library. The whole creation lies upon a powerful and mysterious base with hypnotic and captivating effluvia, thanks to the magic of aphrodisiac-scented molecules, an exclusive invention by the Terenzi family. The robust notes of Grey Amber paired with the enhancing silence of Musk give depth and persistence to the fragrance, wrapping the wearer in a warm and sensual embrace, animated by Mediterranean Thyme adding an aromatic freshness and the regal presence of Australian Sandalwood softened by the sweetness of Madagascar Vanilla. Pisces is an olfactory harmony perceptible only to those with the most sensitive souls.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Poggia Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Poggia from the verb „pogiare“: it is a term used in sailing and maritime contexts, meaning to deliberately move the bow of the boat away from the direction in which the wind is blowing, in order to give the boat more drive and strong acceleration.Poggia encapsulates the very spirit of this acceleration, enhancing the subtle sensuality of the hot summer wind that evolves into the generous and persistent projection of the fragrance itself. The creation opens with a sparkling citrus bouquet, where the reflections of Calabria Bergamot are caressed by the fragrant Sorrento Lemon, while the powerful echo of the Sanguinella Orange from Syracuse arrives, paired with the effervescent sweetness of the Yellow Peach from Romagna. With an acrobatic acceleration, the top note dives into a complex heart, almost an abyss of emotions tied to speed, where the sharp rosemary calms in the seductive embrace of Polynesian Ylang-Ylang, a powerful aphrodisiac, further emphasized by the charm of Turkish Rose and the sweetness of Green Apple and Passion Fruit. The entire creation is pushed to its maximum speed by an innovative and revolutionary base, capable of highlighting all the facets of the entire pyramid, in an artistic construction of stylistic research while respecting classic traditions. There are, in fact, no woods, as is usually the case, supporting the pyramid, but rather a series of natural ingredients that are able to imprint persistence and speed in an incredible projection over time, thanks to the seductive power of Musk, paired with the sweetness of Madagascar Vanilla and the aphrodisiac potency of Mediterranean Grey Amber. Poggia encapsulates the spirit of refined seduction, for those who love to be pursued but elusive, because they know they are unique and fast like the wind.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Porpora Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The multifaceted stylistic path of the Luna collection continues, aimed at exploring boundaries never reached before in the art of perfumery, leading us on this dreamlike journey into increasingly mysterious and secret cosmic spaces.The work contained in this precious ampoule, red as passion, decorated with a jewelry cap in gold representing the lunar phases with precious fire-red lacquers, is named Porpora. The creation is inspired by the magnificence of the famous Red Moon, which sometimes suddenly appears flaming behind the horizon. Perhaps the most magical and mysterious image of this long journey through the memory of happy childhood memories, from the most serene and carefree time of our lives. Paolo and Tiziana were at their holiday home, where the days passed peacefully to the sweet rhythm of the distant clock tower chimes. Often after dinner, they would sit with Grandfather Guglielmo to contemplate the sky and its depth. A vast stage of sparkling lights that disappeared out of sight, so large and infinite that it swept them away in a vertigo of emotions.Around the garden of the house was a beautiful, large rose garden, cultivated with love, wisdom, and expertise by Grandma Luigia. From this heavenly corner, dense and seductive fragrances came, which at night became even more intense as the temperature slowly dropped, thanks to the light breeze coming from the sea. From this magical place, their grandfather would pick the roses with which he would then prepare, with patience and wisdom, his precious essence of absolute. Paolo and Tiziana would collect with him hundreds and hundreds of fragrant, fleshy petals, purplish and velvety, which he would skillfully lay out in his shiny copper cauldron, gleaming like the moon, of the alchemist’s still. Over low heat, fueled by chestnut wood from the nearby forest, which the skilled fireman carefully placed under the cauldron, precious nectar droplets condensed in the glass spirals of the still. With enchanted eyes, Paolo and Tiziana would spend hours watching this indecipherable phenomenon: the fire of the wood transformed beautiful rose petals into drops of precious absolute nectar. The magic of perfume extraction happened before them, like a divine miracle, spreading its fragrance all the way down to the distant valley. That evening they were excited by the total experience of sublimation and extraction, when suddenly, from behind the hill covered with flowers, a Super Moon appeared, huge and radiant like never before, in a flaming, imposing purplish red color. It seemed so close that they feared it might fall on them.Amazement, seduction, excitement, and wonder before such magnificence now enclosed in this precious work, which opens with a decisive mark dictated by the Absolute of Rose, crowned by wild raspberries and spices like cinnamon and cloves. The top bouquet is then laid on an irreverent and fearless heart, on the edge of recklessness, thanks to an innovative intertwining between the sensual seduction of Bulgarian Rose and the hypnotic effect of Poppy, contrasted by the mystical force of incense and patchouli. The precious creation is supported and characterized to ensure an extraordinary longevity on the skin, by the power of chestnut woods mixed with the resins of Benzoin and Myrrh, enhanced by the gentle strength of the ultra-thirty-year-old Amber and Musk blend from the Terenzi Family. The olfactory signature for a unique and one-of-a-kind essence.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Rivèa Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: During a trip along the Ligurian Riviera, Paolo and Tiziana are inspired by a place of natural beauty that combines elegance and the uniqueness of Italian style: Portofino. Walking along the shores of this magnificent village, they remember the energy and magic of the fire lit during the San Giorgio bonfire and reflect on their childhood memories and the sea, which has always been a fundamental element in the important moments of their lives and an endless source of inspiration for their creativity. From this memory, the idea for a new essence was born. The Terenzi brothers are captivated by one of Portofino’s most recognizable features: its crescent-shaped bay, framed by green hills that create a breathtaking view, offering a spectacle of beauty that takes the breath away.The era of life on the Riviera in the 60s is marked by the elegance of the Italian Dolce Vita and the life of the playboys made in Italy, called Les Italiens, who at the time conquered the Riviera with the shout “Bare feet, jeans, hair in the wind and away!” The picturesque coves and golden sandy beaches became the places where one could live the dream of the Dolce Vita. It was in these locations that celebrities and artists gathered to celebrate and enjoy the extraordinary beauty of these landscapes. During this period, the Riviera was dominated by style, grace, and elegance, everyone wore trendy clothing, and the sense of beauty prevailed, giving birth to a golden era for fashion and lifestyle, with Portofino becoming an icon of elegance and beauty. Elegance became the art of combining style and sophistication in every aspect of life, a visible manifestation of our sense of beauty, a loud statement of who we are and how we perceive the world around us.The fragrance dedicated to the trip to Portofino captures the essence of this enchanted place, a journey toward beauty, art, and tradition. The name Rivèa is inspired by the term “Rive,” which in Ligurian dialect means “seafront” or “promenade.” Those who experience Rivèa will be transported into an atmosphere dedicated to the Dolce Vita and the greatest beauties of Italy.The fragrance opens with a bouquet of Bulgarian roses, enhanced by Iranian saffron and Sorrento lemons over a bed of Indian Davana. The generous top rests on an equally rich and seductive heart: Laos vetiver offers an earthy and woody base, while Tigullio seaweed adds a salty hint reminiscent of the ocean’s scent. Ceylon Cypriol and Haitian Amyris contribute musky and woody tones, while Singapore patchouli adds a slightly earthy touch. Finally, grey amber completes the heart with a sensual and enveloping note. The base of this enchanted creation wraps the senses with its persistent, intoxicating warmth. Grey amber returns along with Australian sandalwood, adding a woody sweetness, while Portofino cypress adds a touch of Mediterranean freshness with the echo of Madagascar Bourbon vanilla. Rivèa is the fragrance that captures the soul of Portofino, gifting those who wear it the energy, elegance, and beauty of this enchanting destination. The Dolce Vita in a drop of perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Rosso Pompei Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The endless journey of Paolo and Tiziana reaches the city suspended in time of the Roman Empire. The largest archaeological museum of wonder, where time stopped forever on a night in 79 AD. The children's eyes are filled with the beauty they encounter during their visit to the city of Pompeii on the Amalfi Coast. History reverberates with every step they take, hand in hand, before a breathtaking enchantment that captivates every visitor. An extraordinary journey, always undertaken with Grandpa Guglielmo and the whole family, in search of the traces of their ancestors who, since the dawn of the Roman Empire, have passed down the Terenzi lineage.It is during this visit to the city of Pompeii that Paolo and Tiziana discover the Villa of the Mysteries, adorned with frescoes of astonishing beauty, where the color red echoes, which will become famous worldwide as Pompeii Red. In these famous frescoes, of imposing proportions, are depicted inscrutable figures and mysterious rituals that are said to hide the secret of happiness and pleasure. This secret has been enclosed today in the Rosso Pompei bottle, following the emotions of Paolo and Tiziana in the face of so much beauty and harmony.The fragrance opens with a fruity accord, where the delicate scents of yellow and pink Grapefruit from Sicily echo, combined with Sorrento Lemon and Amalfi Grape, very famous for its sweet nectar. The heart of this creation gently embraces the head, thanks to the seductive power of Grey Amber combined with the forbidden flower of Mexican Tuberose, with hypnotic and aphrodisiac powers, embraced by the gentleness of Lily of the Valley and Royal Jasmine. The base is powerful to ensure an intense duration for the entire creative structure, where the woods of Indian Sandalwood reverberate, whipped by the freshness of Cedarwood from Lebanon, but made mysterious, just like in the Villa in Pompeii, by the vigorous Red Patchouli and Neapolitan Maple, a tree typical of the Vesuvius region. A sensual and mysterious emotion that will envelop you entirely with such a mystery, making your charm even more irresistible and unforgettable, just like the mythical atmosphere of Pompeii.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Saiph Attar 13 ml
listings.description: The creation contained in this attar stems from the exploratory journey the mind undertakes through memories that merge into the childlike dream experienced in an enchanted land. The chiaroscuro of memory becomes, with this nectar, an explosion of colors on the screen of imagination, lit by the gleam of the dream. A fragrance you don't expect, that surprises you from the very first moment. A nectar of poetry ready to captivate, making you fly on the wings of the hippogriff between rainbows of wonder that only creativity can bestow. A bouquet of citrus fruits resting on a bed of rose petals, supported by the effervescence of oxygen, chasing each other in sweet and deep counterpoints of delightful fruits, skillfully supported by precious woods and the warm embrace of vanilla, amber, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Saiph Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the constellation of Orion, an essence inspired by the star Saiph. The creation enclosed in this Extract comes from the exploratory journey that the mind can undertake through memories that merge into the childlike dream experienced in an enchanted land. The chiaroscuro of memory becomes, with this nectar, an explosion of colors on the screen of fantasy, illuminated by the glow of the dream.An effluence you don't expect, which surprises you from the first moment. A nectar of poetry ready to captivate, to make you fly on the wings of the hippogriff through the rainbows of wonder that only creativity can bestow. A bouquet of citrus fruits lying on a bed of rose petals, supported by the effervescence of oxygen, chase each other in sweet and deep counterpoints of the delightful fruits, expertly supported by precious woods and the warm embrace of vanilla, amber, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Siené Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The creation is inspired by Tuscany and specifically one of the most beautiful, complex, and mysterious cities of this land that never ceases to amaze and offer wonders to those who visit and those who smell it. During a journey to discover the beauties of Italy and especially the wonders of Tuscany, we arrived in one of the oldest and most important cities of the Renaissance, Siena, which still today seems to carry with it the lineage of the Medici dynasty. The city of the oldest Palio in the world, still pulsing for its proud and impetuous horses like the wind, for its desire to win against time and modernity, its superb arrogance in resisting modernity and progress, but at the same time being innovative and visionary, with the royal decadence that fascinates relentlessly anyone who observes it. A landscape made of iron-rich and red soils, as generous as the people who inhabit them, as hard as life on the ridge of hills that know how to give much but also take everything if you don't have the courage to live fully according to its rules. Here in the valley, the perfumes and fragrances become intense, the strong and harsh odors of the wild yet gentle nature announce, even if you hadn’t realized it before, that you are in Tuscany and the fire burns strong on the hill, illuminating the evening.This creation requires time to be understood; it does not reveal itself easily to anyone, so take your time, a lot of time, to comprehend its acrobatic vertigo, because the challenge will be hard even for the most experienced noses. We are facing the most complex and unique artistic expression.The composition opens with notes of juniper paired with cypress, a typical and symbolic plant of Tuscany, combined with the characteristic scent of centenary olive trees, before reflecting in the bark of the poplar trees in the Tuscan forest. The complex and rare head, made of woods that are usually found at the base, lies heavy and cumbersome on an even more complex bed, confusing even the most prepared and experienced noses, where the red patchouli of India echoes mixed with the mysticism of frankincense and myrrh, strongly contrasted with Tuscan leather. Such a complex and unique structure requires an even more complex base capable of supporting such a detailed and irreverent olfactory pyramid, dedicated only to those who have the soul to fully understand it. Here, the base opens with the bitter sweetness of Tuscan acacia honey, paired with the sweating strength of the "magical drop Terenzi" made of gray amber, musk and... cleverly mixed with the strength of Indian sandalwood and Oud from Cambodia, ensuring persistence and a trail until the next day. Dedicated to one of the cities we have ever had the fortune to visit and where the fire of tradition and history still burns strong in the hearts of the chosen souls, ready to fully understand its beauty. Siena is not just a city to live in, but above all a lifestyle to be inspired by to truly live!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Sirrah Attar 13 ml
listings.description: Sirrah is a very famous star in the Andromeda constellation, with the royal destiny of soon becoming a Red Giant. A magical star, therefore, evolving in its fiery spirals, yet remaining bright and fixed in its continuous becoming. It is precisely this observation of the star in its becoming and its blazing spirals that inspired the creative vision of this extract, with a seductive and magical touch, both fresh and warm, elegant and sensual, seductive and regal in unison, in a spiral of emotions in progress that captivate in a whirlpool from the very first moment.We can no longer speak of the classic pyramid in this creation, because the molecules chase each other, surpass each other, and then settle only to be surpassed once again, in a continuous pursuit and rediscovery.Here opens a sinuous and sensual bouquet of fruits as ancient as rare, like the Quince paired with the invigorating Passion Fruit, suspended in conjunction with precious spices like Saffron and the rare Green Pepper. The bouquet floats and continues to float thanks to its characteristic spiral, on the notes of Osmanthus, Bulgarian Rose, and Grey Amber, enhanced by the subtle sinuosity and sweetness of Madagascan Green Cardamom and the burning freshness of Oxygen (a now famous and exclusive molecule in the Terenzi Olfactory Library). All of this dives and emerges in the perpetual becoming of the strong and light notes of Italian Leather, intertwined in swirling spirals with the precious woods of Patchouli, Sandalwood, and Birch, whose gentle and deafening echo is the graceful force of White Musk. A creation that will captivate you in a whirlpool of fresh fire spirals of seduction and luminous wonder that follow themselves in a sweet becoming.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Sirrah Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Sirrah is a very famous star in the constellation of Andromeda, with the royal destiny of soon becoming a Red Giant. listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Smeralda Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In Sardinia, between the endless blue of the sky and the vivid green of the waters, there lies a place capable of enchanting every soul that crosses it. It is the Costa Smeralda, a stretch of land sculpted by wind and sea, where wild nature intertwines with timeless elegance. In this unique setting, Mediterranean charm reveals itself in its purest form. And it is under the enigmatic gaze of the Red Moon, the magical moon that every month dyes the sky with scarlet reflections, that Paolo and Tiziana found the inspiration to create a new gem in the Luna Special collection: Smeralda. The Red Moon, a symbol of mystery and power, guides dreams and enchantments, just as the waves guide the sea. On a summer evening, on a hidden beach of the Costa Smeralda, the two siblings were captivated by a sunset that seemed sculpted by the cosmos. The water sparkled with emerald reflections, dancing to the rhythm of the waves, while the air carried the enveloping aroma of the Mediterranean maquis. As night fell, while the moon turned red and the place vibrated with a unique magic, the idea was born to transform that landscape into a fragrance capable of preserving the eternal essence of the coast and its timeless beauty.Smeralda opens with a sparkling freshness that recalls the first breath of the sea. Sardinian myrtle and Sardinian mandarin blend with the vivacity of Sicilian pink grapefruit, while Chilean black pepper and ginger add a bright spiciness. A touch of Costa Smeralda mint evokes the refreshing breath of the wind that caresses the cliffs. The heart of the fragrance reveals an unexpected refinement. Bulgarian rose and Virginia tobacco leaves meet the woody warmth of Australian sandalwood and Cuban cedar. Ceylon cinnamon notes add a welcoming sensuality, while Sardinian iris imparts a powdery delicacy, like the golden reflection of a Mediterranean sunset. Finally, the base dives into the depths of primordial nature. Tuscan leather and Madagascar bourbon vanilla intertwine with Haitian vetiver and musk, while Omani incense and Italian labdanum close the fragrance with an enveloping and persistent trail, like the memory of a night under the Red Moon. With Smeralda, let yourself be carried on a boundless journey, where the breath of the Mediterranean meets the mystery of the cosmos, and every note tells a story of light, magic, and infinite beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Spirito Fiorentino Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: One of the most fascinating cities in the beautiful country (Italy) is the extraordinary Florence, rich in history, traditions, and beauty, expressed through the city’s narrow streets and the breathtaking monuments that make it up. Every single stone or brick of the historic palaces exudes stories and legends, captivating the visitor from the very first moment.On a magical evening in September, Paolo and Tiziana are in Florence for a trip with the whole family and grandparents to discover this enchanting Renaissance city! Florence is a magical city, capable of immediately enveloping and captivating visitors in a whirlwind of emotions and contradictions. The sense of beauty belongs to this place in an absolute and unique way, and there is no other city in the world that can compete with it for the pulsing beauty of its history that wraps visitors like a precious cloak! During evening walks, Paolo and Tiziana, hand in hand with their beloved grandfather Guglielmo, are mesmerized by the unique beauty of the immeasurable artworks, enriched with wonders that cannot be described with adjectives, such as the perfection of Michelangelo's David, Brunelleschi’s dome, or Giotto's bell tower! Climbing the steep and long staircase with over 400 steps of this tower, which dominates the entire city, like the most scenic terrace of Italian Renaissance, Paolo and Tiziana gaze upon the beauties of Florence. Their childlike eyes lose themselves in the wonder and amazement, while their grandfather wisely tells the stories behind the artists who made Florence unique.Suddenly, in a cobalt-blue sky illuminated by bright stars, a huge Red Moon rises, able to color the sky with its fiery pallor. The air fills with intense fragrances, magical effluents accentuated by the palaces of the city of the Violet Lily, which envelop Paolo and Tiziana like a warm cloak, while in the distance, on the banks of the Arno River, large bonfires burn under the Ponte Vecchio, while in the tanneries of Tuscan leather, the echo of this essence reverberates. In an instant, the two children are intoxicated by the unforgettable essence of the “Spirit of Florence,” now contained in this precious red vial, just as the magical Moon, capable of activating beneficial spells and granting fortune to those who know how to admire and understand it. This creation, like the Spirit of Florence, requires time to be understood; it doesn’t reveal itself to everyone, and only a few chosen ones will be able to fully enjoy its beauty.The essence opens with a graceful bouquet of flowers, where the Violet Lily (the symbol of Florence) and Jasmine stand out, embraced by the power of Italian Saffron and the freshness of oranges. The head is very rich and precious, but at the same time, extremely refined and gentle, resting on a very intense and valuable heart that makes this dreamlike journey unforgettable. Here emerges the elegance of Ylang Ylang, paired with the refined seduction of Magnolia, both accentuated by the rare and aphrodisiac Gray Amber, embraced by the ethereal sweetness of White Lily of the Valley. The entire creation is based on a foundation of precious and unique woods, as in the best Tuscan tradition, where we find, along with the precious Sandalwood, Birch, and Musk from the Terenzi Library, the powerful scent of Tuscan Leather, embraced by Oak Moss from the Apennines of these enchanted places. In this precious red vial, as red as passion, is enclosed the emotion of the thrill that only Florence, in its eternal beauty, can offer. In this creation is carefully preserved the Spirit of Florence, which will reveal itself fully only to the chosen and privileged few who have the soul to understand it fully.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tabit Attar 13 ml
listings.description: The creation contained in this attar is shaped by the journey on the wings of dreams. The discovery that our inner self is capable of making through the contamination of lived experiences and crystallized in the memories of time, emphasized and shaped by the fantasy of childhood, free from any mental patterns that life imposes on us as we grow. A journey through infinite spaces in the celestial vault, jumping between luminous stars without fear of falling, because the earth is soft and welcoming like powdered sugar and candied fruits of the notes of this love fragrance.Tabit is a creation that conquers from the first moment and never leaves you. However, its fragrance is powerful, gentle like the caress of a smiling child, yet at the same time disturbing, sensual like an enchanting look that you can’t resist. Its top notes are foamy and immediately playful, counterpoints of citrus and green leaves; fresh and radiant, they settle on the warm sweetness of coconut and peach, enveloping you like the warm sand of a beach in summer on the sunny promenade of a Mediterranean village. The burst of joy explodes with all its beauty in the base notes of this attar, never too far from its heart, regal and gentle. Here, vanilla and precious ambers play with precious woods, while the sweet sugar makes us dream of the delicious candies we wanted to eat as children.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tabit Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The work preserved in this excerpt is shaped by the journey on the wings of dreams. The discovery that our inner self knows how to accomplish through the contamination of lived experiences and crystallized memories of time, highlighted and shaped by the fantasy of the child, free from any mental framework that life imposes upon us as we grow. A journey through infinite spaces in the celestial vault, jumping between luminous stars without fear of falling, because the earth is soft and welcoming like powdered sugar and candied fruits in the notes of this effluence of love.Tabit is a creation that conquers from the very first moment and never leaves you. The extremely powerful scent is yet gentle, tender like the caress of a smiling child, but at the same time, disturbing, sensual like a captivating gaze you can't resist. Its top notes are effervescent and immediately playful, chords of citrus and green leaves; fresh and radiant, they settle on the warm sweetness of coconut and peach, enveloping you like the warm sand of a summer beach along the sunlit coastline of a Mediterranean village. The burst of joy explodes in all its beauty in the base notes of this attar, never too far from its heart, regal and gentle. Here, vanillas and precious ambers play with fine woods, while the sweet sugar makes us dream of the delicious candies we wanted to eat as children!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Talitha Extrait de Parfum 13 ml
listings.description: From the constellation of Ursa Major, we recognize a bright star with an exotic and mysterious name, which has always fascinated dreamers who love gazing at the sky in search of the fire of the stars, just as Paolo and Tiziana loved doing as children with their grandfather Guglielmo. This stylistic project therefore begins with the Ursa pyramid from the Luna collection, continuing an intergalactic journey toward a new, original, and luminous pyramid, completely new, yet still able to maintain a strong connection with the composition from which the journey originates and is inspired, thus ensuring perfect harmony for those who wish to explore the art of layering starting with Ursa by Tiziana Terenzi Luna.The creation opens with a stunning citrus bouquet, where Amalfi Lemon, traditionally extracted by the Terenzi family by macerating its fleshy green leaves, is paired with Bergamot from Reggio Calabria and Pink Grapefruit from Sicily. The sparkling, radiant top note settles on a seductive and elegant heart, where the intoxicating Bulgarian Rose is in counterpoint with Ylang Ylang, enriched by the unexpectedly aromatic push of spices, where we clearly recognize the Nutmeg from Piedmont with the Cardamom from Guatemala and the bizarre hint of Cinnamon from Ceylon, framed in a suspended, timeless elegance granted to the composition by the intoxicating and seductive embrace of Grey Amber and Italian Leather. This heart of sensuality merges into a powerful, robust base, yet at the same time elegant and seductive, where Atlas Cedarwood is combined with the aphrodisiac Guaiacwood and Haitian Vetiver, driven by the invincible power of Musk that enhances the entire creation. Talitha embodies the timeless elegance of the charm of discreet and silent balance, a stellar journey between tradition and innovation, dazzled by the wonder of the unexpected thanks to the touch of madness that its aromatic spices give to the effluence generated by Italian leather and grey amber.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Talitha Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the constellation of Ursa Major, we recognize a bright star with an exotic and mysterious name, which has always fascinated dreamers who love gazing at the sky in search of the fire of the stars, just as Paolo and Tiziana loved doing as children with their grandfather Guglielmo.
