listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Telea Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Telea is the name of a magical star very far away and shrouded in mystery, according to legend, a star with prodigious powers. This star gives its name to Paolo's sailboat. A floating dream, rocked for an entire lifetime and made with precious and fragrant woods, polished brass, rare ropes, and highly technological black sails, to travel far. Telea was built around the desire to sail, ready to face any kind of sea and ocean, but especially designed to become a secret refuge, a place to recharge one’s batteries and find inspiration for new creations and new challenges: a place of "breath," because breath is the brother of fragrance, and wonder takes shape by unfolding its sails toward infinity.Telea is not just an object because it has its own soul and is symbiotic with the spirit of its Captain and Crew. The sea is our home... the sea is our homeland... this is what Father Evelino always said, and with this philosophy, Paolo and Tiziana grew up, sailing with him on the wings of fantasy aboard his beautiful wooden boat. From this deep passion, rooted in their hearts since childhood, the Terenzi brothers have never stopped loving the sea, its immense depths, its infinite spaces, its starry skies, and its precious gifts, like the rare Grey Amber.The creation opens with a roar of joy and happiness, a sound of sparkling life conveyed by the effervescence of citrus fruits like Bergamot from Calabria and Oranges from Sicily, emphasized by the intoxicating sweetness of Hawthorn from Mikonos, the smoothness of Bulgarian Rose, and the tenderness of the Romagna Pear. This head full of happiness dives, like summer into a blue sea, onto a pulsating heart full of colors and sounds, where the hypnotic and sensual power of magical flowers like Jasmin from Locride, Peruvian Heliotrope, and Filipino Ylang-Ylang embrace with precious and aphrodisiac essences, where Red Patchouli and Grey Amber collected from the Mediterranean waves stand out. Like a solid vessel built from sturdy timbers to withstand the force of the sea, this creation also has a strong and vigorous base, where exotic notes of Tahiti Vetiver mixed with the disturbing Musk rely on the strength of fragrant woods like Mahogany, Tuscan Oak, Cambodian Agarwood, and Romagna Oak. Telea is the fragrance of enchanted wonder, inspired by the limitless freedom that only the sea can provide, for those who never stop dreaming and living in the wake of a wave that rolls without boundaries, because as the poet said: "Free man, you will always love the sea! The sea is your mirror: you contemplate your soul in the endless turning of the rolling wave." – Charles Baudelaire

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tempel Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Tempel comet is a periodic comet that reappears every six years orbiting in our solar system and has been visited twice by space probes searching for its mysteries, which are still unresolved today.Just like these grand mysteries, this creation, which takes its name from the comet, opens with a delicate yet opulent head, where the precious and rare Japanese Lily of the Valley embraces the fleshiness of Magnolia and the hypnotic power of Narcissus. This rare Lily of the Valley oil from Japan is the connecting element throughout the entire creation, from the top to the base, passing through its heart. Here is the heart that pulses under the effusion of the Lily of the Valley embraced by the regal Cambodian Oudh, which makes the fragrance intense and sensual. The creation rests on an opulent and intense base, where, again with the Japanese Lily of the Valley, we have an extremely rare Oudh from India, enhanced by the seductive and aphrodisiac power of Grey Amber.Tempel is a fragrance with a royal and precious character, ideal for true connoisseurs of natural and precious Oudh oils, attracted by the hypnotic beauty of priceless flowers and the seductive power of Amber. A stellar composition that will provide you with brilliant light and an air of hypnotic beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Torpè Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This creation stems from the memory of a journey in the heart of the French Riviera, between the sparkling blue of the Mediterranean and the hills dotted with olive trees, in Saint-Tropez. Paolo and Tiziana visited this town, with its timeless lifestyle of sweetness and freedom, and found inspiration in the joyful and vibrant character of this seaside resort.Saint-Tropez represented a fascinating journey through the golden age of life on the Riviera in the 1960s. In those years, the Italian and French Rivieras underwent an extraordinary cultural transformation: the life of the made-in-Italy playboys, known as Les Italiens, who conquered the Riviera in the 1960s with the shout “Barefoot, jeans, wind in the hair, and go!” This iconic image perfectly captures the defiant attitude and desire for freedom of that time. These young people conquered the Riviera with a bold spirit and a liberating attitude, embracing a lifestyle based on relaxation and fun, while a burning fire of passion ignited within them, pushing them to live every moment intensely. When the film “And God Created Woman” hit the big screen, it captivated the hearts of audiences worldwide thanks to the young and unforgettable Brigitte Bardot.Torpè is a tribute to the timeless glamour of that era, when Saint-Tropez became a coveted destination for the international jet-set. Torpè, however, was the name used among the trendiest “rebels” of the area during the 1960s.This creation is a fresh and lively fragrance that, with its marine notes, evokes unforgettable summer nights full of laughter and carefreeness. Each note is dedicated to the sea and its magic, a sensory journey to one of the most enchanting places in the world. Anyone who wears it can close their eyes and find themselves transported to the cobbled streets of Saint-Tropez, between the laughter of children playing, the scent of the salty air, and the warmth of the sun on the skin. The fragrance opens with a citrus and fresh bouquet, thanks to Bergamot from Reggio Calabria, Lemon from Sorrento, Mandarin from Sicily, and merges with marine notes that add depth to the essence. The heart of the fragrance, the true essence of this creation, opens with the soft effusions of Bulgarian Rose, Lavender from the Côte d’Azur, French Iris, and Violets from Provence, which intertwine with the delicate elegance of Saint-Tropez Peony, the sweetness of Sicilian Orange, and the juiciness of Romagna Peach. The entire creation is supported by solid foundations ensuring structure, thanks to precious woods like African Ebony and Australian Sandalwood, combined with Musk, Grey Amber, Indian Patchouli, and Tuscan Oak Moss, creating an enveloping and sensual base that embraces the wearer like a lasting hug. Torpè captures the vibrant and lush essence of the Mediterranean coast. Its accords evoke the meeting between the turquoise sea and the sun-kissed olive groves, creating an unforgettable olfactory experience.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tuttle Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tuttle is a periodic comet in our Solar System and belongs to Halley’s comet family. Due to this origin, and in line with the stylistic project of Paolo and Tiziana, the Tuttle fragrance also clearly echoes and resonates with the Halley creation from the same Comete collection.Tuttle is one of the comets with the greatest beneficial influence on our universe, thanks to its orbit, which is among the closest to Earth, and like all comets, it brings joy, wonder, astonishment, and a great deal of hope to humankind! A precious tribute to happiness, dedicated to those who know how to look at comets with the dreamy eyes of a child.The creation opens with a sparkling and joyful bouquet of fruits and citrus, with Sicilian Grapefruit taking the lead, embraced by the wild strength of Cassis and the revolutionary Peach from Romagna, used for the first time in perfumery and a worldwide exclusive of the Terenzi olfactory library. This lush opening settles into a rich and opulent heart, where the echoes of royal white flowers are also felt, with the Tuberose, Magnolia, and Iris standing out, expertly blended with Lily of the Valley and Royal Jasmine, thanks to the aphrodisiac seduction of the precious and rare Grey Amber. The base of the creation rests on imposing and precious foundations, yet at the same time light and effervescent, guaranteeing long-lasting persistence while simultaneously enhancing its projection over incredible distances. The power of Red Patchouli, combined with the sweetness of Indian Sandalwood, contrasts with the wild forest scent of Italian Birch, accentuated by the Caribbean freshness of Cuban Cedar. This majestic rush of woods is enveloped in the exotic scent of Haitian Vetiver, which adds an unpredictable and innovative touch to the entire creation. The Comet Tuttle will bring to your souls the sparkling joy and happiness that will make the light in your eyes shine, making you incredibly fascinating and irresistible. The comet’s trail in a drop of unique and inimitable perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tyl Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Here rises Tyl, star of the Draco constellation. The fragrance is born from the inspiration and evolution of Draco and pushes toward an unexplored boundary, too complex and expensive to be realized before, bringing to life a unique and entirely new scent. The precious musky notes emphasize and reverberate the golden amber, enlivened by citrus fruits, yet delicately balanced by the grace of flowers and the generosity of vanilla. A starry symphony that can float lightly over the body like a gentle caress and cradle the soul of the child within us!

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Tyrenum Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The creation is inspired by the famous city of Apulia, now known as Trani, once called Tyrenum, a land washed by the sea and battered by the wind, where for centuries sailors from all over the world have loved to seek refuge, enchanted by its captivating beauty. Paolo and Tiziana continue their search for the scent of salt, now arriving in beautiful Apulia to discover the marine salt and its olfactory peculiarities. Trani is known by the motto "Beauty that looks at the sea," because all its most important monumental works are facing the sea and are reflected in the sea. A sunset walk along the city's waterfront is enough to take your breath away and leave the traveler mesmerized forever.A bond, that with the sea, that becomes strong and unbreakable, just like the fragrance Tyrenum which captures the spirit of wonder on the wings of the intense breezes that collect the scent of salt and the pinkish white tuff limestone stones that characterize the city in the colors and reflections of the great blue Adriatic Sea. The creation opens with a sparkling and innovative citrus bouquet where the Bergamot of Reggio Calabria and Brazilian Orange echo, embraced by the effervescent freshness of Himalayan Osmanthus and Sri Lankan Green Tea, sweetened by the strength of Apulian Caramel. This acrobatic balance of fresh and sweet notes settles onto the heart of the fragrance, where the Marine Breeze blows powerfully, carrying the scent of iodine and Adriatic Sea salt, flavored with the sharp counterpoint of Pink and Black Pepper with Guatemalan Cardamom. The structure of the base is as sturdy and tenacious as the stone that holds the city together, and we perceive the bold notes of precious Apulian Olive wood and Indian Patchouli, mixed with the aphrodisiac sweetness of Musk and Grey Amber, a precious gift of the sea, supported by the strength of Trani Stone and the caress of Madagascar Vanilla Berries. Tyrenum captures the spirit of the Marine Breeze in the summer sunsets by the sea, enveloping in hypnotic mystery those who know how to look beyond the horizon.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Ursa Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The story of this fragrance begins around Lake Como. A body of water that has always fascinated us because it is so deep that it far surpasses the sea where we live, yet it is surrounded by a spectacular mountainous backdrop. The lake is located in a basin surrounded by forested mountains, offering a landscape with the most varied and fragrant aspects. Along its shores alternate meadows, forests, rugged and imposing rocks, picturesque villages overlooking the water, and beautiful villas with parks and gardens. The center of the lake, where the three branches meet, is the point with the mildest climate and the broadest panorama. We loved to reach this water crossroad by boat to enjoy the best view of the entire Bellagio promontory, the northern Grigna that dominates the Valsassina valley, and, on clear days, the upper basin with the Alpine range in the background.The most familiar and beloved place has always been the Lecco branch, which offers a more rugged and evocative panorama, with the southern Grigna, of dolomitic origin, and the Corni di Canzo which, descending towards the lake, form picturesque coves and inlets. Our favorite refuge was the Fiumelatte spring, described by Leonardo da Vinci. This stream, which had intrigued Leonardo da Vinci, had enchanted us as children because of its unique peculiarity in the world: the stream flows with a regular intermittent flow from March 25th to October 7th. The water emerges from a mysterious cave full of fragrances that would be impossible to verbalize, beyond being reductive. A place where the perfumer's alchemy came to life before anywhere else. The rock of the cave itself smelled. After the arch through which the stream flows only at specific intervals, here is its bed which appears like a true lunar landscape, shrouded in the cosmic darkness of a place where natural light never filters through.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Uxalpha Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Uxalpha, another marvel of the Luna collection, comes to life on a May night when the pristine sky over Paolo and Tiziana’s hills revealed to them the secret of a shining star. Alpha, the brightest star of the Lynx constellation, shone with the energy of 700 suns, illuminating the darkness with a vivid and contagious light. From that enchanted experience came the inspiration to create a fragrance celebrating the vitality and brilliance of souls that never stop shining. Uxalpha is a hymn to power and radiance, dedicated to those who emit light and vitality at every moment. This essence captures the strength of the Alpha star, guiding its wearer through an olfactory journey exploring the energy and luminosity of the Lynx constellation. The uniqueness of Uxalpha, as well as its companion Ixbeta, lies in its ability to blend with other fragrances from the constellation, creating unique and inimitable combinations. By exploring the Lynx constellation, you will indeed have the chance to discover the art of intergalactic layering, harnessing the astral fusion of the fragrances inspired by it: Lince, Uxalpha, Ixbeta, and Lincys.The top notes of Uxalpha open with a fresh burst of Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Orange, and Pink Grapefruit. This citrus symphony awakens the senses with its sparkling vivacity. At the heart of the fragrance, Cuban Cedarwood introduces a warm and enveloping woody note, while Mexican Coconut and Musk add an exotic sweetness. Italian Labdanum completes the heart with its resinous depth, evoking the magic of a tropical night under the starry sky. The base notes of Uxalpha offer a rich and complex foundation: Grey Amber imparts a warm, mysterious richness, while Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla and Turkish Caramel add a velvety and inviting sweetness. Indian Red Patchouli closes the composition with an earthy and intense note, creating an olfactory symphony that shines with warmth and passion. Uxalpha is an ode to inner brightness and vitality, a sensory journey celebrating the ability to radiate strength and beauty to the whole world.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Vele Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This work is born from the discovery of a constellation, that of the Sails, visible in a distant land, on the other side of the Atlantic Ocean, in the Southern Hemisphere. It tells the story of an exotic and mysterious land through the eyes of two children who, for the first time, were about to embark on a journey as long as it was adventurous.For the first time, in fact, Paolo and Tiziana were traveling to the unknown land where Aunt Marzia lived, the sister of their father Evelino and the daughter of their beloved grandparents: the “extravagant” Brazil. From the very beginning, the air around them was electrifying, and everything smelled of adventure. A real discovery that would change their lives forever. A true explorer's journey, just like the ones dreamed through the pages of the most fantastic books. They would take their first airplane and fly above a sky never before seen, touching the River of January, Rio de Janeiro, before veering towards Salvador de Bahia: the blackest city in Brazil, where more than anywhere else in this land, the centuries-old tradition is alive and deeply rooted, to the point that it captures the soul and creates an instant sense of longing... saudade. Upon arrival, the entire family of the aunt was waiting for them, and it was immediately a celebration of embraces.The discovery finally begins in one of the most magical places on the planet, where nature merges with traditions and these with the rhythm of life. Everything flows at the natural speed of the sun, and everything quiets to the gentle rhythm of the phases of the moon and its pale glow. Paolo and Tiziana visit the colonial house of their aunt, surrounded by a large garden, where in the evening, a beautiful bonfire is lit, and together, in deep and cosmic intimacy, they listen to the bossa nova of Caetano Veloso, admiring their grandfather improvising a drum with steps and logs of wood to accompany these “new” syncopated rhythms, completely unknown to them. Suddenly, a world of new discoveries opens up, new flavors made from colorful exotic fruits, a sky so full of stars they had never seen before, and of course, new fragrances that luxuriantly cross every corner of their senses, until caressing their souls! Wonder was their faithful companion throughout their journey, and on one of these magical nights, around the lush fire, they finally encounter the constellation of the Sails.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Velorum Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Assoluto collection expands, as stars migrate in the firmament, with the creation of Velorum: the brightest star in the Vela constellation. From this magical effluvium that hails the echoes of distant samba rhythms, mixed with the splash of waves from the powerful ocean on the counterpoint of exotic fruits, a new dreamlike journey opens through the mysterious trail of the perfume of stardust. A pure and radiant extract, like the bright white light the star Velorum knows how to spread in the sky: subtle and ethereal, delicate and gentle, yet at the same time powerful and resonating, full of its authoritative, healing energy and harmonious persistence.The precious molecules enclosed in this creation have been carefully preserved in the private library of the Terenzi family for over 50 years, skillfully dosed with love in olfactory acrobatics, laid upon harmonic dissonances, capable of granting the privileged discoverers of this enchantment the exclusive magic of wearing a drop of star. A precious gift dedicated to true experts of the fragrance world, as only they can fully appreciate the uniqueness of the absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Verna Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Between the sea and the mountains of Liguria hides a village carved by time and shaped by the breath of the wind: Vernazza, one of the most precious treasures of the Cinque Terre. Here, where the waves gently break on the rocks and the brightly colored houses reflect on the crystalline water, every corner tells stories of a past still alive through those who inhabit it. In this place full of charm, under the silent shadow of the Black Moon, Paolo and Tiziana found themselves enveloped by a mysterious and evocative aura. It was here that the inspiration to create Verna was born, an olfactory tribute that captures the most authentic soul of this timeless village. When the sky darkens to a deep shade and the moon dissolves into a circle of shadow, the Black Moon is born, a symbol of rebirth and the search for new horizons. During a summer walk in Vernazza, while the village settled into the quiet of the evening, Paolo and Tiziana stopped at the small square by the harbor, where the scent of the sea mingled with that of the earth and every alley seemed to hold an ancient secret. The wind, laden with stories and traditions, blew like an omen, guiding the two siblings toward a new creation. Verna was born thus, as a tribute to the strength of new beginnings, celebrating the authentic essence of Vernazza and the transformative energy of the Black Moon.Verna opens with spicy and luminous notes that evoke the vitality of the village. The Saffron of the Cinque Terre intertwines with Chilean Pink Pepper and Bulgarian Rose, giving rise to a vibrant and enveloping start, like the intense colors of the houses dominating the landscape. At its heart, the fragrance becomes a sensual and complex embrace. Thai Ylang-Ylang and Indian Jasmine Sambac blend with Vernazza Cedarwood and Tuscan Leather, creating a warm and hypnotic symphony. Notes of Romagna Peach and Mexican Tuberose add a creamy sweetness, while Brazilian Coconut evokes a distant exoticism that harmonizes with Mediterranean beauty. The base is a tribute to the primordial strength of this land. Tigullio Fern and Ligurian Wild Fennel intertwine with Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla and Musk, while Oman Incense and Coumarin leave a seductive and persistent trail, like the memory of a sunset on Ligurian terraces. Verna transforms every breath into a fragment of eternity, dissolving time into an olfactory landscape illuminated by the mysterious energy of the Black Moon, where emotion and poetry reveal themselves in pure liquid essence.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi White Fire Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The silence of the snow, its dazzling white made alive and sparkling by the flicker of the flames of the fire. The good and clean aroma, simple and silvery, of the carefree laughter of a child, pure and gentle like a beloved caress. The campfire at high altitude above the glacier of the Alps in Italy. The stage of an adventurous and exhausting climb up to the peaks of Cevedale, with the excitement of an awakening at dawn in the impetuous silence of the vastness of the Dolomites. The crisp and pure air, the energizing freshness of the snow’s fragrance, the intoxicating oxygen, and the muffled scent of the fire on the ice in the glow of the first light of dawn. This fragrance encapsulates the unique sense of the imposing beauty of nature around us, still crystallized in our eyes, in our hearts, and in our most intimate olfactory memory.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi White Fire Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is the latest breakthrough in hair care. After years of research and development in our advanced laboratories, we have created a revolutionary method to perfume your hair with nature’s regenerative touch. Keratin is a very important molecule for hair health, with regenerating properties, but as it is animal-derived, it has objective environmental sustainability limits. For Cereria Terenzi, the environmental impact of our production is one of the core drivers in strategic decisions, as all of our commercial actions are based on a philosophy of eco-sustainability and social responsibility. That is why our research ventured into previously unexplored areas in search of plant-based molecules with zero environmental impact, capable of replicating the properties of animal keratin without harming our planet. Our discovery was astounding: not only did we find plant-based keratin, but through scientific studies and certified lab tests, we found that this rare and precious botanical molecule is at least 20 times more powerful and regenerative than animal-derived keratin. The final result is an exclusive Terenzi formula based on water and natural molecules, providing a gentle, fragrant wellness treatment for your hair, while also being ideal for the most delicate and precious fabrics and garments. Thanks to its special formula containing Phytokeratin and Anti-Dandruff agents, your hair not only stays beautifully scented, but is also nourished with new, natural and sustainable ingredients. Phytokeratin strengthens hair (clinical studies show an 85% increase in resistance) and improves elasticity (an 8% increase), while the anti-dandruff complex significantly reduces dandruff formation and prevents unpleasant scalp residues from appearing on clothing. Tiziana Terenzi Hair Therapy Perfume Mist is a true revolution in hair wellness – with each application, your hair receives a cloud of extraordinary fragrance, offering at the same time a regenerating and revitalising treatment while helping to prevent unsightly dandruff buildup.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Wirtanen Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The astonishing comet Wirtanen, more than many other comets, is surrounded by many mysteries still unresolved to this day, despite having a very short period in our view. The beauty of this celestial mystery gives its name to our creation, which opens with a citrus bouquet, where the Bergamot from Calabria echoes, paired with the gentleness of Ylang Ylang flower from the Philippines and the strength of Bulgarian Rose. This intense and determined head rests on a complex and effervescent base, where the freshness of Indian Black Pepper merges with a precious blend of two Oudh with different characteristics, one from Laos and the other from Cambodia, softened by the hypnotic allure of Night Jasmine and the rare Peony from the Himalayas, which gives the composition an echo of mystery and seduction. The heart finds its foundation on a complex and articulated base, where the sweetness of Caramel and Madagascar Vanilla embraces the intense fragrance of Indian Sandalwood, united with the seductive light of Ambergris and Musk, a famous combination from the Terenzi Library.Wirtanen is a creation with a strong and mysterious character that requires time to be appreciated, but at the same time has the ability to seduce with the softness of a caress, thanks to its balance between Oudh woods and caramel. A journey without destination towards the beauty of the infinite cosmos.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi XIX March Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Focarina of S. Giuseppe on the night of March 18th, at the gates of the spring equinox, is a tradition in our land to burn in large bonfires brushwood and remnants of winter, making room for the rebirth of spring. The scents in the air are intense and fresh, new yet ancient. In our region, all the men and women of the village gather around the great bonfire. The elderly tell stories to the children, and the bravest young people jump through the fire as a sign of challenge and to prove their courage. With this fire, all the sorrows and problems of winter are burned, and we wait with confidence for the arrival of the joy and cheerfulness that spring brings with it. From this fire, all the hopes for the coming days rise, like an apotropaic and collective prayer. A world of storytelling and ancient folk tradition that come together in this complex and absolutely innovative fragrance in its stylistic construction.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Zubenel Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: One of the most important and famous stars is Zubenel from the constellation Libra. The intergalactic journey of the Terenzi brothers continues, pushing beyond the boundaries of artistic perfumery. Their new journey is directed towards the Libra constellation, a path aimed at unveiling the secrets of its olfactory pyramid, a compositional endeavor with new and fascinating sensory vibrations. The raw materials composing the Absolute become protagonists of this almost dreamlike adventure, giving the fragrance an extension of depth and meaning that goes beyond simple aromatic notes. This creation captures the essence of the stars, wrapped in extremely precious molecules, whose composition is inspired by celestial architecture, a symphony of rare and precious notes, evoking the grandeur and mystery of the firmament. Zubenel creates a stunning and intoxicating atmosphere, as if the precious bottle that contains it held the starlight itself.The fragrance opens with the magical intensity of Grey Amber blending with Frankincense incense wrapped in the depth and unique sweetness of Australian Ambrette. The very rich and precious top note, yet extremely refined and gentle, settles on a very intense heart where Italian dark chocolate notes add intrigue and warmth, emphasized by the power of Grey Amber and softened by the sweetness of Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla. The entire creation is built on a base of precious woods with Indian Patchouli mingling with Australian Sandalwood, which warmly and mysteriously envelops also the birch wood from Romagna, all intoxicated by the persistent sweetness of Turkish Caramel. Zubenel is an elegant and celebratory creation of infinite beauty, reflected in a fragrance that enchants and fascinates the boldest personalities privileged enough to wear it.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Beau de Jour Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Classic. Sharp. Maverick. Beau de jour presents the perfectly groomed gentleman who considers every detail. He exhibits the best version of himself to the world, but beneath the surface is something deeper, refreshing and sublime in all its layers. A fresh, commanding entrance of lavender from provence introduces the clean and fervent facets of the beau de jour scent. the cool and refreshing open is further amplified with an infusion of an energetic hybrid of lavenders. The core beats with the herbal inflection of african rosemary and floral green geranium with its subtle mint inflection, a powerful contrast to the leather-like warmth of oakmoss and the electric green of basil. Patchouli and amber create an earthy foundation of radiant wood and sensual musky warmth, further elevating beau de jour’s refreshing notion of masculinity through the finish.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Bois Pacifique journeys to a feeling of endless freedom and vitality. Essence of cardamom recalls a sunlit radiance. Brilliant akigalawood spotlights the fresh, aromatic spice note of turmeric over a woody-spicy blend that instantly conjures a cool sensuality. One becomes lost in nature’s grandeur as the smooth, careening richness of olibanum essence and orris butter courses through the fragrance. Sandalwood, cedar and oakwood facets comprise the forest of Bois Pacifique – a staggering presence of majestic woods illuminated by streaks of awe-inspiring solar light that emanate from a promising horizon.Notes of silver-sleek cardamom, fresh turmeric and akigalawood™ are warmed by the fiery resin, olibanum. The awe-inspiring vitality of deep, multi-dimensional woods – cedar, oakwood and sandalwood – takes root in opulent, amber-vanilla notes.

listings.description: Ébène Fumé All Over Body Spray is a refreshing and invigorating way to wear the Private Blend fragrance. All Over Body Spray is an energizing way to experience Ébène Fumé. The woody, amber fragrance with meditative notes is expressed in a light, fragrant spray. How to use: Spray once or twice on clean skin in the desired areas. Do not rub the fragrance into the skin, as this may alter its olfactory development.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Ébène Fumé is a purifying breath of exquisite exhilaration. The scent is ignited by the curl of palo santo smoke, a breath of fresh air that lifts the soul inspired by the purifying benefits of the legendary burning wood. Palo santo wood releases a mystical aromatic essence that blends together earthy notes, woods, citrus, incense and a soothing breeze of pine needles. The opening ceremony is joined by black pepper absolute and violet leaf expressed by a woody earthiness. The heart of Ébène Fume is highlighted by the smoky leathery notes and drywood undertones of essence and the warm, elegant resin of Spain Orpur cistus absolute. Papyrus essence and magnificent flowers mingle with gorgeous roses, while exquisite African ebony, a wood the color of the darkest night and equally seductive, is captured in sublime notes of leather and resins. Reinforcing the African ebony is the warm, woody, smoky seduction of guaiac wood and natural balsams.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Chic Mamma Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: The fragrance opens with the energy of green roses and red fruits. It then reveals a wonderful heart of rose and jasmine embraced by a powdery accord and chamomile. In the base, amber, musks, and patchouli, along with veloutone, add a comforting touch to the entire composition. A tribute to two undisputed and indisputable Italian "institutions." The Italian Mamma, a sort of mythological creature, famous worldwide for her uniqueness: protective, present, supportive, anxious, and with a strong attachment to her family, especially her children. A great cook and an incomparable nurturer; impossible not to love. The elegance that distinguishes our Italian culture and unites all mothers.“Chic Mamma is dedicated to our mother, whom we always carry in our hearts, and to all Italian mothers who are a symbol of love and elegance.” Chiara and Andrea Valdo

Bergamot, myrtle and nutmeg are enveloped by a fresh scent of geranium, sage and vetiver, before embracing a warm and comforting woody base of amber, frankincense and white musk.Myrtle grows in wild abundance in Sardinia and is a symbol of this proud, untamed land. An essence called ‘Water of the Angels’ is made from myrtle flowers, with toning and astringent properties. Myrtle essential oil is also well-known for its balm-like, anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. A collection dedicated to those who love the satisfying tranquillity of water and nature.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Riso Eau de Toilette 1.5 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the delicate cloud that the rice fragrance leaves on your skin, wrapping you in an all-enveloping embrace and sensation of comfort. The fresh, ethereal impact then evolves into creaminess, warmth and a pleasant, clean sensation generated by the deep notes of amber, vanilla and musk.Rice has always been a prized ingredient in Italy, especially in the Vercelli area of the Lame park, where one of the most famous and important Italian rice varieties is grown: Arborio. Rich in extraordinary properties, this plant is so versatile that is indicated both for dry skin, to provide nourishment and softness thanks to its lipid component, and for oily skin, as the starch absorbs excess sebum.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Scherma Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: A refined and mysterious fragrance, reminiscent of the captivating moment when the fencer is about to score the winning hit. Nutmeg, black saffron and geranium encounter a distinctive ylang-ylang heart, before surrendering to the deep scents of leather and wood. Fencing is one of the world’s oldest sports, steeped in charm, elegance and tradition. Our journey unfolds in one of Italy’s longest standing and most prestigious schools, founded in 1882 in an exclusive men’s club in the dynamic, elegant and refined city of Milan.The Scherma line is based on black tea, an excellent ally in combating the signs of skin ageing, thanks to its highly compacting and antioxidant action.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Spritz Veneziano Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: Inebriating, aromatic and sparkling, this perfume is a bubbly cocktail of joy! A prosecco accord wrapped in the energy of lemon and elemi blends with an intense heart of orange, davana and rosemary before giving way to rich notes of vanilla, amber and musk. Its fresh and energising touch cannot fail to provoke a spontaneous and resounding smile.A tribute to the irresistible long drink that has conquered and entertained the world over, offering magical moments of conviviality and all the emotion of an Italian lifestyle: Spritz Veneziano is a line with an inebriating, aromatic and sparkling scent, formulated with rhubarb extracts, which have antioxidant properties, cinchona extract, for a deep-down detoxifying action, and orange extract, which promotes collagen production and tones the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Tiramisù Eau de Toilette 1.5 ml
listings.description: The incredibly creamy heart of a tiramisu you can't resist!An olfactory interplay with all the different shades of tiramisù to reproduce its delicious creaminess. Contrasts between its tender sweetness and the touches of cocoa that reverberate with spirited pink berries, lively pepper and soft milk cream. A cocoa butter delight and an unforgettable tiramisù accord blend with soft vanilla, benzoin, beeswax and cocoa.A symbol of Italian cuisine, tiramisu is one of the best-loved, most imitated and most envied desserts in our tradition: a true masterpiece of gluttony created by the Made in Italy imagination.. An ever-present temptation to pleasure becomes an expression of home, family and union.

listings.rawTitle: Tuttotondo Vela Eau de Toilette 100 ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with an olfactory adventure in the blue sea! Vela Eau de Toilette is a fresh and aquatic fragrance with crisp marine notes that blend with enveloping hints of white flowers, before immersing in the depths of musk and patchouli. Sailing is a sport with a fascinating history, which makes it possible to reawaken the great sense of wellbeing provided by contact with nature. This line is inspired by the sea and the adventurous spirit that characterises Naples’ historic rowing and sailing club.It is formulated with sea water, rich in precious minerals, which restructure and improve skin tone, promoting hydration and revitalising the cutaneous tissue.

listings.rawTitle: Vilhelm Parfumerie Back to the Roots Eau de Parfum 50 ml

First, the breeze brings you floral notes that are fresh, white, and pure. Then, green sensations appear: deep, fascinating, and woody. They whisper a mystical charm that envelops your mind and body. Here, the balance of this untainted symphony procures a feeling of delicate harmony.Breath, inspire, enjoy. It’s time to calm down. Back to the roots...

For Johann Friedrich Struensee, doomed doctor of the Danish court, it meant a picnic with his love and their friends on the last night before his death. As always, champagne and figs, his favorite fruit, were on the menu, as dusk turned the sky purple. Joy and tears, sorrow and laughter, a bitter sweet cocktail that lives on in this Purple Fig.

listings.rawTitle: Vilhelm Parfumerie Sparkling Jo Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Following Joséphine Baker’s frenetic steps, Vilhelm Parfumerie has translated this entrancing party rhythm into a sparkling fragrance. A homage to the night, an ode to Joséphine.. As soft as a feather boa’s caress, as bubbly as a glass of Champagne, Sparkling Jo is a rambunctious invitation to live a festive and bright, never-ending night. A mix of lightheartedness and fun, it’s what partying is all about.. The Master Perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour has captured the essence of party life by creating this scintillating perfume with hints of pear. This fragrance celebrates the joie de vivre of the most American of all Parisians.

listings.rawTitle: Vilhelm Parfumerie Stockholm 1978 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The right place at the right time, that summer in the Swedish capital: a serene and intoxicating time in a city that was to become a place of congregation and celebration. Crisp lemon, warm almond, an uplifting spray of geranium with the tang of patchouli and a drift of faraway green fields floating on a summer breeze – the ABBA era.

listings.rawTitle: Vilhelm Parfumerie Sun Cities Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The sun cities offer a marvelous haven, an encounter between opulence and refinement, between history and desire. Don’t think it’s a refuge or a great escape: it’s a magical place where the heart and mind are recharged. A powerful journey. Peacefully, the senses awaken here. As a call to greatness, your sacred fire reveals your secret desire.Between sun and opulence, between movement and calmness, Sun Cities is a powerful creation that invites you to a daring quest. What do you dream of?

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Ballroom Bohème Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the early hours of December 12, 1877, nothing could stop the evening’s guests at the Court Opera. The Viennese, addicted to the waltz, pushed aside the chairs and took over the hall, defying an imperial ban on dancing. A tribute to the waltz, the Opera Ball, and Viennese blood.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Elysion Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A fragrance as intangible as Klimt’s golden vision of he Elysian Fields: “an ideal realm, wherein alone we can find pure joy, pure happiness, pure love.” It wears like a subtle, immaterial cloak of bright light,verdant freshness and subdued florality.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Ex Voto Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Within the silence of sacred stone walls and smooth marble floors, flickering altar candles radiate hints of wax, ashes and chilled frankincense.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Freudian Wood Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the world of Freud, wood stands for sexual desire in general and the female bosom in particular. A milky fragrance that captures intimate skin feeling – with animalic and lactonic notes vibrating around a luscious woody core.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Hesperia Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the open doors of the Orangerie, bright notes of green and golden citrus flow into the crisp morning air of the palace gardens.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Klubwasser Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Celebrating the centuries old philosophical concept of the man that is unspoiled by civilization, this fragrance highlights the raw beauty of uncultivated nature. Freshly broken twigs, spiced grasses and dark green nettles mark the path of the noble savage through the undergrowth of the wooded hills.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Nord Du Nord Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: High above the mountain forests, between snow fields and bare rock, the crystal-clear nocturnal sky carries the scent of cold wood and eternal ice.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Palais Nizam Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Franz Ferdinand in India: After a day of elephant riding, tiger hunting and coin shooting, tobacco and spirits are served beneath the arcades of Chowmahalla.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Sale Marino Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: When the Bora wind whips the black waters of the Quarnero, a fresh, salty mist engulfs the Coast of Laurels, the grand riviera of Imperial Austria.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Therion Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A dark, spicy warmth reveals the presence of the great beast. Typhon, or Typhoeus, once ruled the deepest realms of Hades. Klimt places him at the center of the hostile forces, in shades of black, brown and uncanny blue.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Unheimlich Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: According to Freud, the uncanny is the familiar and the unfamiliar at once. This fragrance is an attempt to capture that quality: Dark, clean, dirty, innocent, erotic, unsettling and intriguing at the same time, there is no familiar category that fits this composition.

listings.rawTitle: WienerBlut Volkamaria Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the cafés overlooking the grand avenue and along the shaded parkways, everyone is talking about the same novelty: a soft, milky, almost exotic trail, inspired by a curiously named plant that has conquered the city. It's Volkamaria, an Eau de Parfum that plays with delicate contrasts and transforms them into disarming elegance.. It opens with a luminous flash of Calabrian Bergamot and Green Mandarin: crisp, vibrant, and capable of immediately invigorating the composition. Their citrusy burst slowly fades into the velvety softness of Moroccan Rose, a romantic touch that warms the atmosphere without weighing it down.. The heart is the real coup: Florentine Iris and French Iris intertwine in a silky, elegant, almost powdery blend. It's here that Volkamaria reveals its most sophisticated side. Heliotrope, with its creamy sweetness, rounds out the whole and adds a sense of comfort, like a soft, enveloping light.. The final trail is a warm whisper of Tonka Bean: delicious, sensual, and a little mysterious. It closes the fragrance with a lingering embrace that lingers naturally on the skin.. Volkamaria Eau de Parfum is a successful balance of freshness, sweetness, and sophistication. Easy to wear, yet never boring: it's the ideal choice for those seeking an elegant, versatile, and instantly recognizable fragrance, perfect for both workdays and evenings that deserve a special touch.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff 40 Knots spray deodorant 100 ml
listings.description: 40 Knots represents the pleasure of yachting and cruising on the enchanting Mediterranean Sea and reflects all the colors of marine life.. Each natural deodorant is created with a composition of essential oils and pure essence at its base, making the experience more intense thanks to its no-gas and no-propellant properties. This allows the fragrance to last longer on the skin while giving it a feeling of softness.. Xerjoff Natural Deodorant Spray remains true to its commitment to sustainability and its approach to environmental protection, using recycled and recyclable materials for the packaging.. Olfactory Family: Woody, OrientalTop Notes: Bergamot, Somali incense, CardamomHeart Notes: Jasmine sambac, Cedar, Guaiac wood, Mysore sandalwood, Cistus labdanumBase Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Musk

listings.description: The Join the Club collection of Xerjoff perfumes represents a series of exclusive clubs, from art and poetry to yachting and golf. The JTC 400 perfume seeks to entice, exhilarate and excite, much like the unique shopping experience that this perfume takes its inspiration from Oxford street is the world's biggest high street and offers over a mile of unrivalled shopping, and this perfume takes its inspiration from one of the most celebrated retail stores in the world, located in Oxford Street, 400, London.The philosophy of the Join the Club Collection is to keep each perfume's ingredients secret, instead its olfactory links are to be discovered and devoured.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Accento Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Indulge in the romance of Accento Xerjoff, a fruity scent with undeniably elegant flair. Opening with top notes of fresh pineapple and hyacinth, this refined perfume has a classic heart of jasmine, iris and pink pepper. A warm base of patchouli, amber and musk offers a classic undertone.Rich and mysterious, the V collection by Xerjoff celebrates the tactile beauty of velvet. Soft and intense, each scent of Accento Xerjoff is evocative of pure luxury.

Accento Overdose by Xerjoff opens to fruity, green top notes, with a fresh heart of eucalyptus and Mediterranean pine which offers an elegant edge.A gorgeous base accord of Egyptian jasmine and Bulgarian rose cements the opulent character of Accento Overdose.Rich and mysterious, the V Collection by Xerjoff celebrates the tactile beauty of velvet.Soft and intense, each scent is evocative of pure luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Al-Khatt Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Discover Al-Khatt, a sensual invitation to a far-off land.Crafted by Xerjoff's master perfumers using traditional pure oud distillation, Al-Khatt takes its name from the ancient 'Travels of Ibn Battuta' manuscript. Opening with fresh Italian bergamot and jasmine sambac, this scent has a heart of cashmere accords for a truly seductive take on traditional Arab perfume making.A warm, sweet base of vanilla, Laotian buaya, Bangladesh oud and Assam oud makes for a truly intoxicating blend.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria II Attar 15 ml
listings.description: Alexandria II opens with its sublime lavender, rosewood, cinnamon and rare fruity accords.A touch of rose in the backbone of Alexandria II enriches the lavender and deepens the rosewood.The Laotian oud brings a celestial meaning to this aromatic woody aura and echoes the excellent vanilla amber base.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria II Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the ancient Arabian art of perfumery, Alexandria II is a scent steeped in history and rich culture. Alexandria II Xerjoff opens with fruity hints of apple that meet floral lavender and rose wood, it leads to a classically oriental heart of cedar wood, lily of the valley and Bulgarian rose.Inspired by the thousand year old capital city, Alexandria II Xerjoff has warming base notes of amber, sandalwood and precious Laotian oud.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria II Hair fragrance 30 ml
listings.description: The natural ingredients in Alexandria II Perfumed Hair Mist make for beautifully nourished hair.Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects help hair keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.This rich essence leaves the hair scented with the opulent notes of the precious perfume Alexandria II, while nourishing the hair and awakening the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria II Anniversary Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The essence of a masterpiece.Alexandria II Anniversary is emblematic of the complexity and triumph of Alexandria and Alexandria II from the Oud Stars Collection.A unique creation that honours the conception and significance of the two prestigious perfumes.Alexandria II Anniversary opens with the deep yet sultry tones of Bulgarian rose, cumin and cardamom, smoothly blended at the heart with the most prosperous and precious ingredient in the world: oud.Collected from the depths of the Bornean jungles, the finest Tarakan oud adorns the composition, casting a powerful spell on those who experience it.Presenting an opulent and lustrous new look, this sophisticated scent closes with a warm embrace of musk and vanilla from Madagascar, blended with Australian sandalwood leaving an unforgettable mark on those who wear Alexandria II Anniversary.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria III Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Discover Xerjoff Alexandria III; a heady journey across the Orient, created in collaboration with Kostas, Xerjoff's Brand Ambassador. Rare Laotian oud and Bulgarian rose blend with woody top notes of cinnamon, rosewood and lavender for an irresistibly indulgent scent. The rarest and most desirable ingredient, intoxicating Laotian Oud evokes the most exotic lands, captivating and enchanting with every wear.Alexandria III Xerjoff is part of the Oud Stars Collection, a tribute to traditional Arab perfumery created from pure oud distillation.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria Orientale Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Originally created exclusively for the United Arab Emirates, Alexandria Orientale is an Arabic treasure that pays homage to the most complex and alluring ingredient of all, oud. Oriental in character, this unique scent opens to top notes of green apple, basil and incense from Oman.Now available worldwide, Alexandria Orientale is rare and precious with every turn, a lush heart of Italian orris, Bulgarian rose and coriander lead the nose to a warm, earthy base of Indian sandalwood, tobacco leaves and oud.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Allende Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Allende perfume is as rare as the meteorite from which it takes its name. An intoxicating vortex of vanilla and magnolia, this gourmand scent is beautifully sophisticated, with the most delicate, elegant character. In Allende by Xerjoff, top notes of Madagascan vanilla and magnolia come to life on the skin at first touch, gently leading the nose to a heart of cocoa and vanilla. The irresistible vanilla base offers a beautiful conclusion to this refined scent.Allende is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of the meteorite.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Amabile Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The perfume structure of Amabile follows the path laid down by Accento and Erba Pura; timeless avant-garde perfumes recognizable for their sparklingly fresh top notes; pleasantly acidic notes of fresh fruits blended with floral and spicy notes. The result is an exceptional perfume that is particularly persistent over time, a widely recognized result that has inspired many.Amabile has an exquisite ingredient structure that perfectly matches the style of its two predecessors.

Designed to be worn separately or mixed on the skin to create endless combinations, this harmonious set of layering perfumes gives the wearer the freedom to dose and experiment as they please, with total control over the resulting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Amber Star & Star Musk Set 2x50 ml
listings.description: Discover the power of harmonious scent with Amber and Musk, a box set of blending perfumes: Amber Star and Star Musk. Designed to be mixed on the skin to create endless combinations, these sensual scents offer a smooth musk in a blooming blend. Amber Star opens to top notes of cedar and amber with a warming heart of gurjum balasam and base notes of vanilla bourbon and sandalwood.Star Musk takes on a more floral character, with mandarin zest opening into Haitan vetiver, underpinned by musk and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Apollonia Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Apollonia; is a truly unforgettable experience inspired by the enchanting night sky. Evoking the charm and mystery of deep space, it exudes the beauty of a dark sky illuminated by a sea of shining stars. Delicately floral in character, Apollonia opens to top notes of white flowers, leading to a fragrant heart of iris butter and closing with a classic white musk base.A rare and precious Xerjoff perfume that comes to life on the skin.This perfume is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of the meteorite.

With Shamama accord, anis and pink pepper, Astaral’s beauty is revealed, gradually making way for rose, labdanum absolute and violet at the heart.A sophisticated scent whose beauty soars, Astaral settles to base notes of patchouli, oud and moss.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Aurum Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Best described as the olfactory equivalent of gold, Aurum is as decadent as its name sake. Irresistibly romantic and seductive, tempting rose, chocolate and strawberry all conjure the most sensual notes.Like the most precious metal from which it takes its name, Aurum captivates and entices as it warms against the skin, revealing hints of its opulent character as time goes by.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Black Sukar Attar 15 ml
listings.description: Balmy and floral, Black Sukar opens with peony and freesia.A scrumptious atmosphere follows the trend with the growing notes of Laotian oud, and the smoky petals of the Damask rose.The sugary sweetness of vanilla and musk compose the base layer and orchestrate a seamless oriental and floral delicacy.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Blue Hope Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Complex and intriguing, Blue Hope is an olfactory experience like no other. Defined by its oriental character, this scent takes the nose on an unexpected journey through fresh bergamot to classic jasmine and cedar wood. A comforting base of vanilla and musk adds an irresistibly nostalgic undertone.This perfume is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of the meteorite.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Ceylon Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Ceylon by Xerjoff is a deliciously sensual journey to the teardrop of India, setting the senses alight with every twist and turn.Classically oriental in character of Ceylon, it opens to warm honey, fresh bergamot and jasmine sambac from India, delicately trailing into an enticing heart of black tea, Malaysian oud and Indian sandalwood.A suitably warm base of Madagascan vanilla, amber and musk comes to life on the skin, revealing its complex and intoxicating character as time goes by.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Duran Duran Black Moonlight Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Sensuous, daring and irresistibly evocative, Black Moonlight accompanies the wearer on a journey deep into the heart of the night, where untold secrets whisper and the edge of darkness ignites intrigue. Inspired by the interplay of light and shadow that defines Duran Duran’s music, this exquisite scent embodies the allure of mystery and the quiet power of self-expression.Black Moonlight wraps the wearer in a veil of sophistication, daring the mind to explore the enigmatic corners of the soul and celebrate the complexity within. Bergamot and mandarin awaken the senses, whilst saffron, lavender, sambac jasmine and hazelnut envelop the senses in an intimate embrace.It’s all grounded by the base notes of patchouli, vetiver, tonka bean and benzoin to create a sensual, timeless scent that mirrors Duran Duran’s legacy: constantly-transforming yet introspective – a harmonious blend of art, innovation and emotion.The name of the perfume is printed on the flacon and coffret in Simon Le Bon’s handwriting.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Duran Duran NeoRio Parfum 50 ml Orange
listings.description: NeoRio is a testament to limitless creativity and artistic fusion. Bold and captivating, it mirrors Duran Duran’s ever-evolving spirit and boundary-breaking energy, a quality embedded in Xerjoff’s DNA. Past, present and future collide in a perfume as magnetic and unpredictable as the band itself.The first Xerjoff perfume to feature four distinct variations of its illustrious iconic flacon, NeoRio combines an irresistible burst of candied fig and rum with the sparkling freshness of elemi absolute, before unfolding with the fiery warmth of saffron and the elegance of soft rose oil, all anchored by the creamy richness of Tonka bean and the timeless depth of balsam from Peru. A celebration of boundless energy, freedom, and the thrill of life's most exhilarating moments.The name of the perfume is printed on the flacon and coffret in Simon Le Bon’s handwriting.

listings.description: In honour of Elle, the first perfume born into the first collection ever created in the Xerjoff portfolio, 17/17, the much-adored scent is celebrated with the creation of Elle Anniversary, a sensual and enchanting scent inspired by the pure beauty that lies at the heart of Elle.Graceful and floral, the true spirit of Elle is carried in the flair and elegance of Elle Anniversary, scattered with light flecks of fresh notes in the opening, with lychee and bergamot at the top.A calming and uplifting heart, Elle Anniversary is threaded with delicate jasmine and warm cashmere wood that merge to create a rush of romanticism, which slowly settle to an illustrious base of amber, musk and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Ether Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: In Greek mythology, Ether, meaning pure, fresh air, was considered the pure essence breathed by the gods. The first spray of Ether hits with fresh, citrus notes of Italian Amalfi lemon, bergamot from Reggio Calabria and Mandarin, arousing the senses and preparing them for an aromatic heart of clary sage, lavender and a drop of benzoin.Ether draws to a base of warm sandalwood from Ceylon and musk, with sweet hints of vanilla and caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Fars Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by traditional Arab perfume making, Fars is a harmonious blend of East meets West, as crisp Italian bergamot and herbal French lavender blend for a classic oriental scent.Fars Xerjoff is created from pure oud distillation: this irresistibly luxurious perfume has base notes of patchouli, Haitian vetivers and buaya from Laos, otherwise known as White Oud. Exquisite, rare and precious, this meditative blend has a peppery heart of Egyptian geranium, sandalwood and jasmine absolute; a unique accord that enchants and entices.

listings.description: The Join the Club collection of perfumes represents a series of exclusive clubs, from art and poetry to yachting and golf. In keeping with the rare nature of these fragrances, ingredients are kept a closely guarded secret, instead inviting the wearer to immerse themselves in the imagined world.High fashion reigns supreme with Fatal Charme Xerjoff, a fascinating powdery and floral; scent; that mimics the luxurious world of couture.Artistic, effortlessly stylish and truly narcotic, this exquisite scent encapsulates all that is inspiring and indulgent about the world of fashion and beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Gao Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dark, deep and powerful, Gao is a scent based on a masterful blend of saffron and oud.Opening with a rare blend of Spanish and Iranian saffron, the nose is led to an earthy accord of nagarmotha, juniper berries and resinous gurjun balsam that calms and centres the mind. Oriental in spirit, a traditional base of patchouli, amber and white oud sourced from Laos feels suitably authentic.Gao perfume, a prestigious collection is created from pure oud distillation and is dedicated entirely to traditional Arab perfume making.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Golden Dallah Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Irresistibly warm and exotic, Golden Dallah offers an enticing journey through accords of coffee and fresh spices.Oriental and spicy in character, this precious perfume explodes on the skin with top notes of fresh, exotic spices. A rich heart of coffee absolute, incense and amber leads the nose to an earthy and inviting base accord of cocoa and tonka bean. This perfume has been created exclusively for the online store.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Golden Green Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Exclusively available online, this intriguing scent is part of the Coffee Break collection; a unique tribute to the ancient coffee trade.Golden Green centres on the purity of un-roasted raw green coffee beans, for a truly energising aroma. Opening to pink pepper, cardamom and juniper berries, it leads to an enchanting heart of incense, cedar wood and strong vetiver. The warming base of coffee and musk delicately rounds off the composition.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Golden Moka Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Golden Moka is a truly tantalising explosion of rich coffee and enlivening citrus.Created exclusively, this extraordinary perfume opens with fresh top notes of blood orange, mandarin and lemon. The nose is enticed in further with an earthy, warm heart of coffee absolute, Cambodian oud and amber. Irresistibly alluring and unique, Golden Moka Xerjoff closes with a base of incense and labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Groove Xcape Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A new realm reveals itself with a new chapter of Xerjoff Blends, between the notes of sound and scent.Sergio Momo and Max Casacci, co-founder of Subsonica and musical pioneer, have combined the sacredness of sound with perfumery’s most precious ingredients to create an unparalleled universe that explores the power of rhythm and scent, transporting the wearer to new, celestial heights. Casacci’s new track is created solely through the sounds of Xerjoff perfumes - the collision of the flacons, the swirling of the liquid and the hiss of the spray, mimicked in the Groove Xcape perfume’s metallic top notes through ginger, elemi, pepper and cardamom, while incense, mimosa and myrrh seep into the heart, emulating Max Casacci’s muse for mysticism.Groove Xcape leads to an exquisite base of labdanum, cedar wood and benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Hayat Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Taking its name from the Arabic for "life", Hayat is a complex story of the Aristotelian elements of the universe; earth, fire, air and water.Layered with such scents as saffron, cardamom, cedar wood and oud, Hayat from the Kemi Collection is an intriguing tale of light and shade. Zesty bitter orange undertones welcome top notes of aromatic lavender, while rare and precious saffron casts an intoxicating spell.Kemi is a collection of perfumes created from natural raw elements using innovative distillation techniques.

The Tony Iommi Monkey Special by Xerjoff Blends is what rock 'n' roll in the late '60s was for Iommi.Xerjoff pays homage to Tony’s Italian roots with tantalising top notes of bergamot from Reggio Calabria, rum, Bulgarian Geranium and passion fruit, opening to cinnamon, Bulgarian rose and patchouli at the heart. Australian sandalwood, ambergris, vanilla, Tonka bean, caramel and musk are at the base, rounding off this olfactory journey in a luxuriously sleek and gothic bottle, available online and in selected retails.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Torino 21 spray deodorant 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Torino 24 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: A scent that evokes the memories that come with the friendly indoor tennis match for Xerjoff’s fourth year as Silver Partner for the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin. The components that make up the match are captured in the blend, from the rubbery core of the tennis ball that bounces off the indoor court to the wooden tennis racket in hand.Deliciously enticing, TORINO24 opens floral and fruity with juicy mandarin, mango and plum that fuse with pink lotus absolute and orange blossom. TORINO24 draws to a warm close with moss, patchouli and white musk at the base.  A playful scent that leaves the senses yearning for more.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Uden Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Uden Xerjoff hits the nose like a surging wave, with sea spray and a bright marine breeze bringing the senses to life. Hitting top notes of zesty lemon and grapefruit, the citrus character of this fougère ;scent travels to a bright heart of rose, sandalwood and rum. Charmingly spirited and playful, base notes of vanilla, coffee and musk ignite to create a powerful presence.Uden perfume is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of the meteorite.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Uden Overdose Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Ten years after introducing Uden, one of the bestsellers in the Shooting Stars collection, Xerjoff powerful new version of the same perfume featuring a richer olfactive pyramid, Uden Overdose. Dance upon the waves of the ocean with Uden Overdose, an enchanting fougere fragrance like no other. Exuding power and strength with every note of Uden Overdose Xerjoff, this perfume is inspired by the tempestuous sea, with enticing top notes of lemon and bergamot. A dark heart of ginger, tobacco flowers and coffee leads to a rich base note of amber and musk. Uden Overdose is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of the meteorite.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Via Cavour 1 Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Xerjoff's  Spotlight Collection exclusively presents Via Cavour 1. Opening to top notes with quince and white peach, this delicate perfume is followed by hints of Moroccan rose, dark chocolate, red berries and patchouli at the heart. At the base, oud, caramel, amber, Madagascar vanilla and musk warm up the senses.This scent is named after the street where our Turin store is located, which in turn is named after  Conte  Camillo Benso di Cavour. He was one of the protagonists of  Italian Risorgimento, nicknamed  "Father of the Nation"  by no less than Giuseppe Verdi.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff XXY Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The true beauty of XXY lies in its unique, androgynous character.Inspired by the notion of a feminine and masculine divide, this fruity floral scent is delicately sprinkled with warm spices, for an intriguing and unconventional perfume. Top notes of Calabrian bergamot and grapefruit lead to a precious heart of ylang-ylang and black pepper. A warming base of mysore sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla offers up a classically masculine accord.The XJ 17/17 collection is inspired by the minerals and semi-precious stones on display at the Natural History Museum in London.

listings.rawTitle: Starline Bio anti-spot face cream 50 ml
listings.description: Super innovative cream formula that combines the powerful combination of active ingredients that protect the skin barrier from external aggressions and reduce skin pigmentation (dark spots, sunspots or age spots), regulating the natural production of melanin to prevent the appearance of skin discolorations. Active ingredients: The use of microscopic Starline vectors combined with specific active ingredients such as Phloretin (apple root and leaf, antioxidant activity), Naringin (Citrus Hassaku, tyrosinase inhibitory activity), Morinda Citrifolia (Inhibitor of melanogenesis), is the perfect combination of efficacy and safety to reduce the intensity and chromaticity of aging spots, as the bleaching molecules can reach melanocytes more effectively, controlling melanin biosynthesis and promoting a strong depigmenting, skin lightening, and anti-imperfection effect. In addition, a natural active molecule isolated from the oriental medicinal herb Ramulus Mori, has the strongest known inhibitory effect on tyrosinase (the enzyme that catalyzes melanin biosynthesis). Additionally, the presence of Hyaluronic Acid and Aloe Vera juice ensures that the skin stays well hydrated, while Shea Butter nourishes it, Almond and Argan oils make it elastic, and Vitamin E ensures antioxidant and emollient action. Pomegranate Extract prevents collagen breakdown and free radical formation, thus preventing tissue sagging and wrinkle formation. Result: Specifically for all skin types with discolorations and skin spots. The skin will appear brighter and with an even complexion. Suitable for sensitive skin as well.

listings.rawTitle: Starline Bio illuminating eye contour mask 30 ml

Additionally, thanks to Hyaluronic Acid and Aloe Vera juice, the skin is well hydrated, while Shea Butter and Olive Oil nourish it, and Vitamin E provides antioxidant and emollient action. Result: Thanks to a special pool of anti-aging actives, it helps to fight the first signs of aging by reducing wrinkles and expression lines, instantly giving a more vital look to the eye contour area. Suitable for all skin types.

listings.rawTitle: Starline Bio anti-aging eye contour cream 30 ml
listings.description: An extraordinarily effective cream product that serves as a true dermo-structurer. Formulated for the delicate eye contour area, it reduces fine lines and firms the skin thanks to the hydrophilic action of Hyaluronic Acid that hydrates the tissues. Active ingredients: Starline vector capsules containing a potent blend of biologically active molecules, such as N-Acetyl Glucosamine, Sodium PCA, Yeast Extract, and Phytoceramides (highly effective hydrating and anti-aging agents) as well as Salicin (a powerful anti-inflammatory agent derived from white willow), which carry the active ingredients deep into the skin. Additionally, a new generation of anti-wrinkle products based on Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid (50000 daltons) and Kaempferol (an effective inhibitor of hyaluronidase) works deeply to improve the viscoelastic properties of the skin and reduce deep wrinkles. Result: The special mix of antioxidant, revitalizing, and draining actives provides benefits to puffiness, swelling, and dark circles, brightening the eyes and giving the eye area a renewed youthful look. Suitable for all skin types.

listings.rawTitle: Starline Surgery contour eyes and lips cream 30 ml
listings.description: From the Starline laboratories, a lifting cream specifically designed for the delicate areas around the eyes and lips. With the presence of argan stem cells and biotechnological peptides, it delivers an instant smoothing effect on these sensitive facial areas, significantly reducing expression wrinkles. Active ingredients: Ornithine, a biotechnological amino acid, targets lipoatrophy. Encapsulated in a liposome, it reaches adipocytes and inhibits lipolysis. The accumulation of fat molecules in adipocytes increases their volume and diameter, resulting in a plumping effect. Saccharide Isomerate combats dehydration and wrinkles. Trifluoroacetyl Tripeptide-2, a biomimetic peptide of Elafin, an enzyme inhibiting progerin (a marker of skin senescence), reduces its accumulation in keratinocytes and fibroblasts. Progerin, whose levels increase with age, is associated with DNA replication defects and cellular damage that intensify wrinkles and skin sagging. This peptide remodels the skin and diminishes deep wrinkles. Crocus Chrysantus Extract promotes communication between epidermal and dermal cells, stimulating collagen and elastin production. listings.rawTitle: Compagnie De Provence Marseille solid soap 400 g
listings.description: This Marseille soap cube is made in Marseille and cooked in a cauldron, in accordance with tradition. This natural, authentic product is perfect for washing the hands and body, but is also recommended for washing delicate laundry and floors.To gently wash textiles (and especially delicate laundry items such as baby clothes, silk, lace, etc.), wet them, wash with the soap, working up a lather, then rinse carefully with clean water. You can leave your laundry to soak and should always rinse with cold water. To remove stubborn stains (grease, dirty shirt collars, etc.), rub them with the cube and machine-wash shortly after. To clean floors or make tiles shine, go over them with the Marseille soap then rinse thoroughly.
