listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga 85 Diesel Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: "In the '80s, my parents drove Toyotas and Hondas. They were cool. But around the corner, an Englishwoman drove the neighborhood kids to school in a 1985 300TD Benz. This candle is a tribute to that legend and smells like the air inside, so hot and dangerous.". DS & Durga 85 Diesel Candela is a bold, leathery home fragrance. It evokes the image of sitting on saffron-tanned leather seats, wearing clothes as thick as oriental rugs.. The aroma is lacquered, deep, chestnut-colored, crossed by puffs of freshly lit fuel: a warm, sensual and slightly brutal mix, which captures the rough and iconic aesthetic of those years.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Be Still Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Meditation is the foundation of my life. I see it as the key to stabilizing the spiritual, mental, and physical threads of being. Of course, you don't need any object to meditate, but I like to create a space for it at home. It's like an aromatic wall to shut out the restless world that seeks our attention. 'Be Still' is a simple formula: when you calm down, things begin to blossom.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Bergamot Superior Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: "I was walking against the current in rubber boots in a stream somewhere to the north. The cold water flowed from the lake downstream through the woods. I came across little island worlds in the stream: pristine, covered with freshwater-fed plants.". Wild bergamot weeds sing the language of citrus in spring thanks to the cool breezes of the water and Great Lake Superior.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Big Sur After Rain Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Rainwater in the eucalyptus groves along the highway. Young, green shoots, tapered leaves, damp undergrowth.. When it comes to breathtaking American vistas, Big Sur easily tops the list. The river flowing from the mountains flows into a mist-shrouded sea. The sunsets over the Pacific are something out of this world. From there, you almost feel the magnetic presence of Asia across the ocean.. Driving along Highway 1—top down—the highway has its own music: the howling wind, the car tilting curve after curve, each time revealing a new suspension bridge, a secret beach, a resonant mountain. Poets and mystics have always populated this enchanted place.. And the flora of the California coast is incredibly diverse. Big Sur thrives on its microclimate of heat and fog, a unique balance that creates an almost supernatural landscape.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Breakfast Leipzig Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: The brand wanted to create the scent of the café in Leipzig where Bach wrote his famous Java Cantata in the 1700s. They imagined tightly packed tables of people breakfasting over buttery almond pastries and strong coffee. Smoking pipes, reading newspapers, talking. Creamers of milk, kitchen steam, tobacco clouds, a hint of an old fireplace in the corner, and burgundy leather upholstery on the seats.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Concrete After Lightning Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Electric crackling, sudden downpours, a moment of panic, the smell of grass, the crisp steam rising from the asphalt. A respite from the sweltering summer days.. The smell that comes right after the rain is an aromatic genre loved by many.. Geosmin is the molecule responsible for that scent: it's released by bacteria in the soil when it rains. The fascinating thing is that geosmin mixes with the surrounding odors, transforming itself each time. In the woods, it smells damp, fresh, and earthy; in the city, it becomes the aroma of hot asphalt and concrete suddenly cooled by the rain.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Dream Lychee Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Last summer, I read Cao Xueqin's Dream of the Red Chamber, a family epic from 18th-century China. The spiritual world, Taoism, and poetry are intertwined with the mundane details of aristocratic life in Qing China. Time and again, the reader is privy to detailed descriptions of fantastic gardens and otherworldly kingdoms. Rare fruits, exquisite robes, elegant bushes, and striking flowers are everywhere. This is a quick poem about lychees, spoken in late spring from a garden pavilion set up to entertain the royal family. Light a fire and dream of lychees.. Spring is joyfully languishing. We sip tea at the Lily Rose Pavilion. The south winds now sing the lychee.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Holy Ficus Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: The revered fig tree of Siddhartha and Lord KṚṢṆA. Silently watch the flame for 7 hours and you may spy liberation.India is in our DNA. It is Kavi’s motherland and it has always called to me. It is a big source of inspiration for the brand. The Bodhi, a holy fig tree, is revered in India for its association with Lord Krishna. It is also the tree Gotama Buddha received enlightenment under. You can still visit the place where the tree stood (and stands replanted) in the Bihar state.. Holy Ficus is a loose fantasy based on the this tree. We took a classic fig accord and draped it in ginger, saffron, frankincense, and cardamom. It fills the room with a Indian spices, wonderful fruit, and hopefully a faded memory of something larger.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Parquet Leather Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Basketball is one of America's greatest gifts. It's a sport, but it's also a culture tied to music and fashion. It changes over time, reflecting the world it's part of. The strange story of hanging baskets in a gym seems far removed from the global phenomenon it has become. What does basketball's journey smell like? What ties the way it has evolved? The leather ball, the sneakers, the rubber, and the wood of the parquet floors.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Portable Fireplace Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: "Nothing is more welcoming than a fireplace. The hearth brings back that ancient desire for warmth. The smell of a fireplace alone makes us think of parties, holidays, the joys of cooler weather. Family gatherings, reading, romance.. In the fast-paced modern world, especially in cities, it's rarer to have a working fireplace or take the time to light a fire. It's a commitment. So we created the candle to give you the scent and sensation of a gentle fire roaring wherever you are.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Rama Won’t You Please Come Home Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: Diwali is a major holiday in India and South Asia. The festive atmosphere is everywhere. Families gather to clean, pray, and light candles to welcome Rama and Sita back from their exile in the forest, along with other religious events for Hindus, Jains, and Sikhs. I love the abundance of aromas found in India, from food to flowers and perfumes, which seem to be everywhere. Diwali candles, called diyas, are usually oil- or wax-based in clay lamps.. Our candle recalls the tree flowers and tropical woods of the forest where Rama and Sita were exiled, enriched by a heart of opulent white flowers - tuberose and gardenia.". Welcome Rama into your home with the flowers of the North Indian forest trees, tuberose, gardenia and bastard teak.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Salt Marsh Rose Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: "There are groves dotting some of my favorite places in New England: the coast north of Boston, Nantucket, MV, and the like. Hidden by old gray cedar houses, brackish groundwater bubbles up in the warm summer groves. Small ponds and marshy swamps come alive with birds, frogs, and dragonflies in summer. Large, heavy heads of mallow and wild roses shine like beacons in the damp, muddy grass.". A lazy stroll through hidden groves on the Cape Islands, where marsh roses and marsh mallows siphon salty tides. Ospreys hunt in the estuary's wetlands. Plovers make love.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Spirit Lamp Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: A tea set in the living room of a colonial house. Silver heated by an open flame. Steam, radiating heat, milk.. Spirit Lamp is supposed to evoke just that: the smell of a flame warming a silver tea set in a seedy corner of colonial Boston.. In the teapot, a legendary Bohea tea slowly boils. The steam that rises is fresh and airy, punctuated by hints of candied ginger and coconut milk.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Tomb of the Eagles Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: In the far north, where Orkney eagles carried Stoneage souls beyond the jagged cliffs, clover, sea pinks, sweet cicely, the sonorous sea.The Tomb of the Eagles lays under a farm by the sea all the way up on the island of Orkney. The journey to get there is long and breathtaking.Though in Scotland, Orkney has its own culture with overtones of old Norse ways. It has the largest amount of Stone Age sites in all of Europe. It feels central to some ancient wisdom, in tune with the landscape, the sea, the standing stones, and countless ruins.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Tuberose Myrrhder Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: The night queen’s suspended bulbs in the hour of darkness, caked with spicy Ethiopian myrrh, cacao, currant, and dank Madagascar vanilla.This is an intimate scent for tuberose lovers (like Kavi and me). It’s great for bedrooms, night rituals, or bathtime. A fantasy extracted from shadowy tuberose blooming at night. Deep red African myrrh to spice up a wonderfully realistic flower. It took many attempts to harmonize over 60 ingredients! Cacao, vanilla, ambers, currant, orris root concrete; all lead to a layered bouquet of white tuberose bulbs dangling in the dark of night.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Wild Brooklyn Lavender Scented candle 200 g
listings.description: "I moved to Brooklyn in 2002, I was 22. Almost everyone I knew was busy with something interesting. One night I left a poker game in Bushwick at 3:00 a.m. As I was walking down the street, I found myself confronted by a pack of wild dogs.. That's New York: raw, unpredictable, electric. It really seemed like anything was possible. You could even study the weeds sprouting from the cracks in the Brooklyn asphalt and, why not, build a perfume house from scratch.. DS & Durga Wild Brooklyn Lavender is a fougère candle. This candle celebrates the blossoming Brooklyn of the early 1980s, where packs of wild dogs roamed free in the wild weeds. Wild Brooklyn Lavender Candle is a scent that makes you feel like anything is possible.

listings.rawTitle: D'ORSAY 00:30 En Bas de Chez Toi Scented candle 80 g
listings.description: Marine Notes, Orange Blossom, Musk.A Woody, Musky fragrance evoking the first drops of rain on concrete, imagined by Vincent Ricord for D’ORSAY.With this scented candle, here we are: outside your door. Let’s imagine the moment: it hasn’t rained for eight years. A first drop falls, scenting the asphalt with a familiar Accord Marin, mixed with a hint of Orange. Delicious. The next moment, a deluge of Cedar. This fragrance might as well be in your home.How to use: when using it for the first time, light the candle until its entire surface becomes liquid, this will require about 4 hours of combustion. This will prevent the wax from becoming hollow later on or forming a well around the wick. Allow candle to solidify before relighting. Do not allow the candle to burn for more than 4 hours at a time during subsequent use. To extinguish the candle, it is recommended you use a snuffer to avoid smoke. Regularly cut the wick with the wick trimmer (ideal length 3-5 mm) to prevent the candle from emitting smoke and the wick falling into the wax. Should the wick require centering, gently readjust to correct position when the wax is still molten.Natural wax and sustainable packaging.

listings.rawTitle: D'ORSAY 17:30 Sans un Mot Scented candle 80 g
listings.description: Cardamom, Tuberose, Leather.A Floral evoking an electric afternoon, designed by Vincent Ricord for D’ORSAY.When Leather, Tuberose and Cardamom combine, you suddenly find yourself ablaze in the Mediterranean heat, standing atop a cliff top overlooking the sea. listings.rawTitle: Dyamond Candle Ambra Scented candle 170 g
listings.description: Amber is a sensual, intoxicating, enveloping, and mysterious ingredient, typically used in oriental perfumes, its olfactory notes telling tales of distant places, unsettling scenarios, and landscapes from "One Thousand and One Nights." The aroma of amber is woody and oriental. It is a combination of sweet fragrances, spices, and honey. Its notes are warm and powdery, imparting sweet tobacco and vanilla scents to fragrances. It purifies negative energies, calms the nervous system, and infuses a sense of warmth.The light from scented candles in glass jars creates a magical atmosphere. Lighting a few candles and placing them properly around the home can truly create an intimate, warm, and welcoming environment. Additionally, the simple act of lighting candles, with their gentle flicker, helps soothe and calm the mind.Simple and delicate, a candle provides light, warmth, and an alluring charm to the space it occupies. That’s why giving a candle, symbolically, means wishing light, hope, and warmth in the life of the recipient.The candle should be left burning for 30 to 60 minutes each time it is lit to encourage the melting of the first layer that forms a barrier. This process helps to prevent the formation of "tunnels" and ensures that wax residue does not remain on the edges.

listings.rawTitle: Dyamond Candle Arancia e Cannella Quadrato Class Reed diffuser 100 ml
listings.description: Ambient diffusers with natural Wengé sticks are an essential accessory for those who wish to add a personal touch to their environment, giving each room its own personality. They decorate our spaces, our homes, our offices, creating a new way to personalize the surroundings. The choice of diffuser and fragrance depends on personal taste and the intended use.From the diffuser, the fragrance is gradually released and fills the space with sweet sensations. Just like wearing our favorite perfume: the fragrance represents us and completes us. However, scenting a room or space is not always easy. Fragrances differ olfactorily into families or groups, based on their ability to fill a space differently from another. For this reason, it is important that the choice is a mix of personal taste that belongs to us and the atmosphere a fragrance can create.It is important to use ambient diffusers in moderation, as excessive use of fragrances can be unpleasant for some people. Ambient diffusers should never be placed below one meter in height and never above your nose level. The fragrance tends to rise, and if placed too high, it will diffuse less effectively.Place the diffuser where there are no obstacles above it. Avoid surfaces near heat sources or air currents, such as window sills, near radiators or air conditioners. The risk is that the fragrance will be consumed much faster than expected. When placed properly, the diffuser remains effective for 4 to 6 months.

Vanilla and sandalwood together help the mind relax and enjoy the freshness and vibrancy of white musk, completing the spirituality of a captivating fragrance.Licorice & Musk is a fragrance for fabrics and spaces.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Macaron Home spray 250 ml
listings.description: Simplicity captured in a fragrance. What is simplicity?It’s that special moment: outside it’s cold, and you, wrapped in a warm blanket, let yourself be carried away by the crackling of the fireplace and the enveloping scent of freshly baked cookies. It’s the pleasure of recalling a memory, the scent of home, of true happiness. "Macaron" celebrates just that: a tribute to simplicity, which reveals itself as the true essence of happiness."Macaron" takes you to an intimate and welcoming dimension, where every detail tells a story of sweetness, warmth, and memories. It’s not just a fragrance but a complete sensory experience. Usable on spaces, fabrics, and directly on the skin, it perfectly adapts to everyday life, transforming every space and moment into an oasis of well-being and refinement.Celebrate the art of simplicity with an essence that caresses the senses and warms the heart. Discover the pleasure of carrying the scent of happiness with you.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Midnight Home spray 250 ml
listings.description: It's 3:24 AM, I can't sleep. An idea has lodged itself in my mind, that's just how I am. I get up, change, and fly to the lab. While driving, I visualize what's in my head. I arrive at the lab, turn on the equipment, wash the dirty beaker from the night before, grab the notebook, turn to the shelves where the raw materials are, and take the Musk Plus. I need to give it a good base... 0.3 of vanillin, 0.5 of neroli, a drop of rose absolute, the scent of a pencil mustn't be missing, cedarwood... and I write the scent of the night. The night is special to me for its light, it's a second life. I wait for the night to dream, I smell its fragrance, and I am alive.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Mon Amour Home spray 250 ml
listings.description: Vanilla, floral, honeyed, and oriental fragrance. Delicate fruity touches reveal a sweet vanilla heart, accompanied by the warm notes of honey and tuberose. In the base, the fragrance fades into the velvety embrace of amber and tonka bean.Mon Amour is a fragrance for fabrics and spaces.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Pamplemousse Home spray 1000 ml

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Pantelleria Fycus Home spray 1000 ml

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Tobacco & Spices Home spray 1000 ml
listings.description: A fragrance created from the meeting of contrasting accords: sparkling and spicy in the top with citrusy notes of grapefruit and pink pepper; bold and enveloping in the heart with tobacco leaves softened by amber and Peru balsam; woody and strong in the base, with vetiver and an elegant suede accord. Tobacco & Spices is a fragrance for fabrics and spaces.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Tuberosa Home spray 1000 ml
listings.description: The fragrance opens with a brilliant note of bergamot combined with the preciousness of saffron. In the heart, an explosion of white flowers makes the fragrance opulent and sensual. In the base, a very soft note of white suede embraces an incense note. All of this is wrapped in an elegant cloud of musk. Tuberose is a fragrance for fabrics and spaces.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò White Tea China Home spray 1000 ml
listings.description: The material white tea is sublimated by the soft nuances of sandalwood and amber. In the top, the mate accord plays with the green notes of galbanum and the brightness of bergamot. White Tea China is a fragrance for fabrics and spaces.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Bois Impérial Scented candle 270 g
listings.description: Scented candle delicately perfumed with Bois Impérial by Quentin Bish.Freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood – an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. Majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix.A sustainable Thaï basil and black pepper from Timut opens this fragrances followed by a sustainably produced Haitian Vetiver, and freesia notes by Petalia. The heart is built around the Akigalawood.This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from unused Patchouli parts, sustainably produced from Indonesia. It is upcycling. This sustainably produced Pathchouli from Indonesia brings spicy notes, together with a sustainable Ambrofix. Producers benefit from training in sustainable products methods to improve agricultural and distillation practices and reduce the impact on the environment. Highly concentrated at 12%, mineral wax, cotton wick.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Divine Vanille Scented candle 270 g
listings.description: Scented candle delicately perfumed with Divine Vanille by Olivier Pescheux.Divine Vanille, is a tribute to Vanilla absolute, sustainably produced of Madagascar. Mysterious, suave, deep, carnal … simply irresistible. Natural Tonka Bean and benzoin enhance the soft, balmy and addictive facets of Vanilla. A blend of natural Cinnamon bark and sensual leathery tones of natural Osmanthus reveal rich facets of blond Tobacco and dried fruits. An innovative fraction of natural Cedarwood and Patchouli brings a creamy woody structure highlighted with silky musks, wrapping the fragrance with a delicate luminous veil.A Clary Sage oil, Cinnamom, Black Pepper, all natural, followed by an absolute Ostmanthus giving fruity apricot-like untertones. A touch of natural Incense leads you to an absolute Vanilla, sustainably produced from Madagascar, developping local education and healthcare infrastructure as well as promoting local food security. At the last note , Tonka Beans from Venezuela, Benzoin from Laos, and Patchouli from Indonesia, all sustainably produced.Highly concentrated at 12%, mineral wax, cotton wick.

listings.rawTitle: Etat Libre d'Orange 500 Years Scented candle 230 g
listings.description: Half a millennium lived on the skin — and in its wake, the majestic memory of the rose, the power of spices, and the sense of the precious. The story of humanity captured in a fragrance.“Mignonne, allons voir si la rose...” (Sweetheart, let’s go see if the rose…) has been woven into the heart of this candle, which brings together all the arts — and above all, poetry.The unexpected union of rose and oud creates a mature accord that reveals five centuries of French Renaissance in the Loire Valley, the land of the Valois.

listings.rawTitle: Etat Libre d'Orange I Am Trash - Les Fleurs du Déchet Scented candle 185 g
listings.description: A perfume is conjugated like a verb, and the flame is the verb TO LOVE, conjugated for all people, especially Her and partly Him.They loved each other, as you loved your man, and of this love, like moments in the wind, only a memory and its fragrant flame remain. A beautiful and immortal love. From Ancient Egypt to Los Angeles and the rest of the world, the marble hearts of former lovers will burn for eternity.. Live. Love. Inhale. Like a flock of firebirds to carry by your side.. The most sought-after perfume created from materials we would never think of wanting. Among the waste lies an infinite number of treasures, which we find for you. Love the waste, wear the waste, be the waste.

listings.rawTitle: Etat Libre d'Orange Soul of my Soul Scented candle 230 g
listings.description: A creamy explosion where musks blend with iris butter, releasing powerful vanilla notes that fade into a tonka bean and benzoin accord. Always faithful to musk.Siberian iris, rose absolute, sandalwood, incense, bergamot, vanilla, musk — sacred materials for a mystical wave.In Soul of My Soul, musk and love merge in a divinely spiritual direction to create an explosion of light.

listings.rawTitle: Etat Libre d'Orange You or Someone Like You Scented candle 185 g
listings.description: The flame is a moment in the wind, but even when it’s gone, there is the memory. It is ancient, beautiful, everywhere and always, even marble hearts will still burn in the remembrance of love, promises and lies.Live, Love, Feel. Like a swarm of firebirds that carry you home.185 grams of perpetual palm trees, chlorophyll mint and peaceful blue sky that serve up a garden rose. Anything becomes possible in California, or anywhere else where there is the "possibility in the blue air".

A smell of fruity wine and cloves combines with the wood of raw tables on which filled terracotta tankards stand.Arte dei Vinattieri. Vintners used to sell wine in fiaschi, long-necked bottles covered with a close-fitting straw basket. Taverns and inns became popular gathering places, also visited by soldiers and passing-by foreigners. Whether drunk hot and spicy to warm up cold winters or prescribed by physicians as a restorative cure, wine was extremely relevant in a Florentine’s daily life.Recommended for: studio, living area

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Ambre des Abysses Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Immerse your space in the fascinating depths of Ambre des Abysses, a bold and luxurious candle that balances bright amber warmth with lively aromatic freshness.Facet and daring, this fragrance opens with unexpected and sparkling notes of Bergamot, Orange Blossom, and Mint Leaves. At its heart, Rosemary, Geranium, and Jasmine embrace Patchouli and Amber to impart softness and opulence. In the base, creamy and emblematic notes such as Vanilla and Tonka Bean blend with Oak Moss and a Leather accord to give a robust structure.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Ambre Rubis Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Inspired by the brilliance of a legendary gem, the Ambre Rubis candle unveils a bold and captivating fragrance where amber warmth meets fruity richness and smoky spices.With a vibrant burst, the top notes of Blood Orange and Pink Pepper blend with the smoky charm of Incense, creating an initial impression that is both spicy and deeply aromatic. As the fragrance develops, a heart of Cherry and Rum emerges, imparting a rich sweetness softened by the floral elegance of Jasmine. In the base, Amber forms a warm and inviting foundation, enhanced by the resinous tones of Fir Balsam and the woody nuances of Cedarwood. Together, these elements create a lasting trail that is both comforting and enigmatic, leaving a lasting impression and mysterious allure.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to a length of 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Figuier Noir Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Figuier Noir is a candle that evokes the rich, slightly sweet and earthy scent of fig fruits and the lively leaves of the tree. This composition combines the earthy tenderness of the tree sap with the strength of roots, spices, and woods.Figuier Noir is a synergy of resins to grasp the unreachable stars, a combination of woods to emphasize sincerity, and a weave of roots to leave a solid trace – together with exquisite spices and black fig pulp that define its sillage.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Mon Boudoir Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Evoking the timeless charm of a royal boudoir, the Mon Boudoir candle brings to life the refined sensuality of the legendary 1919 perfume created by Master Perfumer Robert Bienaimé.The fragrance opens with a bright note of bergamot, accompanied by intriguing spicy notes. A heart of rose, geranium, ylang ylang, and jasmine is wrapped in velvety notes of iris and heliotrope. In the base, patchouli and sandalwood blend with the most imperial of ambers, warmed by musk and benzoin, and adorned with Tahitian vanilla.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Quelques Fleurs L’Original Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Imbue your space with the luminous essence of an olfactory icon. Inspired by the legendary 1912 perfume by Robert Bienaimé for Maison Houbigant, the Quelques Fleurs L’Original candle reinterprets the world’s first true multi-floral bouquet.The enchanting and radiant essence bombards the olfactory senses with soft and voluptuous flowers arranged in perfectly blended and harmonious tones. Sensual and captivating, its heart speaks of pure emotion, supported by jasmine, tuberose, lily of the valley, violet, rose, ylang ylang, carnation, broom flower, orange blossom, and cloves. A lively and seductive top note of bergamot, galbanum, tarragon, and lemon dries down to a cultivated base of oakmoss, sandalwood, civet, cedarwood, musk, orris, and tonka bean.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Tabac Nomade Scented candle 195 g
listings.description: Let yourself be carried to the heart of a golden desert with the Tabac Nomade candle, a warm and enveloping blend of tobacco, spices, and sun-kissed richness.Rich and creamy, the fragrance opens with a warm and crystalline accord of bergamot, rose, and spices. At its refined and hypnotic heart, tonka bean and saffron mingle with tobacco leaves to merge into a base characterized by a leather accord and a touch of vanilla.How to use: On first use, burn the candle for 2-3 hours until the entire surface of the wax is liquid. Regularly trim the wick to 3-5 mm. Ensure the wick is straight and centered when extinguishing the candle. Ventilate the room after burning. Do not relight the candle if the wax level is below 5 mm or if the wick holder is visible. Use a snuffer or lid to avoid wax splashes.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Ambre 1er Scented candle 185 g

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Ambrami Scented candle 180 g
listings.description: A fragrance that becomes a reflexive verb , with a warm and reassuring personality . By closing your eyes you will be transported in a play of light where the soft and fruity notes of Osmanthus and the pungent and spicy ones of Cardamom on the top are reflected with the warm scents of Amber and Patchouli in the heart , which in turn meet with the sensuality of Sandalwood and with the strength of Vetiver on the bottom . Ambrami is a Kaleidoscope of energy , a fragrance able to create a seductive and refined atmosphere in all your living spaces.These precious candles, created by a historic Italian wax factory founded in 1902, are made by a blend of waxes and a wick composed of braids in 100% pure cotton. Elevated by an elegant pot that recalls the black of their respective collection, they are characterized by clean lines and an elegant refinement, in perfect Laboratorio Olfattivo style, which makes them refined design objects that enrich the chosen environments creating magical atmospheres. Their high concentration of perfume makes them incredibly performing for an intense and persistent diffusion that envelops the rooms.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Al Contrario maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Black Fire Glass, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Master Waxmakers and Perfumers, combining it with innovative design and the exploration of new materials, such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the finest and most noble essences.Through the ardor of the flame with a wooden wick that reproduces the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory experience is enriched with a new, fourth sensory dimension: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid lies the aerial phase of the “scent of fire,” characterized by its fragrance. The tasting bell will open new horizons for your “nose.”The Tiziana Terenzi collection has always been inspired by journeys and experiences lived around the fire. That beautiful and powerful moment when the soul pauses, as if suspended, and draws close to the absolute to capture the fleeting wonder of the moment. Distant places, experienced with the spirit of a traveler in search of inner growth. Each stop is a chance to climb another step on the ladder of knowledge, leading to wisdom and true richness. *Al Contrario* tells the story of the return journey from these paths, one of the most beautiful and intimate moments for the traveler: the nostalgic longing for the beauties left behind, mixed with the thrilling anticipation of reuniting with loved ones at the warm, crackling hearth of home. As one nears home, the surroundings slowly become familiar and welcoming. In the distance, the green hills of my homeland appear, with their gentle slopes. The plants, the cultivated fields, and the fruits that this marvelous land so generously offers. You recognize the tree you used to climb as a child and the old farmhouse with dim lights glowing behind its half-open windows. After the bend in the road, suddenly, the sea appears, greeting you with its soothing waves. Finally home, finally love, and the fire burning in the fireplace warms the heart, setting the rhythm for the tale of the adventure just concluded. An intimate fragrance, just like the deep emotion of the returning traveler.A perfume dedicated to those who truly understand the essence of travel and life itself. Not everyone knows how to return, just as not everyone can appreciate this exquisite essence, crafted in a delicate balance of almost nostalgic *saudade*, between the sweetness of vanilla and the counterpoint of malt and cocoa seeds. Light yet profound, reflected in the captivating presence of precious woods such as ebony, which grounds its essence. A journey for those who return, ready once again to set off on the path that life offers us each day in its everyday wonder.Warnings: May cause an allergic reaction.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Andromeda maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Oro Foco, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that gathers the ancient knowledge of three generations of Master Waxmakers and Perfumers, blending it with the most innovative design and the search for new materials, such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the finest and most noble essences. Through the intensity of the flame with a wooden wick that reproduces the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory experience is enriched by a new and fourth sensory dimension: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid lies the aerial phase of the “scent of fire,” characterized by its fragrance. The tasting bell will open new frontiers for your nose. We first encountered Andromeda, wrapped in her infinite beauty, enhanced by a trail of bright and fascinating stars, during a trek in the Sibillini Mountains—a little-known but no less enchanting area of our beautiful country. We were searching for a natural and spontaneous event that can be considered a true miracle of Mother Nature. In these silent mountains, every year, a ritual takes place that seems almost supernatural: the flowering season. Between late May and the first days of July, the Castelluccio plateau bears witness to this extraordinary phenomenon. For several weeks, the chromatic monotony of the pastures is broken by a mosaic of colors, with shades ranging from ochre yellow to red. Although the "Fiorita" festival falls on the third and last Sunday of June, there is no specific day to admire this enchanting spectacle. Each year, everything depends on the season’s climatic conditions, and one must know how to seek it, for like our perfume, it does not reveal itself to everyone. The floral species that color the Pian Grande and Pian Perduto during this period are countless. Walking along the paths, we may encounter: gentians, daffodils, violets, poppies, buttercups, asphodels, Viola Eugeniae, clovers, wood sorrel, and many more. During this journey on foot along the trails of Pian Perduto, in absolute silence and with deep respect for the lush surrounding nature, one becomes intoxicated by scents and colors that fill not only the eyes but also the heart and soul. On summer nights, at a rustic campsite around a crackling bonfire, the gaze drifts far beyond the glowing embers, and with it, the soul begins a journey toward a vast sky filled with twinkling stars. A fresh, citrusy bouquet releases effervescent aromas, counterpointed by Ylang-Ylang and Water Jasmine. A delicate sensation of freshness that envelops and accompanies you throughout the day. **Warnings:** Harmful to aquatic organisms with long-lasting effects. May cause an allergic reaction. Do not release into the environment. Dispose of the product/container in accordance with local regulations.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Oro Foco, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Master Waxmakers and Perfumers, combining it with the most innovative design and the search for new materials, such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the finest and most noble essences. Through the ardor of the flame with a wooden wick that reproduces the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory experience is enriched with a new and fourth sensory dimension: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid lies the aerial phase of the "scent of fire," characterized by fragrance. The scent bell will open new frontiers for your "nose."The story of this fragrance originates around Lake Como. A body of water that has always fascinated us because it is so deep that it far surpasses the sea where we live, yet it is enclosed in a spectacular mountainous setting. The lake is situated in a basin surrounded by forested mountains and offers a landscape of varied and fragrant aspects. Along its shores, pastures, forests, rugged and imposing rocks, picturesque villages overlooking the water, and beautiful villas with parks and gardens alternate. The center of the lake, where the three branches meet, is the point with the mildest climate and the broadest panorama. We loved reaching this water crossroads by boat to enjoy the best view of the entire Bellagio promontory, the northern Grigna towering over Valsassina, and, on clear days, the upper basin with the Alpine chain in the background. The most familiar and beloved place has always been the Lecco branch, offering a harsher and more evocative landscape, with the southern Grigna, of Dolomitic origin, and the Corni di Canzo, which, descending towards the lake, form enchanting coves and inlets. Our favorite refuge was the Fiumelatte spring, described by Leonardo da Vinci. This stream, which had intrigued Leonardo da Vinci, bewitched us as children due to its unique peculiarity: the water flows with regular intermittence from March 25th to October 7th. The water emerges from a mysterious cave filled with scents that would be impossible and reductive to verbalize. A place where the perfumer’s alchemy came to life before anywhere else. The very rock of the cave was fragrant. Beyond the vault, where the stream flows only at certain intervals, its bed appears as a true lunar landscape, wrapped in the cosmic darkness of a place where natural light never penetrates.Warnings: harmful to aquatic organisms with long-lasting effects. May cause an allergic reaction. Do not release into the environment. Dispose of the product/container according to local regulations.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Delox maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Fire White Glass, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Master Waxmakers and Perfumers, combining it with the most innovative design and the search for new materials, such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the finest and most noble essences. Through the ardor of the flame with a wooden wick that reproduces the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory experience is enriched with a new and fourth sensory dimension: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid lies the aerial phase of the "scent of fire," characterized by fragrance. The scent bell will open new frontiers for your "nose."This creation is inspired by a sailing journey around the Greek Cyclades archipelago and encapsulates in its bouquet all the colors and flavors of the most southern and authentic Mediterranean. The carefree summer, full of intoxicating scents carried by the "Meltemi" (a wind typical of these latitudes), with its warm and sensual embrace, is magically enclosed in this fragrance inspired by the untouched and ancestral beauty of the Mediterranean. The intense aroma of coffee, prepared in the ancient "moka" (a traditional coffee maker), spreads through the crisp morning air, illuminated by shimmering light reflecting on the sea. Instantly, the gaze is drawn to that infinite blue, framed by fragrant plants and flowers, made even sweeter and more seductive by the distant echo of honey and sweet amber resin. The hypnotic strength of white hyacinth, combined with the opulence of royal iris and ecstasy rose, is enveloped by notes of opoponax and roasted coffee, resting on precious amber and powdery notes, sweetened by honey accents. All this is enhanced by the strength of Lebanese cedarwood. It is wonderful to wake up surrounded by the wonder of discovery, following the traces of our past to best reflect our future.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Foconero maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Black Fire Glass, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Wax Masters and Perfumers, combining it with innovative design and the search for new materials such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the most precious and noble essences. Through the intensity of the flame with a wooden wick that mimics the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory tasting is enriched with a new and fourth sensory experience: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid stands the airy phase of the "smell of fire," characterized by the fragrance. The tasting bell will open new frontiers to your "nose".The creation contained in the black bottle of the classic collection is inspired by a journey to one of the most beautiful bays in Italy. A place full of history and poetry, music and traditions, thanks to its infinite, almost disarming beauty that leaves every traveler breathless and wanting to never leave again. Paolo and Tiziana’s stop tells of this magical, beautiful, and wild land, full of contradictions and fragility, but also rich in strength and generosity, just like the precious fragrance inspired by it. We are in the Gulf of Sorrento, navigating between its beautiful islands that define it and make it unique in the world. Suddenly the profile of Capri appears, and not far away, Procida and the legendary Ischia. The fragrance is inspired by the fresh, salty evenings spent on a road trip in this land of centuries-old tradition, with bold and determined flavors as well as heavenly and paradisiacal scents. The essence of the fire lit in a deep black night, on top of the cliffs of Zaro on Punta Caruso on the island of Ischia, overlooking the sea and the gulf. A night without lights, from the deepest black darkness, illuminated only by the crackling of the bonfire and the glow of the crackling embers that break the silence of nature; around Paolo and Tiziana, a fresh and fragrant wind rises, gathering all the effluvia of this Mediterranean scrub full of beauty and history.At first, you perceive the famous citrus fruits of Sorrento, with lemons and bergamot, accompanied by thyme spices laid on juniper berries and lavender. The heart beats strongly with notes of refined and precious flowers like Ylang-Ylang and Hyacinth, expertly paired with irreverent Cardamom and sweet white Lily of the Valley. The touch of salt odor coming from the sea blends the perfume into a unique freshness that bases its strength on the union with the powerful woods of Sandalwood, Cuban Cedar, and precious red Patchouli, blended with Oak Moss. A precious fragrance that will make you fly over the surface of the sea water with enveloping and seductive notes, fresh, generous, yet warm and gentle at the same time; a sensual and seductive creation, simply beautiful just like the immeasurable beauty of nature and our splendid Italy. In this precious vial, all the emotion of a night in the Gulf of Sorrento is enclosed, smelling the salty emotion of the Maestrale wind, with the famous tune of "O Sole Mio" in the background… Wear this fragrance, close your eyes, and look at the inner beauty!Warnings: Harmful to aquatic life with long-lasting effects. May cause an allergic reaction. Do not dispose of in the environment. Dispose of product/container in accordance with local regulations.

listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Fire White Glass, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Wax Masters and Perfumers, combining it with the most innovative design and the search for new materials such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the most precious and noble essences. Through the intensity of the flame with a wooden wick that mimics the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory tasting is enriched with a new and fourth sensory experience: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid stands the airy phase of the “smell of fire,” characterized by the fragrance. The tasting bell will open new frontiers for your “nose”.Barefoot in the fascinating mystery of Fire at a campsite in the desert. The desert is the space of the echo of questions and the resonance chamber of the world’s noises. The desert arises on the edge of existence, at the intersection of present and past places, like a mirage at the border of oneself. The warm and sensual notes of an unknown and wild night, the seductive aroma of spices, the evocative power of rose, and the ancestral and reassuring scent of honey are exalted in the strength of the flame. The tale of excitement for a unique and unforgettable experience: the first night in a tent in the desert. The darkness and silence of this magical place that, like in this fragrance, excite and fascinate from the very first top notes. And here is this seductive Bulgarian rose that embraces you like a warm cloak, a persistent balance of emotions, but in a sudden flash upon turning around, one senses the full color of the dark, and the darkness moves forward in the unconscious like an ancestral worry. I’ve always been fascinated by a saying I heard during one of my trips: “The desert is as vast as the sky, if you want to be free like a bird, then live in the desert, where there are no borders and no control.” This fragrance fully captures this spirit of infinity, mystery, and freedom. The precious notes of natural Oud know how to give all the intensity and fear contained in the darkest night.Warnings: Harmful to aquatic life with long-lasting effects. May cause an allergic reaction. Do not dispose of in the environment. Dispose of product/container in accordance with local regulations.

The tasting bell will open new frontiers for your “nose.”During the hot and sunny summer days, Tiziana and I, just children, spent most of our time with our grandfather, who filled our time with magical stories, teaching us the wonders of the world. Our father Evelino often accompanied us on our vacation travels aboard his beautiful sailboat, made entirely of fragrant wood. With him, we sailed the seas with bright eyes and a desire for new discoveries, to learn the infinite beauty of our beloved Italy. Just a few miles from our city is an enchanted mountain that rises above the sea, creating a breathtaking scene: Mount Conero. Rocks and forests reflect in the crystal-clear waters of one of the most beautiful bays in Italy, protected by two peaks thrown into the sea by the gods, known as The Two Sisters. We set off at night with the light breezes that accompanied us throughout the journey, carelessly carrying the smells of the Mediterranean scrub. Navigating by the stars, our father steered safely while grandfather Guglielmo showed us the constellation Orion and its mythical belt. Occasionally, we spotted fires on the mainland and bonfires indicating dangers for sailors. An explosion of scents reached our hearts, carried by the warm wind of a summer that still resonates within us. From that distant echo came Orion, a spicy and intense fragrance, strong yet gentle. Effervescent thanks to the citrus bouquet, in contrast with the sweetness of pineapple and the roundness of apple, reaching its brilliant trail thanks to accords of spices such as thyme and oregano. A fresh breeze is felt when wearing it, and the memory of those precious woods accompanies us on a dreamlike journey to infinity.Warnings: May cause a skin allergy. listings.rawTitle: Tiziana Terenzi Ursa maxi Scented candle with 2 wooden wicks 500 g
listings.description: Maxi Oro Foco, Lid, Gold Decoration, 2 Wooden Wicks.Tiziana Terenzi is the brand that brings together the ancient knowledge of three generations of Master Candle Makers and Perfumers, combining it with innovative design and the search for new materials, such as vegetable waxes and artistic fragrances created with the finest and noblest essences. Through the intensity of the flame with a wooden wick that replicates the crackling of a fireplace, the olfactory experience is enriched with a new and fourth sensory experience: at the top of the classic olfactory pyramid stands the airy phase of the "smell of fire", characterized by the perfume. The tasting bell will open new horizons to your "nose".From the constellation of Orion comes one of the most wonderful journeys ever experienced, chasing the olfactory library of the Terenzi family, to create a unique and irreplaceable Absolute. A limited edition fragrance due to the limited availability of priceless and irreplaceable essences and molecules once they are gone. These are ingredients from the family’s library with over 50 years of maceration, some of them completely forbidden nowadays, but still naturally usable if one is well-known and has official proof of possessing them before 1968, as is the case with the Terenzi Brothers. A fragrance with an extremely high concentration, containing 40% of pure and rare natural oils, inspired by one of the brightest stars of the famous Orion constellation. This olfactory pyramid starts a journey through new boundaries of artistic perfumery, where there are no longer limits or rules, but only the will to create wonder and beauty, just as the famous and beautiful star called Orionis. The creation opens with a bold and unusual headnote combining the rare Saffron from Molise with the French Frankincense from Miramar, which immediately leads to the true focal point of the fire creation, just like the bright star of Orion: the heart. This is an explosion of wonderful and powerful effluvia, where the precious and aphrodisiac Grey Amber, a famous molecule carefully preserved in the Terenzi library for over 50 years, takes center stage, skillfully combined with Musk and Red Patchouli from India. This expression of Italian luxury artistic perfumery finds solid foundations on a base of refined and rare woods, with Tolu Balsam particularly standing out.Warnings: may cause a skin allergic reaction. Harmful to aquatic life with long-lasting effects. Keep out of reach of children. Wear protective gloves. In case of skin irritation or rash: consult a doctor. When consulting a doctor, have the product container or label available. Dispose of the product/container according to local regulations.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Lustre Essence de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A light that pierces the darkness. The reflection of a shiny surface. A dazzling brightness.. Lustre ignites with a spark: a sparkling explosion of cardamom that fills the air with spicy energy. Then comes the soft and powdery iris, tempering the brilliance and imbuing the composition with a romantic and precious elegance. Its white creaminess glides into warm and smooth sandalwood, providing continuity and a sense of seamless perfection. In the finish, a delicious vanilla embraces the whole, leaving a soft, enveloping, and refined trail.. Reflecting, emanating, and celebrating light, Lustre is a poetic expression of the desire to freeze the present and let it shine forever.

listings.description: Amouage represents the pinnacle of niche Arabic perfumery, and Material is one of its most captivating expressions. The fragrance opens with the brilliant vivacity of elemi, immediately captured by an intense wave of patchouli that amplifies its character. At the heart, vanilla absolute and benzoin create a warm and sensual veil, while glimmers of osmanthus and tonka bean add luminosity and depth.. In the base, guaiac wood, labdanum, and a touch of oud create a rich, opulent, almost regal trail. Material is a true tale of beauty and magnificence, part of the prestigious Odyssey collection: an olfactory signature that leaves its mark, without compromise.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Meander Capitolo I Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Meander, part of Amouage's Odyssey collection, was created as a tribute to the Dhofar plateau in Oman. It's a fragrance that captures the serene euphoria of a land shrouded in mist, rich in vegetation, and crisscrossed by crystal-clear streams.. Inspired by the landscape of Khareef, the monsoon season that transforms the southern Sultanate into a verdant oasis, Amouage interprets that surreal atmosphere through an accord of incense and smoky vetiver, enriched with green nuances of cypriol and daffodil. The characteristic caramel-colored mud of Dhofar emerges in earthy notes of sandalwood, carrot heart, and orris root, creating a luminous, meditative, and deeply sensorial fragrance.

Opus V was born from this very duality: a floral-woody fragrance that intertwines classic and modern methods of transmitting knowledge, transforming this contrast into an elegant and contemporary olfactory narrative.. With a concentration of 24% and aged for 6 weeks — 3 of maceration and 3 of maturation — it reveals a deep, precise and nuanced structure.

With a 25% concentration of oils and aged for 6 weeks — 3 dedicated to maceration and 3 to maturation — Rose Incense reveals a complex, luminous and deeply magnetic personality.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Opus XIII Silver Oud Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A reflection of life’s most vivid and memorable experiences, shaped by trials, ambition and strength, Silver Oud is the olfactory representation of Stendhal’s 19th-century French novel The Red and the Black and its protagonist, Julien Sorel, intelligent and determined to rise above his destiny.. In keeping with the Maison's narrative tradition, Cécile Zarokian brings this woody and amber Eau de Parfum to life, showcasing the most precious oud in all its majesty.. With a 20% concentration of oils and aged for six weeks—three for maceration and three for maturation—Silver Oud reveals an elegant, intense, and nuanced depth. A fragrance built to leave its mark.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A journey of knowledge and pure aesthetic pleasure, Opus XIV – Royal Tobacco traces a fragrant itinerary along the Tropic of Cancer, from Oman to Cuba, uniting royal incense with the most regal tobacco.. Interpreted by the renowned perfumer Cécile Zarokian , this unprecedented encounter between incense and tobacco comes to life in a surprising, rich and vibrant accord, capable of offering a completely new sensory experience.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Opus XV King Blue Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The union of the real and the unreal, the clash between the impossible and the everyday: a surreal manifesto that reminds us that life is never what it seems. The encounter between fire and belladonna, between juicy mandarin, majestic amber, and shadowy oud gives life to King Blue, a dreamlike wood of rare power.. With a 35% concentration of oils and aging for 10 weeks—5 of maceration and 5 of maturation—the fragrance releases a magnetic, almost visionary depth, capable of dragging the wearer into a universe where anything can happen.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Outlands Essence de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The limit of imagination. Unexplored mysteries. A dance with the unknown.. Outlands is an invitation to transcend boundaries, to venture beyond the visible. The opening is surprising: a luminous explosion of citrus, dominated by the crisp energy of lemon. But as the journey continues, the landscape changes, becoming remote, enigmatic, almost otherworldly.. A rich and multifaceted patchouli—warm, moist, green—draws the traveler deeper into this cryptic territory. Then an amber accord, vibrant with balms and resins, leads to the final encounter: a moment where one finds oneself reflected, transformed, recreated.. Indescribable yet strangely familiar, Outlands plays on extreme contrasts of light and shadow to capture the inexorable movement of the future. A fragrance that doesn't simply evoke a place: it opens it before you.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Overture Man Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Overture Man is an instantly captivating woody fragrance, inspired by a man's solitude before the world: dramatic, bold, and self-assured. Created by renowned perfumer Karine Vinchon-Spehner , it interprets the mystery of the true gentleman in an operatic key, encapsulated in powerful accords of myrrh, sandalwood, and smoky incense.. With a concentration of 31% oils and aged for 6 weeks — 3 of maceration and 3 of maturation — the fragrance reveals an intense and masterful stage presence, made to leave its mark.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Overture Woman Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Overture Woman is a tribute to the contemporary woman: bold, cultured, and shrouded in mystery. It recounts that unrepeatable moment when everything else fades away and only what is experienced in the present matters.. Created by Master Perfumer Annick Menardo, this intense fragrance is a true symphony composed of some of the world's rarest and most sought-after raw materials, capable of evoking the overwhelming emotion of a breathtaking work.. With a 25% concentration of oils and aged for 6 weeks — 3 weeks of maceration and 3 weeks of maturation — Overture Woman reveals a deep, vibrant and richly multifaceted olfactory structure.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An unwavering totem of strength and assertiveness, the original Purpose Eau de Parfum employed the ageless power of Frankincense to convey a sense of feeling at peace, of finding one’s roots, of being complete. Now in the form of an Exceptional Extrait, dosed at an astonishing 50% concentration, Purpose 50 delves deeper into the base of the scent. Joining the Frankincense, the Papyrus and the Sand Vetiver from the Eau de Parfum are an authoritative Sandalwood accord – lending the whole a unique, creamy-woody earthiness – as well as a Vanillin note, which creates a more intimate bond with the wearer’s skin. Purpose 50 is a profoundly moving connection to the earth itself – with its ancient soul , its endless patience and its timeless wisdom.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Reasons Essence de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: When first revealed, Reasons appears almost discreet: the hazelnut opening releases a comforting, surprisingly understated warmth. But it only takes a few moments for the fragrance to expand, gaining presence and majesty. The davana—halfway between herbaceous and fruity—builds layer after layer of enveloping complexity. Then comes the palo santo, with its woody, smoky trail, bringing a deep, earthy energy that grounds the entire composition in a harmonious and timeless stability.. With its richness and emotional weight, Reasons tells us that the past may have vanished, but what it leaves behind lives on: it sustains the present, enriching it with meaning, depth, and value.

listings.rawTitle: Anatole Lebreton L’Eau Guillerette Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: "A light and floral fragrance, fresh and aerial, crisp and crunchy. Full of carefree, springtime joy."L'Eau Guillerette begins almost like a Cologne, with sparkling citrus notes. Next come floral, green and musky effects, swirling around an exquisite bouquet of lily of the valley, lilac and heliotrope. The joyful promenade concludes with the softness of white musk.Mood: fresh and uplifting.

listings.rawTitle: Anatole Lebreton L’Eau Scandaleuse Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “A carnal, intoxicating fragrance that goes too far. Scandalously badass.”A fatal tuberose shamelessly reveals its peach-skinned flesh and dances with dark, animal leather. The two mingle around a teardrop of fruity liqueur, on a soft bed of moss.Mood: extravagante & drama-queen.

listings.rawTitle: Anatole Lebreton Perfumista Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Perfumista is an uncompromising declaration of love for chypre.. The opening is bright and juicy: pear, plum, and raspberry immediately give it momentum and character. Then the tone shifts: rose, jasmine, and patchouli take the lead, deep and confident. Cedar softens the floral edges, making them more sculpted and refined, while Peruvian balsam and musk close the composition with an enveloping and authoritative trail.. It's not a shy perfume. It's a lesson in style, a demonstration of absolute sovereignty.

listings.rawTitle: Anatole Lebreton Racine Carrée Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: “Some roots have a soul, I imagined their fragrance.”A woody, powdery mathematical formula, composed of a bouquet of vetiver root, iris, licorice and cypriol. Surprisingly quirky celery reinforces the aromatic flank of this classic yet ultra-contemporary fragrance.Mood: robust and serene.

listings.rawTitle: Ars Mirabile Filtro d’Amore Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An awakening inner fire, a subtle seduction that captivates the senses: those who wear it leave an indelible mark. Inspired by the ancient secrets of the Ars Mirabile Profumatoria, passed down by the wise Caterina de’ Medici, this perfume was born to evoke passion and desire. An essence that is unforgettable, capable of igniting hearts and creating olfactory addiction.A tribute to overwhelming love and seductive attraction, destined for those who want to leave a mark and be remembered… forever.

listings.description: Sensual and intense, amber is at the centre of the olfactory narrative of the new Harrods exclusive. Ambre Safrano explores the oriental facets of this emblematic raw material. Blended with saffron, suede and woods, the fragrance transports the wearer to the burning heat of the Orient. The golden tones of the saffron reveal a leathery, velvety, gourmand softness. By combining vanilla with the sensuality of sandalwood and oakwood, Ambre Safrano takes us on a heady faraway olfactory journey.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Bouquet de Hongrie Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: She’s getting ready. It’s a beautiful day. The sky is blue. She puts her naked foot on the floor and like a dancer, travels the distance of the mirrored hallway to the dressing table. It’s one of her favourite spots. She likes getting pretty there. There are only flowers from the garden, and both her hands, fresh and clean, which seem to spin around them. Her right hand, agile and light, grabs her powder, then a bottle of perfume. Her left hand clutches eye shadow and nude lipstick. She then moves on to the closet, where she picks a light dress and fixes a rebel strap. She slides on pair of heels and fastens a belt around her waist. Just like every morning, she walks towards her balcony full of flowers. It’s on the 4th floor and overlooks the gardens of Palais Royal. She is happy and thinks of her day ahead, smiling.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Bouquet de Hongrie Hair fragrance 50 ml
listings.description: Floral, green, and musky, Bouquet de Hongrie draws inspiration from a springtime moment in the gardens of the Palais-Royal. This hair perfume delicately scents and softens, leaving a silky effect. Enriched with silk proteins, the formula improves hair hydration, elasticity, and imparts a glossy finish. Silk, long celebrated in Asia for its hair care benefits and known as the "princess" of fibers, provides a crystalline structure that enhances hair hold. How to use: apply to the mid-lengths and ends of the hair.Perfumer: Serge Majoullier.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The bright notes of mandarin, lemon, and tonka bean in Citrus Riviera immediately transport you to the festive and languid atmosphere of the French Riviera, for sunbathing on the pier of the Cap d'Antibes hotel, in the maze of Villa Maeght, and all the way to Picasso's studio in Vallauris.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Creme de Cuir Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: BDK Crème de Cuir is a unisex fragrance that reinterprets leather in a modern, light, and sensual way. Inspired by the atmosphere of Indian summer—when the heat gives way to the soft coolness of the evening—the scent envelops with white, beige, and creamy tones, offering a pure and luminous vision of leather.. Green notes enhance its liveliness, while bergamot and soft musks give an airy and sophisticated, almost ethereal sensation. The result is an elegant, clean and contemporary leather scent, perfect for those who want a sensual but never heavy fragrance.. A refined and minimalist olfactory signature, ideal for those who love chic, modern perfumes with an enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Quai Saint-Bernard, near the Jardin des Plantes, the first couples arrive at the Tino-Rossi garden. As the night falls, the number of dancers increases and the bleachers fill up. Under the silver moon and the lights of the tourist barges that criss-cross the quay a few metres away, the bodies mingle to the rhythm of the music. It is then that two glances cross paths. A discreet invitation brings them to the centre of the track. As if they were carried away, they dance in the heat of the night. From this hand-to-hand seduction punctuated by knowing smiles, they end up slipping away to give free flow to more carnal desires. In the early morning, the sheets give off a scent of sleepless nights, mischievous and lascivious embraces.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Oud Abramad Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: At dawn, the doors close. The light coloured marble has kept the intoxicating heat of the day. It seems as if the lush garden is soothing, and the trees open their arms. The desert’s night creeps under the arcades and the garden seems circled by alcoves. Someone silently crosses the darkness. You can hear the subtle sound of fabric draping like a cloak over the discreet sound of the leather’s patina. The silhouette slow and haughty floats through the silenced garden. Maybe it’s Abramad... heavy door opens and a glimmer of light filters through. A proud shadow covers the stone in the trail of the golden light. She disappears. Lift your heard towards the seven windows of the palace opened like big black eyes. In the hushed obscurity, someone stands facing the desert.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Pas Ce Soir Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Just like every night, Madam is getting ready in her office. She won’t have time to go back home. She freshens up, touches her make-up: red velour lipstick sometimes Bordeaux depending on her mood. She brushes her hair and takes out her necklace from her purse. Her white shirt slightly open highlights her inviting curves. She adds a bit more black to her eyes. She slams the front door as her heels strides on the sidewalk. Just like every Thursdays, she’s going to the cabaret Place de la Concorde. Madam has high hopes like every night. She likes people; she loves life. She finds a stool at the bar and orders a whiskey with ice before lighting her cigarette. In the darkness, she makes out a silhouette in front of her. She turns to the side. It’s him. It’s always him. Their path often cross but they never speak. She smiles, gets up and goes dancing. Alone. Men line up for her attention, she politely replies. Madam is chic, she responds. Close to 2am while a dandy looking men catches her eyes and invites her to dance. She abides but only for a short period, she leans in says she has to go home. She likes him but the morning is soon approaching. She leaves after whispering these words in his ears... « Not tonight ».

On the way home, the scent of the fig trees perfumes the early evening and the fresh, clear sea air already signals the wistfulness of the end of summer.

listings.description: Exalted vanilla leather. Tuberose, jasmine and orange blossom merge in sensuality. White flowers elixir accompanied by a precious vanilla of Madagascar. Smoky leather and woody accords reconstructed from oak wood essence and patchouli.. "My intention was to combine the precious vanilla pod with a bouquet of white flowers to slowly reveal its warm and sensual personality. The vanilla is adorned with the sulfurous and slightly honeyed tones of tuberose, then drinks in the powerful sweetness of jasmine and finally melting into the round, carnal notes of orange blossom. To intensify the trail, I chose to work around the notes of oak wood and patchouli." - Dominique Ropion

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Velvet Tonka Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tonka bean is an ingredient full of contrasts, sometimes reminiscent of vanilla leather, sometimes of almonds, sometimes even revealing chocolatey facets. Velvet Tonka is characterized by its trilogy of tonka bean, orange blossom and almond. When worn on the skin, it coats it like an oriental delicacy dusted with icing sugar. The balmy tonka bean is adorned with almonds and rose petals for a velvety touch, and with a hint of tobacco absolute to give it a honeyed feel. In the base, addictive notes of milky amyris wood unfurl, enhanced by ambroxan and vanilla absolute for an unparalleled velvetiness and sensuality. VelvetTonka is a tribute to the Moroccan origins of founder David Benedek and to the iconography associated with the region through its flavors and its landscapes, like a sweet, indulgent breeze coming straight from the Atlas Mountains.

At the base, blond woods and vetiver bring balance and comfort, leaving a soft, slightly earthy trail on the hands that reassures and accompanies. listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Apricot Innocence Parfum nectar 50 ml
listings.description: Apricot Innocence is a powerful trigger that takes you back in time and evokes the purity of childhood candor. A contemporary and evocative fragrance inspired by Simone Andreoli’s childhood summers, spent playing in his grandparents’ countryside orchard and enjoying the simple pleasures of nature. Lush notes of nectarine and ripe apricot enchant the senses with magical allure, while juicy nuances of sweet orange lend a luminous delicacy with a sophisticated embrace; a memorable opening that instantly transports you to carefree moments, running joyfully through sun-drenched gardens and gathering ripe apricots warmed by golden rays of sunshine. At the heart of Apricot Innocence lies a radiant bouquet of creamy sambac and lush osmanthus, expertly blended with delicate rose petals and hints of vanilla that capture a sense of childlike wonder and innocent joy. Like stumbling upon a long-forgotten childhood treasure, this harmonious composition unfolds like a symphony, revealing layers of complexity with every passing moment; soft amber and velvety white musk create a haven of pristine bliss. Apricot Innocence is not just a fragrance; it is a dream of pure childhood innocence that embraces the senses with the golden hues of sunlit apricots in the warm breeze of exotic blossoms.

listings.rawTitle: Simone Andreoli Criminal Lipstick Parfum nectar 50 ml
listings.description: Criminal Lipstick is a luxurious fragrance that embodies the great strength of women. Simone Andreoli’s inspiration is a tribute to all the women who have left an indelible mark on his personal growth and life journey, showing him how extraordinary they are and helping to shape his belief: strong and resilient. Opening with a fruity explosion of sinful red grapes, fresh pear, and silky fig, this bold perfume quickly unfolds into a captivating floral heart of jasmine, iris, and lily of the valley, blended with a refined oriental rose; a daring bouquet that radiates confidence and sensuality, with notes of femininity balanced by the opulent warmth of woods and balsams. With a touch of mystery and provocative intrigue, it expresses a charm so irresistible that it is “criminal.” A blend of sumptuous oud, sublime vanilla, sharp cedarwood, velvety musk, and rich black amber envelops the skin like an overwhelming echo. Criminal Lipstick is an olfactory rebellion that embodies the bold modern woman; feminine yet formidable, passionate yet elegant. A seductive Parfum Nectar that invites you to defy conventions and tell the world who you are.

listings.description: Take a deep breath and surrender to the call of the wind! Feel the thrill of freedom crashing over you as you glide across crystal-clear waters, propelled into the infinity of the horizon with a 25-knot wind splashing the fresh ocean breeze across your skin. Kite in Crystal Reef is a fragrance that transcends fleeting trends, embodying a timeless allure that elevates the senses. Its sophisticated blend of notes is a harmonious symphony, carefully orchestrated to evoke the essence of luxury and refinement. The regimen concludes with Silver Moon Sérum Regeneration Global, a global regenerating serum that acts as a booster, stimulating deep regeneration of skin structures and enhancing the effectiveness of previous treatments.When applied as directed, Rituelle de Beauté ensures visible benefits in terms of tissue regeneration, firmness, elasticity, and skin softness.Active ingredients: Silver Moon Sérum Lissant Renouvelant contains glycolic acid, ascorbic acid, azelaic acid, ferulic acid, lactobionic acid, and mandelic acid. Silver Moon Sérum Hydratation Profonde contains hyaluronic acid active at four molecular weights, allantoin, and propanediol. Silver Moon Sérum Recompactant contains plant-based collagen, calendula extract, allantoin, and pomegranate oil. Silver Moon Sérum Regeneration Global contains plant stem cells, tocopherol, vitamin C, panthenol tripeptide, and safflower oil.Directions for use: the Rituelle de Beauté protocol requires a precise application method. Each bottle represents a phase and must be used until fully finished before moving on to the next, respecting the predetermined order: Silver Moon Sérum Lissant Renouvelant, Silver Moon Sérum Hydratation Profonde, Silver Moon Sérum Recompactant, and Silver Moon Sérum Regeneration Global. The Silver Moon Sérum Lissant Renouvelant should be applied every day exclusively in the evening, while the serums of the following three phases must be applied daily, in the morning and evening. The entire protocol lasts about two months, with an average of fifteen days per serum, although timing may vary depending on the frequency and amount of product used.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Paris Tonka Sublime Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: From the heart of South America comes a rare treasure: the tonka bean. Revered for centuries as a symbol of luck and passion, its aroma combines creamy vanilla, warm almond, and a delicate touch of spice to create an irresistible allure. Elegant yet powerful, nostalgic yet modern, Tonka Sublime brings depth, sensuality, and timeless sophistication to every fragrance.A luminous, gourmand opening awakens the senses with the spicy touch of star anise, the juicy sweetness of mirabelle plum, and creamy almond, enhanced by the radiant freshness of neroli. At the heart, a delicate jasmine flower is enriched with the velvety, liqueur-like depth of davana and the warm softness of tonka bean: a harmonious fusion of contrasts. The base reveals a sensual trail, where rich sandalwood blends with the modern elegance of amber, leaving a lasting, sophisticated impression.
