listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Lineam Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Lineam shines like the bright lights of a nighttime carousel.Candied fruit opens the composition with a delicious and inviting touch. A childlike, almost fairytale-like feel takes shape thanks to the popcorn accord, softened by a hint of rum. The atmosphere is sparkling and hypnotic, framing an intense and seductive vanilla that boldly reveals itself.. In the base, myrrh and benzoin envelop everything in a warm, velvety embrace, leaving behind a luminous, vibrant, almost fiery trail.

listings.rawTitle: Laurent Mazzone Pistache Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: With Pistache, Laurent Mazzone creates a new and sophisticated interpretation of a rare and fascinating ingredient: the Italian pistachio. Crafted with extreme care to enhance every aromatic nuance, pistachio reveals all its sensory richness, in keeping with the philosophy of the Les Eaux Pures collection: enhancing the raw material in its most authentic and luminous expression.. From the opening, the fragrance envelops the senses with a velvety and refined softness, offering an almost tactile sensation of comfort and warmth. Deep notes of dark cocoa and coffee intertwine elegantly, adding body and intensity to the composition. A delicate floral accent introduces a radiant contrast, illuminating the toasted tones with balance and grace. On the finish, a light and airy musky note completes the structure with lightness and refinement.. Pistache is a fragrance of character and precision, crafted with passion and dedication, where every accord pays homage to Italian excellence and olfactory mastery. A rare signature, suspended between controlled strength and eternal sweetness.. Pistache: the pure light of a precious essence.

listings.rawTitle: Nectar Olfactif Ambre Cristal Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: This refined fragrance envelops the senses with its ambery opulence and an oriental depth that evokes the mysterious allure of distant civilizations. Its warm, velvety notes evoke a sense of eternity, drawing inspiration from a thousand-year-old history preserved in a drop of amber.. The composition stands out for its intense and enveloping elegance, leaving a persistent and sophisticated trail. Perfect for those who want to wear a perfume that is more than just an aroma, but a story: a timeless sensory journey.. Perfumer: Alice Le Berre

listings.rawTitle: Parle Moi de Parfum Looking for Vanilla Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Looking for Vanilla is a hymn to luminous sweetness, a sunny symphony of juicy fruits that awaken the senses with verve. Velvety almond blends with radiant petals that dance in the light, while patchouli envelops the composition with its deep, earthy warmth. In the base, soft, seductive vanilla traces an enveloping, irresistible trail.. A surprising balance of light and matter, capable of enchanting from the first moment.. Perfumer: Michel Almairac

listings.rawTitle: D'ORSAY Holy Berry Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: An explosion of red berries and juicy strawberries reveals itself like a secret hidden under a milky, delicate and sensual veil. Iris adds a touch of ethereal mystery, while white oud leaves an almost sacred trail on the skin. Sandalwood embraces the whole with a deep, enveloping warmth. Finally, Vanilla spreads a dark and hypnotic caress, completing the composition with a restless and fascinating sweetness.. A woody and sweet elixir, vibrant like an emotion pulsating under the skin. Instinctive, magnetic — here temptation turns into ritual, and every drop becomes a sensual and ardent invocation.. Perfumer: Tanguy Guesnet

Its voluptuous and irresistible petals are enveloped by the warm and enveloping spirals of Sandalwood.. listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas The Queen and the Viper Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: This creation by Stéphane Humbert Lucas encapsulates the intensity of the love story between Cleopatra and Mark Antony in an emerald green bottle. A niche fragrance rich in symbolism, perfect for those seeking a lingering, refined, and unique olfactory experience.. The opening is a mentholated breath that hovers over the papyrus. The journey continues on a solar boat: a queen and her faithful companion, two shores united by a shared sea. On days of light, imaginary feluccas and galleons advance laden with ointments, spices, and potions capable of opening up new worlds.. The olfactory pyramid takes the shape of a geometric and sensual woman: a sovereign, a living emerald. The result is a beacon perfume, a magnetic formula, a modern Alexandrian ready to leave its mark on the skin.. Perfect for those looking for a narrative fragrance, rich in symbols and character.

Its intense notes of roasted coffee intertwine with the sweetness of hazelnut, the smoothness of cream, a sensual touch of caramel, and the exotic accent of coconut milk. A delicious, enveloping, and simply unmistakable blend.. Perfect for those who love to get noticed and leave a trail that speaks of character and passion. listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Foresta Magica Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Foresta Magica opens the doors to a place suspended between reality and imagination: an enchanted forest where light filters through the trees and sun-ripened citrus fruits sparkle like sparks of enchanted dust. The vibrant notes of bergamot, lime, lemon, grapefruit, and orange intertwine with the spicy character of ginger and the sweet acidity of blackcurrant, guiding us towards the reassuring embrace of verbena, capable of reawakening bright childhood memories.. In this vibrant green kingdom, the wind carries with it the aromas of fresh herbs and newly bloomed flowers. Rosemary and clary sage, enriched with lavender, drift across soft magnolia and jasmine petals, maintaining a constant aura of lightness.. The deeper we delve, the more the forest reveals its deepest soul: a heart of woody, ethereal, and resinous essences, enveloping like the very breath of nature. An ancestral refuge, untouched, where a silent and inexhaustible peace reigns.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Pink Milk Extrait de Parfum 50 ml

A scent wafts through the air, blending the freshness of citrus with the velvety softness of rose petals soaked in milk, made even more indulgent by the sweetness of a biscuit accord and the creaminess of coconut.. Pink Milk is a small olfactory galaxy, a new star that leaves an irresistible trail. It seduces at first sight, inviting us to dream and always aim a little higher.

The composition opens with a fruity and spicy bouquet, then evolves into a velvety floral heart and closes on a woody and musky base, warm and enveloping.. listings.rawTitle: Etat Libre d'Orange Above the Waves Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Discover Above the Waves, the first tea-inspired fragrance from Etat libre d'Orange.. The tea ritual is more than a simple gesture: it is a way to reconnect with movement, with breath, with life itself.. In honor of Mazu, the goddess who protects sailors, the spirit of movement, and the promise of elevation, we translate this timeless ritual into a fragrance. A blend of three unique, aromatic, and fresh tea varieties. It's a scent that protects and uplifts, reminding us to step back, to rise, to see the bigger picture. Beyond the waves, beyond the elements, this is more than just a fragrance, it's a companion on life's journey.

listings.rawTitle: Jehanne Rigaud Dulce Cocco Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Dulce Cocco is a sweet, creamy, and irresistibly enveloping fragrance. Its heart celebrates coconut in all its creaminess, while a soft milk accord adds depth and sensuality, creating a velvety, indulgent trail.. Designed for those who love intense, gourmand fragrances, Dulce Cocco embodies the joy and sophistication of an exotic, wearable cocktail, transforming every application into a moment of pure pleasure. A white, sensual, and enveloping caress that captivates from the first spray.

listings.rawTitle: Lorenzo Pazzaglia Dangerous Maryx Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The scent of freedom and transgression, suspended between dream and reality, where whispers of forgotten stories resurface.Dangerous Maryx envelops and conquers: an essence that vibrates in the air as the green and forbidden notes of cannabis and absinthe intertwine with the aromatic tones of rosemary, green tea and tobacco leaf, then fade into the earthy veins of patchouli.. It is a fragrance that gives color to life, making it more solemn and luminous, revealing all its depth.

listings.rawTitle: Franck Boclet Rock the Kasbah Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a beauty ritual inspired by the secret gardens of the Kasbah. Rock the Kasbah is a nourishing and sensual body oil, characterized by a fresh and intoxicating scent reminiscent of traditional Moroccan mint tea, enriched with elegant aromatic and fruity notes.. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft, radiant, and delicately scented. Perfect for those seeking a natural, enveloping, and regenerating treatment.. Key Notes:. lemon, mint, rosemary, sage, cedarwood, amber, vanilla, sweet almond, argan, apricot kernel and grapeseed oils.

listings.rawTitle: Franck Boclet Made of Sand Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vastness of the desert and its golden oases, this scented body oil offers an intense and enveloping sensory experience. Warm spicy notes blend with moist woody notes, evoking the winds that sweep across the Atlas Mountains and carrying deep, mysterious aromas.. The silky texture nourishes the skin and leaves a long-lasting scent, perfect for those who love warm, exotic fragrances rich in personality. A true olfactory journey between earth and water, ideal for daily beauty rituals and moments of relaxation.. Top notes: cardamom, driftwood, geranium, eucalyptus, cedar, vetiver, cashmeran, sweet almond, argan, apricot kernel, and grapeseed oils.

listings.rawTitle: Franck Boclet Rock 'N Rai Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Rock N'Raï is an explosion of energy and passion: a scented body oil that combines vibrant, bold notes with a captivating oriental touch. Inspired by the Berber music that enlivens Mediterranean nights, this oil captures the free and magnetic spirit of Morocco, enveloping the skin in an intense, sensual, and irresistible scent.. Its light texture nourishes and illuminates the skin, transforming every application into a beauty ritual with a bold style and unforgettable character. Perfect for those seeking an energizing fragrance with exotic allure.. Key Notes:. orange blossom, rose, lily of the valley, rosemary, patchouli and leather, oils of sweet almond, argan, apricot kernel and grapeseed.

listings.rawTitle: Franck Boclet Sweet Dream in Sahara Body Oil 150 ml
listings.description: Let yourself be transported on a dreamlike journey through the golden dunes of the Sahara: Sweet Dream in Sahara is a scented body oil that releases sweet, warm and enveloping notes, carried by an imaginary breeze that caresses the skin and awakens the senses.. Its nourishing formula leaves skin soft, luminous, and delicately scented, transforming every application into a relaxing ritual with an exotic allure. Perfect for those who love romantic, velvety fragrances inspired by magical desert nights.. Key Notes:. musky and spicy, jasmine, vanilla, iris butter, patchouli, sweet almond, argan, apricot kernel and grapeseed oils.

listings.rawTitle: Jovoy Paris Ha Long Bay Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: Ha Long Bay is a sensorial tribute to Vietnam and the legendary bay from which it takes its name. At the center of the composition is the rare Xoài Cát sandy mango, typical of the Hoa Loc province: a rich and juicy fruit with hints of peach, banana, and apricot, here interpreted in an elegant and contemporary way.. The fragrance opens with vibrant fruity accents, intensified by luminous spices, a delicate note of soft leather, and a woody base that amplifies its trail and persistence. The result is a radiant, lively scent full of personality, capable of evolving on the skin and leaving a lasting impression.. An Eau de Parfum by JOVOY that celebrates the intersection of tradition, premium raw materials, and olfactory modernity. Perfect for those who love sophisticated fruity fragrances with a unique character.

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Midnight Body cream 200 ml

listings.rawTitle: Epicò Mon amour Body cream 200 ml
listings.description: This nourishing body cream, with a light, quickly absorbed texture, envelops the skin in immediate comfort, leaving it smoother, more radiant, and protected day after day. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Carios Extrait de Parfum 100 ml

The juicy opening of red mandarin blends with the aromatic energy of red thyme, while toasted tonka bean adds a warm and sensual touch. The result is a luminous trail with a bold and unmistakable character.. The composition combines spicy freshness and woody depth, enhanced by the olfactory richness typical of Parfums de Marly. A brilliant, enveloping, and sophisticated fragrance, perfect for those seeking an elegant and contemporary signature.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Eragon Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Eragon is a fragrance that combines the vibrant energy of spices with the deep richness of woods. The bright opening of bergamot and cardamom adds vivacity, while cinnamon and davana introduce a warm, velvety sensuality.. In the base, a bold blend of leather, patchouli, and vanilla creates an intense, sophisticated, and irresistibly magnetic trail. This extrait de parfum envelops the skin with refined power and leaves an unforgettable olfactory impression.. An ideal fragrance for those seeking depth, character and powerful elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Valero Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Valero Extrait de Parfum by Parfums de Marly interprets contemporary sophistication with an intensely sophisticated woody fougère signature. Bourbon geranium introduces a delicate floral elegance, lavender adds cleansing and aromatic balance, while ambrox unleashes a modern and enveloping sensuality.. Belonging to the Woody Aromatic family, Valero is an extrait with a clean, precise, and impeccable trail, built on soft textures and a classy finish. A unisex fragrance that celebrates the purity of raw materials and the expression of timeless elegance.. Perfect for those seeking a bright, elegant and deeply refined fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Torino 25 Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: TORINO25 opens with a vibrant blend of saffron and rhubarb, illuminated by the freshness of grapefruit and ginger. The fragrance evolves into an elegant heart of leather and juniper, before settling into a soft and luxurious base of suede.. As Silver Sponsor of the Nitto ATP Finals since 2021, Xerjoff celebrates its deep connection to tennis with this elegant and modern creation. TORINO25 captures the emotion of the champion lifting the trophy: the culmination of years of commitment, passion, and dedication.. A fragrance that embodies grace, energy and euphoria, encapsulating the essence of victory and sporting heritage in a powerful and sophisticated olfactory signature.. Perfect for those looking for an energetic, elegant perfume with a sporty-luxury character.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Louis XV 1722 Rosè Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From the collaboration between Xerjoff and Maison de Venoge comes Louis XV 1722 Rosé, a creation of pure luxury inspired by the prestigious Louis XV Rosé Champagne. A refined fragrance that evokes the sparkling elegance of bubbles and the enchantment of their seductive color.. The composition opens with a luminous blend of raspberry, blackcurrant, and pear, before releasing a floral heart that emerges like bubbles in a glass of champagne: rose, geranium, and cedarwood envelop the senses with delicacy and elegance.. The warm, velvety base combines vanilla and amyris, giving a soft, woody and irresistibly sophisticated trail.. Louis XV 1722 Rosé is a tribute to the art of champagne and high-end perfumery: a fruity, floral and luxurious fragrance, perfect for those who want to wear sparkling and timeless elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Sketchbook P.33 Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Nato da un’idea custodita per anni nel taccuino di Sergio Momo, P.33 prende vita in un flacone inciso realizzato a mano in Toscana, utilizzando materiali di altissima qualità. Una creazione esclusiva che unisce artigianalità e design a un profumo moderno, versatile e irresistibile.. La fragranza si apre con note fresche e luminose di bergamotto, pompelmo e mela, arricchite da un tocco speziato di cannella che aggiunge calore ed eleganza. Nel fondo, un trio di legno di cedro, muschio e ambra assicura profondità, persistenza e una scia avvolgente.. P.33 è un profumo seducente, perfetto in ogni stagione, capace di creare un desiderio irresistibile di indossarlo ancora e ancora.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Gibeon Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Gibeon draws inspiration from the eponymous meteorite that fell in Namibia, renowned for its otherworldly crystalline pattern. This fragrance captures its mystery with a powdery, luminous, and elegantly soothing profile.. The soft opening of neroli meets the velvety richness of Tuscan iris, creating a sophisticated heart. The base notes of Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, clean musk, and cedarwood provide warmth, roundness, and a dreamy trail.. Inside the elegant box of each Shooting Stars collection fragrance is a very special gift: a certified meteorite fragment, born billions of years ago at the same time as the solar system. An authentic piece of the cosmos to treasure forever.

The formula gently absorbs moisture, leaving skin dry, silky, and elegantly scented.. We find the same notes as the famous eau de parfum: floral accords, woody nuances and the prestigious Laotian oud, which give warmth and depth to the trail.. Enriched with natural silk, whose structure is surprisingly similar to that of skin, the powder feels incredibly soft and velvety to the touch.. A luxurious and sensual body powder, perfect to complete the Alexandria II ritual and to give the skin comfort, elegance and an enveloping fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Tony Iommi Deified Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Tony Iommi Deified is the second installment in the collaboration between the legendary Black Sabbath guitarist and Xerjoff. A creation that plays with the concept of a sensory loop: a fragrance with no beginning or end, enveloping the wearer in a continuous and powerful aura.. The fragrance opens with the warmth of saffron and a surprising spicy apple, then evolves into a bold heart where leather and powdery rose dominate with intensity. In the base, a deep blend of papyrus and patchouli creates a hypnotic and persistent olfactory rhythm.. Tony Iommi Deified has a rock and sophisticated character, perfect for those who want to wear an intense, iconic trail with a strong personality.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Black Scented Candles 3x60 g

The two-tone spiral design of the containers, inspired by the movement of the ocean, recalls the endless beauty of nature and makes this set a refined and sophisticated furnishing accessory.. Made with natural vegetable wax, Scentimento candles guarantee a clean, slow burn, diffusing the fragrance long after the flame has gone out.. An ideal gift set as a luxury gift or to enrich your home with enveloping, high-quality fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Blue Scented Candles 3x60 g

listings.rawTitle: Casamorati Bouquet Ideale Hair Mist 30 ml
listings.description: Bouquet Ideale scented hair mist nourishes and strengthens the hair fiber thanks to natural ingredients that act on keratin, leaving hair soft, light, shiny, and with more volume. A gentle formula that conditions without weighing it down, ideal for everyday use.. The fragrance echoes the warm and spicy notes of the iconic Bouquet Ideale perfume, enveloping the hair in a sensual and irresistible aroma. The initial spices blend with an enveloping and reassuring heart, while the warm base of tobacco flowers, vanilla, and musk provides depth and an elegant trail with a decidedly Italian character.. A refined hair mist that enhances the hair with nourishment and fragrance, perfect for those who want well-groomed hair and a captivating fragrance that lasts all day.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Decision Capitolo IV Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Decision opens like an olfactory bolt: a flash that dissolves all hesitation. The opening accord combines the woody freshness and citrus-mineral brilliance of incense, bergamot, myrrh, and juniper berries, creating a clear and decisive, almost electric impact.. As the initial glow expands, the elegant luminosity of Atlas cedar enters, radiating clarity and structure. In the base, a warm and soothing vanilla offers the liberating feeling of acceptance: the moment when the choice becomes final and the mind finds peace.. Intransigent, distinctive, incandescent: Decision embodies the paradox that accompanies every truly important decision. It is a fragrance focused on the goal, yet open to infinite possible directions.. Concentration: 33%Aging: 5 weeks (3 maceration, 2 maturation)

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Boundless Capitolo II Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Boundless by Amouage is a sensory journey that opens with a vibrant and energizing burst of ginger orange. The heart warms with luminous nuances of elemi and cardamom, while a subtle trail of incense introduces a more intimate and contemplative side.. Vanilla, wrapped in a blend of tobacco, myrrh, and cocoa, creates a sophisticated, yet never overpowering, gourmand effect. As the fragrance develops, this delicious warmth gives way to a rich carpet of woods, spices, and golden balms, amplifying its depth.. Part of the Odyssey collection, Boundless is a fragrance that embodies the desire to push boundaries, moving between light and shadow with magnetic elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Casamorati Mefisto Gentiluomo Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Created in 1888 for traditional Italian barbers, Mefisto Gentiluomo embodies the essence of classic masculine elegance. Its clean, crisp notes evoke the atmosphere of barbershops of yesteryear: straight razors, badger brushes, and a soft, flawless shaving foam.. The fragrance opens with a refreshing burst of bergamot, lavender, and grapefruit, evolving into an elegant, floral heart. The base notes of amber, cedarwood, and musk provide warmth, depth, and a trail that captures all the charm of classic Italian style.. A refined citrus-aromatic fragrance, ideal for the man who loves timeless elegance with a touch of authentic luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Opus XVI Timber Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Opus XVI opens with an imposing presence: a solid, vertical, almost monolithic wood structure. But it only takes a few moments for the fragrance to reveal a multitude of nuances. The luminous, woody facets of cypress, cardamom, and lavandin bring clarity and brilliance.. Then come incense, juniper and fir balsam, each with its own vital and dynamic energy, which animates the composition like a moving impulse.. Finally, palo santo, sandalwood, cedarwood and patchouli ground the entire olfactory architecture with a firm, unshakable authority—a symbol of a wisdom that never lets itself be swept away by fashion.. Immensely vast, sculpted yet incredibly accessible, Opus XVI Timber celebrates the most ancestral forms of knowledge while looking optimistically to the wisdom yet to be conquered.. Concentration: 25% Aging: 5 weeks (3 maceration, 2 maturation)

The fragrance opens with a fresh and aromatic combination of eucalyptus, lavender, and rosemary, creating an immediate luminous and regenerating impact. A delicate rose note emerges in the heart, adding softness and refinement. The base is dominated by the rich and earthy nuances of patchouli, supported by musk and sandalwood, for a solid, elegant, and deeply enveloping base.. Casafutura is a one-of-a-kind fragrance: modern, artistic, and full of personality. Perfect for those who love aromatic scents with a futuristic touch and distinctive character.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Tubereuse Astrale Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From the first moment, you feel a warm, spicy caress: cinnamon opens like a fiery breath, while a powdery veil softens the contours and prepares the ground for what's to come. Then the heart explodes without warning. listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: From the first spray, Oud Stallion presents itself without restraint: saffron bursts forth with a spicy and vibrant warmth, like the power of a galloping thoroughbred. Immediately after, cardamom and Indonesian nutmeg arrive, adding a magnetic depth, evoking distant lands and journeys marked by exotic atmospheres and intense memories.. The heart of the fragrance is an elegant crescendo: osmanthus, jasmine and Turkish rose intertwine their nuances in impeccable balance, creating a sensual yet never pretentious floral bouquet, rich in character and luminosity.. Then comes the twist: agarwood asserts itself with authority, joined by leather, tonka, and patchouli. The effect is that of a well-worn, warm saddle, rich with stories and adventures. Cedar, with its noble and slightly smoky character, seals the whole with a touch of aristocratic charm.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Safran Secret Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Safran Secret by Maison Crivelli is like finding yourself in a golden field at sunset, when the light becomes liquid and the silence vibrates with anticipation. There's a suspended, almost magical atmosphere, and this extrait de parfum captures it perfectly.. Its jealously guarded formula revolves around a single star: saffron. Not the reassuring, velvety one might expect, but an intense, dark, almost hypnotic version. The spice dives into a warm, woody accord that envelops it like a mysterious mist, creating a surprising and sensorially explosive contrast.. This is Crivelli at his best: bold, unexpected, capable of simultaneously surprising and captivating. Safran Secret is more than just a perfume; it's an experience that overturns expectations and invites you to lose yourself in a luminous and enigmatic atmosphere, where every breath reveals a fragment of a secret.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Cuir Infrarouge Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Cuir Infrarouge by Maison Crivelli is a total immersion in the electric energy of a night vibrating with lights, music, and desire. Imagine raspberry cocktails that shine like liquid rubies, reflected on faces and bodies moving in the shadows: it is from this atmosphere that Jordi Fernández 's creation is born.. With a powerful 32% concentration, the opening is an explosion of freshness: crisp raspberry meets the citrus brilliance of Italian bergamot, while Laotian cinnamon provides a burst of warmth that immediately ignites the senses. Virginia and Atlas cedarwood build a solid, elegant woody structure that accompanies the fragrance throughout its evolution.. In the heart it becomes more intense, more carnal: Moroccan iris resin intertwines with nuances of leather and oud, evoking the magnetism of nearby bodies, the mystery of dimly lit rooms and that sensuality that is released only in the deepest hours of the night.. The trail is pure hypnosis: Madagascar CO2 vanilla and Venezuelan tonka bean envelop everything in a sweet, lingering warmth, like the last sip of a perfect drink as dawn begins to paint the sky outside.. Cuir Infrarouge is the night transformed into perfume: vibrant, seductive, irresistible.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Narjesi Fleur Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Narjesi Fleur transports you to an enchanted forest, where nature's most captivating notes intertwine in a luminous and seductive trail. Delicate Taif rose meets the energy of orange blossom absolute and the purity of lily, creating a sweet and irresistibly feminine bouquet.. The heart is enriched with the exotic charm of frangipani and jasmine, adding depth and sensuality to the composition. In the base, the musky nuances of Indonesian patchouli and the earthy freshness of vetiver envelop the skin with a warm and magnetic elegance.. A refined, intense and enveloping fragrance, perfect for those who desire a floral perfume rich in personality and natural sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Baz Cuir Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Baz Cuir is an intense and enveloping fragrance that celebrates the wild spirit. A whirlwind of warm spices opens the composition: spicy cardamom and luminous mandarin immediately introduce character and energy.. The heart combines jasmine, amber, incense and a strong leather accord, creating a sensorial atmosphere reminiscent of traditional souks, with its colours, aromas and enveloping warmth.. In the base, woody notes of sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver evoke the beauty of a sunlit forest, adding depth and elegance to the trail.. A leathery, spicy, and magnetic fragrance, perfect for those who love perfumes with a bold character, rich in charm, and a strong olfactory impact.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Durra Ambree Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Durra Ambre takes you on a journey through sparkling waters and starry skies, revealing a world of olfactory wonders. Gourmet, enveloping notes of vanilla blend with the warm embrace of amber, aquatic nuances, Sambac jasmine, and a touch of honey, creating a sensation of sensual and familiar comfort.. Sandalwood adds depth and a refined earthy sensuality, anchoring the fragrance and making it irresistibly elegant.. A composition that captures the magic of the ocean and its grandeur, perfect for those who desire a sweet, luminous, amber-toned fragrance with a sophisticated, marine touch.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Abjar Bois Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Abjar Bois invites you to explore enchanted forests, where nature reveals its most authentic soul. Elegant and rustic cedarwood harmonizes with the creaminess of sandalwood, the luminous freshness of bergamot and mandarin, and the floral elegance of rose.. Patchouli adds depth and warmth, while guaiac wood lends a captivating smoky touch. The interplay of leather and cashmere wood makes the composition unique, sensual, and irresistibly sophisticated.. Wearing Abjar Bois means immersing yourself in a magical and mysterious place, where freedom is palpable and nature embraces every step.. A rich, elegant and strong-personality woody fragrance, perfect for those who love warm, intense and deeply evocative scents.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Aamal Metallique Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Aamal Metallique captures the essence of a bright future, transforming every note into a promise of discovery. The sparkling opening of bergamot and lemon meets the exotic softness of coconut and peach, creating a radiant and irresistible accord.. At the heart, a bouquet of rose, jasmine, and orchid whispers elegantly, like a light breeze announcing new horizons. Solar and salty notes evoke an infinite panorama, while the enveloping base of sandalwood, ambergris, and patchouli gives the composition depth and sensuality.. A sophisticated and modern fragrance that combines radiance and timeless elegance. Perfect for those who desire a scent that inspires, excites the senses, and makes every moment shine.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Haibah Oriental Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Haibah Oriental invites you into an enchanted universe where luminosity and sensuality blend in a rich and enveloping trail. Aldehydes intertwine with the sweet warmth of ylang-ylang, passion fruit, peach, bergamot, and saffron, creating a vibrant and sophisticated opening.. At the heart, a floral bouquet of rose, jasmine and violet blooms, enriched with smoky nuances of incense, the vivacity of tagetes and the spicy touch of pink pepper.. The base envelops with a sensual combination of musk, ambergris, cedarwood and cashmere wood, giving depth and elegance to the fragrance.. Haibah Oriental is an opulent, refined and timeless fragrance, perfect for those who desire an intense olfactory signature, rich in personality and irresistibly sophisticated.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Diwan Gourmand Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: Diwan Gourmand is a fragrance that awakens the senses with a delicious opening of cocoa and chocolate smoke, immediately inviting indulgence. Fruity notes of blackcurrant, plum, and date lead to a spicy heart where rose, cinnamon, and pink pepper intertwine in perfect balance.. The base is a warm and enveloping embrace of tonka bean, amber, and vanilla, enriched by the depth of oud, cedarwood, and patchouli. The fragrance closes with vetiver, leather, and musk, leaving an intense, sensual, and irresistibly captivating trail.. A sophisticated gourmand creation, perfect for those who love rich, enveloping fragrances with a strong character.

listings.rawTitle: The Spirit of Dubai Sama Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Dubai Sama is a fragrance that celebrates the city's luminous rise, inspired by its eternal skies and ambitious spirit. A celestial composition that combines elegance, light, and depth in a captivating scent rich in personality.. The opening reveals a radiant harmony of apricot and Turkish rose, delicate notes that immediately illuminate the senses. In the heart, osmanthus diffuses a golden, velvety sheen, while the warm base of oud and dry amber leaves a lingering, enveloping, and magnetic trail, luminous like dusk on the horizon.. A sophisticated and brilliant fragrance, perfect for those who desire a perfume that combines oriental elegance, modern sensuality and an olfactory image of pure splendor.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Cognac Reign Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Cognac Reign is a bold and sensual ode to the pomp of Louis XIV's court, reimagined with DS & Durga's cutting irony and contemporary sensibility. It's a journey that begins among baroque arches and ends in a metro carriage, where a cognac barrel cracks, releasing centuries of wood, spirit, and memory.. Baroque and modern beats intertwine in a fragrance that evokes both aristocratic parties and cultural raves. Inspired by the sonic echoes of the Royal Fireworks and Lully, Cognac Reign evokes a bygone era with an ironic and surprisingly contemporary freshness. Versailles has never seemed so close. Next stop: the Sun King.. It's the ideal choice for those seeking an opulent fragrance, rich in woody, liqueur, and powdery nuances, yet with a playful and visionary soul. A fragrance for those who love to take risks with elegance: one foot in the past, one eye fixed on the future.

listings.description: Nice Bergamote Extrait de Parfum celebrates the sunny freshness of bergamot, the undisputed protagonist of the composition. The opening is bright and radiant, with citrus notes that release pure energy and sweet, slightly candied nuances, enriched by the softness of bitter orange.. The heart reveals itself in a vibrant floral bouquet: ylang-ylang intertwines with sambac jasmine absolute, a variety with a fruity, nocturnal scent, capable of capturing the intensity of white flowers at their most sensual.. In the drydown, the fragrance settles on a refined, woody base: cedar and patchouli add depth, while tonka bean creates a vanilla sweetness that blends with an irresistible amber sugar accord.. Nice Bergamote Extrait is a true explosion of light and sensuality, perfect for those seeking a modern, luminous citrus fragrance with an elegant and enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums The Musc Extrait de Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The Musc Extrait de Parfum is a refined celebration of musk, reinterpreted by Calice Becker in an intense, magnetic and deeply sensual creation.. The opening warms the senses with cinnamon, a vibrant, spicy note that illuminates the rosy, fruity nuances of the floral heart. The composition continues with Georgywood, an exclusive molecule with a woody, velvety profile, adding depth and an enveloping evolution on the skin.. As the hours pass, patchouli and sandalwood emerge, supporting the richness of the trio of white musks that are the fragrance's protagonists. Ambrofix and Ambrarome absolute add a hypnotic, ambery trail, while beeswax absolute introduces a honeyed, liqueur-like sweetness.. The result is a sensual and persistent extrait, which evolves like a warm and engaging embrace: impossible to forget.. Perfect for those who love modern, creamy and sophisticated musks, with an elegant and deeply enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Milk Eau de Parfum 15 ml
listings.description: Dirty Milk is a perfume that breaks the rules of “clean”, transforming the innocence of milk into an act of pure seduction. It's not the milk you drink, but the one that slides over your skin: warm, thick, almost forbidden, like a touch that shouldn't be there but instead remains.. It is a magnetic contrast between purity and desire, where white candor is tainted by excess and sweetness bends to sin. BORNTOSTANDOUT®’s Dirty Milk envelops you with a milky, sensual creaminess that slowly warms until it explodes in a decadent, hypnotic, irresistible trail.. A constant tension between innocence and eros, between softness and provocation: the scent of those who dare, of those who transform tenderness into temptation. Narcotic, velvety, deeply sensual: Dirty Milk doesn't just smell — it seduces.

In the heart, saffron illuminates the composition with its opulence, while cypriol and black tea add a deep, smoky, almost hypnotic layer.. A magnetic oriental, full of charisma, designed for those seeking fragrances with a bold yet elegant character, capable of evoking atmospheres of warmth, mystery, and intimacy. Black Karak does more than simply perfume: it tells a story, captivates, and captivates.

listings.description: Black Crème is a total extract, a forbidden caress that glides across the skin like warm cream. Milk, melted wax, and ambrette create a velvety, musky, intimate opening—almost a whisper to the touch. A hint of iris softens the atmosphere, before the heart of the fragrance becomes darker and more pulsating: oud, leather, vanilla, and myrrh intertwine in a warm, sensual, and deeply carnal crescendo.. In the base, the fragrance melts into the skin in an irresistible embrace: dark caramel, luminous sandalwood and amber create a “dirty sweet” trail that envelops and draws you in, impossible to ignore.. Signed by Quentin Bisch, Black Crème is a seductive duel of opposites—milk and oud, innocence and sin, purity and skin.A liquid, thick sensuality that settles like hot wax and remains long, hypnotic.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Before Common Encens Scented Candle 200 gr
listings.description: A warm, spicy smoke of myrrh, balsams, saffron, and precious aromas lights a festive flame, full of spirituality. Burning incense is an ancient practice, a ritual shared by cultures from every corner of the world. Those who love aromatic materials know how fascinating the richness of their combinations is.. This candle was born from that very research: an enthralling fusion of oriental resins and rare ingredients from India and Africa. A luminous, enveloping incense that transforms any space into a haven of mystical tranquility and seductive depth.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Portable XMAS Tree Scented Candle 200 ml
listings.description: One part fir, two parts pine, and a touch of clove. Finished with a splash of fir resin, like a natural decoration. PORTABLE XMAS TREE takes classic fir balsam and pushes it further, intertwining it with a premium amber incense.. The result? A festive, ceremonial scent that instantly evokes the holiday spirit—like carrying a pocket-sized Christmas tree with you everywhere.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tales of Amber is a hymn to the primal force of nature, an Extrait de Parfum that takes ambergris into a modern, luminous, and deeply sensual realm. Goldfield & Banks intertwines the precious gift of New Zealand's oceans with the De Laire Amber 83 Accord—an iconic blend of labdanum and vanillin—giving rise to a warm, balsamic, and irresistibly enveloping heart.. At the heart, the fragrance opens like a warm breeze caressing the skin: Australian oud, orange blossom, and iris add floral nuances, powdery softness, and a mineral touch reminiscent of sun-kissed skin. Cinnamon and oud flow through the composition with a spicy, resinous trail, amplifying the amber-woody character and adding depth.. The result is a refined balance between innovation and ancestral roots: a fragrance that evokes ocean depths and wild Australian horizons. As it warms on the skin, Amber 83 releases a gourmand sweetness that interacts with the saline, animalic nuance of ambergris, creating a magnetic contrast of creaminess and marine mystery.. Perfumer: Suzy Le Helley

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi B'Oudhique Hotel Reed Diffuser 300 ml
listings.description: The B'oudhique Hotel diffuser envelops any space with a warm and sophisticated aura, evoking the relaxed elegance and impeccable comfort of a high-end boutique hotel. It's a fragrance designed for those who want to transform their home into a refined haven, always welcoming and never boring.. The opening is brilliant: sparkling bergamot meets bold black pepper, creating a lively and contemporary entrance. Immediately after, orange blossom and rosemary bring a sense of elegant warmth, almost like the caress of a soft light on fine furnishings.. The heart deepens: oud, vetiver, and leather provide structure, texture, and a sensual allure that defines the room. The soft and persistent base blends musk and amber in a silent yet enveloping trail that lingers in the air with effortless elegance.. B'oudhique Hotel isn't just a diffuser, it's an experience. It brings an intimate and refined atmosphere to everyday life, perfect for the living room, study, or bedroom. It's the ideal choice for those who desire spaces that exude harmony, taste, and a subtle sense of luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Zen Garden Reed Diffuser 300 ml
listings.description: The Zen Garden diffuser brings the feeling of a quiet oasis into your home, where the air smells of nature and every breath invites calm. It's a balanced and luminous fragrance, designed to recreate the harmony of a Zen garden, with soft light, vegetal freshness, and inner peace.. The opening is immediately energizing: bergamot, grapefruit and pink pepper intertwine in a citrusy and sparkling accord that brightens the room and gives a sense of mental lightness. At the heart, the fragrance becomes softer and more contemplative: violet and jasmine introduce a discreet floral elegance, like petals moved by a gentle breeze. The warm and enveloping base combines amber woods, vetiver, patchouli, and ambrette, building a serene depth that lingers in the air and invites relaxation.. The natural rattan sticks diffuse the fragrance steadily and gradually, transforming every room into a small sanctuary of balance and well-being.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Valaya body cream 200 ml
listings.description: Valaya Body Cream by Parfums de Marly is an elegant and ultra-sensorial body treatment, designed to enhance the skin with the fresh, musky, and powdery nuances of the iconic Valaya. Its highly hydrating formula envelops the body in silky softness that lasts up to 8 hours, leaving skin smooth, luminous, and delicately scented, like an impalpable veil of pure elegance.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Candy Dust Eau Intimité 30 ml
listings.description: Candy Dust is a delicious cloud with a sharp soul: sweet, but with a wild twist that captures you at the first spray.. The opening is a luminous explosion of ripe raspberry and juicy pear, shaken by a flash of bergamot that makes it sparkle. The heart veers toward a soft sweetness: dragibus, creamy milk, and a delicately powdery peony that adds a feminine, velvety touch.. Then comes the final thrust: powdered sugar, musk and tonka bean intertwine with Orcanox, creating a soft yet deep trail, an irresistible mix of sugar and sensuality that lingers on the skin like a constant temptation.

listings.description: Cuvée Skin Eau Intimité by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a unisex oriental that lives on the skin like a second layer, soft, sensual and almost hypnotic.. The opening combines the musky caress of ambrette with the earthy nuance of oakmoss, creating a subtle, enveloping tension. Within moments, the fragrance slips into a creamy, velvety heart: dense, resinous tonka bean, orchid, vanilla, and soft suede that adds tactility and depth.. As it settles, the composition reveals blond woods and white leather, which adhere to the skin like an intimate and luminous veil. The result is a persistent, sensual, and deeply engaging trail: CUVÉE SKIN does more than perfume, it redefines the skin, transforming it into pure seduction.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Gold Juice Eau Intimité 30 ml
listings.description: Gold Juice Eau Intimité by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a bold, provocative, and impossible-to-ignore fruity oriental.. The opening is a direct blow to the senses: sharp rhubarb and pungent durian create a visceral, almost electric opening. Then the fragrance unexpectedly softens: osmanthus absolute and white flowers exude a sunny, soft, almost luminous warmth—a heart that only partially tames its wild nature.. The base, however, reveals its darker side: caramelized almond and guaiac wood combine in a dense, smoky, seductive accord. A dangerous sweetness that attracts and traps.. GOLD JUICE is addictive. Perhaps precisely because it plays on the fine line between attraction and risk.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Musc X Eau Intimité 30 ml
listings.description: Musc X Eau Intimité by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a unisex oriental that vibrates on the skin like a warm, primal, almost electric pulse.. The opening is a fiery whisper: ambrette and incense envelop the skin with a slowly building warmth, like a shiver rising from the base of the spine. Then the scent expands into a resinous and sensual heart, where benzoin and cistus blend with warm musk, softened by an unexpected veil of cotton candy.. But it's the base that leaves its mark: amberxtreme™ and sinfonide™ explode in a wave of synthetic, pulsating, almost carnal heat. A trail that doesn't seek to please—it conquers, provokes, and lingers.. Musc X isn't trying to be gentle. It seduces you, then etches itself into your memory like a scratch.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Warm Air Eau Intimité 30 ml
listings.description: Warm Air Eau Intimité by BORNTOSTANDOUT® is a unisex amber-oriental that plays with temperatures, transforming the skin into a field of warm, luminous and almost abstract vibrations.. The top note is a clean, metallic flash of geranium, bright as a spark. It quickly dissolves into a syrupy, intriguing accord: toasted caramel, rum extract, and davana create a rich, unusual sweetness that's never cloying.. Then the metamorphosis occurs: the heat rises, the steam materializes. Ambery woods and cashmere envelop a pulsating heart of ambergris, generating a soft vibration, a molecular "buzz" that lingers on the skin.. Warm Air is an idea that becomes material: sensual, tactile, seductive in its deliberately synthetic nature. A perfume that doesn't describe hot air—it makes you feel it.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 7.5 ml
listings.description: Powder Love è una fragranza che profuma di sogno ad occhi aperti: un velo morbido e avvolgente che unisce dolcezza, nostalgia ed eleganza. Come una melodia soffusa, si posa sulla pelle con un accordo delicatamente cipriato e irresistibilmente romantico.. Le sue note gourmand di zucchero filato, marshmallow e confetto richiamano i ricordi più teneri dell’infanzia, mentre i fiori d’arancio e il muschio cipriato aggiungono una sfumatura raffinata, pulita e sognante. Il risultato è un profumo dolce, fiabesco, perfetto per chi ama fragranze vellutate che avvolgono il corpo come una carezza.. Powder Love trasforma ogni giornata in una parentesi di pura fantasia, lasciando una scia golosa e irresistibile.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Parfums Privés Can't Get Enough Eau de Parfum 90 ml
listings.description: A floral-gourmand creation born to ignite obsession and desire. At the heart beats a accord of caramel and vanilla: direct, sugary, carnal, with that gluttony that reaches you without asking permission. The overdose of hedione amplifies the tension, illuminating the fragrance and enveloping each note in an impossible embrace.. CAN'T GET ENOUGH is a ritual of pure indulgence: Once you start, you can't stop — you'll crave more.

Its heart vibrates around the primordial power of Oud, the legendary wood of the gods , which releases a calm yet magnetic energy, capable of instilling confidence, centering, and vision. Every space is imbued with a mystical aura, a woody shadow that envelops and guides, like an ancient call to one's destiny.. Key NotesNatural Oud Wood, Agarwood Oil, Lavender, Saffron, Patchouli, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Tonka in the Sun Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Maison Tahité Tonka in the Sun is a golden ray that rests on the skin: a warm, velvety, luminous journey, where sensuality meets light.. The opening is a radiant sparkle. Soft peach and velvety hazelnut intertwine with the brilliant freshness of bitter orange and yellow mandarin, like the moment when the sun touches the horizon and everything is tinged with gold.. In the heart, an opulent bouquet comes to life, pulsating with desire. Egyptian jasmine and Indian tuberose reveal an intense femininity, while osmanthus brings its fruity and carnal note. Ylang-ylang adds an exotic and enveloping touch, and tonka bean leaves its soft and sensual signature.. The base opens in a creamy and persistent embrace. Australian sandalwood and vanilla blend with amber woods, nagarmotha and milky nuances, creating a warm, bewitching, almost hypnotic trail.. Tonka in the Sun is the essence of a sunny and seductive personality: an olfactory signature that illuminates, caresses and conquers.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Tonka Rouge Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tonka Rouge is a fragrance that thrives on mystery, seduction and character. Designed for those who want to express their essence with a perfume that speaks of fiery elegance and hidden passions, it opens with a liqueur cherry that seduces at first breath, rich, provocative, irresistible.. At the heart, tonka bean unleashes its hypnotic softness, intertwining with the delicious freshness of raspberry. Licorice enters with a spicy and intriguing touch, creating a bold contrast that makes the fragrance lively, pulsating, almost cinematic.. The base is a warm and enveloping crescendo: vanilla blends with sandalwood in a creamy embrace, while a hint of brandy brings depth, luxury and a gourmand nuance with a dangerous allure.. Tonka Rouge is a trail that captures, seduces and is unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Tahité Tonka_Sel Noir Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: An elegance crossed by shadows, where sensuality touches salt and light merges with night. Tonka Sel_Noir is born from this tension: a subtle balance between sweetness and darkness, between skin and sea, between desire and mystery.. The opening vibrates with character. Black pepper unleashes its pungent energy, enveloped in the sharp freshness of citrus. Almond intervenes like an unexpected gesture, softening the edges with a creamy roundness that softens and seduces.. At the heart, ylang-ylang sinks into black salt, creating a magnetic, almost hypnotic contrast. The earthy nuances of patchouli evoke skin warmed by the sun and damp from the sea: a sensual, concrete, close image.. The base spreads out in a creamy and luminous trail. Velvety and soft white sandalwood meets tonka bean with its accents of sweet tobacco and amber resins, sealing the fragrance with a deep, elegant and irresistibly sensual signature.. Tonka Sel_Noir is a dialogue of opposites: salty and sweet, rough and caressing, light and dark. A presence that does not go unnoticed, like a sea breeze at sunset that whispers more than it reveals.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer L'Air du Désert Marocain Noir Elixir Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Noir is the feeling of crossing the desert after sunset: the sun has disappeared, but the earth still retains the warm pulse of day. All around is darkness, the horizon fades, and only silence remains. A dense silence, charged with mystery, where peace and intensity coexist effortlessly.. In this new interpretation, the olfactory structure deepens and becomes more magnetic. Resinous and amber notes are pushed to the forefront: cistus dominates, while amber dries and expands, suggesting the immensity of the nocturnal landscape. At 30% concentration, the effect is that of an elixir with a long, almost endless trail.. To balance such depth, Tauer inserts a clear and luminous contrast: bergamot, lemon, and petitgrain bring a sharp, citrusy vibration, like the cold light of stars in a black sky. A brilliant flash that lightens the composition, giving it breath, tension, and a subtle yet decisive freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Rose Absolue Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Rose Absolue builds on the sumptuous legacy of Tauerville’s Rose Flash and takes it to a new level of depth and intensity.It is the manifesto of Andy Tauer's love for the rose: a powerful, persistent, deeply expressive declaration.. The composition opens with a brilliant sparkle of fruity berries, vibrant citrus, and light spices. From the first moment, rose dominates the scene with an opulent and vibrant presence, expanding into a velvety heart built around a magnificent rose absolute.. As the minutes pass, the fragrance slips into a warm and enveloping base of amber, woods and resins, which add body, depth and an elegant sensuality.It's a recognizable, familiar rose, but made fuller, denser, bolder. An unmistakably Tauer olfactory signature.. The high concentration of natural ingredients, including precious Bulgarian rose absolute, gives the juice a rich, intense color: it is therefore advisable to avoid applying it on light-colored fabrics.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer Vanilla Absolue Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Andy Tauer Vanilla Absolue is born from the soul of Tauerville's Vanilla Flash, which here transforms into a deeper, more luxurious and intensely material interpretation of vanilla. It is the natural continuation of Andy Tauer's research towards warm, resinous and persistent themes, fragrances that reveal themselves slowly, layer after layer, on the skin.. The opening reveals a delicate glow of spices and a fruity nuance that settles on a pink-toned geranium, introducing a rich and structured heart. Here, dark vanilla intertwines with notes of rose and warm, velvety tobacco, creating a full, almost tactile accord.. listings.rawTitle: Cave Wood Mirage Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Chiudo gli occhi e respiro. Davanti a me si apre una foresta che non appartiene a nessuna terra conosciuta: un luogo sospeso tra luce e ombra, dove il reale si piega al sogno. II primo soffio mi investe come un bagliore accecante: bergamotto e limone scintillano nell’aria, attraversati dal fremito dello zenzero, vivo e pulsante. E come se il vento stesso mi invitasse a seguirlo, a perdermi oltre il confine del visibile.. Avanzo, e il silenzio si accende di presenze invisibili. II calore speziato del pepe danza intorno a me, una rosa segreta mi sfiora con la sua morbidezza, mentre incenso e cipriolo velano il cammino di fumi rituali. II respiro del legno bianco mi sostiene, radicato e puro, come un sentiero inciso nella memoria della natura.. Poi il miraggio si rivela. II cuoio sussurra di forza e di destino, mentre ambra e muschi mi avvolgono come una seconda pelle, invisibile e sensuale.. In quell’istante capisco: non sto semplicemente camminando nella foresta.. lo sono la foresta, il miraggio, l’enigma che resta sospeso nell’aria.. Io Sono Wood Mirage.

It's an olfactory snapshot of pure carefreeness: the blue sky overhead, the soft white clouds drifting by, the warm air smelling of freedom. A reassuring and luminous scent that caresses the skin like a summer that is in no hurry to end.

It's a fragrance that speaks of slow nights, of silences charged with meaning, of rugged and timeless elegance. listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Rakugan Eau de Parfum 50 ml

L’apertura è morbida e avvolgente, dominata dalla dolcezza naturale dello zucchero di canna grezzo, mai eccessiva, mai stucchevole. A bilanciarla arriva una freschezza limpida e ariosa, che pulisce il palato olfattivo e dona alla composizione una grazia misurata, quasi meditativa.. Sul fondo emerge una sfumatura balsamica delicatamente mielata, calda e setosa, che avvolge i sensi con discrezione e profondità. Rakugan è un profumo di sottrazione, non di eccesso: raffinato, intimo, pensato per chi riconosce la bellezza nei dettagli più sottili.

listings.rawTitle: J-Scent Wood Flake Eau de Parfum 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Lannosea Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Lannosea opens like a golden light cutting through the salty morning air, clean and enveloping. Preserved lemon, candied by the sun and touched by sea salt, illuminates the composition alongside bergamot and pink pepper, creating a luminous and flavorful explosion, refined yet unpredictable. It's a vibrant opening, where citrus sweetness meets a transparent, almost mineral freshness.. The heart changes pace. Roasted coffee emerges discreetly, bringing depth and introspection, while Litsea Cubeba spreads a sense of inner balance and clarity. Orange blossom and elderberry soften the composition with a velvety floral touch, elegant and confident, like a silent force that needs no assertion.. The trail builds on an intense and sophisticated woody base. Guaiac, oak, and ambery labdanum create a solid presence, warmed by Smokewood, an exclusive molecule that evokes freshly burned wood, elegant and mysterious. The result is a magnetic and sensual finish, a fragrance that expresses identity, character, and freedom. Lannosea is for those who choose to stand out without compromise.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Resplendent Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Resplendent is a luminous and mysterious veil, where incense and rose intertwine in a game of silent seduction. It evokes a stone palace perched in the mountains, a maze of perfumed rooms, where secrets flow through the air on tension-charged floral currents.. It's the fragrance of a Queen wrapped in dark red silk, observing the world from a balcony. She carries with her the shadows of past loves and an inner strength that refuses to be controlled. In her stillness, she shines: the skin exudes white flowers veiled in dew, tinged with the pungent vibration of ancient spices.. The opening is solemn and magnetic, led by expertly dosed frankincense, illuminated by saffron, and softened by the sensual creaminess of ylang-ylang. Resplendent envelops the skin in layered, sophisticated, and deeply seductive richness, like a drape of crimson silk.. This Queen, thoughtful yet undeniably powerful, moves protected by an aura of floral and spicy smoke, her invisible shield. In Resplendent, Boadicea the Victorious expresses the full force of a perfumery capable of defining characters, evoking worlds, and leaving an indelible impression.

listings.rawTitle: Boadicea The Victorious Decadence Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The word decadence evokes unbridled hedonism, something ripe to the point of excess, opulent, and irresistibly epicurean. It's a concept that perfectly fits this sumptuous perfume from Boadicea the Victorious, crafted with intense and overt theatricality.. The opening is a juicy and sparkling explosion: apple and raspberry intertwine in an almost chewy and vibrant accord, enlivened by pink berries, saffron—the house's unmistakable signature—and a spicy touch of coriander. The fruit is rich, intoxicating, distilled like a fine liqueur: it recalls Calvados and Chambord, with black raspberry, blackberry, and blackcurrant lending depth and sensuality. It's a bright and tangy opening that continues to pulse on the skin throughout the fragrance's evolution.. A nocturnal and sophisticated heart emerges, where leather and oud blend with pink geranium and magnolia, creating an elegant and slightly provocative contrast. The composition then flows into a dark and magnetic base: a sweet and fruity Cambodian oud, wrapped in patchouli, oxidized suede, and honeyed amber that amplifies the sense of opulence.. Decadence is a powerful, uncompromising fragrance, defined by a spectacular balance of red fruits, apple, and the smokier, more sensual side of oud and saffron, so beloved by Boadicea. An intense, nocturnal fragrance, designed for those who aren't afraid of excess.

In this composition, Carlos Benaïm brings out all the olfactory richness of magnolia, building the perfume around an exceptional essence. Bergamot, lemon, and grapefruit enhance its sparkling and luminous character, while peach and apricot add a soft and welcoming sweetness.. At the base, oakmoss and patchouli create an elegant contrast, breaking the summer immediacy and opening to a deeper, more poetic vision: white magnolia petals reaching towards an infinite blue sky.. A delicate yet energizing fragrance, fresh without being ephemeral, capable of regenerating the senses with grace and naturalness.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle En Passant Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Paris, a bright May morning. At the corner of an alley, a light breeze carries with it the scent of blooming lilacs.. This "silent" flower, devoid of any natural essence, comes to life thanks to the talent of Olivia Giacobetti , who recreates it with surprising realism. En Passant is a tribute to its ephemeral bloom: petals delicately warmed by the sun, slightly dusty, punctuated by the bright green of the leaves and the crunchiness of the stems.. A hint of cucumber introduces an airy freshness, like a veil of crystalline dew settling on the skin. On the base, cedar and white musk discreetly support the composition, leaving room for an intimate and luminous finish.. The result is a transparent, poetic, profoundly spring-like fragrance: the skin vibrates, breathes, and sings a silent song of spring.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle French Lover Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: In stark contrast to contemporary archetypes of men's perfumery, Pierre Bourdon chooses a different path. An instinctive, natural virility that doesn't need to be declared.. French Lover doesn't dress the skin: it enhances it, with a refinement born exclusively from the extraordinary quality of the raw materials. It is the innate seduction of a man who doesn't have to prove anything, because everything is already there.. Angelica, lively and aromatic, is ignited by capsicum and galbanum, releasing green and spicy nuances that interact with the dry elegance of iris, cedar, and vetiver. The structure is clean, understated, and profoundly masculine.. In the base, patchouli and white musks release an almost animalistic sensuality, dark and vibrant, which brings the incense back to life and makes it surprisingly carnal.. A cultured, magnetic, quietly powerful perfume. The olfactory signature of those who conquer without raising their voice.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Lipstick Rose Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: An eternal gesture of seduction. That intimate, suspended moment when a diva, in the muffled silence of the dressing room, looks at herself in the mirror and slides lipstick onto her lips.. The composition opens with powdery shades of violet and iris, flowers long associated with the world of makeup, capable of evoking the magnetic aura of the eternal feminine. These elegant, sophisticated notes evoke skin, light, and mystery.. A smile takes shape thanks to a juicy and playful raspberry, which tempers the sparkling grapefruit, adding vivacity and charm. On the base, velvety strands of vanilla and white musk envelop the fragrance in a sensual and reassuring sweetness.. Everything is in its place. The lights go up, the curtain opens: showtime.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Something really hot is coming. This amber blend, signed by one of the great masters of the genre, Maurice Roucel , releases a direct eroticism, without filters or compromises.. The luminous opening of bergamot and mandarin illuminates a deliberately floral-free formula, as if to clear the scene and prepare the ground for a deeply sensual amber and musky base. Here, the creamy allure of vanilla, the enveloping texture of sandalwood, and the sensual temptation of musk intertwine.. It's an honest, self-confident, frontal seduction. An immense scent, burning on the skin like an uncontainable desire. No hesitation, just pure intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: It has the timeless charm of a great classic. The absolute protagonist is the iris, proud and elegant, whose precious rhizome releases impalpable and powdery nuances of rare refinement.. The opening is enlivened by the exotic call of spices—cloves and capsicum—intertwined with the velvety sweetness of peach and plum, adding roundness and sensuality. Beneath this spicy vibration, the fragrance slowly unfolds in an endless trail of vanilla and white musk, caressed by light, velvety honeyed touches.. The result is an enveloping, elegant, deeply intimate perfume. A paradise that is nowhere else, but right on your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Monsieur. Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Woody, exotic, sensual, full of mystery. Patchouli has always been one of the most beloved ingredients by perfumers, and Bruno Jovanovic dedicates a radical, uncompromising composition to it.. The structure revolves around an exceptional dose of patchouli, obtained through molecular distillation, a cutting-edge technique that selects only its noblest and purest facets. At the top, mandarin introduces a bright and vibrant contrast, illuminating the dark heart of the fragrance. Patchouli then explodes in all its richness, enveloped by the deep and delicious notes of rum and vanilla absolute.. Cedar and incense infuse a mystical, vertical tension, while the musks in the base round out the composition, providing comfort and a perfectly calibrated epidermal sensuality.. Raw yet sophisticated. Civilized, with a wild soul.. This is Monsieur. Nothing more needs to be added.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Vetiver Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: A quintessential masculine ingredient, vetiver unleashes a unique allure in this fragrance, thanks to an extraordinary Haitian essence at the heart of the composition.. Breaking away from the stereotypes of the genre, Dominique Ropion imbues this precious root with an irresistible lightness, the kind of lightness that doesn't take itself too seriously. Bergamot, bitter orange, and pink pepper bring out its brightest and most playful side, while sandalwood, oakmoss, and musks amplify its seductive power and elegantly anchor it to the skin.. Refined and sophisticated, but also original and ironic, this vetiver is a mirror of the man who wears it.. In a word: extraordinary.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Of all flowers, this is undoubtedly the most fatal. Tuberose, the absolute protagonist of this iconic creation by Dominique Ropion , is brought here to an extreme concentration, capable of fully revealing its most seductive secret: duality.. The first impact on the skin is surprisingly innocent. A luminous, botanical freshness reminiscent of a freshly picked bouquet. But that's just the beginning. Soon after, its more animalic and magnetic side emerges: camphorated accents and deep, dark spices underscore its untamed character.. Balancing this strength are milky notes and the soft comfort of white musks, which envelop the tuberose without taming it, making it even more irresistible.. Respectable and provocative at the same time, Carnal Flower is a flower with a thousand facets, which merges with the person who wears it… and leaves no one indifferent.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Iris Poudre Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: A tribute to the great aldehyde florals of the twentieth century, Iris Poudre reinterprets their classic elegance with a contemporary look, made of refined contrasts and measured sensuality.. The supreme flower of seduction and a true treasure in the perfumer's palette, iris intertwines its powdery nuances with the creamy vanilla of tonka bean and the silky comfort of white musks. Enveloped in a veil of aldehydes, the heart of the fragrance radiates a clean and sparkling, almost ethereal luminosity.. Floral accents with a cosmetic character — rose and violet — add references to the eternal feminine, completing a composition of great finesse.. The result is a perfume that gracefully oscillates between sophisticated seduction and infinite softness, elegant, intimate, timeless.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Portrait of a Lady Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: With Portrait of a Lady, Frédéric Malle and perfumer Dominique Ropion mark a new milestone in the great history of perfumery.. The protagonist is an immeasurable rose, opulent and profound, amplified by woody tones, amber, and incense. Through this masterful balance, the fragrance redefines the boundaries of chypre, an olfactory family symbolic of the most refined eras of the twentieth century.. A masterful interplay of light and shadow, strength and delicacy, extreme elegance and absolute control. Everything speaks of high craftsmanship, vision, and creative courage.. From this mastery is born a perfume of monumental splendor, conceived not to follow time, but to pass through it and endure.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Promise Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: An emblem of Middle Eastern culture, oud is a rare and precious natural treasure. A true "black gold," with a deep and multifaceted profile, it exerts an irresistible charm on Dominique Ropion .. With Promise, the master perfumer recreates all its nobility through cypriol, a plant native to India, combined with the exquisite essences of Turkish and Bulgarian roses. The result is an intense and solemn composition, where strength and refinement coexist in perfect balance.. This fragrance is an olfactory celebration of the most powerful bonds, of those promises that unite two people beyond words. Its magnetism is immediate, unmistakable: a perfume that anyone who truly knows the subject would be able to recognize among a thousand, without hesitation.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Rose Tonnerre Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: In the heart of a mist-shrouded garden, in the silence of the night, a rose releases its most intense fragrance. The air is charged with electricity, almost stormy, and awakens the darkest nuances of nature.. Rose Tonnerre was born from a personal project by Édouard Fléchier : a new base, a sort of olfactory sketch, presented to Frédéric Malle, capable of evoking the deep, earthy aroma of Périgord truffle. A dark, woody, and animalic accord, initially conceived for men's fragrances.. Hence the seemingly paradoxical intuition: to combine this primordial material with the quintessential feminine note, the rose. In the hands of the master perfumer, the queen of flowers transforms, darkens, becomes sensual, carnal, magnetic.. The result is a hypnotic, intense fragrance that is impossible to ignore. Simply: bewitching.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Acne Studios par Frederic Malle Eau de Parfum 10 ml
listings.description: Acne Studios is not just a style. It is a multiplicity of languages, an attitude that is difficult to pigeonhole: functional but eclectic, cultured but instinctive, anything but basic.. Frédéric Malle attempted to encapsulate Acne Studios in a bottle. For this special collaboration, he called upon the young and brilliant Suzy Le Helley , entrusting her with the creation of a true olfactory manifesto.. The composition unfolds through a powerful dose of aldehydes, intertwined with rose, violet, and a delicate touch of orange blossom. Enveloping accords of vanilla and peach provide comfort, while generous notes of sandalwood build a warm and sophisticated structure. A hint of incense adds depth, all immersed in a sea of musks.. The result is a fragrance that moves effortlessly from utilitarian comfort to eccentric elegance. An olfactory interpretation faithful to the spirit of Acne Studios: free, contemporary, impossible to reduce to a single definition.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Acne Studios par Frederic Malle Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Acne Studios is not just a style. It is a multiplicity of languages, an attitude that is difficult to pigeonhole: functional but eclectic, cultured but instinctive, anything but basic.. Frédéric Malle attempted to encapsulate Acne Studios in a bottle. For this special collaboration, he called upon the young and brilliant Suzy Le Helley , entrusting her with the creation of a true olfactory manifesto.. The composition unfolds through a powerful dose of aldehydes, intertwined with rose, violet, and a delicate touch of orange blossom. Enveloping accords of vanilla and peach provide comfort, while generous notes of sandalwood build a warm and sophisticated structure. A hint of incense adds depth, all immersed in a sea of musks.. The result is a fragrance that moves effortlessly from utilitarian comfort to eccentric elegance. An olfactory interpretation faithful to the spirit of Acne Studios: free, contemporary, impossible to reduce to a single definition.

listings.rawTitle: Nobile 1942 Il Capriccio del Maestro Extrait de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The perfume enters Giacomo's most intimate dimension, painting an authentic portrait of him, full of contrasts and anxieties. A complex man, impossible to pigeonhole.. He loved irregular and noisy company, but he sought solitude with equal intensity. Lazy and brilliant, shy and brazen, playful and instinctive, he lived suspended between the primitive call of the mists of his lake—the forays through the sedge, the wild nature broken by gunfire and curses—and the burning desire to escape to Milan, where he imagined fame, success, money, and women.. Women and cigars were constant presences, symbols of a life lived without reserve. Sensitive and cynical, extroverted and tormented, he alternated sudden bursts of joy with moments of profound melancholy and gloom. Creative and visionary, but irregular in his work, capable of loving and suffering with absolute passion, without restraints or rules. Charming and contradictory, seducer and liar, braggart and unfaithful.. This was Giacomo Puccini: a restless, intense, deeply human soul.

listings.rawTitle: Tauer No 01 Maroc Pour Elle Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: With Le Maroc pour Elle Eau de Parfum, Andy Tauer brings to life an intimate and sensual vision, where authenticity and oriental charm blend in a deeply natural feminine fragrance. It's an olfactory dream come true, inspired by the most authentic and vibrant Morocco.. At the heart of the composition, Moroccan rose reveals its softest and most refined side, intertwining with the hypnotic call of jasmine. It all rests on a warm and enveloping base of woods and balsams, a direct evocation of the Moroccan mountains and their resinous scents.. The opening is bright and airy: red mandarin brings energy and juiciness, while lavender adds an elegant aromatic touch, setting the stage for a slow and seductive evolution. The base, dominated by cedar and oriental resins, closes the fragrance with a sophisticated and persistent depth.. Le Maroc pour Elle is more than just a perfume: it's a tale of starry nights, dance movements, and souks brimming with spices and flowers. A timeless elegance, intense yet never overpowering, that lingers on the skin like a precious memory.
