Fresh, elegant, and enveloping, Aqua Majestae is a unisex cologne perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and natural floral scent for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Ambre Kashmir Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A warm breeze sweeps across the East, carrying deep, enveloping accords that resonate in the Kashmir Valley.. The fragrance opens with bright citrus notes, enhanced by a spicy touch of cinnamon, releasing a lively, juicy and nuanced freshness. At its heart, mystical and enigmatic incense blends with Turkish rose and pink pepper, creating a refined and perfectly balanced contrast. In the base, warm, full-bodied and resinous notes elegantly envelop the amber signature, giving the composition sensuality, intensity and depth.. Perfumer: Jérôme Di Marino

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Aura Tonka Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the heart of the Amazon rainforest, Brazilian teak trees guard small fragrant treasures: the luminous tonka beans.. Their vanilla and tobacco nuances blend with the powdery delicacy of almond, enveloping the composition with a subtle and refined bitter note. The tonka bean gives the fragrance a soft, gourmand, and balsamic character, lightened by the lively acidity of citrus in the opening. The solar and luminous floral heart finally gives way to a seductive base of vanilla and woods.. Perfumer: Jérôme Di Marino

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Rose Sheherazade Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: The Turkish rose of the Orient enchants the senses: to the notes of an ancient lute, it seduces, embraces, and mesmerizes. Its slow and sinuous movements accompany the melody in a tale of a thousand and one roses, under the warm sky of a summer night.. The fragrance opens with a radiant citrus accord, luminous and vibrant. At its heart, the sensual opulence of Turkish rose explodes, enriched with fruity nuances that evoke love and passion. Its intense and velvety scent releases a gourmand freshness, irresistible and refined. In the base, delicate vanilla nuances rest on warm and enveloping woody and musky notes.. Perfumer: Maïa Lernout

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Bois Selenga Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the mountainous regions of Mongolia, the Selenga River spreads its Siberian freshness, carrying woody and spicy accords northeastward.. The fragrance opens with a fresh and sparkling trio: the spicy facets of pink pepper meet the green vibrancy of cardamom, while bergamot adds brightness and an elegant floral note. In the heart, the powdery refinement of iris blends with the richness of rose, contrasting with the pungent and citrusy accents of ginger. In the base, the spicy and mysterious warmth of olibanum combines with the elegance of cedar, while vanilla planifolia reveals an enveloping and irresistible sensuality.. Perfumer: Nathalie Lorson

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Almond Wood Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In the orchards of Eastern Europe, cherry trees and their generous blossoms enchant with their tenacity, suspended between the warmth of the sun and the cool, dry winds.. This fragrance is an explosion of vibrant and joyful colors. The opening reveals the delicacy of white almond, followed by cherry, raspberry, and cherry blossoms. In the heart, Indian jasmine sambac and Turkish rose enrich the composition with soft and sensual petals. The precious and woody base intertwines Indonesian patchouli, Haitian vetiver, and sandalwood, giving depth and a memorable trail. The sweet and almondy nuances of tonka bean and heliotrope complete the perfume with a gourmand and vanilla finish.. Perfumer: Karine Dubreuil-Sereni

listings.rawTitle: Premiere Note Taïga Wood Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: As night falls, the boreal Taiga forest lights up with a majestic spectacle: luminous and colorful veils appear in the dark sky, like auroras suspended in the silence.. The delicately floral heart combines lily of the valley and magnolia, while black pepper and coriander seeds add a subtle and elegant spicy touch. The base envelops the composition with velvety woody notes of oakmoss, white cedar, and cashmere wood. White amber and praline soften the sillage, giving the fragrance a luminous and refined elegance.. Perfumer: Karine Dubreuil-Sereni

Elegant and intense, Ilhabela is a niche perfume perfect for those seeking a warm, tropical, and charming fragrance, capable of transporting the senses on an exclusive olfactory journey.

listings.rawTitle: Le Couvent Maison de Parfum Tonka Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Tonka is a warm and enveloping fragrance that celebrates all the sensuality of tonka bean in a soft, elegant and deeply emotional composition. listings.rawTitle: L'Atelier 100BON Ambre & Tonka Eau de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Une parabole de sensualité exaltée par le jeu des contrastes entre l’Ambre, qui confère une profondeur sensuelle, et la Fève Tonka, à la douceur envoûtante. " Ambre est une fragrance extraordinaire comme aucune autre. Lorsqu’on en découvre l’essence magique, on tombe irrémédiablement amoureux de son harmonie voluptueuse. Pleine de mystère, à la fois intrigante et délicate, sophistiquée et persistante, elle se dévoile sur la peau et laisse un sillage enchanteur ! Imaginée et réalisée il y a plus de 100 ans, archétype de la parfumerie française, elle demeure l’essence du désir et traverse les époques sans effort. Pour cette version Season 1, j’ai d’abord gardé tout mon sérieux et amené les ingrédients classiques à leur point d’équilibre. Puis, très lentement, avec de petites nuances, je me suis laissé emporter vers l’enfance et le péché de l’insouciance... " Parfumeurs : Jean-Claude & Céline Ellena.

An ideal fragrance for those who love sophisticated and unconventional spicy floral perfumes, capable of telling a story on the skin.. The nose: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.description: A fragrance dedicated to Grandiflorum jasmine, one of the most precious and beloved flowers in high perfumery. Different from the greener and colder common jasmine, Grandiflorum reveals a warmer, creamier, and more sensual soul, capable of evolving on the skin with elegance and depth. The perfume tells the story of a flower hand-picked with extreme care between July and September, when jasmine reaches its maximum olfactory expression. A rare and precious raw material, because only a few grams of essence are obtained from thousands of fresh flowers.. The composition opens with green, bright, and delicate nuances, almost like jasmine freshly bloomed at dawn. Over time, the fragrance becomes softer and more floral, recalling the sweetness of orange blossom, finally revealing a warm, enveloping, and slightly animalic base.. A sophisticated and sensual jasmine perfume, perfect for those who love intense, elegant, and characterful floral fragrances.. The nose: Jean-Claude Ellena

listings.rawTitle: Laboratorio Olfattivo Rose me Twice Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A refined fragrance dedicated to the rose, the most studied and interpreted flower in the history of perfumery. With its infinite olfactory nuances, the rose is never a simple note: it can be fresh, velvety, powdery, fruity, luminous, or surprisingly tea-like.. This composition explores the most elegant and sophisticated side of the rose: that linked to its tea and violet facets. A nod to the historic "La France" rose, the first tea hybrid created in 1867 by Jean-Baptiste Guillot, which profoundly influenced the olfactory imagination of perfumers.. The heart of the fragrance revolves around the delicacy of the tea rose, made even more captivating by the presence of ionone, a precious molecule capable of evoking both the soft scent of violet and the aromatic elegance of tea.. The result is an elegant, luminous, and sophisticated floral perfume, ideal for those who love rose fragrances but desire a more modern, refined, and less obvious interpretation.. listings.rawTitle: Jeroboam Eliksiro Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Since ancient times, humankind has sought to transform herbs, bark, powders, and oils into something magical: a love elixir capable of captivating, seducing, and transmitting positive energy.. The lively and juicy opening combines mandarin and pink pepper, lending freshness and brilliance to an opulent, sensual, and memorable composition.

listings.rawTitle: Mes Bisous Out of Reach Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: Out of Reach souls embody the desire for escape: they chase nothing, yet remain impossible to ignore. They move freely, without maps or drama, unreachable not because they hide, but because they belong to a universe all their own.. Fresh, magnetic, and subtly addictive, they leave on the skin the citrus glow of the sun, the salt of the sea on the lips, and a soft sweetness that lingers in the air even after they've passed.. Out of Reach doesn't promise eternity, but a moment suspended in gold: a luminous, free aura, kissed with blue.

listings.rawTitle: AVAU Golden Coast Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Bright and sunny, Golden Coast is a fragrance that invites you to live in the moment with full awareness.. It opens with the vibrant freshness of grapefruit, made even brighter by the spicy spark of Timut pepper. In the heart, rose brings softness and sensuality, while cinnamon adds an intimate and comforting warmth.. The base becomes more enveloping and profound, with earthy vetiver, tobacco nuances, and the creaminess of sandalwood. A warm, present, and reassuring fragrance, conceived as a personal promise: to stay connected to oneself.

listings.rawTitle: AVAU Silent Drift Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Silent Drift is a calm and enveloping fragrance, designed as a pause to rediscover one's inner rhythm.. It opens with the luminous freshness of bergamot, the aromatic breath of cypress, and the vibrancy of pink pepper. In the heart, iris lends powdery elegance, rose adds emotional warmth, and apricot softens the composition with a velvety nuance.. The base is intimate and reassuring, with ambrette seeds, white musk, and sandalwood. A soft and silent fragrance that invites you to slow down, breathe, and reconnect with yourself.

The opening is sparkling and juicy, with mandarin, pear, marigold, and pink pepper. In the heart, peony and Damask rose create an airy, elegant, and feminine bouquet, where delicacy and character meet.. The base adds softness and structure thanks to white musk, patchouli, and cedarwood. A lively, free, and sunny fragrance, perfect for those who love modern and dynamic flowers.

In the heart, violet adds a softer, silkier nuance, while cashmeran provides warmth and structure.. The base is deep and persistent, with vetiver, leather, and cistus absolute. An earthy, elegant, and confident trail, designed for those who love fragrances with a clear and contemporary character.

The tropical notes deepen and become more vibrant, delivering a sensation of pure summer on the skin. In the base, the composition softens with amber woods and musky vanilla, which add warmth, sweetness, and longevity. An accent of plantain completes the fragrance with an even sunnier and more exotic touch.. Perfect for those looking for a tropical, fruity, and gourmand perfume, capable of conveying energy, good humor, and a luminous trail. A colorful and happy fragrance, to wear like a smile on your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Superz Budapest Soho Extrait de Parfum 1.5 ml
listings.description: The vibrant energy of a modern metropolis, which is soft and sophisticated, yet spicy, mystical, and balanced.Soho is a captivating and pulsating fragrance that embodies the vibrant energy of a modern metropolis. At the heart of the scent are tonka bean, vanilla, and coconut, which together create a seductive harmony. The tonka bean caresses the senses with its warm and sweet spiciness, while the sweet notes of vanilla and coconut add a refined and soft touch to the fragrance. Nutmeg, agarwood, and musk contribute to the character of the scent, further enhancing Soho's uniqueness. The spicy notes of nutmeg bring liveliness, while agarwood creates a mystical and woody dimension. Sandalwood adds an earthy, woody base that reflects the balance between urban life and nature. Soho is not just a fragrance; it’s an adventure where urban life meets nature, creating an unforgettable experience.The Canarium resin found in Soho, medically known as "elemi" (Canarium luzonicum), is a fresh, citrus-scented ingredient produced by the plant beneath its bark. Freshly, it resembles thick, crystalline honey, but it later solidifies. It belongs to the family of balsam trees, making it a relative of Juniperus thurifera (from which frankincense is made) and the Somali balsam tree (Commiphora myrrha), from which myrrh is produced.
